string.text: I'm in bad shape. Can't you see? I need a medkit, or at least a bandage.
Here, take this medkit.
Thanks, brother. I won't forget this.
Here, take this bandage.
Sorry, I don't have anything.
How do you get around the Zone like that? Some nasty thing gets you, and you won't even be able to patch yourself up.
Heh, how'd you let that happen? Sorry, I'm keeping mine. Otherwise I'll have nothing left myself.
Your choice, but don't think it does you any credit.
I've only got enough for two. Here, take it.
Let's get to the point. About Ivar. He seems to be doing better since your visit.
Then he should be on the mend now. The worst is over.
Unless he's crazy, like that scientist said? And made the whole thing up himself.
What? Oh... No! Of course not. That's not what I meant.

Then where did he get the plans? \nListen! Could those papers be in that "den"? Or at least some of them? You said they kept all the group's special equipment there. That would mean the documentation, too.

Quite possibly. There must be something there. You know the code, don't you? It's based on the date of the first accident at the Chernobyl NPP. Try looking there. Just don't get lost in those catacombs.
That's a hike to the Red Forest... Yeah.
You could try going through here. I've got an artifact, one of the "ruby" ones. I think it should let you get rid of that anomaly.
A ruby artifact? They're so rare... You sure you can spare it?
What else can we do? No sense sending you on such a huge detour when the entrance to the Cave is right here, within arm's reach. You can pay me back sometime.
Or could he actually be one of Ivar's patients?
Thanks. You said there are "Tarzankas" there. How am I supposed to spot them in that darkness?

I think Ghost or Strelok marked the route with chemical beacons. There are patches of "Witch's Jelly" here and there. The "Tarzankas" are marked by two patches close together, no more than a couple of meters apart. That's where you'll find them.
I'll give it a try, if those anomalous patches haven't faded yet. So, the code's based on the first accident. The first accident was the one in April '86? Then the code would be... Ah, got it.
If you do find anything there, though, you'll need some sort of specialist to make sense of it. I can't help you with that.
There's a brainy fellow at the Bar. Maybe he can figure it out. If I find anything, I should see him first, before I go poking around anywhere. Who knows what does what in that lab?
I've been to the scientist's "den". Picked up some technical papers there. Wonder if there's anything useful in them?
There must be something. But you'll need some sort of specialist. I can't help you with that.
There's a brainy fellow at the Bar. Maybe he can figure it out. I should see him first, before I go poking around anywhere. Who knows what does what in that lab?
Don't get carried away... Even in our very brief meetings, Strelok struck me as a very sensible man.
I think that would be best.
I suppose I'll do that.
Good. I've still got more to ask him... But that can wait. Let's get down to business: he said he'd given you some of Strelok's notes.

Yes. Not so much notes as fragments of them. Some were probably lost, or Strelok didn't give him everything, just what he thought necessary. I don't know. Ivar could barely explain what they were or why he was giving them to me. Perhaps he was afraid they'd go missing, or someone would take them. You need to read them. Here they are.
Of course I'll read them. But briefly, is there anything about the Dark Valley and the laboratory there?

No. That was probably on the maps among those plans Ivar mentioned. I tried asking him, but he couldn't explain. As for these notes... They describe some strange things. But they do shed some light on why Ivar decided he'd been wrong to switch off the Brain Scorcher. If he took these scraps of information as the truth, then his determination makes sense...
Took them as the truth? What do you mean?

These fragments don't make everything clear. I get the impression they aren't Strelok's own notes, but excerpts from a newspaper, a scientific report, or a conversation he had with someone, which he thought Ivar ought to see... At first, I actually thought it was a fragment of a science fiction story. The things it describes are so... unusual, I suppose. But if you compare the various things we now know about the Zone, it could well be true... Still, how could Strelok have learned all this? Or is it simply his hypothesis, nothing more? And is he even one of the people in that conversation?

Exactly... So many questions. And where did he get all those plans? A scientist told me secret documents sit in the archives for almost fifty years. Nobody can even find out about them, let alone make copies. And yet...
Yes, it's all very unusual. Unless... I'm almost afraid to suggest it.
You're early. I'm waiting for a message. Once it comes, we'll talk.
All right, let's work something out. I'll just check my stash so I know what I've got to bargain with. I think you mentioned one capsule.
A Dummy for telling you roughly where to find the door code. Capsules for the approximate location of the pump connections. Or we can negotiate.
And where are the pumps themselves?
That's a separate matter. Artifacts won't cover that one. And we'll only get to it if we settle the first two.
Hmm... A computer in the lab at Radar. I have a rough idea where it might be. But you're asking a lot. For a Dummy, you could've given me the code itself.
Oh, nothing... Just a thought. I'm not sure. All right, I've handed over the Dummy. No point complaining now.
Three?! Why so expensive? I remember you asking for one to begin with.

Inflation, Marked One. We can't keep up. And I didn't say one. I said capsules. There are a few options: three capsules and, naturally, a container for three artifacts. Two Dummies, or some kind of Absolute.
Great. No time to waste. I just need to get them.
Doctor, has Ghost been here since we last saw each other?
No. You'd already met him, and as I understand it, he told you something rather absurd.

He certainly did... And it's been bothering me ever since. Didn't I tell you? He thinks I might have been... I don't even know how to put it. Recruited by the Monolith, maybe. Strelok's last entry says something along those lines. Could that have happened to me or not?
But you say you've come to understand everything, and there's no other consciousness inside you.

I've come to understand myself. And I'm definitely not Strelok. There's nothing of him in me. It was all a trick of Strelok's, and Ghost believed it. But the Monolith... What is it? The Monolith men, the ones who are still human, accept me. They don't turn me away. That Swan fellow kept talking about some sort of call, too. I sowed his seeds. And somehow I got where Strelok was trying to go, but couldn't, no matter how badly he wanted to. Maybe Strelok wanted me to go to the Monolith, but for some reason told Ghost something completely different? \nBut that's not the point. He wrote that you either had to survive the "Black Mark" or have your consciousness reshaped by the Monolith. Something like that. So which of those let me through? And why did it send me back? Why does it still draw me in? And why did Ghost think there was something of the Monolith in me? So many unanswered questions...

And you're unlikely to find the answers. I think the Monolith is an illusion. I believe Strelok said so, too. So there's no point wondering what might have happened if... Strelok was most likely mistaken himself.

Maybe so. I ought to see Ivar again and talk to him. Whether Strelok was wrong or not, I need to find out what he told Ivar about those flooded tunnels. Ghost might have something to say, too, if he's still at Yantar. That tunnel leads somewhere. North, I think...
Have you decided to head north again?
I haven't decided yet. But something draws me there. If only I knew why...
Someone told me about a "Monolith weapon." Said it was some thing you couldn't even pick up, so you needed a case of tools. I don't think you could hide something like that in a desk drawer.

Who could have told you that if nobody's ever held it? You listen to all sorts of tall tales... Though Dr. Perelman did mention some tools for picking something up and putting it in a sealed container. But I think he was talking about an artifact. Or perhaps it was the "Black Mark" he wanted to put in a container.
Well, well... Where does that little tunnel lead?
That's what I want to find out.
Right. So you're telling me you came all the way here and you're willing to pay a tidy sum out of sheer curiosity? Or are you suggesting Zub's gotten a little stupid?
I'm saying there's merchandise, a seller, and a buyer. Nothing else matters.
You're quick on the uptake... Well, let's add a little.
Add a little to what?
The price. Anyway, come back in about fifteen minutes. I need to rummage around and find what I need.
You're being cagey. And, uh, give me a rough price so I can get ready, too. What do you want? Tier-one artifacts?

Was that supposed to be funny? Go collect tin cans, comedian. Get some Dummies and capsules ready, and more than one of each. But that's just for starters. It's not those that matter most. It's what you can do for me, which is why I need to talk to someone. I have a feeling we'll make a deal.
Fifteen minutes it is, then.
All right, here's some sausage...
Let me open a can for you...
I've got some bread that isn't completely stale...
I'm short on grub myself.
Will you show me the way?
I don't know the way. Sanyok does. So does our lieutenant. Took the map the other day. Everyone's sick of his nagging.
Heard about the route to the Cordon?

The one the lads used when they slipped out to buy vodka from Sidorovich? Hard not to hear about it. That new lieutenant's been chewing my ear off. My idiots kept blabbing about how one of them found the path... Even scribbled a map. Then the lieutenant caught them talking and searched them, the clown... Those scribbles only mark the way to the local Farmstead, though. Nobody's saying anything about the Cordon...
Could you bring me the map?
Sherstyuk's got it all sorted! Ten bottles!
Have a conscience, soldier. For ten, I'll brave the anomalies myself...
All right, you'll get your ten bottles...
Five! Final offer!
Now we're talking! It's a deal!
I'll come to you if I need anything...
About that map you promised...
What map? My head's still foggy after yesterday...
You promised to bring me a map of the path to the Farmstead for ten bottles.
Ahh, right... I've got the map. To that Farmstead... The Forgotten one. And from there, the Cordon's a stone's throw away... Let's trade!
Here's your vodka...
Here, our lieutenant's report, with the map. Don't get lost...
About that map you promised...
What map? My head's still foggy after yesterday...
You promised to bring me a map of the safe route to the Farmstead for five bottles.
Ahh, right... I've got the map. To that Farmstead... The Forgotten one. And the Cordon's not far from there... Let's trade!
Here's your vodka...
Here, our lieutenant's report, with the map. Don't get lost...

If only I knew... We've got an unspoken agreement with the unit in the old research institute. They leave us alone, we leave them alone. Fox, Red, and I were coming back from a run, already working out how much Sidorovich would pay for our haul... Then a chopper appeared, and another... Troops landed, Red stepped into "Aspic," and I started drawing the soldiers off. Got carried away with that... Good thing some stalkers helped me out. I don't even know what happened to Fox and Red.
I met Fox at the Cordon. He says they had to leave Red in a tunnel. The Doctor made this medicine for him. I'm taking it there. Maybe I can still help...
Fox is at the Cordon, barely alive. Said he'd come here to Red once he recovered. Red's nearby, in a tunnel. I patched him up a little. He'll live...
Fox died at the Cordon. I haven't heard anything about Red...
Yeah... A shame about those guys...
Good to see you, Marked One...
Hang in there, man. I haven't got anything on me...
Why should I waste a medkit on every bit of scum I meet?
I'll never forget this, pal... I'll do anything you want...
Pal, I'll give you everything... Won't hold anything back! Everything I stashed away for myself. Just help me...

I... I swear on my fucking life... God knows, till the day I die! Brick always talks straight! I'm telling you... I had this little gadget. Thought it might have some games, but it wanted a password. Tried everything. Typed passwords, all sorts of crap. Nothing... I was about to throw it away, but Shersh says, let's take it to those eggheads in the Swamps. They'll pay good money. Enough booze for a week...
I've got some loot stashed in the Swamps... Artifacts, booze... I'll show you. May I never see freedom again if I'm lying... Call me a punk...
Listen, Brick, I'm not interested in booze. Where's the PDA?
All right, take it...
Piss off... You mangy bastard...

I'm telling you, Shersh took it and headed for the Swamps... Bastard left me here. When those beasts attacked, he took off. I'll kill the prick! Only just happened, less than an hour ago. He's probably trudging through the Swamps already...
Thanks. All right, look. Brick keeps his word. I've got a stash here, by the railcar in the Swamps. Put a few things away for a rainy day...
You made it to the Swamps in an hour? Bullshit!
Right... What did you do with the PDA you took from that Duty man in the Valley?
What's so hard about it? Straight south from here, skirt around the soldiers, climb over the barbed wire, and there's the Swamps...
Shersh took it! I fucking swear! Took it and ran off to the eggheads in the Swamps to trade it for booze...
Get your act together. Stop being a thug...
Come on, I wanted to thank you, and you...
With what, exactly?
I've been pinching a bit of loot for myself. Taking it out of the communal stash, you might say... I could share, if you're not too proud.
Let's see what you've been pinching, then...
I've got a stash in the Swamps. Hid a little box on the locomotive. There's a new suit and a great artifact in it... \nThanks again. I'm getting out of here. This place is damned unpleasant...
Good health to you, sir...
Sakharov's tuned a special helmet. Says it'll shield you from the radiation...
Well?
I'm just not sure...
If the Professor himself made it, what's there to doubt... Come on, where do I put it?
Listen... Can you wait a bit longer? I can't quite bring myself to do it.
Wait? What for? I'm not going to get any better here. At least this gives me some hope.
I understand... But hang on a little longer.
Oh, all right! Here it is. Put it on your head and go.
Wait, what happens after that? I put the helmet on, and suppose it even helps... Where do I go... What if it breaks, or something...

Listen, Fang, we've made our decision! Sakharov says he can help you. Who else are we going to trust? Put the helmet on and go up to the surface. A helicopter will arrive soon and take you straight to Sakharov. I'd come with you, but the military might not take two of us... So take the helmet and head up!
I don't follow. North through the labs? What labs?..
Listen, can I leave some loot here with you?
Go ahead. It's no use to me. Just, uh... Don't leave anything nasty. I'm bad enough as it is... You understand...
No, nothing nasty. So you'll keep an eye on it?

Heh... An ear, more like. But my hearing's sharp enough to shoot a spider... Put your things in that little box over there. And... Maybe a bottle of vodka? The Doctor doesn't bring any, and my insides feel like they're in a Burner... Well? One bottle? You'll have less to worry about with me looking after your stuff. Eh?
Yeah, I've got some... Here. It'll do you good.
Sorry, I haven't got any on me. I'll bring some when I do.
Oh... Much obliged... Don't worry about your things. Nobody'll come poking around here.
Ahh... It keeps tormenting me... Try to understand...
Vodka? Here, I've got some. It'll do you good...
No, none left. Used it all to get myself feeling better...
Ohhh... May your road be free of anomalies, my friend Marked One...
Ahh... Everything's burning...
Everything will be all right. Put the helmet on. Here's a Compass to get you through the teleport. You'll come out in that cave in the Misty Thicket. Wait for the Doctor there.

Of course I'll wait... Where would I go in the forest when I can't see? I know every way in and out of that little cave by touch. I'll wait there, then. All right. I hope we meet again. You remind me of someone... Take care...
Wait! Before you go. I wanted to ask what you know about the Monolith. And what does "it's an illusion" mean? The Doctor... Well, I mean, while I was out, I dreamed he said that.

I don't really know anything. There was a legend that it was some special artifact that granted wishes. We all wanted to reach the Monolith. Maybe it's an illusion because nobody ever managed to get there... I don't know. You can see what happened to me. I had other things to worry about. But Ghost and Strelok met some scientist who apparently had ideas of his own about the Monolith... \nOh, I just remembered something else. Shortly before I got hit, Strelok asked me to think about how to crack a system of combination locks. I didn't really look into it. There wasn't time, and he was always hurrying off somewhere. He asked me to find a decent computer. Said we'd figure it out together, work out how to make a decoder. He mentioned some labs with coded doors. I think he wanted to make a quick dash north through some labs. Maybe to that Monolith...
I don't follow. North through the labs? What labs?..

I didn't understand him either... Strelok and Ghost were always crazy. Turned up out of nowhere, then suddenly set off on another raid. One day Strelok came bursting in after a raid and said, "This is our chance!" He'd found something... Ghost kept swearing afterward about how they'd barely escaped the mercs that day. Kept asking me whether Strelok had given me anything, and if so, what... I told him he hadn't given me anything useful, just instructions... I never really understood which labs he meant...
And?
Not long, I think. I had a tuned helmet... Where did I put it... Hold on, must've dropped it.
Nothing, really. I went to the Valley as he asked, and got hit on the way back...
All right, just a moment...
Wait... So the Doctor wasn't here while I was out? I don't understand...

I don't understand you... You really thought the Doctor had just been here? No... He dropped by a couple of days ago. I told him I'd asked you to contact Sakharov so he could come up with some protection or something. That's when he left the artifact. And a note for you, in case you came back. Said that if you managed to get some protection made, it ought to protect me while going through the teleport... I forgot about the tripwire myself. Didn't think about how you'd get in. I'm used to the Doctor turning up quietly.
Fang, I remembered something.
Yeah? Well, congratulations...
Did he explain?

Not a chance. Just muttered that we had to get the body to the Doctor, urgently. But the Doctor wasn't there... He'd gone to the Garbage... No, the Cordon. And an emission was building. Any moment now. I don't know why he was so stubborn. The man was practically a corpse. You could see that. Barely alive, and he wouldn't have survived the emission anyway... Something like that.
So, did you get him to the Doctor?

We got him to the hut, but like I said, the Doctor wasn't there. I don't remember carrying him any farther. I followed Strelok to take shelter in the cave. Waited out the emission there. I think that's how it went... Then I headed to the Dark Valley on business, and by then there was nobody in the hut... That's right...
Was it Ghost who carried me to the Doctor, then?

You? No... I doubt it was you. I can't see you, but that man was almost a corpse, or like a zombie, all twisted up. I don't think Ghost carried him any farther. Probably buried him somewhere there, or just left him. Do you really think we were carrying you?
That's the feeling I have. I can't say for sure... But what did Strelok actually tell Ghost?

How would I know? Ghost only said that he needed that man alive, whether he was a stalker or a zombie or whatever. And that Strelok wanted it, too. Something like that. Didn't explain why. I didn't ask. I was thinking about the emission and where to take shelter. My own skin matters more than some half-dead stranger.
Ghost, then... Never would have guessed.
I remembered someone carrying somebody out of a dangerous place. And you were there.
Me? Who were we carrying?
I don't know. Maybe it was me... What can you tell me about it?
About what? Well... All sorts of things have happened in the Zone. I remember dragging a scientist through a swamp...

No. It wasn't in the Swamps. I have a feeling it was somewhere in the Misty Thicket. You told someone to leave the body, but the other man didn't want to. Don't you remember anything like that? Who was the other man?

In the Thicket? I found the entrance to a cave there. I remember that. Later Strelok set himself up in it, and I found all sorts of parts for him. The things he asked for... He was doing some strange experiments... Oh! Yes! Something happened after one of those experiments. Near the dead Monolith. That's what he called that big stone sticking out in the Thicket...
Try to remember what happened, not the stone.

That's what I'm doing. Something wasn't working with his experiment. I ran off for spare batteries... Yeah, I think that's right. When I came back, he was already saying something to Ghost, and there was some man's body nearby. Looked like a stalker... Anyway, he ran off to turn his device off, or adjust it, or something. Said in passing that Ghost would explain everything...
All right, I'll take it... Here's the vodka.
I haven't got any vodka on me. Don't give it to anyone else. I'll be back.
Well, tough guy, finally awake?
What the fu... Where am I now... What do you want?

Take it easy. I thought men like you had nerves of steel. How do you sleep at night? Doesn't your conscience bother you? Not that I really care how you sleep... As I understand it, you can get certain things done?
I don't know what you're talking about.

Talking? We haven't even started talking yet... Come back, and then we'll talk! From where, you ask? Let me explain...\nWe're at our base near the old Agroprom Research Institute. A while back, we received a directive from above: ensure the highest possible level of security in this area... Following me?
No! What the hell does that have to do with me?

Just listen! There's an entrance to the underground right here on the base, and all sorts of nasty things come crawling out of it from time to time! We've blocked it several times. Doesn't help. I sent a group of my contract soldiers down there. Only one came back. Shaking all over, mumbling something you can't make out... I don't want to risk any more of my men. Then you turned up... Getting the picture now?
You want to hide behind me? Make me do your dirty work? Earn yourself a medal?

Keep your mouth shut unless you've got something useful to say! You're a dead man already! Give us trouble, and we'll shoot you without a second thought... Here's the deal. Go underground. If you die, you're a lousy stalker. If you make it through the whole place and find out what's down there, come back. We'll talk man to man. Maybe we'll even let you have a little something out of our generosity...
Go in empty-handed? Where's all my stuff?

What did you expect? You think we're idiots? But we're not monsters... We've already lowered a few things into the catacombs. There's a backpack right at the beginning. Try climbing back up, and we'll shoot you, no questions asked... Our patrol will meet you at the far end of the tunnel and bring you back here. Got it? Move... Clock's running! You've got two minutes to get down there...
You're still here! Time's ticking...
I found the album you told me about.
So that's the album Seryoga put together? Sanya said Seryoga made it himself, pasted the photos in. He never came back after they cleared the sewer. That's what Sanya heard.
Leave it here. Maybe you and Sanya will see each other again.
I'll keep it for now. Maybe later.
Thanks... At least take this. Two boxes of armor-piercing ammo, sixty rounds. That's all I've got.
Of course. If you change your mind, you know where to find me.

Sanya and I are from the same place, the same Cossack village. He kept talking about going to Kharkiv. Wanted to save a little money to get started. All I was thinking about then was getting out alive myself.
Will you leave the album with me? Maybe Sanya and I will meet again. I don't want Seryoga to be forgotten completely.
People who know these things told me your men used to go to Yantar?

Sanyok was supposed to send that case to regimental headquarters. But when we deserted, Sanya took that hunk of metal for some reason. I said, why are you lugging that thing around? He says, let those bastards run around looking for their papers. What did I care? We'd have been better off taking more canned food. Didn't have a key anyway. Maybe the map's in there. I don't know.

Huh? Yantar? Where the scientists' base is? Yeah. They went to call home. Say they were alive and well, that sort of thing. Asked the stalkers about the route. One even drew a map. Told them to stay away from certain places. Then the new company commander arrived, searched everything and took whatever he found. Put it all with the other documents. Filled a whole case. Would it have killed him to leave it alone? Bastard... Men like him are why Sanyok and I had to desert. I never went myself. Too scared. So I can't tell you the way.\nExcept...
Except what?
And what did you do with the case?
I threw it away. Why keep that crap? Tossed it off the stairs into the swamp. To the right when you go outside, if you want it. There's radiation there, though... I wouldn't risk going in.
To the right? All right, I'll look...
Hi... I'm here as agreed. Got the Vintorez on you?
Hmm... Did you promise me something? Five thousand dollars, I think?
You're a funny guy! A grand and a crate of vodka...
Ahh, right! Sherstyuk keeps his word! Let's trade!
Uh... Don't take this the wrong way, but... How do I put it... Someone stole your gun. Don't get upset, though. Between us, it was a shit gun. Only good for scaring crows...
Here's the check. And the vodka...
Well, damn...
Yes, that's right. Here's your old blunderbuss. Why you'd want it when there's a Kalashnikov...
Hi... I'm here as agreed. Got the Vintorez on you?
Hmm... Did you promise me something? Five thousand dollars, I think?
You're a funny guy! Two grand...
Here, a couple of checks for two thousand dollars.
Yes, that's right. Here's your old blunderbuss. Why you'd want it when there's a Kalashnikov...
Someone told me about an unusual gun.
What gun? And what's in it for me?
A man I respect says your captain's keeping a unique rifle, a Vintorez, that he confiscated from a stalker. What's unique is that it doesn't wear out after a hundred shots. Heard of it?

I've heard a few things. That new boss has collected all sorts of stuff. No idea what he wants with all that junk. So you're interested in that gun? I could get it. But it's a delicate business, you understand. Vodka won't cover this one... I need hard currency. Understand? Two thousand dollars!
Two grand? No way. Too much...
Deal. You'll get two grand in bearer checks.
A grand! And a crate of vodka! Final offer!
Now we're talking! It's a deal!
I'll think it over. Maybe I can manage on my own...
Hmm. Why's that?
How do I put it? Keeps his cards close to his chest. Always trying to find things out. I don't like people like that.
And where can I find him?
I don't think anyone knows. Ghost is a ghost, all right. Turns up, spoils your mood, and leaves. God knows when or where he'll turn up again.
A shame. I don't remember anything about myself. Strelok and Ghost seem to have known me. Or I knew them.
Yeah... Having no memory can't be much fun. Though maybe it's for the best? I don't know. Not for me to judge.
Oh! I was just thinking about you. People are telling stories about Marked One. Say you're a real slippery character...\nI mean, you've been everywhere ordinary stalkers won't go...
Yeah, I've had to do some running around.

The guys and I talked it over and decided it was time to leave. Good thing you came by. I remembered a bit of unfinished business that might concern you, too. Thought I'd tell Marked One and let him decide what to do with it.
Yeah? What is it?

The guys and I were once holed up with the Hermit at Tesla, waiting out an emission. We got talking about all the wonders of the Zone. Among other things, someone said that nothing that's ever happened disappears. It's recorded in some kind of field. And the people who pass themselves off as clairvoyants can actually just tap into that field.
Could you get to the point?

Huh? Oh, right. Anyway, this Hermit said he knew a smart stalker who had what we call clairvoyance. That stalker said there are places in the Zone where an ordinary person can enter this information field and learn almost anything. There you have it.
Right. Who's this Hermit? And what do you want?

Never heard of the Hermit? Ilyukha Mozgun. Made himself a little den near the bunker at Tesla. He's a bit... Hell, not just a bit. He's completely nuts, but he knows things you and I can't even imagine. If you're there, tell him Fox is planning to leave, but hasn't forgotten his promise. I left what I promised in the same place as the gravitsapa. All right?
Gravitsapa? Sounds like gibberish... All right, if I happen to see him, I'll tell him.
Then it's settled.
How are you, friend? Any progress? Or not? Well, your call.
Lisaped, did you misspeak?! Where am I supposed to get a ruby artifact? To hell with repairs like that. Give me the gun back.
Take it. Could've turned out a fine piece of work.
What do you need? I hope I don't have to rob an army warehouse.
Running around, searching... Just give me back the rifle.
Your call. Take it.
I'll let you get on with it.
Your call. Take it.
I'll let you get on with it.
Right... I've checked on the artifact through my contacts.
Understood. I'll wait, then.
Oh, Marked One, here's your artifact. Enjoy it. I hope we can keep doing good business together.
Thanks. Same to you.
Hello! What can I get you? Hmm... Marked One? Is that right? I'm Artyom. They call me the Cook...
Yeah, you know me? Looks like you've set up a whole bar here! A little diner a meter from piles of radioactive garbage...

I've heard of you... As for the place, there's nowhere else here. Maybe you're so tough you can run around the Zone for days on end. But guess what? Not everyone can! Especially rookies. For some, getting as far as the Garbage is a feat in itself! Have you forgotten how you started?..
Hmm... I was thinking of heading that way. Why?
Nope... I'm going the other way...

Raven, the one who leads that little stalker group with a camp on the old farm, asked me to find something. I talked to my guys, and we decided to help his team. Will you take him this package? He'll thank you for it, no doubt... But you need to be quick. Get there right away, or it'll be too late.
What's in the package?
Some useful herbs. If you know how to use them, of course. So, will you? You've got to make it in a couple of hours, or they'll spoil... Raven promised some antirads in return...

Fair enough. My memory's not what it used to be. But why gather here? The Bar isn't far. Better food, and you can stock up on weapons. What have you got here? Thieves and bandits hanging around, and soldiers could show up, too.

The Bar, the Bar... So what? Have you forgotten? You can't get into that damn place unless you've been in the news at least ten times... Serious people there. They won't bother with small fry. Here, these guys are their own masters. Some buy supplies, some sell artifacts... You get it. A kiddie pool for people who are still children in the Zone. Bandits? Don't worry. Gray gave them a proper beating last time, and I hear you helped. They won't be back for a long time. And the military... We'll think of something. There aren't many of us yet, but later we might be able to give them a proper fight.
Well, it's your choice. Listen, what's with this sudden generosity? Helping rookies?

It's my nature. How I was raised. Before, out in the big world, I worked as a cook. Used to feed cats and dogs the leftovers from lunch. They'd wander the streets hungry, all mangy... Broke my heart! But in the Zone, feed a dog all you like, it'll still hit you with a psi attack! And I don't much feel like feeding the cats either. So I've decided to feed these kids instead... I've got a few connections beyond the perimeter. They bring in food and gear. And I don't neglect myself either. I'm not running at a loss. Digested all that? My heart and soul are at peace, and my wallet's happy, too.
All right, you've convinced me... Maybe we'll trade if I need something...
That's all? You could've shot them yourself. Look how many of those monsters are running around.

If only it were that simple. This is the Zone. Who the hell knows what happens to those things. Maybe they've mutated, maybe their parts are fragile to begin with, and they tear them up in bushes and anomalies. Anyway, not every beast has a decent "spare part" you can actually use. That's why they're valuable.
So that's how it is. I'll bear that in mind.

Same problem with other beasts, by the way. Different parts for each. Tushkano heads are valuable, for example, but getting one is a hell of a job! You shoot it in the body, and the head bursts! Some sort of pressure inside, maybe. Once I needed just one with its head intact. Almost shot every tushkano at the Cordon before I got one.
Take it before it starts to stink...
I could take a walk. They say there are artifacts there, and the scenery's nice... All right, I won't forget. I'll look for your friend while I'm at it.
Here. Take the tails and give them to them for passage.
That's more like it.
Show me. If it's his, I might recognize it.
That really is his shotgun! Let me have it!
Just give it to you? Petrukha, I'm not Father Frost.
I could give you a watch or a belt for one artifact.
Give me the watch... I'll find another shotgun like this.
The belt's better. I'll find another shotgun like this.
Sorry, I'd rather keep it.
There we go. Take it... Here, a little extra present. Spare a thought for my friend.
All right.
I was there. Looked for your friend, too. Nobody's saying anything about him. Saw some bodies, but I don't know if one was his...
Petrukha, I'm not a bloodhound. I'm not tracking him down, and that's final.
Well, damn... All right, I'll have a look around.
Found a strange little note on one of them. Here. Some abbreviations, БО, КК, НЗ... Can't make sense of it. Here...

Nothing strange about it. It all makes sense to me now... Ah, Marked One, it's not good news, but thanks anyway. Here's a little something for your trouble. What I've got. Who gave the job and what's written there doesn't matter anymore. Not your problem... My friend used to brag about his BM. Did he have it on him?

Yes! There was some stuff in the backpack. Might've been his, can't say for sure. If it was, he probably wanted to go somewhere traveling light, but picked the wrong time to put his weapons down. There's a tushkano nest nearby, zombies wander around, and boars come through, too. Anything could've happened. Maybe some canned food poisoned him. I found a shotgun there, too. A proper hunting gun.
It's all nonsense. You wouldn't waste an artifact on an experiment, would you? That's stupid. You could trade it to Sidorovich for medkits and ammo. What would you get out of this?
Take it. So what did you promise me? "I'll give you more than Sidorovich would," and all that.
Oh, all right. Give me what you've got...
That's all? Well... thanks.
It's no trouble. I'm curious about this method, too...
Yes, here's fifteen bottles... It's the real stuff, don't worry...
Do you need medkits all the time?
Yeah, tell me about it... Those blind dogs have mutated even more lately. The tiniest wound is enough to kill you. So you have to disinfect it right away and cut out a whole chunk of infected flesh.
All right, I'll collect them... Yeah, the Zone... Gets scarier every day.
Sorry, Fox, I've got to keep moving...
Fox, I brought you what I promised...
Oh! Just in time. I might recover a little now.
Here. Get well...
Where did I put them? Did I drop them or something...
Thanks for the help... Write down this recipe...\nI've got a good artifact here. Take it, it'll come in handy...
What sort of rifle? Where can I find it?

There aren't any weapons depots around here, and decent ammo's almost impossible to find. But there's plenty of ammo for the PM pistol... Some clever fellow converted an MP5 submachine gun to use it. One of those would make it easier to fend off the beasts. I know the stalker who had it died in the railway tunnel that used to lead to Agroprom, before it collapsed. I won't leave you empty-handed. I'll share something interesting about a certain place. Heard about it by chance at the Bar.
That's quite a bit of information... Tell me what's going on at the Bar instead. What else did you find out?

It used to be an industrial area. Now it's mostly ruins. Duty's set up its base there. There's also the 100 Rads Bar. Stalkers from all over the Zone gather there. The local trader runs the place and works as the bartender. Go there to trade, talk, or find an interesting job. You'll hear the latest news, too. \nThere's a man who repairs gear as well. The whole area is under Duty's protection, so behave yourself. Don't wave your weapon around for nothing. Start shooting, and the patrol will put a stop to it fast.
Got it...
Well, will you do it? The rifle...
If I were you, I wouldn't wait for that gun. Go find even an ordinary PM. Everyone and his dog has one, and it takes the same ammo.
I'll try to find a PM, but there's some special gun in that tunnel. I'd love to have it!
In the tunnel, you say? I'll look on my way...
We'll see how it goes. No promises...
Yurik, still wasting good air?
Still wasting a little air. How's it going with the rifle?
Found it, tried it out. Nice little gun. Who converted it? And how did you hear about it in the first place?

At the Bar... Someone said the bandits have a man who can do that sort of work. Their boss, what's his name... Borman, Bury, Bo... Bu... It's on the tip of my tongue. Didn't remember it. Anyway, that craftsman works for him. He's the one who converted the gun.
Bo, bu... You forgot the bit that mattered. Here, take it.
Hold on, I'll use it a little longer.

Yeah, with this little beauty, I'm king of the Garbage... Thanks won't put food on your plate. I'll send a location to your PDA. Have a look there. \nListen, Marked One, could I ask you for something else?
Why so down? How about a hundred and fifty grams each to cheer us up?

No, I don't want any.
Uh...
I heard you've been to Agroprom?
A stalker said there's a rumor some specialist stashed an unusual suit somewhere in the institute's eastern block. Supposedly tough as steel. 
Hard to believe.
I'd like to find one. You can't get far in a jacket. One little dog bite, and it's falling apart. Sidorovich won't give me credit because of that incident. How am I supposed to collect artifacts without proper protection?
What do you think? Is the rumor true? About that sturdy suit?
Sounds like bullshit to me. People talk...
If I find it, I'd rather keep it...
Remember that sturdy suit?
Yeah... Why?
I brought that suit. Here.
I was thinking of going to Agroprom. Maybe I'll find it.
Marked One, you're something else! I didn't think you'd do it. I've heard about a recipe. Use it, and thanks!\nHere, take this, too. I think it'll come in handy!
What do you need done?

When I was drawing those soldiers off, I tried hiding underground. There was a good spot near the exit on the institute side. The soldiers left it alone... Then, of course, they decided to raid the sewer basements. I got out as fast as I could, but dropped my PDA in the rush. You're going there anyway. Maybe you could pick it up? If the soldiers haven't helped themselves to it... Be careful, though. They haven't come back out yet.
If I find it, I'll bring it...
No, Mole, I'm going my own way...
I found your PDA...
Is it damaged?
Doesn't look damaged. Unless the bloodsuckers scratched it a little, heh-heh... Here, check it...
Yeah, it's smashed to pieces!
Intact. Batteries aren't even flat. Here's the artifact I promised...
Why's that?

My health's been giving me trouble. Maybe the climate here doesn't agree with me, maybe something else... Sometimes the pain shoots through my back so badly I can't straighten up. The guys laugh, but it's no joke to me. An old stalker came through recently. They call him Guide. Met him? He's the one who suggested it.
All right, I'll get it...
It's all lies... Besides, I don't have time...
How's your back?
Getting around, barely. Might as well be riding in a cart. What have you got?
Here they are, the beauties...
I haven't collected them yet. Be patient.

Thanks. You're still young. You don't understand what it's like guarding this passage with a bad back... Here, I wrote down a recipe. Don't lose it... I'll try mixing up that tincture meanwhile...\nCare for a hundred grams?... All right, I can see you're in a hurry. Take it with you. A little present...
All right, take care. Get well!
Didn't that tincture help?

Hell if I know... Maybe I need to drink some more... Bullet came by recently. Says an ointment helps a lot. It's made from bloodsucker tentacles. Could you do it? Get me three? I'll make it worth your while. If you're willing, try asking the hunters. They'll definitely have some...
Tentacles? I'll try...
Sorry, Commander, but I don't fancy running around the whole Zone for your back...
How are you? Looking ready for action...
You're my only hope. You and that miracle ointment.
Take the tentacles, but I think you'll only make it worse...
Sorry, I haven't got it yet...
How much worse can it get? Maybe it'll help... Give me your PDA. I'll send you the recipe and something else:
Well, get better...
Well, what was that job? Can I make some money?
Don't worry, I'll make it worth your while... Someone gave me another recipe. You're interested, right? How to turn a "Wrenched" into a "Gravi," for example...
So if I ask, he'll just tell me where everything is and who his friends are?

At least try to find out who Fang knew. His contacts... If you don't get the weapon, but learn something worthwhile, that's good. If you do get it, even better. I heard you're looking for Strelok. Fang was closely connected to him. There's a lead for your search. Gives you an incentive, and gives me some confidence you won't abandon this or forget the job.
Hmm... I think your job's worth more than one recipe. Something more substantial.

You haven't even started, and you're bargaining already. We'll see. If all you give me is information, that's all I'll give you. If it's more than words, I'll give you something tangible along with the recipe. Understand? Nobody's forcing you. Just don't forget this while you're running around the Zone looking for Strelok. Keep in mind that Petrenko asked you to find something out.
All right. I'll keep it in mind.
All right, let's talk it over.
Heard of Fang? Used to be a jack of all trades.

All right, down to business. There's information that someone got hold of an unusual weapon. Its prototype, rather. An experimental one-off, supposedly made by Fang himself. Don't know how he got it. Fang might've given it to him, or he stole it, or found it after it was lost. I've been given a lead on where it was hidden or abandoned. Could be bullshit, but... Will you check? In the Dark Valley, to the left of the factory gates, there's a trailer with a metal structure nearby. Worth looking for a backpack somewhere there.
An unusual weapon, then? I'll try to find it.
Yes, give it a try. The lead might not be accurate. It's secondhand.
Understood.
Sorry, another time...
Maybe. But why "was"?

But he's dead. Quite a while, I think. Someone said so... \nAnyway, down to business. There's information that Fang made a unique, unusual weapon. Clearly a commission, using special blueprints, a sample, specifications, or something... We ought to try to find it. Its prototype, rather, the experimental model. If there's one of them, surely more could be made from it.
How am I supposed to find it? Where? Ask Fang, or what are you suggesting? Search the whole Zone inch by inch... How did you even hear about it if Fang's dead, as you say?

Fang used to look for various parts at the Bar. Asked Docent and the Barkeep. Showed them sketches and plans of exactly what he needed. He used to come here a lot. On his last visit, he told our man Prapor he'd finally made the weapon. Said it hit like a hammer, but wasn't finished. Just a prototype. Hadn't given it to the client yet. Hid it away.
Does Prapor know Fang well? Maybe Fang told him where he hid it?

No, he didn't. You can have plenty of "good acquaintances" and supposed "friends" in the Zone. For a while. Until it's time to divide the loot. So nobody's eager to tell everything they know, even to their closest acquaintances. Prapor's somewhere here at the Bar. Ask him if you want.
Greetings! I've got the gun we talked about!
So you found it... Any trouble?
No trouble, really. Apart from someone putting the backpack in a very nasty place.
The trouble is that I couldn't find it!

Well, Duty pays its debts. Here's a detector. Where I got it doesn't matter... What matters is that it detects almost every kind of anomaly. Take it! And that's not all. Give me your contact code. I'll send you an artifact transformation method...
Could you spare some ammo?

Of course I'll share! Take some from that box. Well, then. Let's put the word out. Plenty of people are sick of those bastards. If we get enough men together, we'll try to stamp out that nest of vipers.
Word is you've got some "herb"?

Herb? Well, now... Who told you? Ah, everyone knows already. There's a place where those "wonder roots" grow. Only it's like this. Someone found his way there and found out about them, rather than bringing any back. And now he wants a share for what he knows. Understand?
Of course I understand. I wasn't born yesterday. I know how these things work. How much, and what?
I'm too old to be chasing a profit. Just want an artifact to get the wife's teeth fixed. Got a good one? Or a couple of ordinary ones, and we'll both be happy.
I've got two ordinary ones. Here...
All right, we'll both be happy. Here's a tier-two artifact.
I've got a very good artifact. You could fix every old woman's teeth in the village!
I don't have any artifacts on me. Let me think...

Good, then! Now listen:\nThere's a nasty place the stalkers call the Red Forest. That's where the herb grows. A little fellow of the woods prepares it. Goes by Forester. Does it scientifically. I think you can make a deal with him. I did. Now I quietly smoke a little roll-up now and then... Well? Reckon you can find your own way?
Forester in the Red Forest? That's a long way...
Word is you've got some "herb"?

What "herb"? Son, what's wrong with you? I don't keep livestock...\nOh! Wait! You mean "that herb"? People, honestly. Give two people a smoke, and the whole Zone hears about it!\nWell... If I look, I might have enough for a couple of joints. Interested? Almost giving it away...
No, it's not for me. And not a couple of joints. Can you arrange a large batch? I'll pay, if I have to.

Oh, so that's it... "A large batch," you say? Decided to become a drug dealer? Well, everyone has their own path. Some become pimps, some car mechanics... All right. Your business.\nI don't have a large batch. But I can tell you who has what you need. Not for nothing, of course! Two ordinary artifacts, or one better one.
All right, here's two artifacts...
I've got a tier-two one. Take it...
I don't have any artifacts on me. Let me think...

Then it's a deal! Now listen:\nThere's a place the stalkers call the Gut. Somewhere there, this herb grows. One of the locals prepares it. As far as I know, everyone calls him Chinaman. The samples of his "dope" that reach us are quite impressive! So if you want a batch, head straight to the Gut. Think you can find your own way?
Chinaman? In the Gut? That's a long way...
Word is you've got some "herb"?
What? Herb? Are you out of your mind? Oh! Sorry. Didn't understand at first. You mean joints? I don't have any now. Had a couple to try, but gave them to a fellow.
Yeah. That "herb." Where can I get a big supply?

Grows in the Swamps. Needs processing, though. How, exactly, I haven't got a clue. The man I got those samples from knows.\nWho is it? Let's be straight with each other. I need pseudodog tails. Get me five, and I'll tell you who to ask. If those are hard to get, five flesh eyes will do, too... Deal? Or if you're desperate... A tier-three artifact will be enough.
Good thing I came prepared. Here's five tails...
I've got some flesh eyes saved up. Take them.
I've got a tier-three artifact. It's yours.
I haven't got that shit on me. Let me think...

Excellent! Now I can... Uh... Never mind. Anyway, listen:\nThere's a railway in the Swamps. A half-ruined little station. Boryan gathers his straw around there. Talk to him. Prepares his herb scientifically. I think you can make a deal. He did say not to spread the word, but you're not a blabbermouth, are you? Well? Think you can find your own way?
A railway halt in the Swamps? Boryan? That's a long way...
About that "herb." Can we make a deal?
I've forgotten something. Haven't we talked this all over? A good artifact to get the wife's teeth fixed. Or a couple of ordinary ones, and we'll both be happy.
I've got two ordinary ones. Here...
All right, we'll both be happy. Here's a tier-two artifact.
I've got a very good artifact. You could fix every old woman's teeth in the village!
I don't have any artifacts on me. Let me think...

Good, then! Now listen:\nThere's a nasty place the stalkers call the Red Forest. That's where the herb grows. A little fellow of the woods prepares it. Goes by Forester. Does it scientifically. I think you can make a deal with him. I did. Now I quietly smoke a little roll-up now and then... Well? Reckon you can find your own way?
Forester in the Red Forest? That's a long way...
About that "herb." Can we make a deal?
Hit your head again? We've already talked this over. Two ordinary artifacts, or one nice one, and we both walk away happy...
All right, here's two artifacts...
I've got a tier-two one. Take it...
I don't have any artifacts on me. Let me think...

Then it's a deal! Now listen:\nThere's a place the stalkers call the Gut. Somewhere there, this herb grows. One of the locals prepares it. As far as I know, everyone calls him Chinaman. The samples of his "dope" that reach us are quite impressive! So if you want a batch, head straight to the Gut. Think you can find your own way?
Chinaman? In the Gut? That's a long way...
About that "herb." Can we make a deal?
We had a deal, didn't we? Five pseudodog tails or five eyes, and we'll shake on it...\nThough if you're really desperate, give me an artifact no lower than tier three. I suppose I'll agree.
I got five pseudodog tails. Take them.
Let's shake on it. Here are the eyes you asked for.
Yeah, I'm desperate. Here's the artifact.
All right. We'll shake on it later, then...

Excellent! Now I can... Uh... Never mind. Anyway, listen:\nThere's a railway in the Swamps. A half-ruined little station. Boryan gathers his straw around there. Talk to him. Prepares his herb scientifically. I think you can make a deal. He did say not to spread the word, but you're not a blabbermouth, are you? Well? Think you can find your own way?
A railway halt in the Swamps? Boryan? That's a long way...
Stepanych, the old geezer, said you've got some "herb"?
Stepanych, that damned blabbermouth. Can't keep anything to himself. What's your interest? Decided to treat yourself?
Uh... No. Not for me. There's a group of stalkers who want to buy some of that "hay."

Ah... So that's it. Well, I know where that wonder herb grows. I take it you need more than one puff? Let's make a deal. You help me, I help you. Been short on ammo for my shotgun lately. Three hundred shells from you, a bag of "herb" from me.
I've got three hundred shot shells here.
Here, take two hundred slugs.
Would a hundred buckshot shells do?
Hmm... All right. I'll collect them.
Thanks. I wasn't even expecting it. The bag of "herb" is in my storeroom over there. Take it if you need it. Drop by if you need anything.
All right, we'll see.
I hear you've got some special "poison weed"?
They sa-a-ay, you say... What's your interest? And who's saying it?
I want to do someone a favor. As I understand it, it's some kind of drug. Supposedly this "herb" makes you stronger and so on. There's a group of stalkers who want to buy some of that "hay."

Ah... So that's it. Well, I've got a secret patch. I take it you need more than a single dose? Let's make a deal. You help me, I help you. A bag of "herb" from me, a SPAS from you. Just what the doctor ordered for hunting.
Oh! I've got a SPAS on me. Here.
I've got this SPAS. Will it do?
Thanks, but no... I'd like one in perfect condition...
You'll get one in perfect condition. Just wait.
Hmm... All right. I'll try to get it.

Thanks. I wasn't even expecting it. But I haven't got the "herb" on me. I was crossing the bridge on my way from the hunters and ran into burers. Hid in a pipe under the bridge. Dropped everything that slowed me down. If you're as good as people say, you should be able to get it. Eh? Take care... Drop by if you need anything.
All right, we'll see.
I hear you've got some special "poison weed"?
Yeah. I already told you... Or do you mean something else?
Uh... I don't know. As I understand it, it's some kind of drug. Supposedly it makes you stronger and so on. There's a group of stalkers who want to buy some of that "hay."

Ah... So that's it. Yes, that kind of plant does turn up. I take it you need more than a single dose? Let's make a deal. You help me, I help you. For my experiments, I need some substance from the anomaly stalkers call "Witch's Jelly." I hear the quartermaster of the scientific expedition based here in the Swamps has special containers for it. So, two jars of "Witch's Jelly" from you, and a little bag of "herb" from me...
Oh! I've got just the thing on me.
Hmm... All right. I'll try to get it.
Thanks. I wasn't even expecting it. The bag of "herb" is under the boat in the yard. Take it if you need it. Drop by if you need anything.
All right, we'll see.
About that "poison weed"...
Well? Brought the shotgun ammo? Three hundred shells... Or just here to talk about life?
I've got three hundred shot shells here.
Here, take two hundred slugs.
Would a hundred buckshot shells do?
No, I didn't bring it. Just forgot what you asked for.
Thanks. I wasn't even expecting it. The bag of "herb" is in my storeroom over there. Take it if you need it. Drop by if you need anything.
All right, we'll see.
About that "poison weed"...
Well? Brought the SPAS? Or just here to talk about life?
Yeah, I brought it. Here.
No, I didn't bring it. Just forgot what you asked for.

Thanks. I wasn't even expecting it. But I haven't got the "herb" on me. I was crossing the bridge on my way from the hunters and ran into burers. Hid in a pipe under the bridge. Dropped everything that slowed me down. If you're as good as people say, you should be able to get it. Eh? Take care... Drop by if you need anything.
All right, we'll see.
About that "poison weed"...
Well? Brought the "Witch's Jelly"? Or just here to talk about life?
Yeah, I brought them. Here are your cans.
No, I didn't bring it. Just forgot what you asked for.
Thanks. I wasn't even expecting it. The bag of "herb" is under the boat in the yard. Take it if you need it. Drop by if you need anything.
All right, we'll see.
Why are you still here? Weren't you taking a squad to the Valley?

We're short on ammo. The bandits took my PDA. I'd been sent the coordinates of an ammunition stash. The data's encrypted, so I doubt those bastards will know what it is. I managed to activate the marker. If you get the chance, try picking up the signal and finding it... Then we'll have a chance to wipe out that nest of vipers. You'll get something out of it, too. I'll share an artifact transformation recipe: how to turn a "Fireball" into a "Soul"...
Interesting recipe... I'll try it...
I've got to find the laboratory...
Hi. I had a hard time finding your PDA.
Excellent. Now we can get a squad together... Is the information intact?
See for yourself... Here, take it...
Well, your computer's wrecked. Crushed.

Right... Looks fine! Here are the coordinates... I think you've got a right to know, too.\nThe mercenaries abandoned some ammunition crates in the Misty Thicket. They might've wanted a staging depot, or had an order from someone. Nobody knows for sure. Strange things happen there, though. Their nerves gave out, and they left in a hurry. According to our information, it's here, not far from the old quarry. Use it if you're there. If there's anything left, of course...\nAnyway, my gratitude knows no bounds! Don't hold it against me if it isn't much!
Hi. How's it going? Everything all right?
For now, yes... Listen... Could you bring me a suit? I need it... Not desperately. But I do.
What, you're planning to go somewhere?! You'll be sitting here a good while yet, until you recover...

I'm already... better. Can't sit here forever. Work to do... My friend... from our group... I think he's dead. Last contacted us from Radar... somewhere in the northern part of the forest... Find him, if it's not too much trouble... He had a suit... Got it from Sakharov... New... experimental... I need one like that. For the work...
Radar?! Nasty place... All right, maybe I'll bring it. Looks like nothing's going to keep you here anyway...
Try... I'll thank you... Left something... here, at the Bar... before...
Hi, Ivar. Found the suit... And your friend. What's left of him, rather.
Yes... A shame... We can start getting ready now... Soon.
All right, take it... I wouldn't rush to leave the Bar, though.
Thanks... You helped me out. Take this... A good artifact.
I'll get going. You get some rest.
Well, our job isn't running around underground. Need to use our heads more...\nMarked One, did you see a decoder in that laboratory?
Hard, huh! I've already been underground... And you...
Do I have to take measurements and hunt for artifacts again for this? To hell with that...

No more measurements needed. There's no radiation there now... Almost none. A level that's safe for your health. The Professor says the modulation's changed. In this phase, it'll take at least several days before the radiation becomes deadly again. And what do artifacts have to do with it? You got out somehow. There must be other exits...
Why didn't you say right away that the modulation could be harmless? Maybe I didn't need to take measurements?

You were the one flipping switches. Something changed! Without the measurements, you wouldn't have gotten inside... What difference does it make now? I'm telling you, it's safe there for the moment. How long it'll stay that way isn't clear. Well?
Did I drop it or something...
Saw messages on the network saying you had a job for a stalker.
Well... I do. Need to test a theory. Got a new recipe, but haven't tried it yet. Need to get:\n
Those artifacts are everywhere. I'll bring one right now...
Sorry, another time...
About the artifact. Here, I've got one.
Found it, then... In a hurry, like you've got the runs... Just a little joke. Wasn't expecting it. Didn't think anyone would trade an artifact for a trivial jumble of words.
I need it. Give me the recipe. Here, take this.
Hmm... You're right. I'll keep it.

All right, bad news, Marked One. I couldn't make anything,\nbut there's another recipe, a proven one. Write it down, or remember it: you can get a rare artifact from an ordinary "Pellicle" by throwing it into a "Snowball." The resulting "Ruby Pellicle" lets you remove a "Springboard" anomaly from your path.\nSince you're so reliable, maybe we could do another little job? Come back in a while. We'll talk.
Do you have something that needs doing?

Yes, yes... As I understand it, you managed to visit a laboratory conducting rather interesting research into subspace transportation?
Uh...
Its designation is X-18.
Could you try looking there for documents relevant to our field? Judging by the scraps of information stalkers bring us, a great many documents were never removed. We could reward anyone who finds them quite generously. But we need all the documents from that laboratory. Then we could offer the maximum reward...
Hmm. I'll try, but no promises...
Sorry, I can't take this on...
About the documents from Lab X-18.
Yes, yes... Have you managed to find anything?
I did... Take them. This is what I found.
I'll come back later. I haven't looked everywhere yet.
Right, let's see... Take a little present for these documents.
So what's in the documents, Professor?

Right... Guard roster... Accounting records... Work orders...\nWell. Nothing interesting yet. A shame. We'd hoped for more... The reward might have been more substantial, too. Perhaps you could search more thoroughly?
All right, Professor. I'll look some more. No promises...
No, Professor. I haven't got any more time for this.
A shame, a great shame. Well... We'll have to ask someone else.

Right... Guard roster... Accounting records... Work orders... \nNow, what's this? Reports on experiments... Interesting, very interesting. A description of the practical steps needed to produce the observed effects! Well! We weren't expecting that. Honestly, we weren't! You've certainly earned a large reward! Unfortunately, our limited funds don't allow us to thank you properly. But we do have a good artifact you might find useful.
All right, I'll do my bit for our science...
I haven't been to Sidorovich yet.
Heard you need a courier?

Yes, I need something delivered to Yantar.\nSakharov has several exoskeletons. I've arranged to trade a rare artifact for a couple of them. The artifact's in a heavy protective container. Will you do it?
It's not too far. I'll make the trip...
Find someone else...
I'm back from Sakharov at Yantar...
Well, our courier's back... How are the exoskeletons?
Brought them. Here they both are...
Well... You have Duty's gratitude. You'll be put forward for a commendation... Accept our special Duty suit and some supplies.
Brought both of them...
They look a bit worn... Oh, all right... You have Duty's gratitude. You'll be put forward for a commendation... Take our Duty suit, with breathing protection, and some ammo...
Didn't get them here.
Good evening, Professor. I'm here as agreed with Petrenko...
Ah, an unusual artifact?
Petrenko says there's never been one like it...

Yes, judging by the description, it defies all sense! I promised him new exoskeletons for his men. Unfortunately, one was slightly damaged in transit. Perhaps you could repair it? We have nobody to do that. I think Petrenko will appreciate your efforts... Their power systems haven't been activated. Petrenko knows what to connect and how.
Good health to you... How are you?
You know, the ointment helped... Just need to keep it warm now, and everything will be fine.
I'll bring it. Don't worry...
How's your lower back? Looking ready for action...
Aches a little when the weather changes. Needs some warmth...
Here are your mutant bits. Let's see this artifact...
Marked One, you did me a favor. Thanks... Hard to come by.
Take it, take it... I can spare it for a good man...
And what do you need this time?
You see... Well... I need a burer paw, or something from another legendary mutant...
That's asking a lot. Rookie... All right, I'll bring it if I get the chance. No promises...
Enough, Yurik! I get it. You'll keep asking me to do things, and saying you're a rookie and can't do them yourself. But I'm not a wish-granting goldfish!
Well, Yurchik... Need more mutant bits?
Yes! Of course! Have you got any?
Here's a nice little paw, great hunter...
Here's a bloodsucker jaw. Take it...
Here's a chimera claw. Something to brag about...
A controller's hand. That's a serious beast.
Uh... Nope!
Now I can strut around camp and tell stories... About you, of course.\nI haven't got anything, as usual... All I can offer is an artifact I found here.
Maybe we can work something out after all? I need to speak to your boss...

Work something out?! You think we're cops?!
Though...
There's one option...
Last time we helped those spineless scientists in the Dark Valley, I saw an unusual artifact through my binoculars. We were fighting off pseudodogs by the bridge over the swamp... Beyond the swamp, there are some big boulders. Something was lying near them. Then a controller turned up, and we had to get out fast...
That damned green thing's been haunting my dreams ever since.
Could you bring it? I'll let you through and give you a decent artifact...
I suppose it's worth a try...
And you say you're not cops... I'll talk to the Barkeep instead...
Hi, Sergeant. Why are your eyes so red?
I haven't been sleeping well... That mystery's bothering me...
Here's your "mystery." Sleep easy...
Have two hundred grams, then you'll sleep all right.

I'll be grateful till the day I die. Green bastard...
And I thought our resident drunk was lying about the Zone producing something so unusual...
Here's a present for you, too. Think it'll come in handy.
You can go through... Friend...
What do you need done?

Heard you agreed to help our "old man," Prapor. Do the rest of us a favor, too:\nThere's a way to improve your body's resistance to radiation and anomalies. Drink a whole bottle of vodka infused with a boar hoof in one go. That's the important part: down the whole bottle yourself. There's eight of us. Bring eight hooves and eight bottles of vodka, and we'll give you a very useful, expensive artifact.\nDeal?
All right, I'll do you the favor... The things people come up with just to get drunk.
Max, get your ass up from that campfire and shoot some boars yourself...
Max, have you even gotten up?
Quiet, Marked One... You're disturbing my meditation...
Take your hooves and bottles... I'm not your delivery boy!
Oh, come on!.. Fuck!.. Meditators...

Ah, good man, brother! The guys and I will be Terminators now... Here's our present. Rumor has it you can turn this artifact into an even rarer one, but I don't know the recipe. Sorry... I can give you another recipe, for an "Emerald." You can make one from an ordinary artifact... Only the artifact has to have entirely positive properties... Here. And it needs a special place: the "Greedy" anomaly. That's where you can cook it up.
Thanks kindly. I'll look for that recipe...
A bit risky, of course... But it's worth a try...
Good or bad, time will tell... Meanwhile, here's what I promised... Congratulations on your discharge, soldier!
I'll be grateful till the day I die...\nHere's a present for you, too. Think it'll come in handy.\nWe won't meet again... Goodbye.
Hi, Wolf. Moved to the Warehouses? Who's with your rookies?
Don't worry, the rookies won't be left on their own. There's someone to replace me. \nBy the way, Marked One, since you're always running around the Zone, have you seen Petrukha anywhere?
Petrukha? How should I know? You're the ones who are such good friends.
You see, Marked One, we didn't part on the best of terms. I've got an idea where he might've gone, but it needs checking. What do you say?
Wolf, you're keeping something back. He's your right-hand man. What do you need me to do?
If you're at the Forgotten Farmstead, ask whether that bird's turned up. If you meet him, you don't have to mention our conversation or my interest in him.
I'll look when I'm at the farmstead. But you know, no promises.
Listen, have you heard of "emerald" artifacts?

Well... I've not only heard of them. I've held some. That stalker Ghost brought several from somewhere, when he and Vasilyev were getting ready to look for the entrance to the underground laboratory.\nHe said he'd picked the wrong moment to enter the factory grounds. A whole pack of snorks turned up from somewhere. Had to leave some artifacts there. Said there's a green construction trailer by the far wall, on the right as you look in from the entrance. Left them inside...\nThey're probably still there. As far as I know, nobody's risked going into the radiation since.
So it might be lying there...
Yes, possibly. Valuable and rare, those emeralds... Bring them if you find them. We'll talk.

Listen, since we're talking about it... I spoke to one of your men in the Gut. Petrov. He says three emerald artifacts gathered together can move a person downward, a few meters. Just not clear how... What do you think?

What am I supposed to think... That's the Zone for you. What here is ever "clear"? Who knows? Try it. Stranger things happen... Just make sure there's some space beneath you, not solid earth. You could bury yourself alive that way.
Well, you hear all sorts of things!
Hmm, I managed to find this little "green" artifact...
Only one? Ghost said there were several. Yes... A fine one! Will you donate it to science?
No, I need it myself... Know how to make these?
You said yourself the artifact's valuable. What will you offer for it?

Can't say for sure. Vasilyev once mentioned that a Jellyfish-class artifact with entirely positive properties can be turned into an emerald artifact. In the Misty Thicket, in an acidic anomaly... Haven't checked whether it's true, of course...
I've got a recipe for an artifact... Well, agree?
All right, take it, man of science.
I'll think about it. We'll talk later.
Then write down the recipe. A very good artifact, no cheating.
If you need anything else, let me know.
It's not far, really. Of course I'll bring it...

Be careful. It's dangerous there... The courier was an experienced stalker, and he got caught. Watch yourself, especially in those rags. Shame I haven't got anything decent for you. \nTry looking in stashes. Stalkers often put things away for a rainy day.
I just can't... There are constant electrical discharges in that tunnel...
Get rid of anomalies? I've heard something about that. All right, I'll look for the poor fellow.
I think Tolik will turn up soon enough...
Here's the radio. Tolik, the little chicken, saw a bloodsucker and ran so fast half the Zone thought an emission had started...
Thanks. It'll come in handy.
Listen, go on your own. I just can't...
What do you mean, you can't?
I've got no strength left... And... I just can't. Leave me.
Stop acting like a child! Pull yourself together!
All right. Stay here. I'll tell your people.
No need to shout. I told you, I'm not going anywhere. Sorry... Go yourself.
Ahh! All right. Stay put, I'll send help.
Leave me...
Oh, to hell with it! Stay, then.
Marked One... Well, what's out there?
Stay put. I'll check some more.
It's all right. I made it to the end of the tunnel.
So what? What's the point of all this...
Matveyev! Get up! Keep going straight.
Leave me...
Oh, to hell with it! Stay, then.
Who's there? Doctor?
Fang! It's me, Marked One. Glad you're alive. How are you?
Could be better... Glad you came, at least. The Doctor hasn't shown up. I'm wondering whether we were wrong to refuse the scientists' help.
The scientists aren't going anywhere. We can contact them as a last resort. The Doctor will come. Wait.
He'll come, then what? Take me to the hut?

Not yet... You see, the helmet probably won't work here in the Thicket. It did its job, protected you during teleportation. But we'll think of something. What matters is you're alive, you can talk... All that.
What kind of life is this... Better than a coffin, though. Can't argue there.
Don't lose hope. We'll find a way.
That's all I can do. Thanks, Marked One. Drop by. Don't forget me.
Of course I'll come back.
Who's there? Doctor?
No, it's me, Marked One. How are you doing?
All right. Just sitting here...
All right, everything will be fine.
Yes, it's me. We need to have a serious talk.
Serious? So it was all for nothing... You can't help me anymore, right?
Marked One?

No, that's not what I mean. Keep hoping for the best... I met Ghost, and he told me God knows what. That Ivar brought me to Strelok, and the Doctor knew it from the start. From what I understood, Strelok needed me as a guinea pig or something... Is that true?
What? I don't understand any of this. Who's Ivar?
So you don't know him? Strelok didn't tell you?
Don't remember that name. I told you, Strelok keeps his own counsel. Only told you things when he wanted you to know. Otherwise, you couldn't get another word out of him.
All right, fine. But what about me?
How would I know what's happened to you... I never knew you until you found me yourself.
You said my voice reminded you of someone...
I did say that. When you can't see, you picture all sorts of things. Keep hoping it's someone you know talking to you. A friend. Someone who'll help.
Do you know what experiments Strelok was doing here in the Thicket?

I found the entrance to a cave here. I remember that. Later Strelok set himself up in it, and I found all sorts of parts for him. The things he asked for... He was doing some strange experiments... Oh! Yes! Something happened after one of those experiments. Near the dead Monolith. That's what he called that big stone sticking out near the hut...
What incident? Try to remember.

That's what I'm doing. Something wasn't working with his experiment. I ran off for spare batteries... Yeah, I think that's right. When I came back, he was already saying something to Ghost, and there was some man's body nearby. Looked like a stalker... Anyway, he ran off to turn his device off, or something. Just said in passing that Ghost would explain everything...
Did he explain?

Not a chance. Just muttered that we had to get the body to the Doctor, urgently. But the Doctor wasn't there... He'd gone to the Garbage... No, the Cordon. And an emission was building. Any moment now. I don't know why he was so stubborn. The man was practically a corpse. You could see that. Barely alive, and he wouldn't have survived the emission anyway... Something like that.
So, did you get him to the Doctor?

We got him to the hut, but like I said, the Doctor wasn't there. I don't remember carrying him any farther. I followed Strelok to take shelter in the cave. Waited out the emission there. I think that's how it went... Then I headed to the Dark Valley on business, and by then there was nobody in the hut... That's right...
Was it Ghost who carried me to the Doctor, then?

You? No... I doubt it was you. I can't see you, but that man was almost a corpse, or like a zombie, all twisted up. I don't think Ghost carried him any farther. Probably buried him somewhere there, or just left him. Do you really think we were carrying you?
That's the feeling I have. Can't say for sure... But what did Strelok tell Ghost?

How would I know? Ghost only said that he needed that man alive, whether he was a stalker or a zombie or whatever. And that Strelok wanted it, too. Something like that. Didn't explain why. I didn't ask. Like I said, I was thinking about the emission. My own skin matters more than some half-dead stranger. You're obsessed with that man...
I already told you about his experiments. And what happened with that man...

I'm thinking it might have been me after all. Strelok deliberately did something to me, but for some reason didn't tell anyone, even the people who seemed most loyal. I don't understand... Or couldn't he trust anyone at all? What was he planning to do, then?
You're getting carried away... Are you talking to me, or thinking aloud?
Thinking aloud, mostly, since you don't know anything. Or don't remember... Try a little harder, maybe. What could Strelok have told Ghost about that man?

I don't know anything else about him. But I remember sending parts to Strelok through Ghost once, on Strelok's orders. Ghost said Strelok was trying to do something with psi energy. Some device. A generator or emitter. And... Send the beam somewhere, probably... Hey! Wait! Maybe that weapon I was making wasn't meant for shooting at all. Just his experiment on a small scale... A trial run. He wanted something bigger, much more powerful.
You think so?
Well, I'm only guessing... What else can I do? Can't ask Strelok. Ghost also said something hadn't worked out. The beams or fields overlapped, or something.
So there was some interference...
Something like that, anyway. Can't remember exactly. I don't think it had anything to do with that man. He was just explaining why Strelok ran off right away.
All right, Fang. Take care. Or maybe goodbye. Who knows...
So what's going to happen to me? Have you decided?
Everything will be all right. The Doctor will think of something.
Hi, Fang.
Marked One? Wasn't expecting you. The Doctor came. Said you'd decided to try getting right to the center. You didn't go after all? Good choice.
Marked One?
I don't know what's right or wrong anymore. I did get to the center. There's nothing there, though. Just emptiness... What about the Doctor? Has he done anything?
Not yet. But Ivar came by. Yes, that Ivar... Turns out he's the Zone's foremost expert on zombies.
And what did he say?
Nothing yet. Gave me some hope. Asked what happened, what I remember and what I don't. Asked about Strelok, too.
What's Strelok to him?
Not him... His questions made me remember something. Gave him some ideas about helping me. He left right away.
What did you remember?

Ghost once asked if I knew anyone with the "Black Mark." I asked why. Said Strelok needed a carrier, or the Mark itself. But he couldn't find one. Just his luck. One day the network's full of "help me get rid of it," the next nobody, as if all the carriers died at once. So, talking about the Mark, Ghost said that if Strelok couldn't find it, he'd need a live Monolith man.
What? You caught Monolith men for him? Went to Pripyat for them?

Wait, I haven't finished... Not an ordinary Monolith man. That wouldn't do, he said. Needed someone who wasn't completely Monolith yet, or something. I asked who that was, and how to find one. Ask everyone, "Hey, are you a Monolith man by any chance? Planning to become one?" Didn't understand him. What sort of joke is that...
And him?

He said he didn't understand either, but that's what Strelok had said. There was an idea, but it meant contacting someone who could provide a man like that. I asked who he planned to contact. Ghost says, don't you know Strelok? He just clouded the issue, then went quiet. Said he'd questioned Strelok himself, but Strelok brushed him off: "Just a thought. Don't worry about it..." That sort of thing. Never got anything out of him. I don't think Strelok let Ghost in on much. Or something happened between them, and he stopped telling him everything.
Ghost's quite a character... So you trusted him completely?

Who can you trust completely in the Zone? That's how it happened. Fate brought us together, we worked on things. Told each other what we thought necessary, but... I kept some things back. So did he. We both knew it, but didn't bring it up. We worked well together. That was enough.
So what's Ivar's idea?
