I don't know. I told him about that man and Strelok's experiments with radiation, or irradiation, or whatever... Couldn't see Ivar, of course, but I got the impression he was stunned... Don't know why. His breathing changed, started fidgeting. Can't explain why I thought so. Felt it.
I wonder what got him so worked up...

Don't know. He started asking about Strelok's setup, the experiments. I said, go to the den. It's probably all still there. What difference does it make to me now? His experiments don't make me feel any better. Ivar said those very experiments would help cure me. Could help, rather. If Strelok managed to bring one man back to his senses, by accident or on purpose, Ivar would try it, too.
Try what?

How would I know! He ran off. Said there was hope, but there could be consequences. I might forget something, for example. Makes no difference to me. I'd like to forget this whole Zone, never remember it again...
So Ivar ran off to the den?
No. Said that was for later. First he urgently had to meet someone... Outside the Zone altogether. Don't go chasing him. He promised to come himself. Told me to wait and hope.
I'm not chasing anyone else. Done enough of that... All right. Wait and hope.
Yes. Fang, I remembered something.
Yeah? Well, congratulations...
Marked One?
I remembered someone carrying somebody out of a dangerous place. And you were there.
Me? Who were we carrying?
I don't know. Maybe it was me... What can you tell me about it?
About what? Well... All sorts of things have happened in the Zone. I remember dragging a scientist through a swamp...

No. It wasn't in the Swamps. I have a feeling it was somewhere here, in the Misty Thicket. You told someone to leave the body, but the other man didn't want to. Don't you remember anything like that? Who was the other man?

In the Thicket? I found the entrance to a cave here. I remember that. Later Strelok set himself up in it, and I found all sorts of parts for him. The things he asked for... He was doing some strange experiments... Oh! Yes! Something happened after one of those experiments. Near the dead Monolith. That's what he called that big stone sticking out near the hut...
Try to remember what happened, not the stone.

That's what I'm doing. Something wasn't working with his experiment. I ran off for spare batteries... Yeah, I think that's right. When I came back, he was already saying something to Ghost, and there was some man's body nearby. Looked like a stalker... Anyway, he ran off to turn his device off, or adjust it, or something. Said in passing that Ghost would explain everything...
Did he explain?

Not a chance. Just muttered that we had to get the body to the Doctor, urgently. But the Doctor wasn't there... He'd gone to the Garbage... No, the Cordon. And an emission was building. Any moment now. I don't know why he was so stubborn. The man was practically a corpse. You could see that. Barely alive, and he wouldn't have survived the emission anyway... Something like that.
So, did you get him to the Doctor?

We got him to the hut, but like I said, the Doctor wasn't there. I don't remember carrying him any farther. I followed Strelok to take shelter in the cave. Waited out the emission there. I think that's how it went... Then I headed to the Dark Valley on business, and by then there was nobody in the hut... That's right...
Was it Ghost who carried me to the Doctor, then?

You? No... I doubt it was you. I can't see you, but that man was almost a corpse, or like a zombie, all twisted up. I don't think Ghost carried him any farther. Probably buried him somewhere there, or just left him. Do you really think we were carrying you?
That's the feeling I have. I can't say for sure... But what did Strelok actually tell Ghost?

How would I know? Ghost only said that he needed that man alive, whether he was a stalker or a zombie or whatever. And that Strelok wanted it, too. Something like that. Didn't explain why. I didn't ask. I was thinking about the emission and where to take shelter. My own skin matters more than some half-dead stranger.
Ghost, then... Never would have guessed.
Yes. I wanted to ask you something. They told me at the Bar you'd made some unusual weapon.
Marked One? Is that you?
Made all sorts of things. Weapons, too. Fixed someone's TOZ, another man's Kalashnikov. Can't remember everything.
A special weapon. Some prototype that runs on a battery.

Oh! Yes. But I never finished it. Strelok gave me some drawings. Where he found them, who knows... I told him it wouldn't fire. Where would I find a power source like that? He said, don't worry, the power's not your problem. Just build the thing. So I did. If that's what you mean.
Have you tried firing it?

I did. Strelok brought a couple of strange batteries to try. Said he couldn't get more yet. Missing some special substance. Thought he was joking, pulling my leg. Loaded it, pointed it at a stone, and it really did go off. Smashed the stone to bits. A fragment nearly hit me in the head. I said, you should warn me! I'd have stood farther away. He scratched his head and said there'd been a little error in the calculations. Needed some modifications.
What, the battery?
No, the design itself. Focus the beam more tightly.
Did you modify it?

Yes. Not all the way. Started on it, changed a few things. Didn't test it a second time, though. Thought, to hell with it, let him fire it himself. Maybe he'd made another mistake, enough to take my arm off this time.
And what about the weapon?
What kind of weapon is that? I wouldn't even call it a weapon. It's just another one of Strelok's experiments. You had it right: a prototype.
So it's the one I found here?
Fine, a prototype. Where is it?
Well, probably. There isn't another one...
I left it right here in the cave. Came across it again just before you arrived. Need it? Take it.
Excellent. Just what we need.
Tell me how much longer I have to stay here.
Not much longer now...
What business?
Yeah, here's an ordinary artifact. Take it...
I'll give you a good artifact.
I'll part with ten thousand for it.
I haven't got anything.
Tick-tock, Marked One, tick-tock...
I know. I'll have it all soon...
Good work, you did it. Yurik's free now...
What are you talking about? I want to exchange ammo.
Nothing. When there's something to tell, you'll hear about it... Let's see what ammo you've got.
Here's the flash drive with the information. Seems important...

Important? Let's see... What have we got here... \nRight... Coordinates for the passage to the Warehouses. Nothing new, but not everyone has them... I'll mark them on your map too. Oh, here's information on the Diamond Kolobok hypermodified artifact! Write this down! And a little cash: that's your reward.\nI think Duty will appreciate this information.
Good work... Oh, here's information on the Diamond Kolobok hypermodified artifact! Write this down! Here, a little cash.\nI think Duty will appreciate this information.
Well, well. Information, you say? Are you taking the piss? This flash drive's blank! Quite the joker... Careful: the doctor might play a joke too. Give that enema bulb a good squeeze!...
Good health to you, stalker! Haven't seen you before... What's your name?
Hello to you, too. I'm Marked One...
Marked One?... No, never heard of you. New to the Zone?
I don't think so. I can't remember! I'm looking for people who might know me, or know something about Strelok...
Ask around. Maybe you'll find someone...
Well, Marked One? Found anyone?
Not yet... I'll ask around some more...
Go ahead... Need anything?
Hello, stalker! Haven't seen you before... What's your name?
Hello to you, too. I'm Marked One...
Marked One?... So you're the one Sidor told me about? You swiped a case of documents from the military? A whole briefcase, apparently...
Yeah, that's me...
Have you got the case on you, or what?
Yes, here it is. Nearly pulled my arms off. Is it full of lead...
I've stashed it away for now...

Well, then. What did you need those for, eh? I don't buy Sidorovich's stories... Now I need time to go through them. Maybe there's something that'll help us get north. Go take a walk, enjoy yourself. Get some sleep, for once. You look rough... Here, you must be running short...
Fair enough. What could be in there, anyway? Sidorovich keeps dreaming of untold riches beyond the Brain Scorcher. Take a break. Have a chat with the others...
All right, I'll get going.
Marked One! Sidorovich told me about you! You stole that document case from the military?
Yeah, that happened...
Have you got the case on you, or what?
Here it is. Nearly pulled my arms off. Is it full of lead...
I've stashed it away for now...

Well, then. What did you need those for, eh? I don't buy Sidorovich's stories... Now I need time to go through them. Maybe there's something that'll help us get north. Go take a walk, enjoy yourself. Get some sleep, for once. You look rough... Here, you must be running short...
Fair enough. What could be in there, anyway? Sidorovich keeps dreaming of untold riches beyond the Brain Scorcher. Take a break. Have a chat with the others...
All right, I'll get going.
Uh... Marked One, I take it? Sidor told me about you. Said you were hard to forget. Hard to mistake for anyone else, too.
Yeah, I'm Marked One...
Right, that's good. Sidor said you wanted to find someone, and you were trying to get north?
I'm looking for Strelok. A stalker with that nickname...

Someone brought me some military documents recently. They seem to have something to do with the Brain Scorcher. Now the brains need time to work through them. Maybe we'll learn how to get north. Meanwhile, you can talk to people here at the Bar. If anything comes up, I'll let you know...
Always on the move, brother... How's the search?
Haven't found anything out yet... I'll ask around some more...
Go ahead... Need anything? You never know...
Marked One, there's a job that could be useful to you, too...
What's the job, and what's in it for me?

Here's where we stand. The Agroprom documents are starting to make some sense, but we're missing information. They mention a laboratory called X-18. The description sounds like the abandoned underground rooms in the Dark Valley.\nWord reached me that you're looking for Strelok. Sidor also said you were heading for the center of the Zone. Strelok knew a lot of interesting things. Maybe he knew the way to the center. Maybe he's even there now. Who knows... Getting the picture?
You're being cagey. I did my job. Sidor and I are square. What do you want from me?

What do I want? These documents don't give us the route, that's what. And nobody knows a way to the center these days. So if you're still set on getting there, you'll have to go to X-18 and find the missing information. I don't know exactly where the entrance is, but I have reliable word that Borov, the leader of those psychos, knows where the damn place is. Try to get it out of him. If you haven't been to the Valley yet, there's a reliable trail through a radioactive grove east of the Duty checkpoint in the Garbage.
Borov? How would that work?

You're new here. Haven't drawn much attention yet... See that fellow at the counter? Goes by Zub. He's got contacts in all sorts of factions. Try talking it over with him. All you have to do is get into X-18 and bring back the missing documents. Well, Marked One? Will you do it? The sooner you find those documents, the sooner you'll find Strelok...
You've convinced me. I'll try.
No, I don't want to take it on yet.
Excellent. I'll be waiting.
Your call, Marked One. Just remember, this is our only lead on opening a way north.
I thought you were heading to the Dark Valley, Marked One?
I need to get ready, pick up some gear...
Well, if there's anything I can do...
Here you are, Marked One... Been to the lab? Found anything?
I found that damn basement. Here's what was in it.
Hmm... I think there were some papers...

Let's see... Formulas, graphs, diagrams... Stop hovering. I need to work this out. Go have a drink. Ah... Here's a little something for squeezing through where even cockroaches can't fit... I'm joking! Relax.
You should've taken them... Instead of standing around gawking! All sorts of rumors about those labs. What are we supposed to believe? Well, it's your call. No papers, no way north...
So Yantar, then? Is that right? What about the Red Forest?

There was one half-crazy fellow here. Said his partner found some tunnel in the Red Forest leading to an underground lab. But the fellow telling the story was too scared to go in, and his partner never came back... No! Drunk stalkers will tell you anything...\nYou're better off getting to the scientists at Yantar and finding out where X-16 is, so you can get the missing documents.
Why me? Look at all the layabouts in the bar...

Exactly: layabouts... They might not even go. Say, "We're well fed right here." Or stop halfway for a drinking session and forget the whole thing. And time won't wait. I know you're not doing this for money. You've got a personal stake in it. That's why you're the only one I can rely on.
Since when do you care so much about me? And how do you know what I need? Did Sidor tell you, or someone else?
Don't pick apart every word. Plenty of people in the Zone have noticed you by now. You're the one telling everyone you want your memory back... So, ready?
All right, I'm ready. Wouldn't go if I didn't need to get to Yantar myself.
No, I'm not ready yet.
Good. I'm sending you the coordinates for the passage to the Wild Territory. Yantar's beyond it. I'll be waiting.
Get ready, Marked One. This can't wait long.
Still rushing around? You look awful. Get some rest.
I will. Later. What did you learn from the documents?
We're studying them. I'll remember you if anything turns up.

Things are becoming clearer. Just as I suspected, the Brain Scorcher is man-made. It's an experimental Kaymanov emitter. Its components were manufactured in X-18. These documents refer to X-16, where the finished units were sent. From the scraps of information here, that lab is in an industrial complex near Lake Yantar.\nHmm... I only recently heard that someone managed to get into X-16 from the Red Forest somehow... Strange.\nAll right, Yantar it is. There's a scientists' camp nearby. They'll surely be able to give you better directions.
Well, shall we begin? Ready for a trip to Yantar?
All right, I'll try to find out what's there...
I'm not heading to Yantar yet...
Good. I'm sending you the coordinates for the passage to the Wild Territory. Yantar's beyond it. I'll be waiting.
Get ready, Marked One. This can't wait long.
I thought you were at Yantar already... What is it?
Well, Marked One, got the X-16 documents on you?
Yes, here they are.
No.

You really went into that death trap? Didn't expect that from you. Either you're lucky, or just... Never mind... I'll give these to Docent. Let him puzzle them out... You have the thanks of every stalker! Maybe you can relax a little now.\nOh, speaking of Docent! He was waiting for you. Wanted to pass something on, or give you something, or tell you something... Ask him yourself.

You really went into that death trap? Didn't expect that from you. Either you're lucky, or just... Never mind... I'll give these to Docent. Let him puzzle them out... You have the thanks of every stalker! Maybe you can relax a little now.
Unbelievable! Here I am bending over backward, working my fingers to the bone, while he's taking it easy. Get those documents, now! We can't make any progress without them!
Marked One, with all due respect... What did you want?
Well, Marked One, all that's left is to deal with the Scorcher and open the way north. Ready to head out now?
Ready.
No way! Let me catch my breath...

Here's the situation, Marked One. According to these documents, the Scorcher's emissions are of the same kind as those at Yantar... So talk to Sakharov and show him these papers. I've marked the places where stalkers died trying to reach the center. The documents mention a Brain Scorcher control bunker. I know its coordinates. There's also a reference to an entry code: 23486. Give it a try... \nIt may be possible to shut down the whole system there. That's why you need to reach the bunker beneath the antennas and turn off the Scorcher as soon as possible. I don't know what comes next, but I have a feeling it'll be worth it. One thing's certain: once it's off, the Scorcher won't stop us reaching the center of the Zone. What's waiting there... God knows.
Of course, get some rest! Have a drink, something to eat...
Go on.
Hold on! Tell me how to get there! All this talk of bunkers and coordinates...
All you need to do is ask Sakharov whether you can reach the bunker beneath the antennas with your mind intact, and turn them off. Clear?

For crying out loud! Take the road north through the northern checkpoint. You'll reach the old Army Warehouses, a little village, and a stinking swamp. Keep going. Ignore the stoned Freedom boys... The Scorcher will make itself known soon enough. You won't miss it!\nAll you need to do is ask Sakharov whether you can reach the bunker beneath the antennas and turn them off. Clear?

That's clear. What isn't clear is why you've dumped all this on me: X-18, X-16, and now the Scorcher. Why the special interest? You'd think there was nobody else around. Maybe it's Strelok you're interested in, rather than the center of the Zone?
I wouldn't mind a word with Strelok, of course. But you've got the wrong idea.
I see it how I see it. Here's the deal: you've told me the way... Maybe I'll go. In the meantime, I suggest you find some other brave volunteers.

Suit yourself... I'll look, but don't drag your feet either.\nOh, one more thing! Duty's commander needs a volunteer for some job at the Army Warehouses. If you're interested, go see him. If you haven't had dealings with them yet, I'll speak to the guards. They'll let you through.
Hello, Marked One. Time goes by, but you never change. Still keeping everyone at arm's length. Sit down, have a drink. Maybe it'll soften you up a little.
Oh! Marked One! What are you doing here?
Listen, I went to the bunker beneath the Scorcher... You've got something wrong! There's no control panel down there! I searched the whole place!

Ah!... I sent you a message after you left. Didn't get it? There was a mistake. Outdated information. I knew straightaway it all sounded too easy! Never mind. The important thing is you're still alive... We've found a way to switch off that damn Scorcher!
Hmm! How? And more importantly, where?
I don't know where. I wasn't the one who switched it off. Don't worry about it... You're your own man now. You decide what to do and when. Haven't you noticed anything yourself?

Everyone you ask around here "knows" something about Strelok. He's probably another one of those experts. If he wants me that badly, he'll find me... I haven't got time to run around the Farmstead looking for someone I don't even know...
Why would I care, right? \nOh, I forgot! He talked to Ivar about something, back when Ivar could still speak clearly. Don't know what they were discussing, but they didn't part on friendly terms.
How do you know?
It happened right here in the bar, with me standing nearby. I wasn't listening. None of my business. But I definitely heard Strelok's name.
Another wild-goose chase...
What are you talking about?
Just talking to myself... Thinking where to go next.

Don't overthink it. Head north. That's where you wanted to go, wasn't it? Everyone else has already rushed off. Loot's what matters in our line of work. They'll be hauling it back by the sackful soon... Though nobody's brought any back yet. About time they did...
What am I supposed to notice? Plucked your eyebrows?

Honestly! And it's hardly your first day in the Zone... There are barely any people left here! The Scorcher's been switched off! Ivar's group did it. Heard of them? Call themselves the Seekers. Mind you, Ivar came back to the Bar alone. Haven't seen anyone else from his group. \nAnyway, he finally found a weakness in that damned Brain Scorcher. Now everyone who can throw a bolt has headed for the center. Pripyat, or even farther. Place is deserted... There should be enough profit for everyone now! An untouched Klondike up there!
Who's Ivar? Don't think I've met him... You say he's been in the Zone a long time? Maybe he knows Strelok...

From the Baltic states, I think. Serious-minded people... Don't know about Strelok. Maybe he did know him. Never said much himself. Try talking to Ivar. If... if you can. Hasn't been quite himself since Radar.
Not himself? What do you mean?

Yes, looks like the emissions got to him. Don't know what happened to the rest of his group. When he first came back, he could still talk normally. Then he got worse by the day. Now he mutters. Sometimes it makes sense, sometimes it doesn't. His head clears occasionally, though, and he can talk fairly well.
So where is he?

Here at the base. Where else could he go in that state? \nPoor bastard... He tried treating the zombies himself. They say that's why he came here. Some kind of head doctor, used to treat people with mental problems. And look how it turned out. Turning into a zombie himself, right before our eyes. Some fate...
Treated people's brains, you say? Interesting... Can't he be helped anymore?

Who can help him, if even he couldn't turn anyone back from a zombie? They say he managed to bring a few around for a while, ones who hadn't had too much exposure to the brain scrambling. But I don't know for sure... \nI've put out a request on the network. If anyone sees the Doctor, tell him he's urgently needed at the Bar. Finding that Doctor is like looking for a needle in a haystack, though. Still, if he hears, he should come.
Did the Doctor know Ivar?
I don't know for sure! Ivar said something about the Doctor. Who knows? Maybe they had interests in common. Try asking him while he can still talk reasonably well.
All right, I'll try talking to Ivar...
Try it. Don't rush off yourself, either. Rest a little. You look rough, like you've got a hell of a hangover... Hope you're not... Touch wood.
Oh! How's it going? \nNever told me where you've been all this time, by the way.
I already told you: I went underground at that Scorcher. Something wrong with your hearing?

Oh, come on... Be honest, just between us. Where'd you disappear to for two weeks? Spill it. Spent the whole time drinking somewhere, then heard the Scorcher was off and remembered to show up? Save face, say you went but couldn't find anything... Wanted to play the hero. Am I right? Going to tell me?
What the hell are you talking about?! I've got nothing to tell you... Two weeks, you say... I'd like to know about that myself.
If you don't want to, suit yourself...\nOh! Some fellow's asked for you a couple of times. You were never around.
As if any woman would be asking for me here... What fellow? What does he want?
I didn't ask who he was or what he wanted... Seems he's got something about Strelok for you.
Who is he, anyway?

Don't know. Like I said, he didn't introduce himself... Think he came to see Sultan. Probably one of his men. He's gone now... Can't remember where they're staying. Some farmstead. Look there if you want. Thought you'd be interested, since you keep asking about Strelok.
How's life, brother? Get some rest. You look like death...
Hi, friend. Why are you so out of breath?
Oh, nothing... Tell me why you called me here.

You're as sudden as a case of the shits. All right. Here goes:\nRemember how you kept asking about a stalker called Ghost? He was here recently. Asked about you. We got talking, and I had the impression he really wanted a word with you.
I want a good "talk" with him, too! Where is he?

Yes, thought so. He says he's preparing for something, but he's willing to wait a couple of days for you. He'll be at Radar. Somewhere at the fork. I've passed the message on. Up to you whether you fancy another hike to Radar...\nHow about you? Buying anything?
Hello... How's it going? All right? Good. What do you want?
Hey! What are you snooping around for? Who are you?
Marked One. Don't you recognize me?

Plenty of marked men around. Can't remember them all. I'm Brom. Like bromine, the chemical element. The jokers always bring up that army dessert...\nAnyway, can't you see I'm on duty? Garrison patrol, sort of. Could have you thrown in the guardhouse.\nIf you've got no business here, go to the bar. Knock back a shot of tea for me...
You again? Can't sit still, can you...
Hic... Ahhh, shit. Drunk again. Duty wants to kick me out if I fail this job too. And I'm not in any state to... You know... Do the thing...
We'll see. I'll let you know if I get the chance.
All right. I've got some vodka. Here.

You... You're a savior! A saint! I, uh... Can't remember the recipe. Had it written down. Hid the note in a stash. Well... The paper was in a bag with the good stuff. We drank it, and the bag stayed there. Only I can't remember exactly where. Either at the Farmstead, when we were waiting in ambush. Or in the Gut, when... Well, I've been there.
Just my luck, dealing with a drunk... Where, exactly?

Don't get worked up, my benefactor. Forgot a little, that's all. Happens...
At the Forgotten Farmstead, I remember drinking in a little shop. There's one there. Stinks something awful from the swamp nearby!
If it's in the Gut, there's a ruined railway bridge. A column of military vehicles next to it. There was a little box in one of the truck beds...
Believe me. No tricks...
I understand.
What could you understand... Let's have a little drink. To meeting you!
What could you possibly understand... Pour me a drink...
Well, let's have some...
I don't drink, sir... Well, no.
All right, let's get started...
I haven't got any...
One of us! Drop by, we'll talk about life.
One of us! Listen, I've got a job... Se... Su... Secret! Get it?
I can smell it. You stink. Have you washed this year?

Uh... What? Listen to me! I'm telling you straight! And... What was I saying? Oh!\nThis one ba... Bloke. Yes, bloke. Owes me money! That's it! Loads! My legs... Aren't working right. And my eye hurts. Well... Understand? Well?

Uh... What? Listen to me! I'm telling you straight! And... What was I saying? Oh!\nYou want to hear something amaz... Ama... Ah, fuck... Hang on... A recipe for cooking an artifact! That's it! Want it?

Uh... What? Listen to me! I'm telling you straight! And... What was I saying? Oh!\nYou see how it... There. Can't do it. Yes. Without that poison! Told myself so many times: that's it! Not another drop. And here I am again. Smashed. Help me, friend! I'll tell you about such easy pickings you won't believe it!
No. What do you want?
Depends what kind, and what you want for it...
I didn't understand a word. What do you want from me?

Tell him Brom, his pal... Me, that is. Tell him Brom's dying. Just don't say where... Tell him to pay what he owes. Understand? Grab him by the scruff and make him... I'll give you something... Cross my heart... I'm serious! Well...

You're crazy! I'm talking to you like a friend! And I can... Used to know, rather. Well... Anyway. There's a recipe. I'll tell you. Just bring me some vodka, eh? About ten bottles... Eh? I'm planning a trip. Might run into radiation, or some other nasty stuff. I'll treat the boys. Well? Deal?

There's a Doctor. They call him the Swamp Doctor. Kind old fellow. Knows a lot. Maybe he could tell me how to beat the bottle. I'd look for him myself, but I can't. My legs won't work, and I shake all over without a drink. Once I have a drink, though, I'm done for. Can't go into the Zone alone. Nobody will take me as a partner, either. I understand. What good would I be? I'd only get others killed... Well? If you see the Doctor, will you ask him for me? I'll give you a very useful recipe: how to cook a Steel Kolobok. I know it. Someone told me...
Ah! Hi, brother. Ah, life... Listen, have a drink with me...
Hic... You helped, yeah. Let's drink to Duty, then? And... Ah!
Ah!... You! Why are you... All black? Ahhh... Caught it, then... Never mind. Let's have a drink...
You mean the "Black Mark"? Know anything about it?
Well... Pour me one... For the conversation... Throat's dry...
Here, take it! Just don't overdo it!
I don't drink, sir... Well, no.

Come on! That's insulting! Just wetting my throat... All right, listen.\nThat Mark... It's alive. Yes. That's why it feeds on your life. But the Mark isn't quite of this world... Are you listening? Or staring at the women on TV? Pour another!
All right... Just don't pass out...
I haven't got any more!

Ahhh! How can you put out the fire burning inside!
What was I saying? Oh, yes! The Mark...
Like I said, it drinks your life, and that very life poisons it! There! Had a pal who put up with it for a couple of days, and the damn thing died by itself! The main thing is not to let it build up its otherworldly energy. Don't try to throw it away. Don't put it on the ground. Understand? Let it choke on your life!
Oh! Forgot something else: stay away from other people. The damn thing doesn't just "eat" you! Drains strength from those around you too. So it won't "die" with people nearby. Go farther out into the Zone. That's the only way.
Huh? Well, suit yourself... I'm feeling tired...
You should... Have a drink... Otherwise... You're done for... With that Mark...
What?.. Oh, the SPAS! Marked One, you're a star!
Here's your big hunk of metal. Where's the artifact?
An artifact?! I can offer this one, with a recipe thrown in...
Wow, thanks!
Ah... A shame it's wrecked, but it'll do.
Didn't you promise me an artifact? Where is it?
You did a great job! Here's your reward.
Not really. You'd have been better off repairing it and keeping it...
I've heard about your grandfather already. Anything new?
Ah, leave me alone. I'm miserable...

Listen, here's the thing... Remember my amnesia? I keep finding PDAs, but I can't figure out their passwords. Forgotten a lot from my old life. Words and all that. Still want to get my hands on some loot, though. Got any tricks for someone like me?
Yes, I've got something. Wrote a little program for myself. I can share an early version. Doesn't work all that well, but it'll do for your purposes. If the memory fills up, come back. I'll clear it.
I'm ready to pay for a new flash drive. What was the price?

Mind you, it's still rough. A beta. Plenty of problems: the longer you spend working on a password, the faster the device's memory fills up. Should handle ten or twenty anagrams, though. Then you'll need to see me again.
Thanks. I'll try it out.
How much will this thing cost me?
Let's be fair. A capsule, or a good tier-three artifact. Or something of equal value. You understand. Knowledge like this isn't given away in the Zone.
Marked One, of course I remember. I'm not the one with amnesia here. What exactly do you want?
I've got a capsule lying around. Will this one do?
Yes, well... The old one's memory filled up. You said I could come back and we'd find a way to fix that.
Nothing complicated. For a good tier-two artifact, we'll reset the date and it'll all work...
I've got just the right artifact.
Well, let's see what I can say...
A Dummy's more substantial, eh? How about that?
Lost my head for a moment. I don't need anything.
Will you take a check? Can I pay cash?
Haven't got anything like that yet. I'll have to work out the passwords myself... Maybe I'll stop by later.
Pick up a trail?! Not my field. Electronics are more my thing.
All right. I've got ten of them. Take them.
We'll discuss it later.

In principle, we track all unencrypted beacons from personal PDAs. I could mark a particular PDA on your map.\nBut knowledge is hard won in the Zone. In return for this service, I'd like you to bring me new information. Personal PDAs often contain unique data that looks like gibberish to a nonspecialist.\nTo get our arrangement started, bring me 10 PDAs of any kind. Then you'll be able to use this exclusive service for a reasonable fee.
Here, look... Filthy, isn't it... That damn pseudodog shat on it!

Hmm, it really is broken... Something may have burned out during an emission. I've got working ones. Want one? 
A tier-two artifact, and give me yours too. 
If you want yours brought back to life, that could take a lot of work... Hmm... Yes, a lot... I'll do it for a capsule containing an artifact, or a good artifact cooked from one of those capsules. I'll take checks too. 
What'll it be?
Go on, bring it back to life. Here's the capsule.
Oh, thank you. Don't worry. I think we can restore it. Come back in an hour. Should be ready by then.
Can't get by without a PDA. Take a good artifact.
Thank you. Come back in an hour. Should be ready.
I've got this Dummy here. Take it.
Come back in an hour. It'll be good as new.
I've got a couple of checks. They're yours.
Come back in about an hour. We'll fix it.
Just give me a new one, then...
Wise choice. A PDA's something you always need... Here. Almost new. I'll register its details in your name. Use it. Shouldn't let you down.
Hell if I know where I put it... Got a new one?
Uh... I've got working ones... A tier-two artifact for one. There's quite a bit of work. You need a new identification code entered, after all. And everything wiped clean... Well?
Just give me a new one, then...
Wise choice. A PDA's something you always need... Here. Almost new. I'll register its details in your name. Use it. Shouldn't let you down.
I'll think about it, ask around.
Ask around, of course. I'm not inflating the price. It's worth that much.
Let's do it.
No, I've changed my mind.
Come over, stalker... Good to see a new face in this madhouse...
What's with the grand welcome?

Sorry, I get carried away sometimes... Not enough poetry in my life. Shall we introduce ourselves? Everyone here calls me Docent. Just for a laugh... Never even finished my postgraduate studies, actually. There I go again. Who do I have the pleasure of speaking to?
I'm Marked One. Plain and simple...

Well, Marked One, let's get down to Zone business. I collect information, mainly from PDAs that belonged to various stalkers. Most of it's usually corrupted, of course. Most of what's left is rubbish. But sometimes there's something interesting among the encrypted data. So if any PDAs happen to come your way, preferably intact, bring them in. We'll agree on a price...
Hi, Docent!
Good health to you, too.

Yes, that's enough. If you'd like to try joining Duty, come see me. We need good fighters. Fair warning, though: before we accept you, you'll have to complete a series of dangerous assignments. We don't need weaklings. Everyone gets tested.
Stop! No entry to Duty's base! Outsiders have no business there.
What are you standing around for? Get moving.
You let me down, Marked One. I vouched for you and got chewed out for it... \nHand over your weapons. Then you can pass.
All right... I hope it'll be kept safe, no matter what.
Oh, I was just...
Take your weapons back.
Thanks. Good luck.
Stop! Only faction members beyond this point. No entry to the bunker without special permission! If you want it, go see Sergeant Plichko.
What are you standing around for? Get moving.
Ah! It's you... Heard you've combed through the whole Zone? Interesting. I'll keep you in mind.\nWell? What have you got?
Marked One, I was just thinking about you... Since you take on all sorts of jobs. I've got an assignment. Not too difficult, but important!
Not hard, but important... I've got a bad feeling about it...
Well? Nothing special. Heard you're getting ready to head for the Army Warehouses? Eh?
Can't hide anything around here! Anyway, what's the job?

We've got a group at the Warehouses. Tell them the assignment's canceled, and they're to act under code twenty-nine. Say thirteen and eight are out of the game. Well? Doesn't sound difficult, does it?
Who am I supposed to tell? What a load of nonsense. Eight, twenty, three-fifteen. Like children, honestly...

It's important! Tell Major Cherepanov. He and his group should be at the southern farmstead by the Warehouses. The numbers mean what they mean. Best not to think about things like that. You'll stay healthier. Deliver the message quickly and come straight back. I'll have a little something for you. Well? Remember what to say?
Uh... All right. Code twenty-nine, thirteen and eight are out. I think.
Exactly! Get moving. I'll try to find someone else too, so if you get there first, the reward's yours...
Well? Why are you still here? No time to waste! It's urgent.
How's it going? Everything all right?
Ah, you. Heard the news? A lot of our men died at the Warehouses. You weren't there, by any chance? Know any details?
What happened at the Warehouses? Any idea? I've been told our entire group was wiped out. Is that true?
About storage. Can I still leave my loot here?

Uh, Marked One, take a closer look around! What do you see? Or, more precisely, what DON'T you see? Not many real fighters left. Greed's eaten away at a lot of them. So there's no way to guarantee the absolute safety of anyone's valuables now. Sorry...
Where am I supposed to keep it now, then?
I hear someone at the bar will do it. For a price, of course...
I'd like to check my stash here one last time. May I?
Go and have a look. For the last time.

During our last raid on a very unpleasant place in the Dark Valley, a squad led by a highly experienced officer obtained some extremely important documents. There's a problem: every man in that squad died in a firefight with a gang of psychos. The situation's very tense. Sending more men into the area would only make it worse, but those documents are of great interest...
What documents? And a more precise description of where to look.
Your call. We'll offer it to a stalker who needs it more...
I found a case in that building in the Dark Valley...

Now that's something to thank you for! Hmm... How do we repay a man of such distinction? Rubles would only insult such a brave, strong fighter, of course... I think the best reward is recognition of your services by all of us! Here, take your reward... Oh! By the way! We captured a mercenary alive recently. Learned there's a safe route from our Rostok straight to the Red Forest! If you need it, you can check it out... Don't forget to report back to us, either...
All right, I'll check...
The Barkeep said you had a job at the Army Warehouses...

I'd like you to do something for me personally. Understand? One of our people went to the Warehouses recently... Now, I've been told you're a quick, sharp fellow. I need you to quietly find out who he went to see, and most importantly, what he took with him. You see, there's a situation... I have a suspicion I'd like to check. That's why I'm asking an outsider. Understand?
Not really... Who am I supposed to ask, and what about? Everyone I meet? And who am I asking about?

No, no, no... Don't go blabbing. Find out about the courier casually, as if in passing. I'll send you information on Freedom's base location. \nOnce you're there, work out how to get accepted as one of their own and loosen their tongues. Ask someone local if a fellow came by with a peculiar little briefcase. A white case, that sort of thing...\nSomeone might talk with a hangover. They all drink like fish. Take plenty of vodka for that. Well, will you do it?
All right, I'll go talk to Freedom. I'm heading that way anyway. What if I don't find anything out?

Then you don't. But do your best. I can't give this assignment to any of my own people yet. One last thing. Major Cherepanov and his men disobeyed my orders and went to assault Freedom's base on their own. Suicidal fools. Let them get what they asked for. Skull's long overdue a lesson. Stay out of their private war. Try to gain Freedom's trust, and above all, do what I've asked. The rest doesn't matter.
No, I'm not ready for heroics like that yet.
Your choice. This conversation never happened. Don't tell anyone.
You bet! I'll outlive all of you... Actually, I'm here for my things.

Where have you been all this time? Wanted to offer you a job, but someone said they'd seen you heading for Radar... A week went by. Then two... We decided that was it... Even talked about it. Hoped it was quick, without suffering, not like the others living out there. And you're alive... Incredible! How did you last half a month there...

Half a month? Damn! Felt like one day to me... Can't make sense of it myself. Thought something was wrong with my PDA, or my watch was off. Now I see the Bar's empty, as if all that time really did pass... All right, we'll figure it out... Open my storage locker for now.

That's the problem, stalker. There's nothing in your locker anymore. Once I figured you weren't coming back, I cleared the space. Why keep a dead man's belongings... Don't take offense. You're alive, of course, but who could've guessed? Besides, it started stinking. Whether you had food in there or mutant tails, I don't know. Asked two fellows to clear it out. They practically needed gas masks to shovel out the rot. So... That's how it happened.
What does that mean?! Everything I've worked for! I don't believe it!

Go take a look... Why get so upset over your gear? You're alive. That's what matters! Stuff can be replaced. If you had any artifacts there, they've probably been put to use already. But you're a stalker... Since things turned out this way, I can give you a little money to get back on your feet...
Marked One, holy... You're alive?!
You bet! I'll outlive all of you... Why the surprise?

Where have you been all this time? Wanted to offer you a job, but someone said they'd seen you heading for Radar... A week went by. Then two... We decided that was it... Even talked about it. Hoped it was quick, without suffering, not like the others living out there. And you're alive... Incredible! How did you last half a month there...

Half a month? Damn! Felt like one day to me... Can't make sense of it myself. Thought something was wrong with my PDA, or my watch was off. Now I see the Bar's empty, as if all that time really did pass... All right, we'll figure it out...

Well! Incredible! You're alive. That's what matters! Running short, I imagine? You're a stalker, though... We can work a few things out, can't we? Since things turned out this way, I can give you a little money to get back on your feet...
Alive again? How's life back on this mortal earth? Kidding. Good to see you.
Greetings, seeker...\nInterested in anything? Or looking for work? Have a look. There are a few jobs you might be able to help with...
Hello, brother. What brings you to me?
Good to see you, Marked One... Still looking for Strelok? Or what?
Keep moving. Don't stop... What are you staring at?
Oh, hi, old friend! Glad the mutants haven't eaten you yet.
Chasing profit isn't my business! I've got my own path... What about you?
What's going on here? I don't understand...

Me? Talked it over with the boys and decided someone has to protect this place! Let those treasure hunters get their teeth kicked in and crawl back. Then we'll see who was right. Our job is to protect the world from the Zone! Or at least this little piece of it...

Haven't you heard? Everyone's gone mad! Apparently the Brain Scorcher's off! So everyone without a backbone rushed to the center... Pripyat, the power plant itself... Artifact hunters! Talked it over with the boys and decided someone has to protect this place! Let those treasure hunters get their teeth kicked in and crawl back. Then we'll see who was right. Our job is to protect the world from the Zone! Or at least this little piece of it...
Marked One! Defend every inch of our land against the Zone!
Oh! How are you doing, man? What's wrong?
And... You... Ohhh...
Piss off... No, wait. Let's have a drink...

Listen, smart guy... Stop interrupting...\nWhere was I?... Oh, yes! Hundreds of zombies coming at us. We keep them away from the entrance. Shooting and shooting, but they keep coming. Tough bastards. Fall down, get back up. Climb over heads, over bodies. Like tanks, straight at us. More coming out of other gaps... We shoot... Shoo... ting... Still coming... Hrr...
Hey! Asleep or something? What happened next? Zombies came at you, fine. Keep going. What happened after the zombies?

Huh?... Zombies? Yes! That's it!\nWe can see we're in trouble. Rifles hot, ammo running out, and they keep coming... Coming... Zombies... Right, said that already... I tell Seryoga: drop the first ones to slow the others, then run straight for those doors. Small chance, but it's a chance. Stay here and we're dead... Or we'll become like them...
By the way, someone told me you can't go far at Yantar without turning into a zombie. How did you survive?
I'm sick of your interruptions! Don't believe me, do you? No respect? Think I'm standing here lying? Seen this gray hair?!
All right, all right... I'll shut up. Go on.

Damn! Lost my train of thought... Zombies... Uh... Right!\nAgreed on a count and ran. Made it to the entrance, pressed ourselves against it, but didn't know what next. An Electro was blocking the way. Then we heard this snuffling, almost snoring... Ever heard a snork snuffle? What would you know, rookie... One would have you shaking. This was coming from several directions... And the zombies stopped milling around outside the shed. Slowly started turning toward us. That was it! Seryoga, my friend, says: let's get through the Electro. It switches off sometimes. What do you mean, switches off? He'd noticed it seemed to fade out now and then. Only for a couple of seconds...
Uh... Sorry, not trying to interrupt, but how do you notice something like that with snorks around?

It does... Sens... What do you call it... Heightened senses. Understand? He noticed...
No time to think. Snorks about to swarm us. He signals: go! I ran and got through. Heard a blast behind me. Waited. Shouted, called him. No answer. Crept to a window and saw... Wish I hadn't... That pack of snorks over his body...
Sat a couple of minutes. What was I waiting for? For them to finish with him and come for me? Stupid. Had to run for the exit while they were busy. Didn't matter where I died, inside or out. So I waited for the Electro to fade for a couple of seconds and ran. Found the way out by some instinct. Ran without looking. Anywhere far away. Came to my senses near the scientists' bunker. They asked where this gray-haired fellow had come from. I started telling them. Couldn't stop talking...
Then I asked for help. Maybe Seryoga was still alive, or had managed to hide... They said it was too late. Emissions were active there now. What fucking emissions? There hadn't been anything... Turns out we'd happened to go in when the emissions were off. That's when I broke completely. Sat right down where I stood. Realized another five minutes and I'd have been a zombie myself... They say I sat there a long time, muttering and holding my head. Don't remember that...
That's my "interesting" adventure. God spare you anything like it. Why am I telling you? You haven't understood a thing...
Yeah, I've figured a few things out...
Well... Go on, pour me one.
Oh! You're done for already. Well, goodbye...
Let's drink! What's wrong with me? Curious, are you? You're all curious at first. Run into what I've seen, and the curiosity goes away. Curious, he says...
What did you see, anyway? Stop waving your hands. You've spilled more than you've drunk...
My hands... And have you seen this gray hair?! Exactly...
Come on. Tell me what happened to you.

Hang on... Another drink. Can't tell this dry.\nSo... Once, a friend and I were at Yantar. On the grounds of that... You've probably heard. Factory, plant, whatever used to be there. We went in. Quiet enough. Started working our way deeper, and then it began. Zombies poured out of every gap... Dozens. No, hundreds! Not lying. Like cockroaches. Nowhere to hide. Barely made it into some shed. They came straight at us, a whole crowd.
Wait, I don't follow. Are you definitely talking about Yantar?
I'd like to ask a few things.
What do you want to know?
Who are you, and how did you get here?

My surname is Kruglov. I'm a professor of biology studying the Zone. Just yesterday, for example, I encountered a very interesting species: Antropomorphus Dendromutantus Vulgaris. I mainly discover and describe new species of mutated animals, their behavior and characteristics. I then analyze that information and send it to the outside world. Some goes to the Barkeep, of course. My discoveries have saved stalkers' lives more than once. I was bringing my research results to Yantar when our helicopter came under fire.
Tell me about the Zone.

The Zone is a remarkable gift to humanity. Of course, you can't live here. Radiation, anomalies, mutants. All deadly, certainly, but of immense scientific value. Almost a natural experiment. A reserve for scientists. It's hard to imagine what studying the Zone will do for science. Technologies, medicines, new varieties of plants, medicinal and edible. Biotechnology, cures for incurable diseases, and who knows what else. Perhaps we'll solve the food problem for the entire planet. If only people would stop interfering, we might already be leading humanity into a "golden age."
The Duty boys think otherwise, and Freedom isn't exactly eager to help you either.
You can't see the whole picture, on a global scale. Problems here and now matter more to you than any future progress.
Maybe there is some use in studying the Zone.

You see it too? How pleasant to meet someone who isn't a narrow-minded pragmatist. I've always said we must look at the problem more broadly, set aside our human yardsticks. Even if the Zone does harm, it can also bring benefits. Enormous benefits, I assure you.
Why are the mercenaries after this information?

No offense, but stalkers are like children. What they learn has a powerful effect on them. Look at their legends. The wish-granting Monolith, for example. It's a kindergarten. Except the games here involve weapons and cost lives. Some stalkers act like offended children being denied dangerous information. Only they're holding rifles, not sticks. Nothing restrains their use of force. They readily open fire and kill Zone researchers. They imagine that getting this information will open the gates to the center. Naive fools. Unfortunately, very dangerous fools.
I'm looking for Lab X-16. Do you know where it is?
X-16? Hmm... Sakharov mentioned something like that, but I can't remember. Better ask him. He's at Yantar, in the mobile laboratory.
I'm afraid I have to go. Good luck.

Stalker, help! We were returning from Yantar when mercenaries shot our helicopter down. The pilots and three of our ecologists died. The mercenaries shot one of them. We're not fighters. We're scientists... What could we do...
Why did the mercenaries need it?

We were investigating a route through Yantar to Radar. Rumor has it there may be quite a few artifacts at Radar, and perhaps a direct route to the reactor itself. Psi-field intensity is uneven. With enough observations, we may be able to develop protection that allows people to cross those lethal emissions.
So what? What would that do for the mercenaries?

Apparently someone can't wait to reach the center of the Zone and the Monolith. So he, or they, hire these "soldiers of fortune" to seize any information that could help.\nSorry, I haven't introduced myself. Kruglov's my surname. What should I call you?

Call me Marked One. Heard something about the Monolith and the Zone's center already. What is it? Why is someone looking for information about it, and why would you know anything? And what did you want from me?

Marked One, you seem an experienced stalker, but you ask too many questions. If we get out, I'll answer them all. Not now, though. We've lost our weapons, our communications, our research results... Most importantly, three months of work are gone. Or are they? The mercenaries only just left. Maybe you could negotiate with them? Get a copy of our data back, at least? Or perhaps inform Sakharov, head of the scientific expedition at Yantar, about the incident?
Negotiate with the mercenaries? What's in it for me?
Head to Yantar? I was going that way anyway...
I can help with weapons. Can you pay?
The Barkeep has communication gear. Should I bring a radio?
Let me take you to Yantar instead...
Listen, Kruglov, your problems aren't my concern...
Don't worry! You'll be compensated. I promise! I have information you'll find very useful.\nThe mercenaries headed toward Yantar. Weren't in any hurry.
Thank you, Marked One. I'll write Sakharov a few lines. He'll reward you. Hurry, though. You know the Zone's dangerous. Anything could happen...
We have a little cash. I also know a place with a rare artifact. Think we can agree... Don't forget the ammunition!
Yes, that would be very helpful... Please hurry! I'm afraid some mutant will show up, and that'll be it! We're done for...
Thank you very much! Just remember, we're scientists, not fighters... If anything happens, don't count on us too much. Once we're somewhere safe, I'll tell you something useful.
That's a shame. I hope you'll reconsider. We have very little chance of staying alive...
All right, I'll try to work something out...
All right, take care. I'm off to Sakharov...
All right, stay here. I'll try to find guns quickly.
I'll try to be quick...
Anyway, show me the way. Run if anything happens...
Keep hoping...
Marked One, is that you? Well, did you make a deal with the mercenaries?
I've run all over the place for your data!
I spoke to them. Their leader wants something...
What, exactly?
Hmm... Hold on.
Nothing yet. I'll let you know if I get anywhere.
Well, we're screwed. The mercenary leader kicked the bucket.
Did they give it to you? Got the data? Don't keep me waiting...
Never mind. Stay here. I'll try to be quick.
Well, that's how it is... We wait...
Don't worry about it. I don't need anything anymore.
He wants some unusual artifact...
An artifact?
Bucket? What... What bucket... Oh! Dead? What about our data? Anything?
Here. Their leader gave me the PDA. Says it's yours.
No, it didn't work out. Looks like your data's gone...
I don't know. There's no data.

Yes, mine... Looks like all the data's intact... Thank God we met a Duty squad. They shared their weapons. We'll try reaching Yantar ourselves now. Thank you for your help, Marked One! We can't offer much in return yet, but still...\nLook, there's a safe route from the Bar to the Army Warehouses here. Once you enter, turn right immediately. Follow the barbed wire and you'll see a small box. Hid a couple of artifacts there for myself. They're yours by rights...\nHmm... Oh! All right! There's another place! Look under the old excavator behind the factory at Yantar. Might find something...

Ahhh! Have to start over... Never mind... Thank God we met a Duty squad. They shared their weapons. We'll try getting to Yantar ourselves. Thanks for trying. If you go to Yantar, look under the old excavator behind the factory. Hid something there for a rainy day... Take care!
Ahhh! Have to start over... Never mind... Thank God we met a Duty squad. They shared their weapons. We'll try getting to Yantar ourselves. Thanks for trying. Take... Take care!
Take care, man of science...
Marked One! Have you been to Sakharov yet?
Yes, I gave him your note. Sakharov said he'd send a helicopter.
I haven't seen him... I had other things to do!
Thank God! We met a Duty squad. Shared their weapons. We'll wait...
Marked One! Did you find guns and ammo?
Yeah, I got it. Here's the rifle. Take it...
I already gave it to you...
I haven't found any weapons yet...
I've given everyone weapons already. Time to settle up.
Thanks. Have you armed my colleagues, too?
My colleagues need weapons too. Come back once you've armed everyone. We'll discuss your reward...
Yeah, gave each of them a gun...
No, not all of them yet...
All right, understood...

Excellent. We'll try reaching Yantar ourselves now. Thank you for your help, Marked One! We can't offer much in return yet, but still...\nLook, there's a safe route from the Bar to the Army Warehouses here. Once you enter, turn right immediately. Follow the barbed wire and you'll see a small box. Hid a couple of artifacts there for myself. They're yours by rights. Take a little money from us too, with our thanks.
All right, we'll see. It wasn't much trouble, really...
Hi, Marked One! Did you bring the radio?
Listen, Marked One, a helicopter carrying a special team will be here soon. Don't hang around here too much. You never know...
No time to talk. Move out!
Hi. Thanks for the help... Looking for something?
Well, Marked One? Think you could help us? We'll try to make it worth your while...
Head to Yantar? I was going that way anyway...
All right, I'll help with guns. You know how to use them?
I'm heading to the Bar. I'll ask the Barkeep for a radio.
Listen, Kruglov, your problems aren't my concern...
Thank you, Marked One. I'll write Sakharov a few lines. He'll reward you. Hurry, though. You know the Zone's dangerous. Anything could happen...
We can do it! And you won't lose out...
Yes, that would be very helpful... Please hurry! I'm afraid some mutant will show up, and that'll be it! We're done for...
That's a shame. I hope you'll reconsider. We have very little chance of staying alive...
All right, take care. I'm off to Sakharov...
All right, stay here. I'll try to find guns quickly.
I'll try to be quick...
Everyone makes their own luck...
Hi. Thanks for the help...
Marked One, stop running back and forth. Make up your mind...
I don't need you to teach me...
Time's precious, Marked One. You promised to tell Sakharov...
I'll let you know. Soon.
Take it. "This" is called a rifle! Press here...
I don't have a weapon for you...
I'll pull the trigger! Some Rambo you are...
Cool it, Terminator...
Did you get us weapons?
Here! You know which end the bullet comes out of?
I don't have any spare guns yet.
Yeah, from somewhere on the side, I think... Got any ammo?
I'll give you some... Funny guy...
How's it going with the radio? I'm getting hungry...
You'll get your radio. Calm down.
Thanks for your help. The helicopter will be here soon.
Come on, move out! We'll talk later.
Run!
Here's a rifle. You know how to use it?
Hold on, I don't have a gun for you.
We're not as dumb as some people. We'll manage...
Yeah, yeah, go on...
Thanks for the gun...

Still good. I've spoken to the right people. You can go to the Valley. None of Borov's men will shoot at you before you've spoken to him.\nMarked One, shall we finish that convoy business? Check the ambush site. If the cargo's there, I'll send men to collect it... Well? Don't worry about the reward. I've got a couple of unusual artifacts... You won't regret it!
All right, stop complaining... Thanks for the work! Here's something from me. A new, unusual artifact. Nobody's seen one like it!
All right, thanks. Take care...
Yes, an artifact. How are you doing? Still alive, I see.
Alive, thanks. While you were away, we met some Duty men. They called a rescue helicopter. Think we'll be flying out soon. How did it go?
Here's the situation. Their leader, Wolfhound, will return your PDA with the data in exchange for an artifact called Electric Beads. The question is where to find those Beads.

Electric Beads? Heard of it. As far as I know, you can't just find one. You have to throw particular ingredients into an anomaly. Wrote it down from what our colleague, Docent Semyonov, told me. Honestly, can't remember the details. Maybe visit Yantar and ask him? We'll be there too. Have to redo all our work. Sorry we can't take you along. The military's suspicious of stalkers.
All right, fly off. We'll meet again if we can.
Oh, something... How are you doing? Still alive, I see.
Alive, thanks. While you were away, we met some Duty men. They called a rescue helicopter. Think we'll be flying out soon. Did you reach an agreement?
Not exactly. Their leader, Wolfhound, will return your PDA with the data, but we have to scout the military base at Agroprom.

Could you try? Our gratitude will know no bounds. Within reason, of course. We'll be at Yantar for now. Have to redo all our work. Sorry we can't take you along. The military's suspicious of stalkers.
All right, fly off. We'll meet again if we can.
Barkeep, I met some scientists in the Wild Territory...
You meet all sorts in the Zone... What's it got to do with me...

Hear me out! The scientists' helicopter was shot down. Kruglov's their leader. Mercenaries stripped them of everything. Kruglov wants a radio so he can call for help. Can you help with communications?
Kruglov, you say? I can help... Not for free, of course. Tell you what, my good man. Give me an average artifact... I'll give you a radio. Settle up with Kruglov yourself. Deal?
All right, it's a deal! Here's the artifact...
Hmm, no... I haven't got an artifact...
You're alive? Good... I brought the radio...
Excellent! Give it here, I'll call the helicopter...
Here. But... It cost me money, not to mention all the time I lost... You understand?

Absolutely! Of course we owe you!\nLook, there's a safe route from the Bar to the Army Warehouses here. Once you enter, turn right immediately. Follow the barbed wire and you'll see a small box. Hid a couple of artifacts there for myself. They're yours by rights. Take a little money from us too, with our thanks.
All right. I think the artifacts will come in handy...
Then it's a deal. Here's the radio. If you go to Yantar, give Sakharov my regards...
All right, I'll pass it on... Been running around so much I forgot to ask. Heard anything about the Monolith?
All sorts of rumors. Some say it's an artifact. Others say just a stone somewhere in the center. For some reason they all insist it grants wishes... Experts! Nobody knows anything for sure.
Someone must have told the story first, though. Someone has to know for certain. Why all this interest in the Zone's center?
You're awfully curious. Am I supposed to know everything? I know what people say here. Ask the stalkers. Maybe they'll tell you more.
I'll ask later. Kruglov's waiting for the radio right now.
No, it didn't work out... Their leader's dead...
And the data? The results of our work. Weren't they there?
No, I didn't find it.
That's a real shame... We'll have to start over. What do we do now? Maybe you could still help us?
I'm going to Yantar. I can pass word to Sakharov.
I need to go to the Bar. I'll ask the Barkeep for a radio.
How about I bring you weapons, and you make your own way?
Listen, work it out yourself. I'm going my own way.
Thank you, Marked One...
There's a bit of a problem with Rat.
A rat? Everyone's got problems. Some have lice, some have worms. You've got a rat, then?
Heard already. They say the little rat kicked the bucket... Did you finish your business with him?
Come on! You already said that. Bring two checks for a thousand dollars each. Then you'll get some information.
Ha ha! Very funny! That bandit called Rat had important information. How to get into the underground lab in the Dark Valley...
No, didn't get the chance... Everyone who knew where that underground lab in the Dark Valley was is dropping like flies...
Don't get all worked up at me. Meant no harm... Could've said straightaway you wanted the underground lab in the Dark Valley. Might have pointed you toward a lead sooner...
Stop dragging it out... Get to the point...
Know the saying, "Whoever has the information has everything"? No? Well, this information will cost you two checks. Interested?
Oh, for... Here's a couple of checks...

You'll earn more. Good relations last! Remember.\nBack to business... I've heard some documents weren't evacuated from the underground lab because the road used by the evacuation convoy was destroyed. South of the Dark Valley. Somewhere in what we now call the Gut. Heard someone stole a briefcase with some documents from the military recently. But some are still there. One of the hunters, Chinaman, said there were even maps. With entrances marked. Understand? Talk to the hunters. Find Chinaman, if he's still alive... Maybe something will turn up.
That's a mouthful!
Something's happened with Borov.
An opportunity? Heard Borov got slaughtered like a pig... Little play on words... What's your interest in it?
I heard already. Two checks, then I'll share the information...
I needed to ask him something. Something only he knew.
Hmm. As they say, what Borov knew, a pig might know too. In this particular case, Rat.
Rat? Who's that?
Heard the saying, "Knowledge is money"? No? Put it simply, then: two checks for a thousand dollars each, and I'll tell you where Rat is and who he is.
Here are your checks.

Money's dust. Good relations are diamonds! Remember. There's a fellow called Rat. Stole a lot of Borov's secrets! Try pulling his tail... My information says he was seen around the hunters in the Gut. Hurry, and you might catch him alive...
Where am I supposed to get that much?
There's a little job...
What kind?
Hey! About that order...
What? That music's blaring. I can't hear a thing...
All right, I agree. Here's the artifact. So, what now?
I think I'll give it some thought...
Still good. I've spoken to the right people. You can go to the Valley. None of Borov's men will shoot at you before you've spoken to him.
They say Borov had a little mishap. Got killed. But there's a fellow who took plenty of Borov's secrets.\nApparently seen in the Gut...
Zub keeps his word. You owe an artifact. Tier three, no less... Then everything will be fine. Remember?
Still good. I've spoken to the right people. You can go to the Valley. None of Borov's men will shoot at you before you've spoken to him.
Hello, hello. Did you want something?
The Barkeep said you know how to get into the laboratory. The underground one.
That incident? Just had to run my mouth while drinking...
So it's just talk? Not true?

Why wouldn't it be true... A friend went there. But the person who came back wasn't him anymore. His body, but his head wasn't working. Had a few pages from some collection of orders in his pocket. Mentioned a bunker, or maybe a laboratory... What was it? Kh... X... Anyway, written like this: "X-16." Nobody dared repeat his trip. So I can't say for certain whether it really led to that laboratory...
Where does that passage start?
Where does it start? There's an old mine adit in the Limansk nature reserve. We also call it the Red Forest. The entrance is near the forester's house. The tunnel starts at the end of the workings...
An old mine tunnel in the Red Forest...
There's a problem with the documents from the lab at Yantar...
What? Uh... Paper too tough for you? Or what?
Ha ha ha. Everyone's a comedian. I lost them somewhere. Or maybe someone swiped them...

Yes... Been saying for ages some people are born suckers. Not you, of course. Just came to mind.\nBe grateful I have copies. We scanned those documents. Work deserves payment, you understand! Bring a tier-two artifact, and you'll get the copies.
All right, it's a deal! Here's the artifact...
Hmm, no... I haven't got an artifact...
Here, don't lose it again... Or go ahead and lose it. I've got more. I like customers like you...
Careful! One of these days, those jokes will get you in trouble.
Cooked up a strange "Compass." Know anything about it?
Yes. Someone brought me one and explained some procedures for teleporting to different areas. Interested?
Cordon.
Good. Listen. After activating the teleport with a Ruby Compass, put a Sparkler on your belt and enter the anomaly that forms.
And what do you want for such valuable information?

Artifacts, of course. I know five possible teleport destinations: the Cordon, Dark Valley, Yantar, Army Warehouses, and Limansk. A tier-three artifact in good condition for each. I can offer a discount: an Absolute for information on every teleport I know. Which will it be?

Have you forgotten already? I told you before. All right, listen... \nI know five possible teleport destinations: the Cordon, Dark Valley, Yantar, Army Warehouses, and Limansk. For each one, I want a tier-three artifact in good condition. I can offer you a discount: give me an Absolute, and I'll tell you about every teleport I know. What will it be?
Dark Valley.
Good. Listen. After activating the teleport with a Ruby Compass, put a Droplet on your belt and enter the anomaly that forms.
Yantar.
Good. Listen. After activating the teleport with a Ruby Compass, put a Thorn on your belt and enter the anomaly that forms.
Army Warehouses.
Good. Listen. After activating the teleport with a Ruby Compass, put a Jellyfish on your belt and enter the anomaly that forms.
Limansk.
Good. Listen. After activating the teleport with a Ruby Compass, put a Slug on your belt and enter the anomaly that forms.
I'll buy all the recipes at once.

Good. Listen carefully. After activating the teleport with a Ruby Compass, put one of these artifacts on your belt, depending on your destination. 
 • Cordon: Sparkler 
 • Dark Valley: Droplet 
 • Yantar: Thorn 
 • Army Warehouses: Jellyfish 
 • Limansk: Slime
Nothing interests me right now.
Thank you.
Got your snide message. What's the news?
Well, listen carefully...
I've got two tier-three artifacts. Will they do?
Here's the PKM and the artifact for Cap. Hope it works out.
Thanks, but I haven't got that much yet. Another time...
I'll tell them in a few minutes to expect your gift within the next few days. You can go see your "enemies" now. Zub's word is law.
I'm willing to part with two capsules. Agreed?
Excellent. Thanks for the help!
Picked up two Dummies recently. Will that do?
I'll part with a Modified artifact.
A Mesomodified artifact would be even better.
I'll spare a Hypermodified artifact.
Can't be helped. Take the Absolute.
Take the Absolute.
I'd really like to patch things up with Sidorovich. No hard feelings.
Here's the thing. I've wronged a few people.
Conscience bothering you? Happens... Have some vodka. You'll feel better.
The paramilitary faction, Duty.

Well... Not exactly. Sometimes I need to earn a little. They don't trust me with good jobs, and find ways to trip me up. \nYou said you could sort out all kinds of business, didn't you? Could you help?
The hunters are keeping their distance.
Depends who you screwed over. Might help. Not free, naturally. Money makes your problems someone else's, as they say. Understand?
Borov's boys are giving me trouble.
I get it, I get it.
The mercenaries at the Warehouses despise me...
If you understood, you wouldn't have come to me. Get to the point. Who's giving you trouble?
I've upset the scientists.
Right, good. Go walk around for a couple of hours. I'll look into it.
Just ordinary guys. Stalkers.
It's a deal.
The potheads are pissed off at me.
I've changed my mind. Maybe another time.
Hello. I'm Marked One. Could we have a quick word?
A quick word? Sure, why not... What did you want?
They told me you got rid of the "Black Mark." Tell me how?

Caught a Black Mark? Nasty thing won't let go easily... Gave me hell! A zombified stalker's notes told me how to get rid of it. Was at Yantar asking the eggheads what to do... One of the zombies walked right into me... So I...
Brother, I'd love to hear the story another time! Be specific. You know this thing's pounding my head...

Huh? Yes... Sorry... There's a place in the Misty Thicket with a stone fragment. Maybe it isn't stone. It glows from inside, so I don't know... Anyway, if you stand near it during an emission, the Mark disappears. Some other kind of radiation affects the place, though. You won't last long... Stock up on medkits, antirads and vodka, then head there. Somewhere northwest, in a little valley.
All right, get rid of it and I'll owe you a bottle...
I went to see Ivar. He's on the mend.
You're visiting him a lot. He's looked better for ages without your help. Can talk properly now. Makes our Docent happy.
What's it to him?
Used to enjoy talking about lofty things with him. Theories, consciousness, subconscious, superconscious... All sorts of fantasies. Ask what they discussed.
I'll ask... sometime.
Everyone else rushed for the center ages ago. Why are you dragging your feet...
There's still time...
Only out of respect for what you've done, Marked One.
Money, artifacts... Here, take the rubles...
Sure, why not...
That's the spirit! [pours a shot] To a lucky find, Marked One. Maybe that capsule will produce something worthwhile...
If only the god of the Zone could hear you...
The cauldron's in use! Come back later...
I've got an ordinary little artifact. Take it.
Thanks, but I think I'll pass.
Suit yourself... Don't say I didn't offer. An extra drop never hurts in the Zone... For disinfection.
Right. Come back in half an hour. Should be cooked by then.
Here... A decent tier-two artifact.
I'd rather see Sidorovich. He's kinder.
I'm kind enough already... No profit, no deal...
A hundred grand... I'll try...
Yes! I've spoken to the right people. They're willing. Waiting for your share, then we can start work...
About your job with the documents.
Found something? \nOne little weasel tried palming off old accounting files as something interesting... Hope you don't think I'm an idiot? \nIf you've forgotten what to look for and where, here:
I went to the Gut. Dug something out of the abandoned convoy. Here.
Hmm... Well. Let's have a look...
Much obliged, of course...
I've been to that nasty place called X-18. Guess what I found in the pitch darkness?
Documents, perhaps? Or other useful junk for our common cause?
Exactly. Take the hard drives and documents... And what's my share?
Get your PDA out. I'll send you the recipe.
Uh... I think I'll go and have another look.
Wait, Marked One! Glanced through your papers. Looks like what we need. Need time to be more certain. We'll think... \nHere's an Emerald. It'll help...
There... That's better. I was starting to lose faith in people.
What are you unhappy about? Look harder. Maybe you missed something... Then the reward will be bigger too.
I already looked! Bring this, bring that...
Find the scientists' new protective suit. Protects the brain against psi-emissions. Rumor says a stalker with one disappeared in Radar's wooded area. Can you manage it in three or four days?
Got some kind of burner for an old friend?
A burner?.. Hmm. Interesting request. Hate to ask, but what the hell do you need it for?
I just got a terrible craving for smoked sausage!
Really?.. Let's say you're right. All right, I've got something. Seems to work. An ordinary artifact for it.
An artifact for that crap? Bit steep...
All right. I can spare it. Here's the artifact.
Heard you've got more artifacts than you know what to do with... If you need anything else, hair dye or nail-polishing files, don't be shy.\nHere's your burner. Soot up whatever you want...
Uh... I've got a tier-three artifact. The things I do out of the goodness of my heart...
Uh... I've got tier-two artifacts. The things I do out of the goodness of my heart...
Thanks. You've helped me out... I'm off to the stash for my things. Think it'll cover it. At least most of it.
Hurry up and get to the Barkeep. Time's running out.
I've been thinking... What was it you needed for your friend?
About barter. There's something I need.
Well! I didn't put that thing in my stuff! It appeared on its own!

Everyone says that... Someone told me it isn't quite an artifact. Rather, an artifact unlike the others.\nA parasite.\nCan disguise itself as any object to get picked up. Only shows its true nature once it's settled in.
Professor, I found something near the crashed helicopter.
In the Dark Valley? Our working sensors detected someone near the helicopter... That was you? Tell us what happened, and... How they died?

Don't know what happened. People who saw it fall said it came from the center, already damaged. Smoke from the engine... Pilots died outright. Two people in ecologist suits got out, but... A chimera den there. You understand...
Yes... The Zone's offspring... The more we learn, the more mysteries we uncover. Did you find anything that could shed light on their work?
Here. Just a container with some artifact, and documents...
Found the documents on one of the scientists. Here. There was more, but...
A container and documents, but... Stolen. Someone took them while I slept...

Thank you... Research on an artifact with varying phases! Sample in the container... Very interesting! Further experiments needed!\nUnfortunately, we can't offer material compensation. We're supplied with only essential equipment, but... We can help you transform artifacts.

Thank you... Research on an artifact with varying phases! Sample placed in a maximum-protection container! A shame you couldn't investigate the crash site more thoroughly. We'll have to ask our friends in Duty...\nUnfortunately, we're supplied with only essential equipment and can't offer material compensation, but...\nHad a new, untested anomaly detector somewhere... Here! Please take it...
A shame, a great shame... If you find it, bring it in.
Professor, I found the container and the documents!
From the Dark Valley? Excellent! Let me have it...
Here. There you go...
Sorry, I don't have it on me yet.

Thank you... Let's see... Research on an artifact with varying phases! Sample in the container... Very interesting! Further experiments needed!\nUnfortunately, we can't offer material compensation. We're supplied with only essential equipment. Though... Take this:
All right, I'll try to find your rat...
I heard you had a mechanic who was good with weapons?
There was someone. Poisoned himself a couple of months ago... Drank counterfeit vodka, the idiot. Fell asleep and never woke up. What else can you say...
What do you want from me?
Simple job. Examine the body, find distinguishing details, report back. Result: you get a decent gun, I sleep peacefully.\nFair?
I suppose. Where do I go? What "distinguishing features" am I looking for?
Sounds easy. Ever gone into those anomalies yourself? Try it...

Thought so. I can tell you're an old hand, Marked One! Now, business:\nOur associate called from the Garbage. His name's none of your concern. My lackeys saw a body they thought was his in a little grove beyond the vehicle graveyard. They were too scared to get closer. Anomalies everywhere. If you get through, check it. The fellow never parted with his harmonica. Believed it saved him from every scrape. Find it on the corpse, and it's him. If not, we need to get out of here and change all our hiding places.
Your call. I make the offer, you make the choice. I'll find someone else who's interested...
Shame. Wanted to trade him for an MP5 in PM caliber. Never mind...
Hmm, actually, there are a couple of those guns left... With ammo so scarce, a lot of people wanted weapons like that.
And? I take it I won't get this marvel of technology for nothing?
You've got it... There's a little job. Need to confirm someone's death...
I don't kill on contract! Find another mercenary!
Notice I said confirm, not kill. An old associate got into a situation with no way out. Literally. Went through anomalies for an artifact, took radiation, couldn't get back. Died there.
So what? Plenty of people kick the bucket...

You're right in general, but not here. He's an old associate, been with us a long time. Knew a lot of things, and a lot of people.\nI'm wondering whether he really died, or decided to sell us out to Duty or the military... Convenient, isn't it? You're dead, and nobody bears you a grudge. He got caught too easily, if that was him. Doesn't fit an experienced crook.
Listen, Borov, about that job with your accomplice...
How's the job going?
I've changed my mind. I'm not going into those anomalies...
Tell me again where the body is.
Found your corpse. Almost died in the anomalies myself...
