Don't play for a better price. Was it him? Was the accordion there?
Lost your nerve? All right, your choice...

Thought you had a brain, Marked One. Again:\nOur associate called from the Garbage. My lackeys saw a body supposedly his beyond the vehicle graveyard, in a small grove. Check whether it has a harmonica.\nThat's it!
All right, all right. Can't a man ask...
It was him! Here's the accordion. Took it off the body...
It was him! And the accordion was on the body.
There wasn't an accordion!
Whew, damn! Thank God! Thanks, you've set my mind at ease... As agreed, here's the modified MP5! A little gift for my peace of mind too: ammunition for it!
Where's the accordion? Have you got it on you, or what?
Damn! Had a feeling! We'll have to shut down all our hideouts... The boys will be "delighted"... I promised you an MP5 chambered for pistol ammunition. Here.
All right, as a favor...
No, I didn't take it. He'd covered it in radioactive vomit... My health matters more...
Shame. Borov keeps his word, though. As agreed, here's the modified MP5! I'll tell my boys to stay alert, just in case... Take a little ammo too...
I checked the underground entrance. Think that rubble can be cleared.
You think so? Well, well... Go clear it. What's it to me...
Get about ten men together and we could clear it in half a day. Can you help? Spare your boys to clear the blockage...
Clear the rubble? What are my boys, Tajiks?
I understand... I'll try to pay what I can.

Sure! 10 artifacts... Tier one... Each... Relax, joking. Heard you helped find a PDA. Good man. Did right by the code. Bring my boys 10 cans of meat, as much bread, and 10... No, too much... 5 bottles of vodka. They'll tear open a pharaoh's tomb for you.\nOh! And 10 cans of that hangover cure...

Compensate?.. What was that shooting? Fellow came running, eyes bulging... You kill the crooks at the factory? I'll smooth it over. Thought they could live without Papa Borov, by their own rules. Served them right! Won't give my men to clear the blockage, though. "Compensate" one lot today, mine tomorrow? Turning a blind eye, but don't ask again. Clear it yourself or find someone. Plenty of people around. Understood?

Sure! 10 artifacts... Tier one... Each... Relax, joking. Hard, labor-intensive work. Bring my boys 30 cans of meat, as much bread, and 15 bottles of vodka. They'll tear open a pharaoh's tomb for you.\nOh! And 15 cans of that hangover cure...

Sure! 10 artifacts... Tier one... Each... Relax, joking. Hard, labor-intensive work. Bring my boys 30 cans of meat, as much bread, and 15 bottles of vodka. They'll tear open a pharaoh's tomb for you.\nOh! And 15 cans of that hangover cure...
All right, I'll have that done in no time!
I see. Well, they've only got themselves to blame!
About clearing the rubble...
What else? We've discussed everything... You bring the horilka and something to eat... We'll figure it out. Don't worry.

Heard about trouble at the factory. Fellow came running, eyes bulging... You kill the crooks? I'll smooth it over. Thought they could live without Papa Borov, by their own rules. Served them right! Won't give my men to clear the blockage, though. "Compensate" one lot today, mine tomorrow? Turning a blind eye, but don't ask again. Clear it yourself or find someone. Plenty of people around. Understood?
Uh...
There! I brought everything, as agreed.
Slipped my mind. How much do you need?
Hmm... All right, I'll go get it.

All right. I did promise... It's hard work. Go find something to do for about... 10 hours. Don't hang around there. Our boys don't know you well, and I don't want them thinking they're working for you. Come back when I signal. Get some sleep, prepare... Remember, you're going in first, since you asked for it. Then we'll see if it's worth following you.

Fuck... Thought my mutts were stupid, but apparently not just them...
For those without a working brain:
Vodka, in bottles: 15!
Food, in round cans: 30!
Bread, not-too-stale loaves: 30!
Energy drinks: 15 cans...
Clear?

Fuck... Thought my mutts were stupid, but apparently not just them...
For those without a working brain:
Vodka, in bottles: 5!
Food, in round cans: 10!
Bread, not-too-stale loaves: 10!
Energy drinks: 10 cans...
Clear?
All right. I'll wait for the signal.
Nothing. Just lying there like a corpse. Searched him, found nothing.
Certain now? No doubts. Just thought of something. Little rat kicked the bucket, then... Good riddance. Here's our special coat for finding the bastard. Protects from bullets, helps carry loads...

Certain now? Not doubting. Thought of something. Little rat kicked the bucket... Good riddance. Our special coat for finding him. Protects from bullets, helps carry loads...\nForgot! Wanted the underground scientists' entrance? Sketched a diagram. You'll find it. Very close.
A coat, you say? Hmm...
So you've left the Valley?
Well, the facts are staring you in the face, as they say. Why ask when you can see the answer?
I don't understand any of this...
You don't need to understand. Keep moving. Don't draw attention here...
What brought you here? I thought you worked the outskirts...
Are you a prosecutor? Interesting questions you're asking.
Well... Strange. Only stalkers usually go into a hellhole like that.
Yes... The shepherds thought Borov would only guard the perimeter and urge the poor sheep toward fresh grass. Forgot Borov's a shepherd too. Not a sheep, or a dog on a chain.
What? What shepherds? What dogs and sheep?
Shepherds above shepherds. Bosses, fuck... Don't worry. Less you know, better you sleep. Unnecessary questions give you headaches, and there's no doctor nearby to treat them...
What about the Doctor?.. Do you know where he is, by the way?

The little doctor was curious too. Without Papa Borov's protection, that curiosity would've caught up with him. Now keeps his tongue up his ass and stays quiet. Alive, though. Some people can swallow it. Doctor might still be useful...
Yeah, I'm all right. More or less.
You look rough... You should rest somewhere. A sanatorium, maybe. Otherwise...\nAll right.\nBusiness?
I've been thinking... About your reputation services.
Unhappy about what? Something done badly? Tell me, I'll punish someone at random...
I'll manage on my own, without your services.
No... Oh! All right! Leave everything as it is.
Careful, lad... You never know. Might shoot you by mistake. But you're the boss! All right, we'll take our man off you.
Interesting. I take it this isn't for nothing?

You're smart. Goodwill's worth a lot. Give me a quarter of your loot sales every day, and I'll handle misunderstandings here. Misunderstandings, mind! Get yourself into serious shit through stupidity, and there's no washing it off... What do you think?
A quarter? Every day? Isn't that a bit much? What if I don't need it?

Think about it. Need someone with the right information. Costs money. Might need to grease someone's palm too... If you don't need it anymore, come say: sorry, friend, I'll manage. No hard feelings! Business... Decided?
Yes, rumors can do a lot of harm. I agree!
I'll come to you if I need anything.
Wise choice! Protect your honor, as they say... You understand... Preparing and spreading the right rumors takes time, though. Keep that in mind...
Just ask! Borov wouldn't offer you a bad deal!
How's life? Need help with something? You know what I mean?
Your boss asked me to pass on some funny numbers.
What commander? Voronin? What do I care about him?... In short, he can shove his orders!
No, someone else. His surname's Ivantsov.
Svyat? What message did he send? Stop being cagey!
Well... I said twenty-nine. Thirteen and eight were out, apparently. Didn't say where they went. Why "holy," though?
Twenty-ni-i-ine. Understood. Svyat because his name's Svyatoslav. Tell him Skull understood everything. Say: seven, seventy-two. Got it? He'll give you supplies. Thanks. We'll work out what to do.
Oh! More childish games.
What is this Thicket?
In the Misty Thicket? I'll have a look. Might find something.
There's a place here. Not of this world at all. I don't go there, and I don't advise anyone else to.
Your call. Just don't find an early death... Up to you, though.
I'd like a look at your "selection."
What have you got for us? Blind dog tails or boar hooves?
We'd love to, but the stalkers bought everything...
I see. A shame.
I'm here for Prapor from the Garbage. We urgently need bloodsucker tentacles for medicine. Can you help?
About those dead men's hands...
What have you got?
I'm still collecting them...
Well... We can help. Talk to our Prosha. He should have tentacles to trade.
You need bloodsucker tentacles? For medicine? What kind of wondrous medicine do you make from a bloodsucker?
I don't know. He makes it himself.
I've got nothing to trade right now... I'd hunt some mutant parts, but the medicine's urgent.
If Prapor sent you, as you say, I can help. Sorry, not free... Bloodsucker mandibles are rare and expensive. Can't just give them away. Got a job. Help me, I'll help you.
What's the job? Tell me, don't keep me waiting.
Good timing. Got an order for a sturdy coat from the Swamps. Doesn't concern you... Need five dead men's hands for it. Get them, you'll get bloodsucker tentacles.
Where am I supposed to get them? Five, at that?

No problem. Abandoned estate a little west of here, crawling with walking dead. Zombies. Nasty things. Hard to kill with buckshot, ugly as sin. Killing animals is one thing...\nOur hunters won't go. Don't want those "Children of the Zone" myself. Give me chills...\nYour job, Marked One. Do it, get a bloodsucker part. Get ten dead men's hands, and I'll give two jaws. Have a pair saved. Need zombie hands badly now. Think, but don't delay.
I'll go and have a look at this estate...
Here, I got five zombie hands.
Good man, Marked One! Decent sort, I can see that. Hand them over. Here's a tentacle. One of them. Shame you didn't get ten...
Just what I've got...
Here are those zombie grabbers. Ten of them!
Good man, Marked One! Saw straightaway you were decent. How many creatures did you kill? Hand them over. A couple of bloodsucker tentacles, as agreed. Take them! Spoil quickly, unfortunately...
Thanks! Well, I'm off...
Wait, wait. Don't rush off, Marked One...
Did something happen? You look frightened.

There's something... Honestly, you just proved yourself. Handled a whole pack alone. Experienced at this... Ordinary hunters like us avoid it. Hunting's one thing, these dark offspring of the Zone another... Help with something else. We'll pay generously.
Get to the point. Enough beating around the bush. If I can help, I will. If not, I'll be on my way.

Listen. Bad rumors have been going around lately. Strange things happen at night in the abandoned village nearby... We've heard noises from there for three nights. You can hear them even here. Someone screaming like a little child crying, then howling. Gives you chills... People have started disappearing, too. Our hunters, Pashka Komarov and Seryoga Lozhkar, didn't return yesterday. They were hunting around there. Several people vanished before that. Something's wrong...\nIt's north of here, a little before the bridge. Good hunting, plenty of animals. We used to go there for fleshes often. Now I don't know what to do. Zombies pestering us on one side, God knows what on the other... We may have to leave this place soon.
So what do you suggest?

Men are scared. Give the village a kilometer's berth. Can't force anyone. You're experienced, proved yourself, know weapons...\nGo see what's happening. Unknown creature settled there? We'd feel safer without it. Understand... Will you do it, Marked One?
Right... Quite a job you've given me. I'm not armed right now, used all my ammo on zombies. Need to hurry too. Make medicine, save a friend...

I understand. That evil only becomes active around midnight. It dies down by dawn, and it's quiet during the day. You've got time to prepare. Do your business, then come by tonight... Will you help your fellow stalkers? We don't have your virtual money, but we've got something better. Help us, and we'll repay you properly. Well, what have you decided?
All right, Ignat. I'll try to sort out your problem. You helped me, after all. I'll be here tonight. Need to go for now...
No, I'm not tackling "That" bare-handed. Haven't got time anyway...
I dealt with your problem. The village is cleared!
Really? What was there? We did notice the sounds had died down. The roaring stopped.
"Children of the Zone" made a home there. A controller, and something else. Couldn't understand what... Or who... Better you don't know. Sleep better. Took some doing...
No reason to doubt you. Good work, Marked One! Helped us all. Never doubted you.\nAs for that village, better I don't know. As you said, sleep better. Everyone's been on edge lately anyway...
Didn't you mention something about payment?
Here's another mutant mandible. Rare, valuable goods.\nWhy the face? Expected something substantial instead of this stink? What else can we give... Take five sausages and some buckshot too.
All right, we'll see. Thanks!

Thank you! Wait... Some information. Want to keep that mandible from spoiling? Scientists in the western Swamps have a base, study mutants. Know flesh preservation. Prosha visits to save valuable goods. Ask Pakhom, their boss, apparently. Say I sent you. He'll help.
Well, damn! Valuable information. All right, I'll get going. Been here longer than I meant to...
Where's your virtuoso with the axe?
Business. Had to go to the Swamps. What's your interest?
I wanted to trade some mutant innards...
Promised he'd be here in two or three days. Who knows how it'll go in the Zone.
Where's Prosha, your virtuoso with the axe?
He sleeps in the mornings. Come back in the afternoon.
Where is he? I need him urgently...
I told you, the man's resting! Everyone wants something. Come back when the sun's shining on your head...
Would you sell me some mutant parts?
Well... No. Mutants are dangerous. Giving up parts we've worked hard to hunt for the rubles stalkers can offer... Doesn't make sense for us.
No other options?
Talk to our Prosha. Sometimes he builds up a stock of some parts and runs short of others. Might trade one kind for another...
Who's Prosha?
Our virtuoso with the axe... Our butcher. There he is...
Our virtuoso with the axe... The butcher. Away on business. Back soon...
If the knife isn't made of tin, I'll take it...
Give me some credit. We use them ourselves. You won't regret it.
Hand over your artifact. I'm sick of hauling all these cans on my back. I'll put my back out at this rate.
A rare specimen. Called "Pizza." You won't regret it.
A discount? That would come in handy...
Excellent choice. As a hunter, I can tell you you won't regret it!
Let's be honest, friend. You're a decent man, but see it from my side: someone comes, claims someone sent him, asks for our goods... Words don't fill your stomach, do they?
Are you asking me?
I don't know. Where do you get plans, drawings, diagrams like that?

How would I know! Rainbow was secret. Only name and approximate location known, from indirect archival evidence. Even the name might just be a code word. Secret plans don't lie in the road. Strelok was bluffing, or Ivar misunderstood. You say he's not himself.

Sane or not... I understood him as I did. Strelok gave him drawings. Could Ivar turn it off without knowing how? Secret facility. Suddenly he switches it off. Where'd he learn where and how? What archive?
Stop pestering! A secret archive like that won't open for at least 50 years. Only possible if he came from... The future, where it's no secret anymore... Leave me alone! See Fedotov...
All right, all right... Take care... You're right. Why am I pestering you? Where did you say Fedotov was?
I already told you, on the other side. You'll find it.
Yeah. I'll find it. No need to see me off.
Friend, spare some medicine. I can barely walk...
You do look... But understand: if I give away my supplies, what do I do? No pharmacy here. Could trade an ordinary artifact, of course. From my emergency reserve.
All right, all right. Here's the artifact.
Vergas, I'm going to die! I haven't got any artifacts.
Ah, my friend... What are you doing to yourself!
Here, a pair of antirads and two special medkits. Mind you, that's all I've got for now.
How could you... Set out without supplies? Got a head on your shoulders? All right, here's a ration. Eat. A special medkit too. First and last time, mind.
Thanks. You saved me. I'll pay you back sometime.
Remember that decoder? Have you fixed it?
Of course. As agreed. You did bring the artifact, right?
Yes. Here's the artifact. How does this thing work?
Damn, forgot. Wait. A tier-two one, you said... I'll bring it.

Here it is. Simple to use: connect it, switch it on, and try combinations of four digits. There are two columns of lights. Lights in the left column show how many digits are in the combination but in the wrong positions. Lights in both columns show how many digits are present and in the right positions. You'll have to work out which digits go where... It resets automatically after eight attempts. Once every light comes on, switch it off and enter the combination without removing the device. Remember: enter the combination while it's still connected. Only disconnect it afterward.
Seems a bit complicated...
What can you do? Practically fixed it on my knee. Had to simplify a few things... Works, though. That's what matters.
All right, I'll try. I'll walk over there. Who knows...
How's that diagram of the guard posts coming along?
I'll draw it if there's enough food... Did you bring it?
Yeah, as agreed... Here, eat up.
You eat a lot. I couldn't get that much...
Thanks... Drew this from memory... Who knows, though. Something might have changed already.
Nothing at all? Ah... I'm so hungry!
All right, we'll see... Take care...
I'll bring it. Don't worry...
Soldier, I've got a little job for you.
Business with me? I leave everyone alone. No harm from me. Why the sudden interest?
Don't get worked up... I need to get into the institute quietly. No shooting. Understand?
Could use a proper meal and drink. Might think better then... Some canned meat, bread, something sweet to drink. Eh? Could you treat me?
I'll give you enough to eat for the rest of your life! Talk...
Always hungry... How much do you want?
Oh, sir... Don't hurt me... Sanyok drew up the duty rosters. He knows how it all works. They always stuck me on kitchen duty...
Not much. Five cans of food. Loaves... Hmm, five too. And that good drink, energy drinks, to wash it down... Ten cans...
Don't play dumb... Who's Sanyok? Where's that bastard?
Boy, can you eat! Stay put, I'll bring it...
My friend Sanyok... Went to see Sidorovich at the Cordon a couple of days ago. Should've been back ages ago. Not lying. Honestly...
Careful, you bastard! God help you if you lied! You'll regret being born...
I found this soldier's album at Agroprom.
What? Think I've never seen soldiers' discharge albums? Made one myself... Youth. Memories! I'll take it. Can give you a battery. Deal?
All right, I agree. It's certainly no use to me.
No way! There are maps in there, diagrams...
Feeling nostalgic myself. Yeah... Here, take this.
Then take it... Carry it around yourself.
I'll give it to you, Vergas. In a little while...
I get it... I'm not stupid...
That watch is too fancy. I'd like something simpler.
I don't need batteries. I won't take them.
Could bandage myself with my undershirt. Something more substantial, please.
That bread goes bad too quickly. I won't finish it in time.
Vergas, I'm back with that "mug."
By all means! Look as long as you like.
Take it, then. Ah, the trouble that thing's given me...
A shame, yeah... That thing's given me so much grief...
Sorry I didn't give it straight away. You know my head's not all there.
Thanks kindly. Just ask, I'll always help.
This loot's no use to me. Can I swap it?
Thanks for that, at least.
Not a museum exhibit. Give me the reward, take the mug.
No, same one. Take it off me. Just taking up backpack space.
Sure, have a look. I don't mind.
Leave me alone!
Come to tease an old man again?
Thanks again for the find, Marked One. Here's something for your trouble:
Let me have another look. Just wipe my glasses first.
Never mind. You'll have that with your tea yourself. Don't be so upset. Take this for your trouble:
Knew your head wasn't right after the death truck, Marked One. But not this bad! That's it! Don't bring that mug to me again.
Maybe you'd like a cuckoo clock?
Don't go wandering around at night?
Get into a tushkano nest, and you'll remember those bandages.
At least the crust's crunchy. Best thing to eat with an unexpected shot.
What, found another one?
Let me have another look. I've got my doubts...
Something's wrong with my memory. Can't remember without artifacts.
A mercenary, here? Why would he be?
Here are two tier-three artifacts. Get those papers out. We'll look through them together.
Oh! Damn you. All right, I'll look.
Life's hard, Marked One. Worse now. Everyone scattered. Nobody brings anything decent. Should be coming from the north with sacks by now, but nobody in sight...
All right, don't get carried away. Back to business... Where are those papers about flooded tunnels and pumps?

Tunnels, pumps... Remember something. Switch it on in one place, pumps elsewhere. Didn't look closely. Papers are gone. Not a wastepaper warehouse. Zub came by for old times' sake and took the bundle.
What?! Two valuable artifacts for this worthless thing?!

First, your artifacts paid an earlier promise, not these data. Second, it's information: power switching in one place, pumps elsewhere, papers given to Zub. Apparently in Limansk now. Fair. Stop staring, unclench fists. Know I may still help, and everything costs. Cool down...
All right... I'll be back.
What choice have you got? Some free food for thought: a fellow came recently, apparently a mercenary. Asked about underground passages too. Not necessarily those, but any leading north.
Still hanging around here? Everyone's rushed off to the center. Careful, you'll miss your share...

Let stalkers go there. Quieter here. Especially now. No random shooting like before at the Bar. Get drunk, start shooting... Kill each other. Then claim they remember nothing, as if a demon or someone else's consciousness possessed them...
So? It's possible after all?

What? Oh, the device... Told him it might theoretically be possible, treating the mind as a computer. But someone implanted with another's consciousness might not retain their own. One would be erased, or they'd mix... Pure speculation anyway.
And what did he say?
He said there was probably someone wandering around the Zone with another person's consciousness...
Who?..
How would I know? \nSemetsky, probably. All just talk. Unrealistic. Only meant the man's sometimes got interesting stories. Plenty to talk about with him...
Interesting... I'll go. Not feeling well. Need to think...
Speaking of someone else's consciousness... Heard anything interesting about that here? People tell each other all sorts of stories.
Talked about it once... Can't remember who told it. If you're going to discuss it with anyone, though, it's Ivar...
Yes... Ivar's having a hard time. He's a decent man, though. Doesn't talk for the sake of it.
Tell me about it. Had nobody to talk to. Ivar's a decent man. Interested in all that: the noosphere, consciousness...
So what did you say he told you?..
Said there's a device that can transfer someone else's consciousness into another mind... Implant it. Like keeping a computer's operating system but replacing all the working data.
So? Does he know where a device like that is, or has he used it?

No. Understood it as a theoretical discussion: could this be done to a human mind? Mental exercise. His argument, my counterargument. Interesting talking to someone intelligent. Was interesting... He's not up to it now.
Docent! Here's the capsule. Don't keep me waiting... What was in there?
I haven't got an artifact right now...
Strange capsule inside. Wouldn't advise carrying it! Who knows what part of you it affects...\nTake it... Container too. Out of my sight...
A strange thing, indeed. What do I do with it now?
Marked One, did you ask me to open the container? I opened it. The rest isn't my problem. Go...
All right... Thanks for that, at least.
I've got an artifact... What's in there?
Will you take a Dummy?
I've got a decent Modified artifact here. Deal?
Found a strange case at the Garbage. Will you take a look?
Why not? I'm free right now. Show me...
Well, will this take long?
Right... Easy enough, but it'll cost you a tier-tw... \nAhem. A tier-two artifact.
Agreed... I brought just the thing with me.
Done! Not much. Look... \nPapers, a broken PDA with a recipe, old Soviet rubles. \nDon't be so upset. Could've been worse. Better luck next time.
Thanks for your work.
Isn't that a bit much for something so small? Sorry, changed my mind.
You're the boss. If you change your mind, you know where to find me. Don't forget your case...
Of course.
You need PDAs? Here, take a couple.

Strip the nonsense from stalker stories, and this strange place apparently exists. Out of the way. Mentions guides, or one guide, who knew a safe path... District Center and Tesla come up together too. Not a direct link, just conversation... That's all.
Not much... Nobody mentions the scientists?
No... Most of the PDAs people bring me belonged to stalkers or bandits. Go see them yourself. Maybe they'll tell you something at Yantar.
I understand that... I thought you might know something specific, to save me wearing out my boots for nothing.
Could we work out another deal?
Fifteen thousand rubles, or a good tier-one artifact.
I've got this tier-one artifact. Will it do?
I've got a tier-two artifact. Take it.
Here are your rubles.
I've changed my mind. Another time.
Damn, I forgot about the PDA. Hold on.
Docent, I've found a PDA... Strange records on it. Looks like someone was handling contracts through it.
So what? People use all sorts of things. Big Zone, even more people wanting to make money.
Here's a tier-three artifact. Will that do?
All right. Go on for now. It'll be ready by tomorrow evening.
No problem. I'll let you get on with it.
No, I mean something else. It writes things by itself. Who's looking for what, who needs what, dates... No idea where it comes from. Know what it is?
Here's a Dummy. You said you'd take it.

Let me see... A network monitoring module. Tracks traders' activity: who's offering work and who isn't. Everything comes to your PDA automatically. A lot of people used to have one, until a strong electromagnetic pulse a few months ago wrecked half the electronics. Burned out nearly all the modules. Only a few survived. I've worked on a couple and learned how to restore them. Not for free, of course. A tier-three artifact. Though... a good Dummy would do. Don't bargain. I'm not padding the price.
Listen, I've still got that PDA that exploded. Hate to throw it away... Maybe the module survived, or can be repaired. Will you look?
Give it here... Burned casing goes in the trash. Module... Who knows. Might be alive. Two tier-two artifacts, and I'll look. No guarantees. Wasn't me who burned it. Agreed?
Here's the artifacts. Two of them, and a PDA.
Two artifacts... Not much. Should've asked for more. Come back the day after tomorrow, no earlier. Don't rush me. Electronics need care. This isn't hammering a nail.
Ask for more next time. I know you. Day after tomorrow it is.
A tier-three artifact for a bit of metal in a PDA... Generous.
I haven't got it on me. I'll come back later.
You know where to find me if you decide. Don't forget payment.
Definitely.
A piece of hardware, yes. Not many left in the Zone now. Not many people who can work with them either. Generous means free. I charge for work. Life's hard. You know. Well?
Marked One, we've discussed it. A tier-three artifact, a good Dummy, and it'll all be ready the next day.
Docent, about the module...
Broken something again? Dropped it? Or stuck it in an anomaly this time? Anything can happen with you stalkers...
Can't make up your mind? Switch it on, switch it off... Not my business. Same price.
That much money for a switch... Turn it off.
No, it works. I want notifications off. They're driving me mad.
That much money for a switch... Turn it back on.
You've worn it out... I soldered it, tuned it, and now it's "switch it off." Never mind. Used to it. Switching things on and off is work too, you understand.
A bit expensive. I'll come back later.
Come in, come in... Just remember, my prices don't stand still. Life goes on in the Zone. Everything gets dearer.
Well, we're used to it.
Not for some switch. For fine-tuning an electronic module. There's a difference. Use it wisely.
Adjust the frequency? How does that work?

The module scans the network periodically for new jobs. If it finds a suitable signal, you get a notification. Otherwise it checks again later. I can adjust the antenna's sensitivity threshold. That affects scan frequency and how soon you hear about a new order. At the minimum, it picks up signals about every 15 minutes, so you hear quickly. At the maximum, about once every half-hour, but the cache fills more slowly. Messages quiet down at night. Want me to adjust it?
Your current setting:
Make it send messages less often. It's annoying.
Let's adjust it.
I want messages more often. Don't want to miss anything.
Another time.
Restore the default setting.
I'm happy with it now. Thanks.
Could you make it simpler? I don't understand any of it.

All right, in language a stalker can understand. Two things. 
First, how often the antenna connects and checks the network. 
Second, how often you receive notifications. Those aren't the same. The Zone's network is unstable. It finds a signal, but the packet takes time to get through, then the module processes it... Say it checks every 20 minutes, but you only get a notification once an hour because the packet couldn't get through sooner. I can adjust both thresholds. At the minimum, everything's fast, almost immediate. At the maximum, much less often, but the cache fills more slowly. Nights are quieter. Everyone's asleep... 
Want me to adjust it?
Thank you.
The module's acting up. Notifications are getting less frequent...
Cache is full. Module accumulates scan data, fills its memory. More scans, faster buildup. Can clear it, but not free. A tier-two artifact, or several tier-one ones...
Done. Wiped it clean. Good as new now. Off you go. I've got plenty more to do.
Two tier-one artifacts. Here. Get to work.
A tier-two one. Here. It's about time.
Will a tier-three one do? Take it. I can spare it.
Not yet. I'll come back when I've got one.
Well, is the module ready?
Ah, Marked One. Just in time. Give me the PDA. I'll flash it now. One minute.
Here. What do you think?

Done. It'll pull contracts from the network: who needs what, who's offering what. Don't expect it instantly. You know the Zone's network. Might arrive in five minutes, an hour, or stay silent until the antenna catches something. Still better than wearing out your boots asking everyone you meet for work... Use it.
Thanks, Docent.
Go on, get out of my sight...
As courteous as ever.
Don't interrupt, impatient one. This takes precision.
Got it. I'll come back later. Thanks for explaining.
Decoded! Why are we standing here? Where's our little artifact?
Here's the artifact. Don't keep me waiting... What's in there?
Right. Nothing but stalker nonsense... Oh, hold on... There's a recipe here too. Write it down.
Yeah... I thought there'd be something more interesting.
I said come back in an hour! Haven't finished sorting it out...
Wait a bit. I'll bring it right now...
I've got a locked case here. Will you see what's inside?
Well... I can look. But... You understand. Remember what they say about only cats getting things done quickly?
I'll pay whatever's needed. Here, take it.
I'll think about the cats and the rest.
All right... Let's look... Stop hovering. You'll get everything inside, don't worry. Go sit in the bar for an hour. I'll open it and figure it out.
All right, get to work.
Well? Any progress with the case?
I said come back in a couple of hours! Haven't figured it out...
The lock was simple! Inside... Collecting toilet paper? Just the thing, then. An artifact for my time... Got an ordinary one?
Here. Strange, I thought there'd be something worthwhile.
I haven't got any artifacts right now... I'll come back later.
Soldiers' letters, notebooks, old orders. Here's a diagram for getting through the anomaly field from Agroprom to Yantar, avoiding radiation... Want it? Your call.
The Mark? What does he need it for?
What a question... How would I know? Maybe he isn't looking for it. Said something about it before leaving, but I didn't understand.
Strange. He said Strelok kept asking about the Black Mark... What did Ivar say?
Nothing. Said goodbye. Said someone might have been right. Your Strelok, maybe. Was busy. Didn't listen or remember. Don't need it. Why do you want Ivar?
He mentioned flooded tunnels once. Did he tell you anything about that? Or did you find something in the papers?
They've brought me enough papers to start a library. Think I remember everything?
Come on, try to remember. It's important now.
He mentioned something that didn't matter to me then, but does now. Remember the papers I brought you from a lab at Radar?
You've brought so many I could start a library. Think I remember everything? Why would I need to?
I can remind you. Something about flooded tunnels. You found something about pumps too. Come on, remember. It's important now...
I already said two tier-three artifacts. Period.
Sticking to your principles, eh? You'll get your artifacts.
For one artifact.
Hmm. A stalker left me a two-mesh belt. You can have it while I slowly improve yours. Any artifact, and the belt's yours.
All right, I agree. Here's the artifact.
Here. A belt for two artifacts.
I've got a belt for two artifacts.
I've got a three-mesh one. Give me a tier-three artifact, and I'll let you have it while I work on your belt.
All right, then...
All right, here you go. For three artifacts.
I got one for three artifacts.
Need to rebuild the voltage multiplier. Got one ready for four discharge units. Spare a modified artifact or better, or a Cobblestone, and I'll replace it quickly.
A Modified artifact?! That's too much, Docent... Take it. Can't do without a belt.
I'll fit it. Here, an extra mesh... Done. Take it...
Can't help you right now, but keep checking in... Maybe I'll get the components.
I got a Mesomodified artifact. Take it...
I'll keep checking in...
I've got a Hypermodified artifact! Well? Deal?
Here's an Absolute. Give me the belt...
You ask a lot! Here's a Cobblestone.
I've got one for four artifacts.
Four to five? Isn't that a bit much? Five discharge units need very powerful thyristor assemblies. Haven't got any now. Come back later...
Think about it. Where would I get new ones now? Only by special order. Time and expense. Here, take it. Be careful.
I'll keep checking in...
I've changed my mind. I don't need anything.
I think I'll give it some more thought...
I found some diagrams. Could you make sense of them?
What diagrams? From where? And why do you need them?
Got them in the cave... Doesn't matter. What matters is they're from an underground laboratory. Eggheads seem to have lived there...
Lived there? Maybe described elsewhere... Only skimmed a few sections and glanced at the diagrams. Can't make heads or tails of those. I'll dig a little more. Might find something.
Why didn't you say so... Trying to drive the price up?
Uh-huh... Not this... Unless there's something here...
Why are you taking so long? Seen anything else?
Uh-huh... Something.
Well!? Do I have to drag everything out of you...
Always rushing me... What's the hurry? Found an employee's notes in his personal correspondence... Something interesting seems to be taking shape...
Well? Why are you milking this for all it's worth again?
Well... I'd like an artifact. A good tier-two one. Eh?
These documents seem to be from an underground lab. Might have Brain Scorcher power diagrams. It needs switching on, or everyone will die...
Docent, all you need to do is look through the papers and say clearly if there's anything useful! An artifact, tier two at that, isn't a bit much?

You understand: work needs payment! Otherwise, why would anyone do it? Never mind... I'll make a concession, just for you... \nAccording to the notes, this laboratory has a backup geothermal generator. It may be shut down now. If so, you'll need to get it running by opening the heat-transfer fluid circulation. Once it's working, you can switch power lines to other facilities. The notes say that's done at the generator control station. Its location isn't quite clear, but they give the access code:
I don't get it. So what? There's a generator. What does that do for us?
Exactly! Power goes to the main supply line. Then switch the Scorcher to it. Don't know where or how. Nothing here about it. Probably wherever the Scorcher's controlled.
All right... It's something, at least.
If we don't switch it on, some die? Doesn't really matter to me. \nComplicated diagram. Takes time... I'll look while you're here. See whether it's worth doing...
Have a look...
Right... Well, that's clear... This, too...
Well, learned anything about the Brain Scorcher's power supply?
Not much, honestly. Missing the general description. Wiring, switching, protection diagrams and so on... But no idea how they fit together or what they're for. Hmm...
So what do we do?
How would I know? Where did you say you found these diagrams?
Time should be managed, not killed. All right, I'll bring it by when I get a chance. Thanks.
Don't get worked up. You ought to understand. As for what I "owe" you, we'll work something out.
I'll look... Come back tomorrow. Should have it figured out by then.

Reading, impatient fellow. You're interrupting... Drainage systems for flooded underground areas. High-powered pumps, apparently. Working? Unclear. Switched from an underground utility junction. Location unclear. Artifact for specifics. Still owe for earlier documents, so two tier-one artifacts. Why silent?

Pumps? Who knows where. High-powered too. All flooded, then. Flooded so badly it's best to stay out... Doubt those pumps will help even if I find them. Useless information. Hold the artifacts. Maybe next time.
Spent time looking for it. Life's hard too... You know. Should charge you for every page, really. Already giving you discounts.
I found a laptop underground... Interested?
Could take a look. Five half-liter bottles of pure drink. Deal?
Five bottles? All right, I agree...
No, I'll sell it to someone else...
Five bottles for you, an unknown quantity for me... We'll see.
Yeah, have a look. Let me know if there's anything interesting.
I found some papers in the underground laboratory at Radar...
Let me see. Beyond me. Need a doctor of physics. Biology... Something... No idea... Don't understand a damn thing. Take it to the scientists. Maybe they'll figure it out. I don't need it...
Well... I'll offer it to someone else.
Yes... Myself... Only myself! Can't trust anyone now. Your story's nice, but I can't trust you either. Sorry.
Right. Don't take anything on faith. Find out for yourself.
Certain now... But how? Whatever anyone says, I'll doubt everything. Even my "memories." Only one way. North, to the Monolith... Find out there whether Strelok did anything or not.
Do you know the way to the Monolith?
Not yet... Ghost knows. Or pretends, and wants to see how I do it. Doesn't matter... He'll tell me what I need. Now he won't have a choice.
It's very dangerous. You realize there... May be no way back? Think carefully.

What's to think about? Doubt who I am for the rest of my life? Lie awake wondering if I'm a zombie, or becoming one? Better die at the Monolith with a chance to learn everything than become something else.

What's to think about? Doubt who I am for the rest of my life? Lie awake wondering if I'm a zombie, or becoming one? Better die at the Monolith with a chance to learn everything than become something else. See Fang once more, then go.
Hello... How are you feeling?
I've got no strength. Can't stand straight... Who are you? Who am I?

Here's a medkit. It'll perk you up. Remember to take the pills with water. I've arranged it with Wolf: for now, you can get water from the next basement free. Still, you need rest and proper treatment. Anything could send you back to the grave now.
So you didn't recognize me... A shame. I'd hoped you would.
I'm the Doctor. Many call me the Swamp Doctor. I used to live in a swamp... Heard they'd found you, came to have a look... Who are you? I'm not sure yet. You've taken a beating. I have one guess, but it's too incredible. I won't tell you until you remember yourself. The risk is too great: you might build an identity that isn't yours around the name. Relax for now... Maybe you'll meet someone familiar. Memory loss needs a nudge from outside.
Go talk to Sidorovich. He nursed you while I was away. I'll start making my way toward the center of the Zone.
Doctor? Don't remember... Sidorovich? Where, what... Oh... My head...
Feeling a bit better? Remembered anything about yourself?
No, nothing... I'll look for people who can help.
That's right! Bye, we'll meet again...
Contacted Sakharov. He made a special helmet. Fang said you'd thought of moving him somewhere here, but feared sending him through the teleport.
Yes. He probably wouldn't have survived. What about the helmet? You gave it to Fang, and he came out at Agroprom?
The professor said they'd take him out of the Zone by helicopter for treatment immediately. Thought it was the only real help. Can't hide underground all his life.
So where did he go, blind as he is?
Nowhere... Sakharov said the helicopter would come once he got the helmet's signal. Told me to wait underground. Must've taken him: nobody was left. Helicopters do fly there often. Seen them.
Well... Let's hope proper doctors can help Fang. I couldn't have done any more anyway.
I agree. Don't go underground anymore. Fang isn't there now.
That was the plan. Sakharov said the helicopter would come once he got the helmet's signal. Had doubts. What if it didn't come? Why tell me to wait underground?
And what about Fang?
I gave him that helmet and the Compass you left. He came here through the teleport. The helmet protected him.
Here? The Thicket? Good. Wanted that for ages, but had no protection for Fang. Mustn't surface yet. Electronics fail here. Helmet probably won't work.
Didn't think of that then. Wasn't planning to enter the forest. Said he knew the little cave by touch and could get from the teleport to his sleeping place. Wait there.
All right, I'll be sure to visit him.
Doctor, what now? Helmet won't work here. Still trapped underground, just somewhere else. Starting to regret not sending him to Sakharov. Promised real help, at least.
Think it'll be fine. Feels at home here, at least. Spent a lot of time in this cave. Easier for me too. I'll do everything possible. Hope for a quick recovery. Time passes faster here.
Time's our only hope. You've already done everything you could.
Marked One, glad you're still here. Rest. Don't go anywhere.
No, Doctor. I need to go north.
What's worrying you so much?

I've thought of another possibility. What if, for some reason, I already had that Monolith virus in my head? Strelok knew, and deliberately brought me to the Thicket to break my link with it. He got information from Ivar for a reason. Ivar was trying to treat... different people... Never mind. Why couldn't I remember part of my life? What if Ghost was right: it wasn't a mistake in Strelok's experiment, but his intention? He knew the Monolith would keep calling because part of it was still in me. When I touched it, or its terminal, I wouldn't receive knowledge. I'd implant something Strelok had put inside me. If Strelok understood that consciousness virus in his own future, he could try putting his virus into the Monolith through me... And achieve his goal after all.
Maybe... Doctor, do you know what a "time loop" is?
Saw a picture of a snake eating its tail. Seems similar. A trap you can't escape, perhaps. Nobody understands time's nature. Only guesses. Why?
Something's happened. Red's medicine is missing.
Missing? It shouldn't be! It keeps for at least six months!
I mean, I lost it... Can you mix up another batch? I know it's my fault, but that's what happened.
Right... If Red's still alive... Unlikely, of course. Get the ingredients together. Remember? Vodka, a pair of tushkano heads, and a pair of dog tails.
Yes, all right. I'll be quick...
Ah! Finally made it... How are you? Recovered? You're looking lively...
Thanks for the kind words. Got a lot of questions for you. One at a time, though. \nI saw your note. You were underground and said something to me, weren't you?

You were delirious underground at Agroprom. Said strange things Strelok had said before. Fang said something similar too. Ghost told me a quick way to their stash so I could take Fang there after his trouble.
So you knew Strelok? Why didn't you say so earlier?
Met briefly a few times. Don't know where he is now. Never did before, either. Always appeared suddenly and left straightaway. What would that have told you?
Still... Though you're right. What good would it have done... What was I saying? Raving about, rather?

Monolith? Strange. Before Fang's trouble, he said Strelok told him of Monolith and a fragment. Didn't understand... Ghost said Strelok asked Ivar about related psychosis and hallucinations. Thought Monolith was an illusion, or induced one. No details. Asked if I knew what Strelok meant, whether he'd passed me anything.
And what did you do?

What could I say? Not a psychiatrist. Psychosis, hallucinations: psychiatric matters. Told him Ivar worked on that, but then Ivar disappeared. Nobody's seen the Monolith. Thought it was only a legend...
Ivar? He's in a bad way. You might be the only one who can help.
Ivar... Sounds familiar.
What about you? Remembered anything? Know what you were saying there?
I'm not sure... Those fragments of memory... They're too vague.
I understand. That's why I wanted you to meet Ghost. He spent a long time with Strelok. Surely knows what he meant...
This Ghost... Where is he?

Here the other day. Told him someone was looking for him. Ghost wouldn't wait. Left into the night. "Can't wait! Something very important!"\nDidn't say exactly where. Always secretive. Think he'll visit the "den," though. Kept the group's special equipment there...
A den? What's that supposed to be?

You don't know? Old mine workings start nearby. Either Germans during the war or Beria's people afterward mined some important ore. Dug plenty. No witnesses left.
After the Chernobyl NPP blew, someone decided to use the caves. Government, foreign sponsors, who knows.
Brought equipment, even a railway branch into a tunnel, apparently. Then it stopped.
Fang found it while working with diggers. Made a home there: warm, safe from emissions, nobody could find them...
How do I find it?
One entrance is in the mine tunnel opposite the hut. I'll mark it for you.
Maybe I should go there, then?

Main tunnel's been blocked by an anomaly over a month. May have dispersed... Another entrance in the Red Forest, exact location unknown. \nTarzankas in the Cave let you reach the "den" quickly. Find the right one. Don't know where, never needed it. Strelok's group worked there, kept long-raid supplies. \nTry reaching it. Might jog something...
Red Forest? Dangerous... I'll look. Maybe getting through here is easier.
Suit yourself...\nOh! Can't just walk into the "den." Armored doors, electronic locks. Ghost let slip Strelok set the code to the date of the first accident at the Chernobyl NPP. Remember...
Hello... Come in, let's have some tea...
Good to see you...
About that underground "den."
Yes? Found it? How was it?
Why do I need him now, if you seem to know something, too?
Please... It's important! Feel this isn't chance. The Zone breathes. Its breath could burn our world. What's hidden in your head might prevent that "end of the world"... Do your best, Marked One.
Well, damn! How do you find someone who doesn't want to be found? Never mind. Idle talk. So you're suggesting another trip north... Ahhh...

Found it, yes. How? Don't understand. Familiar surroundings, feel I've been there. Nothing concrete... Scientist working for Ghost gassed me. Says Ghost visited, said not to look. He'll find me or send word through the Doctor. Thoughts?
Ghost... Always plotting, hiding things, holding back. Could just talk to you. No, has his own plans... Good that the place seemed familiar. Feel a breakthrough's coming. Hope it's soon...
Sooner? What's your interest in it?

Can't tell you everything I think and know about you now. My words could become suggestions to your damaged mind. You'd accept them as facts and think they were memories. That's why I want you to remember and realize who you are yourself, without hints.

Why do you care about my realization?! Why always hold something back? Will I go mad if you tell me? Some maniac who ate his children? Stop stalling! Know something, say it. Don't worry about my "fragile mind"...
No... Understand, this matters... Matters to you. It's better this way. Believe me. You must meet Ghost first.
Damn it!.. Where am I supposed to find him? He's always here, until suddenly he isn't. The Zone's a big place...
Headed north. Says there's a control center where power and connection circuits for the laboratory installations converge. Never said why he wanted it.
I found a note from Ghost.
What note? Where did you see it?
Doc, what does "use as a lockpick" mean?
That's what Ghost wrote?
Yes... His note. He mentioned some "half-zombie."
Ghost... Bitter, perhaps. Seemed to resent Strelok somehow... Hard to speak for him, say what he meant. Can't answer for him...
And for yourself...?
I've already told you everything I wanted to, or could.
I remember, I remember... You have to do it yourself, and so on... Fine.
I was in the underground laboratory in the Dark Valley. Found a note from Ghost. Said he'd wait for Strelok in the "den."
Addressed to Strelok, then? Probably an old note. Nobody's seen Strelok in God knows how long. Must have been ages ago.
That's what I thought. But... Why leave Strelok a letter there? Did he think Strelok would come? What for?
Can't say. So long ago. Forgot, left it by accident? Decided it didn't matter? Realized he wouldn't find Strelok? Ghost says Strelok always appeared out of nowhere. Then vanished. What's it about?
Yes... Nonsense. Something about a control panel and a "den." Something about the Black Mark too. Was Strelok infected?
He shouldn't have. I think he said he had natural immunity.
How is that possible?
Don't know. Maybe I misunderstood him myself. We spoke in a hurry. Just before Fang had his trouble. Never met again after that.
Marked One, now. Don't remember my old name.
Marked One, you know how memory works. Remember this, forget that... Have a drink, talk. Maybe I'll remember something... Pour...
Pour, pour... Come on! Here we go!
My pouring arm's broken right now.
Listen, friend, does "Black Mark" mean anything to you?
God preserve us... Cross yourself! Heard of that curse. Who hasn't... God forbid I ever find one...
Picked one up... Damn thing... How do I get rid of it?
Uh... Heard Barin boasting at the Bar once that he'd got rid of a Black Mark... Ask him.
Brought the exoskeleton. "Hungry." Can we sort it out? Charge it, I mean.

Quarter, full, or half? Remember the terms? A good tier-three artifact for a full charge: lasts a week. An average artifact for half the exo battery: three-day guarantee. An ordinary artifact for a day. As a regular customer, you've got another option. I have some spare batteries. Not great quality, but about a day's charge, maybe a little less. Best part: you can replace one yourself anytime, day or night.\nFor one battery, an ordinary artifact, or two discharged batteries plus five thousand. Take your pick:
Quarter, full, or half? Remember the terms? Good tier-three artifact for a full charge: a week. Average artifact for half the exo battery: three-day guarantee. Ordinary artifact for a day. Choose:
Give me a day's worth. Haven't found any good artifacts yet...
No problem. Go about your business. I'll tell you when it's ready.
Got it! No watering down the amps and kilowatts. I know your sort...
Let's cut it by half, then. Three days, that is. Here's a tier-two artifact and an exoskeleton.
Enough for half. Take a walk for an hour and a half, or rest at the bar. The exo will charge by then. Keep your PDA on. I'll tell you when it's ready.
I'll drop by another time.
Let's go all out! Here's the exoskeleton and a good artifact. Charge it while the charging's good.
Now there's a man who means business! Come back in about two hours. It'll be ready.
I want to change the battery myself. Here's the capsule, as agreed.
Good capsule... Here's the battery. Should last a day, but as I said, maybe a little less. Come back to exchange it again afterward.
Yeah... As if I've got anywhere else to go...
Sorry, almost all gone. Only one left. If you're keen, I'll trade it for two of yours...
About exchanging batteries. Here's the money and two of mine.
Let's have a look... Good. Here. Be careful with it. Not many left...
Well, is my exoskeleton feeling lively again?
You bet! Full of usefulness now! It'll stay that way for a while too. Take your technological marvel.
Oh, thanks, then. Something's sparking there. Is it supposed to? Think I'll ground myself on a radiator so it doesn't zap me.
Still a couple of turns left. Working on it.
What a shame... I'll have to wander around some more.
No, I'm not finished yet. Come back later...
All right, all right...
Thank you.
Looking... Wearing out my feet, shooting dogs... They bite me back.
There'll always be more dogs. Look how big the Zone is. A man's just a bug... Anyway, what have you got?
Did you send word that it was all ready?
Equipment worked properly. Material absorbed the anomalous quarks. We'll see how long it lasts. Our research almost guarantees three days, maybe more. Here.
Done... Not quite. Some malfunction completely destabilized the material. Simply put, it evaporated. Sorry. Method's too experimental. So...
Thanks. Three days guaranteed, then. Can it be irradiated again?
A shame. Can you try again, though?
Yes, certainly. Just bring the materials needed for the work.
No problem, if you've got the chimera claw we need, or a zombie part...
Still suffering, poor soul, or are you better now?
Hardly. I'm sick of everything. Getting dark thoughts... Why am I alive? What's the point?

You're in a bad way... Saw Boryan. Gave you herbs. Instructions included. Said it should ease in ten days. If not, find him: northern farmstead in the Swamps. Here's the medicine. Remember the recipe?
Marked One, you're a real man. Let's drink to... Oh, what am I saying... Artifact?! Ah... Yes... Get the container out. I promised.
You could at least wash yourself. Bye.
Still drinking? Or nursing a hangover already?
Well... Uh... Same as always. What do you want?

Talked to your debtor. Says who owes whom is debatable. Told me about fleeing dogs in the Gut, your lost capsule container... Decent man. No complaints against you. Found the container. You promised me something. Forgotten?
Me?! Well... Yes... My memory! Right! We talked. Well?
What do you think... Here's the capsule from that container. My reward?
Marked One, you're a good man. Won't forget it. Take an artifact capsule... First I've seen at Agroprom...
You really stink. You ought to quit. I'll be back.
No... I'll get going. See you, Chinaman Nikitin...
Hi, man. Met before? You look familiar...
I don't remember. I don't remember who I am or where I'm from.
Well, look at you! What do I call you, Ivan the Forgetful?
Marked One. That's what they call me.
Shake on it, Marked One. What brings you to our Gut? Not many artifacts, but you can feed the dogs anytime... With yourself.
Seen herds of them. Here on my own business. What are you doing here?
Don't want to talk, don't. I'm not so secretive. Watch the beasts. Gather things. Hunt, basically. Teaching stalkers how to be real hunters. Might help. In time...
I see. I don't need anything yet. I'll keep moving.
Take care, familiar stranger...
Hello, you cagey fellow. How's life?
Getting by. Still sitting here? When are you going hunting?
Looking for someone. Rats, or Rat, something like that. Seen him?
Hunting's serious business. You can't rush it.
Rat? Every other fellow here is a rat... Swipe anything not nailed down. Whether it's the rat you need, God knows...
How can I trust you?
Fair enough...

Marked One? You? You're my pal now! Heard you stood up for me. Know thanks aren't enough... World's round. We'll settle up. A little present for now: write this recipe down.\nWho are you looking for? Might know him.
Hmm, I think I'll pass.
Dimon, the one called Nut, said you've got a lead on a stash belonging to Ghost himself.
Where did you see that wanderer? Haven't heard from him in a while.
Hiding out in the Gut. Says he's got business there. What about the stash, then? You owe me. Remember?

Always repay debts... An interesting corpse had bad luck. Bullet in belly, head sideways, done. Note from Ghost to a friend, apparently. District Center hideout location. A stopover: food, sleep, ammo, medicine. Not feeding you lies, but never been there. Can't describe it. Note mentioned a Kooptorg store. Something there, definitely...
Yeah... Not much. Thanks anyway. Take care.
Well? All right, suit yourself. I'll relax a little...
About the cards from the recorders.
What are you talking about? Have you brought something?
Got a few. Have a look. Is this what you need?
Yes, thanks. Sorry, buried in work. Didn't understand at first.
No, nothing. Forget it...
About the cards from the recorders. Offer still good?
Made up your mind?
At least tell me what to look for, and where...

Let's get to it. I'll mark the towers on your PDA: four in the Swamps, three in the Misty Thicket, two in the Red Forest. Nine altogether. Collect the cards in any order. If you can't get one straightaway, don't despair. Try again later. What matters is the data. We'll handle the rest. \nThank you, Marked One. We haven't had a stable connection with those areas for a month. Instead of observations, we're getting Arctic firewood prices.
I'll try not to delay, but no promises. Depends how things go. It's not a quick trip to the Cordon, you know...
Just asking. I'm not ready for scientific heroics yet.

No precise answers. Apparently no shooting. All died almost simultaneously. Mutants chewed some, definitely after death. Ghost wasn't there. Mikhalych said he'd left in Limansk. Other reports, unreliable. Don't know where he is. Want a heartfelt talk myself. Documents from bodies here. Everything. Hiding nothing.

Not much. We'll try other channels for Ghost. Your thanks will be tangible. Choose: repair your gear with our soldier next building, or daily consumables through Kuznetsov. Apparently good friends. Which?
Repairs never hurt.
I'd rather talk to Kuznetsov about the reward.
Very good. You're dismissed.
Thanks kindly. Take care.
Want to get through, stalker?
Yes, I wouldn't mind...
Got any grub? We're sitting here like idiots...
What do you need? And how much?
A can of food or a couple of sausages. A couple of energy drinks will do too, but only nearer nighttime... Then you can pass...
Here's a can. I was saving it for myself...
Here's some sausage. Get your strength up...
Here's two cans of energy drink...
I haven't got that much right now...
Thanks! Get through, quick...
Got it! Take care...
Get through quickly, before some officer turns up...
All right, I'm moving...
Passage is prohibited here, stalker.
Where's Kuznetsov? Isn't he supposed to be here...
Kuznetsov? His shift's over. It's my shift now. Lieutenant Kovalchuk! Understood? I keep it simple: turn around and get out! All sorts wandering in here...
Cool it, Lieutenant... Some vodka? For your health?
I don't drink! You people think everyone does...
Suit yourself... Someone must be waiting beyond the perimeter. Expecting you back to help your relatives. Can give money for you and your family.
I'm moving, I'm moving...
I know about your money. What's it to me? Your name, stalker?
Known as Marked One... Can convert money to dollars later. Ask your relief. Old fellow in the village does it easily. Leave the Zone rich. Two thousand, and your men see nothing for ten minutes?
Uh... Foreign currency? Dollars? All right, just this once. Three thousand from you. We'll see after that...
Here are your rubles.
Wait a bit. I'll bring it soon...
Hey! You! Come on, get through, quick...
I'm going...
All right, go through... But be quick...
Get out of here, stalker...
Already gone...
Turn around, stalker, while we're feeling friendly...
So that's how it is...
Why do you look so worried?
Oh, Marked One. Speak of the devil. Heard you were looking for a stalker called Ghost. Find him?
In twenty minutes, you say? All right, I'll talk to him.
No, not yet. Why?
No, I don't want to do this.
Hmm. Here's the thing. A month ago, maybe more now, Ghost volunteered to escort a group to a distant point in the Zone.
Right... And?
A group disappeared. No contact, no news since. Told our battalion commander to organize a search. Going deep into the Zone with soldiers means losing them and your own life too.
What can I do?

You helped me, I'll help you. Experienced stalker needs supplies, good equipment? Wants Ghost too?\nTell commander we have a guide to find the group's traces. Agreed? Go to the checkpoint in twenty minutes, find deputy battalion commander. Don't display weapons. I'll warn men, but nervous soldiers might shoot at that arsenal... Come within a day, or I'll find someone else.
I've got a question about the lost package.
What's it to you? Sidor's nagged me enough! My fault?! Those creatures attacked... Had to stay alive... Should I pay for that damn box with my life?
Calm down... Sidorovich said to find it. Where did you lose it?
Where? Hmm... All this running and talking's dried my throat out... Bring something to drink? Then we'll talk. Okay?
Can't you do it for nothing? All right... We'll see.
Here, take it... Wet your whistle. So, what do you say?
Oh! Good man! Now I can have a little medicine... Want a shot? No?\nAnyway, I've roughly marked where I lost it on this paper. Can't remember more precisely.
Ah... I see... All right, take care...
Listen! I've told you everything I know! What else do you want?
Don't get worked up. I was just asking...
Help me use the teleport...
We need a Compass artifact to create a teleport. Do you have one available?
Of course. Why else would I bother you?
I'd like to get to the Warehouses.
Some appetite, guys... I'll walk rather than pay an artifact!
Excellent! I can help set the teleport coordinates. Not for free, naturally. Need to help the boys here.\nWhere would you like to go?
Hmm... Damn, I haven't got one of those!
Yantar. To hell with walking there. This is better...
Know how to use it? There's a translucent sphere in the mist down in that hollow. Activate a charged Compass on your belt, then step in.
Come on, we'll figure it out! As long as we're alive, we're not dead!
The Gut, if possible...
Set it for the Swamps.
That's enough!
Here are two blind dog tails.
Here's a burer paw.
Here's a pseudogiant appendage.
Here's a controller's hand.
A chimera claw. Very hard.
Take a poltergeist eye.
Will a flesh hide do?
Here's a snork foot.
That's enough! No more ammo for you if you haven't learned to use a weapon. Off you go...
I've got a dog tail and a boar hoof here.
I've got a wild cat tail lying around.
A zombie hand. Very cold.
Three tushkano heads.
A couple of warm boar hooves.
A nice pseudodog tail.
Will a flesh eye do?
I've got a bloodsucker tentacle.
Can I still trade mutant parts?
Of course. Not just shot shells, either. What have you got...
I don't carry stinking things around.
Then you won't get any ammo...
Here's everything I've shot so far.
No. Stalkers bought it all, and no new deliveries yet. You took the last of it. Better come by in the morning...
All right! Thanks for the information.
Give an irresponsible man ammunition to kill our own people later? \nNice idea... Not happening. Be grateful we haven't shot you here and still let you through for proof of mutant kills...
All right, all right. I get it...
Man, leave... Won't go willingly? We'll help you however we can.
What's gotten into you all?
Hi! What do you want?
Our boss wanted to see you. Doesn't mean you're welcome here. Go through. Don't hang around.
Piss off. Now we'll get screwed because of you...
Idiots!
Repairs are a good thing. Let's settle on that.

True. Rags and a bent gun won't get you past the first dog. If you need repairs, tell me or my relief. We'll inform the posts. They'll let you through. Repairman's usually upstairs in the building on the left. You'll find him when needed.
I want to see your repairman.
Seems all good. Everyone's been warned about you. I'll remind them. Should be able to set out in ten or fifteen minutes. How are you? A little drink?
I'm all right. Not much time. Always something to do...
I see. Stop by when you can. Have a shot, talk. Our boys promised to bring food. Come over...
All right. Maybe I'll drop by. Bye.
Yes, I've got an artifact. Here.
Your call...
That's the route. If you know it, don't bring it up again.
Thank you, brother! You've really saved me! Don't even know how to thank you...
Listen, I need the flash drive you were taking to the trader. Got it?
True... Those fools can't even search properly. Take it! Saved my life, after all. Well hidden. Those thugs hardly searched me.
Thanks. Where did you hide it? Never know, might be useful someday.

Not below the belt. Don't worry. Worked for a trader for ages. Know how to hide information! Here. Run to Sidor. Might generously give two hundred rubles... Miser.\nWhy did I go to that sawmill? Better stay out of Sidor's sight. He'll eat me alive.
Come on, you just got lucky.
Lucky, yes... Can barely move my legs. Sidor too... Do a little favor? Profit for you, peace for me. Give this flash drive to Sidorovich, the local trader. Needs it, so he'll pay. Here...
Hmm... Where did you hide it? Never know, might be useful someday.

Not below the belt. Don't worry. Worked for a trader for ages. Know how to hide information! Here. Run to Sidor. Might generously pay... Miser.\nWhy did I go to that sawmill? Better stay out of Sidor's sight. He'll eat me alive.
May your road be smooth as velvet, stalker!
Hi. I'm Marked One. Wolf sent me.
Wolf sent you? Listen, help! They're demanding some PDA from me. I don't know anything about it! I swear!
Sir, could you tell me a safe route?
Listen to you! Where are you heading? Might need something there myself.
Ivan Nebov promised to show me the way to Clear Sky's old base. Didn't get the chance. Poor fellow died. Know where it is, by any chance? How to get there?

Heard a little...
Don't give information free normally. Exception...
Leave, turn left, cross hollow. Trailer by the wire takes you to abandoned farmstead. Call it Southern. Trail south from there. Base was around there.
Remember me if you find something interesting...
I'll try not to forget.
I need two "Flamethrowers." Petrenko does, actually. Can you get them?
Two at once? What for? Set things alight with both hands?
He needs them. They said you'd agreed. Got them or not?
We had a deal... I've got them... Let's do business: two tier-two artifacts from you, two flamethrowers from me. Need to cover my costs too.
All right, here. Take the artifacts.
I haven't got them on me. I'll come back a bit later.
Not spoiled? I'm joking. Here are your "Flamethrowers." Take them.
And the second one?
I'm not you. Can't hold two... Here's the other one. Fire away, don't get splashed...
Vergas, do you know Fang?
Knew him... Stubborn devil. Start arguing about weapons and you'll never win. Never mind... Speak well of the dead, or not at all.
But he's alive.
How can he be alive? I've seen his grave myself!
Alive how? Alive like that. Can't surface or be around people. Speaks badly, can't see, drags a leg too.
You call that alive? Seen people who can barely see, drag a leg, can't speak, only moan? Better to die outright than "live" like that.
Maybe you're right... It's not about him anyway. It's Strelok. He knew him, after all. Didn't he tell you?
No. He didn't say.
Didn't someone promise me something for fixing the notebook? You should keep your word.
All right, you'll get your "something"...
You're in a hurry... I still need some time...
Well, I'll wait...
Well, thanks, old man... I owe you!

Can't properly repay you. Too much happened. Maybe this helps. Coming through the Gut, saw a giant struggling in the swamp by the regional committee's dacha. Couldn't get out. Barely moving. Cut off its appendage. A little spoiled now, but here.

Can't repay properly, too much happened. But coming through the Gut, saw a giant struggling left of the swamp bridge. Hunters wounded it, apparently. Barely moving. Hurry, good trophies. By a lone birch.

Can't repay properly, too much happened. Coming through the Gut, saw a giant struggling in the swamp by the regional committee's dacha. Cut its appendage. Later met a fellow who needed it badly. Gave a recipe. Write it down. Useful.
From a giant, you say? All right, I'll find a use for it.
A giant, you say? We'll see.
Interesting recipe. Think I had one like that... Or maybe I didn't. Thanks all the same.
I've got some questions.
Ask away. I'll try to help.
What do you know about the Zone?
What's at the center of the Zone?

Quite a question... Spent two years trying to answer! Never found a way to the center and back alive. Tried with friends several times. Barely returned myself. Not all of them did...\nWhy go? For a dream. To fulfill our wishes.
Wishes come true?

Beautiful legend about the Wish Granter. Supposedly a place in the center grants any desire, however incredible. But I know the center offers plenty of ways to die. Don't believe in that Granter anymore. Don't risk yourself for nothing. Wouldn't advise it.
I know plenty. Be more specific.
Heard anything about Strelok?
Where did the Zone come from?
Another blast here in 2006. That's when it appeared. Hardly an answer, I know. Few know the truth, if anyone here does.
A tough stalker, apparently. Don't know him. Haven't been near the center for ages. Mostly rookies here on the outskirts. Find someone who spends time deeper in the Zone. Ask them.
What do you know about the "death trucks"?
What brought you to the Zone?

Worked in a mine. Closed it as unprofitable. No money, no prospects. Heard you could get fabulously rich in the Zone. Had some experience, decided to risk it. Not rich, but got money. Ordinary story. Many came that way...

Know nothing. Don't want to!\nSorry, heard about you... Too much supernatural stuff. Spend a month here and you're superstitious for life. Corpses in the truck bed, corpses driving... Who, where from, why? Hope not from the other side.
Thank you.
What's the most dangerous thing in the Zone?

Hard to say. Too many unknown dangers to encounter them all. Enough already. Flesh bit off a toe, radiation made hair fall, Burner caught right leg. Nasty... Bloodsucker face to face once, don't remind me... Talk forever, won't understand until you experience it. One tip: caution. Always, everywhere.
It's you... Will you help, or not? If not, keep going.
Let's start. Get your men ready.
No. I'll try alone, keep the noise down.
Your call. Shout if you need help... Rambo.
Seven or eight?! They'll kill us all! Need another way...
Listen, smart guy! What do you suggest? Sit in the bushes and admire the sky?
Well... Didn't Sidorovich say he had military contacts? Don't know... Doubt we'll save Nimble by going in head-on.
I understand! What do we do?\nGo talk to Wolf. Don't want to discuss this by radio. Maybe he'll arrange support or something...
Yes, I think that would be best.
Hmm... Let me try doing something quietly. Alone.
I understand! What are we going to do?\nWolf's dead, and Sidor couldn't care less about people...
We haven't worked it out yet...
What do you think... We need to storm the place!
Ha! What did I tell you! Shall we start? The boys and I will try distracting them from the right. You go in from the left...
Yes, I spoke to him. I'll try finding the PDA the bandits want myself. Heading for the Gut...
Hunters charge a toll there. Got anything? Here's a pseudodog tail. Give it if they ask. Let you through... Don't hang around the vehicle depot! Give it a wide berth!
Yeah, got it. I'll give it a wide berth. I'm off.
You said that already! Get moving! Decide what you're doing!
Uh... My head's not quite right... Well, I'm off.
I'll try negotiating. Wolf says go without weapons or gear.
Are you crazy? They'll kill you! Well... Your call.
Could you help store my things? No time to find a stash spot here...
Of course, why not. Give me your stuff...
Very good. I'm off, then.
We'll see. Just back me up. If anything happens...
Spoke to Nimble. They want something from him. I'll ask Wolf.
Don't take too long! We'll wait a couple of hours. If there's no word, we'll give those bastards hell!
I understand. I'll try not to take too long...
It all worked out. The bandits let Nimble go, and they're leaving.
Good man! Didn't expect that. Handled everything so... Anyway, you've earned my respect, Marked One! Stop by sometime for a shot of tea...
Found some PDA. I'll go show them. Stay sharp. I might need to fight my way out...
Don't worry! We'll back you up...
Wolf's dead. I don't know what to do...
I'd like my weapon back...
Of course. Here it is...
Thank you.
Wolf? Wait with the requests... I need to talk to Wolf!
Our boss wanted to see you. Doesn't mean you're welcome here. Go through. Don't hang around.
Stop, stalker! Nobody in camp will talk to you right now.
Why?
What kind of idiot talks freely to a passenger from a death truck? Prove you're someone we can deal with first.
What "death truck"? I don't remember anything... Nothing.
Who knows... Truly nasty. Few things worse...\nNot discussing it with you! Superstitious, perhaps. Best leave now while I'm asking nicely.
What do I have to do for you to trust me?
Let Sidorovich test you. We'll watch. If you're normal, don't reach for your gun without cause, and have a working head, we'll get along. Don't worry.
All right, have it your way.
Get out before our guys beat you up, idiot!
Are you crazy? Been too long since someone punched your face?
Told you not to touch the soldiers! You did! Nobody'll get any peace now!
Cool it, rookie...
What now? Conscience waking up? Get lost...
What are you talking about?
Nimble's in trouble... Bandits caught him nearby, took him away. Only managed to send an SOS. Someone saw them at the old vehicle depot across the road.
What now? "Passenger"... Get lost... Go about "your" business...
Ahh...
You don't rescue your prisoners? Not very friendly... Or too scared?

Could smack you, but why? Not simple. Few men, mostly rookies. Can't risk them. Lose this camp and decent stalkers suffer. What about you? If you're not scared, I'll take help. Not proud. Help with the bandits?
You want me to go alone?
You won't manage that way. My scouts are good fighters. Watching those bastards now. Together you've got decent odds. Well? Still too scared?
I'll try.
Respect! I owe you a bottle. Sent you the men's coordinates. I'll tell them about you now.
Yeah. All right. I'll go.
I might take it on... But I haven't got a decent gun...
Probably no use from you... Maybe distract them while Petrukha and his boys do the work. Can you shoot? Here's a Makarov. Don't shoot yourself out of fright... Drink for courage... Ready? Too scared?
All right, let's see what's there...
Don't worry! Sent the men's coordinates. I'll tell them you're coming.
I'm not scared. But I'm not going.
So you are scared... Then go to hell!
Hmm... Know your head's not right, but this bad! Explained the situation already. Are you going, or not? Too scared after all?
Your men and I cleaned up the vehicle depot.
I swept the vehicle depot. It's clear now.
Wow! The boys say you really gave them hell! A thank-you doesn't fill a glass, I know! So besides our heartfelt thanks, I've got something else...
Working on it.
Keep me posted, all right?
About ten bandits at the vehicle depot. We can't handle it alone.
Ten? Where from? Damn it... What's Petrukha watching? Said he'd manage. Can't rush in. Lose Nimble and others. You're not well known yet? Let's find out what they want. Will you go to them?
Oh, no! I'm not sticking my head in its mouth...
I'll try sending someone else. You... Off you go...
We could try. What if they shoot us without a word?
Shouldn't. Leave all your weapons here. Jacket off too. Find what they want from Nimble. No heroics. Talk, come back... Then decide what to do...
Managed to make a deal with the bandits. Nimble's free.
Hmm... Didn't expect that... How did you manage? Must be something about you... Anyway, here's a token of the stalker community's gratitude...
I've got bad news. Nimble's dead...
Dead? How could you... All right, go...
I get it. I'm not stupid.
What have you got to tell me, stalker?
Not much to tell... Had to clear out the vehicle depot. That's about it.
So modest! Since you dealt with the bandits, I can't let you leave empty-handed! Here, for your immediate needs...
Managed to make a deal with the bandits. Nimble's free...
Hmm... Didn't expect that... How did you manage? Must be something about you... Anyway, here's a token of the stalker community's gratitude...
Couldn't make a deal. Had to wipe out the bastards. Nimble's free...
Hmm... Didn't expect that... How did you manage? Must be something about you... Anyway, here's a token of the stalker community's gratitude...
Couldn't make a deal. Had to wipe out the bastards. Nimble's dead...
Dead? How could you... All right, go...
Well... They started it!
How's it going, Nimble?

You won't believe what I heard! The Zone's strongest and kindest controller once lived deep in the forest around the Brain Scorcher. It rarely attacked first. Sometimes it hid from an enemy altogether, so neither would suffer. Late one spring, stalkers found huge numbers of blind-dog litters. They started clearing the forest of puppies and packs. Said there were too many beasts already. One ugly blind puppy survived. Maybe others did somewhere, but this one was lucky. The controller found it. Pity must have stirred in the creature. Took the puppy everywhere, raised it, shared its prey. Became its parent, really. Imagine that?
Really?

The two creatures became inseparable! People saw them often: a controller in the distance, the dog running and jumping around its feet. They'd stand awhile, then go into the forest together. Never hurt a human. What the hell? Late that autumn, either Duty was scouting through radioactive woods or mercenaries were seeking a campsite. Their route took them through the pair's den. Saw the controller resting among the trees and opened fire. It ran for its den, but there were good shots in the squad. Two bursts, and it fell. They say it still crawled 10 meters toward home. Someone taking a smoke break noticed, fired a couple more bullets, and that was it. Quiet.
Those bastards...
