The controller lay in fallen autumn leaves, wet and muddy with its blood. The dog ran up and lay quietly beside it. Rain came that night, and people heard mournful howling. Every night for two or three weeks. Then silence. A year or two later, a Freedom man, Petka Silencer or Petka Barrel, doesn't matter, went to restock his forest stash. Said he saw a controller's skeleton, with a pseudodog's skeleton beside it. Died together, inseparable... Friends. And people call these creatures soulless. They should look at themselves. Some humans...
Sad story... Sometimes you think these creatures aren't just monsters. Animals trying to survive... Never mind. What's come over me...
Job's done. Here's the box from the checkpoint.
Small military post at the Swamps' southern edge. Almost the Zone's border. Couple of eggheads there, doing scientific stuff. Find it if you want... Go on. Wasted enough time on you...

Good man! Thanks won't feed you... Ten... No, eight thousand, and we're square!\nNot just about us... Other papers...\nZone information. Not educated myself, but Barkeep knows a smart fellow. Take this box. Useful for all of us, apparently. Will you?
All right, it's a deal. I'll take it there.
You mentioned your family friend, and a way to get my memory back?

Right! My kum, Mikhalych, settled in Limansk, an abandoned town. Says there's a machine that might clear the memory. So he's heard... Reach Limansk, give him my regards.\nWill you carry the case to the Bar?
Hold on with that box... Limansk? Where's that?
Little town just beyond the Red Forest. Don't go directly. Stalkers disappear... Through the Army Warehouses. Well-used trail... Understand?
I think I understand...
Well? Agreed about the box? Will you take it there?
No, I can't.
All right, I'll find someone else...
Here. By the way!\nShould've suggested it. A scientist works in the Swamps nearby. Boasted over a drink he could dig up a file on anyone in the Zone. Contacts in the agencies, apparently...
I don't get it. What's this got to do with me?
Must've hit your head hard. For the especially gifted:\nFingerprints can identify you! Think. Tell you your name and why you came to the Zone. Understand?
Yes, I understand. What scientist? And where, exactly?
Screw... Memory's fading... Stalker, drank plenty. Always bought vodka. Thought drank himself dead. Brought good loot, gifted hands. Fixed TV, dosimeters... Why mention him?
His regards, I said. Said I could get something from you. Sidorovich, need small metal pipes. About this size. More for Screw than me... Anything like that?
What?! Where would I get that? Are they worth something? Haven't got anything like it! If it's not worth money, I don't damn well need it!
Right. I see. How much will it cost me?

Radiation made you deaf? Nothing like it! One option, though. Glad Screw's alive. Free advice: Lyokha Tambovsky. Smart, always making things. Might find something. At the Garbage, looking for parts. Message a couple hours ago...
Thanks. Did something for free for once... Old tightwad...
What was that, Marked One? It's not just my memory. My hearing's bad too...
THANK YOU, I said. Good health to you, Sidorovich.
Health? What health... Need anything else from me?
Sidorovich, did you call for me?
You imagined it, dear boy... Had too much stale vodka, probably...
Thought you'd gone to Agroprom? Read your messages more carefully, Marked One... Never know what else you might imagine. Found out what the soldiers are up to there?
Hmm... I met a soldier there.
Be more specific than "met a soldier." A bit thin. Hardly counts as information...
Information, he wants. A soldier's in the swamp. Served at the base before. Says the military's clearing the approaches to Agroprom. Some commission coming in summer.
I don't know... I need to stock up on gear.
Well, I've scouted the place.
Well? Stop dragging the cat by the balls. Get to the bottom... Pah, the point.
A deserter's lead helped me find something. Documents the military took from stalkers. Apparently about laboratories. A couple of references here. Found a soldier's album with pages from that bundle.
Well, damn it! That's bad. Try to find something tangible... Then I'll call someone in Kyiv.
Ah, Marked One... Your call. Choose. Your money, our merchandise.
Right, yes... The names on the signatures look familiar. But where are the documents themselves? Did you find out?
Soldier said the military took documents from stalkers. Apparently about laboratories. Look, a couple of references. Found a soldier's album with pages from that bundle.
If I had it, I'd have brought it. I need some supplies...
They're guarding them. At the base. In a safe, I think.
See what you need... Choose. Your money, our merchandise.
We'll think. Thanks. Here's something. Know a couple of people who can quietly get the documents. You can head to the Bar. I'll tell Duty's checkpoints to let you through. See you...
Doesn't seem so. Probably communications acting up. Happens. Sometimes the same message arrives several times. Or not at all... The Zone, brother...
Uh... Sent you a message to take the documents you found to the Bar. Didn't arrive? Communications must be acting up.
Yeah, I... Thought you needed those papers.
No, don't need them. Take them to the Barkeep. Spoken to him already. Sent word to the Duty checkpoint to let you through too. Get moving.

New cordon battalion commander wants most officers replaced. Doesn't like our understanding with them. Gathered facts, documents, photos for prosecutors. Bad for me and other stalkers. Harder to get supplies and ship loot...

All the incriminating material's at the checkpoint. Officer loyal to the new commander on duty. Try getting the document case. Difficult. Guarded, APCs at the entrance too... You're resourceful. Maybe quietly?
All right, I'll see what I can do...
I'll repay you. Tell you about my kum, give something for the road. No noise, all right? Military gets offended, we're all in trouble. On good terms with Kuznetsov? Ask him. Concerns him too...
I need it! You help me, I help you! My kum has information that could help your memory. If it works, I'll tell you how to meet him. Think you'll agree... Well?
What do you want from me?
Come on! It's a checkpoint in name only! Ten half-drunk conscripts and a warrant officer!.. Fine. Was really counting on you, though, Marked One.
Marked One, I've been thinking. Got something to suggest... What you really need is to find Strelok, right?
Let's say so.

Learned about Strelok. Real stalker. Found northern route, they say. Untouched Klondike...\nHelping find him, not for your pretty eyes. Earn it. Good for everyone: kill Strelok, learn what happened to you. I'll learn... Benefit too. Deal?
Go on.

Serious man. Need that.\nOther traders and I seek the way north, center. Someone or something blocks it. How Strelok slipped through, no idea. Place boils brains... Recently stalkers watched nearby soldiers. Important documents acquired, apparently linked to center. Third floor of institute, guarded. Need badly. Understand?
Exactly! If you get those papers, take them to the Barkeep immediately after leaving Agroprom. Runs things at the 100 Rads stalker bar, on the old Rostok factory grounds.
Understood.

Sending coordinates, information to PDA. North through Garbage, west, couple kilometers to Agroprom. Artifacts like mushrooms after rain at Garbage, radiation too. Buy antirads or vodka. Otherwise glow like New Year's tree... Joke! Good luck.
Don't get it. You want me to kill a hundred soldiers over some vague idea of yours? Hit your own head, have you, friend?

You joked, I laughed. Don't twist words! Not "kill"! Find out details. Look around Agroprom.\nSoldiers came for vodka, mentioned two deserters in swamp near base. Ask about the trouble, documents, everything. Understand?
That's clearer. Talk to the deserters, see what's going on.
Are you going to grill me every time? What about the documents? Managed to do anything?
Not yet. Best not to rush into it. I'll look around.
Don't take too long! This is important!
Listen, Marked One, good timing! Wolf said you were a good shot? We could really use help.
Hmm... Can't complain. Go on.

I'm Fanatic. In charge since Wolf left. Some fellows came yesterday. Bandits, apparently, but serious ones... Damn... Gave us one day to clear the camp. Their base now, they said. Coming back today. Won't end with talking this time.
What did you decide?
Ambush. Can't stand head-on. Good equipment, know guns. Our boys inexperienced. Hide in houses, pretend gone, attack when right. Need fighters like you. Repay after. Will you?
Strange. Why want this shitty farmstead on the Zone's edge, next to the military? Think it was an excuse... Looking for something or someone.
Maybe you know? You're mysterious. Nobody knows where you came from. Don't remember, or playing dumb... Don't like it. Nobody touched this frog pond before you appeared!
Who do you think I am?! Work for Sidor, jobs for Wolf, helping stalkers: none of that counts? Want to know why they came myself...
Never mind, just... Nerves. Don't understand this uninvited visit myself. Will you help?
I'll help.

Prepare. Hide greenest rookies in houses/basements, don't stick heads out. No pointless deaths. You, me, couple stronger men cover fire area. Enemy reaches fire, shoot from all sides! Coming from bridge soon. Find cover with good field. Start on my command. Your call, but little chance in open.
All right.
No, I'm not ready yet.
A fighter like you would've helped. We'll have to manage ourselves...
We're waiting for those beauties. They'll be here soon, I reckon.
You're a scary man, Marked One! Better stay out of your way.
A little.
Here, take a couple of artifacts to remember us by.
Hi, Marked One. Good to see you!
Hello to you, too.
By the way, where's Wolf gone?
Got a message from a passing stalker recently. Packed up, grabbed dynamite, rushed deeper into the Zone. Was recovering from a wound at the Cordon. Asked me to watch the rookies.
Ah... It's you, Marked One... Want something, or just passing through?
Oh, I was just...
Ah... It's you... Rambo... I've heard about you. Just what we needed...
Hmm... Who are you? And what brought this on?

I'm Fanatic. In charge since Wolf left. Some fellows came yesterday. Bandits, apparently, but serious ones... Damn... Gave us one day to clear the camp. Their base now, they said. Coming back today. Won't end with talking this time.
What did you decide?
Ambush. Can't stand head-on. Good equipment, know guns. Our boys inexperienced. Hide in houses, pretend gone, attack when right. If you're so Rambo-like, help rookies like me?
Didn't expect you to... People like you only think of themselves. We'll have to manage alone...
What are you waiting for? You're the tough guy... Get out front.
Yeah... Already...
You really are frightening, Marked One! One request: use your head before shooting everything in sight. Okay?
Hmm... Too many people giving advice these days.
Don't sulk. I'm talking sense... I'll tell our people you're someone we can deal with. Here, a couple of artifacts to remember us by.
You again? Get out... I vouched for you! Pah...
Hello to you, too.
I've got a flash drive here. Have a look.
Look at you! A whole flash drive! Now that's something...
Enough laughing... That laptop I brought you, does it read flash drives? Need to see what's on one.
Let's try... Seems fine. I can send this gibberish to your PDA...
Send it over. What's this gibberish?
Ask yourself. Escape a madhouse with your case files? Relax, joking... Don't go mad reading it. Erasing my copy. Don't need that nonsense. Enough loons in the Zone.
Just out of boredom... I'll skim it and throw it away. Thanks.
Tell me. Get it off your chest.
Yeah... Wait a bit.
There was something in those papers about a safe route north.
You've got sharp eyes, young man...
I'll try to find it.
Agroprom Research Institute? Safe path there directly from here. Soldiers came running from there, at least... Sometimes take mail outside the Zone. So...
I've got just that artifact. Here you go.
Yes, yes. I know already. Need to ask those soldiers...
Just right, thanks.\nVerified safe trail behind factory buildings to Red Forest. Map here.\nWouldn't advise without serious preparation. Our scouting group vanished. No news...
Dangerous? Probably need a good weapon... Means Agroprom. Think there was a chance to get decent equipment there. But... All that going back and forth...
I need my flamethrower refilled. Can you do it?
Gas and fuel shortages. Bring a gas cylinder and full canister, I'll fix it quickly. Ordinary artifact for the work. Might not manage sober... Bring vodka too! Actually, don't. Got some tucked away.
Short on artifacts right now... I'll manage without the flamethrower.
Gone sober? Here, I've got everything. Get to it.
You must have some in reserve? Could you mix up some of your own?
Wait ten minutes. I'll mix it up. Go relax for now.
A reserve... Might have one, but... All right, for a good man. An artifact, no lower than tier three, and it's a deal! Or a couple of tier two? Eh?
Get to work. I'll wait.
Whoa! I'll make do for now.
All right, deal! Here's a good artifact. When will it be ready?
Here's a pair of tier-two ones. When will it be ready?
Should be ready in ten minutes. Go do your business. Don't distract me, or it might blow. Go chat with the men.
Yeah. I'll get going.
Well, have you refilled the flamethrower yet?
Yes, I've filled it. Here. Tightened all the fittings. Holds pressure. Use it. Stop by if you need anything.
Don't rush me, all right? Where's the fire...
Thanks. I'll drop by.
All right, all right...
Delivered the food. Your guy's definitely not all there.
A little. He's mad, but sometimes says things that make you wonder: coincidence or a gift for prediction? Happens with madmen. Read it in a scientific magazine once. Long ago.
What did he predict?
Not exactly predicted... A truck turned up here recently. Heard about it? He was talking about it arriving long before it did.
All nonsense... Write down what every loon says and you'll go mad yourself... Didn't forget the food, did you?
Oh! Of course, here.
Bye.
You and your dynamite again...
I remember. I brought the mutant innards.
I've been thinking. Take my preserved body part.
Stubborn, eh? All right... We'll see.
All right, I'll try...
Yeah. Here, they gave it to me. Careful... Take it.
Well, would you look at that. I've got some on me! Take it.
Wow! You're well stocked. Didn't expect that... In that case, here. Don't strain yourself. Drop it and there'll be nothing left of you but a dirty smear.
I think I left one like that in storage. You're welcome to take it for your research.
I'll try to get some...
How? There's an option. If you're feeling brave, as they say... Our brains haven't managed to test a theory.
I want to find the Doctor. The Swamp Doctor.
Uh... Usually at his place... His hut in the Misty Thicket... Look there, I think...
Misty Thicket? What is it, and where?

Don't know? Thought experienced after all you've done... Nearby Misty Thicket, truly strange. Time unlike outside. Instruments fail, mutants fiercer, tougher. How Doctor lives there, no idea. Must have reason. Through that misty hollow...
Thanks... Yeah... That's the Zone, brother...
I need to think it over...
Yes, I've got an artifact right here!
Here, I've saved up ten thousand rubles...
Give me a few hours. Maybe I'll find an artifact and bring it to you. Well... Deal?
Five hours, no more. \nWe'll sit by the fire nearby... Succeed, prove you're more than talk, and I'll offer an interesting job.
I'm off, then...
No, I haven't got anything like that.
Then piss off!
I'm leaving. Work it out yourselves. Don't be rude. I owe your Baldy nothing.
Is it a big debt? I've got a little...
Got artifacts? A Jellyfish, or Stone Blood... Ordinary ones, basically. Or ten thousand in cash.
All right, we'll see...
To hell with you idiots...
Not much. Your information's pretty thin... And I had to buy that gun back. Understand?
All right, but if there's nothing there, I'll be back.
Here's the deal. Three "Fireballs." Got it? Tell me when to come.
We're short on money... Brother, there's a path to the Valley only our people use. Return my gun, I'll show it. Deal?
Good man! Look, here in the Dark Valley, under a bush on the waste ground...
All right, what else can I do? Take it.
Call me when you're ready for a proper conversation...
What's wrong? Moonlighting as an informant? Tell him everything... Maybe I need something. Don't make faces. Remember how you helped. Maybe do it together? I'll share...
Quite a change of heart... What will you share?
Bring a couple of cured flesh hides, if you don't mind, and I'll tell a terrible secret! No regrets. You know me! Something about Gho-o-ost! Well?
Clearer? Here. If it doesn't help, I can treat you with a rifle butt.
Find your own medicine. I understand.
Don't take offense. You know how things go. There. Remembered it. Another drink, maybe?
Right. Talk, or I'll bless you with a punch in the teeth!
Hey, sick man! Spit it out. What about Ghost?
What? Give me the artifact. And the hides. Then I'll talk.
Hey, sick man! Spit it out. What about Ghost?
What? You, uh, bring a bottle. Two. And two hides, too. Then my head might clear...
I haven't managed to find your Leshy yet...
Your men, Bullet and his friends. Started a fight with the bandits...
That's all we needed! We had an agreement... Never mind! I'll report it to the right people. Let them sort it out.
Thanks, friend. You really helped me. I won't forget.
What's happening here?
All right, don't strain yourself...
Even so... Thanks!

Got into trouble... Wanted to do some proper work. Gather artifacts, shoot mutants... Look how it ended. Heavy shooting at the old vehicle dump nearby. Wouldn't go there. Who knows who or why... Lost my gun too. Fucking Robin Hoods... You seem tough, though you look better suited to a coffin... Could you find me a special rifle?
Let's go.
Good health to you, friend! How's it going?
Marked One, good to see you!
Oh, it's you. What else?
Drop by sometime. We'll sit down, have a shot of tea...
Still alive, more or less. Sidor says you're good with everything? Help me find some metal pipes? About this size...

Pipes... Plenty of junk in those radioactive heaps. Needed some myself, took a dose finding them. Won vodka from Stas, treated it. Sell almost free. Want more things there, no protection. Have a radiation-removing artifact now, but belt battery dead. A couple batteries for the pipes. Deal?
Hmm, I haven't got a pair on me. Can you wait?
Yeah, don't mess with radiation. I know. Here, take it.
Of course... I'll be here another couple of days. Or you could look yourself. Might get lucky...
Good! Here are the tubes. Barely radioactive... Enjoy.
No, I don't think I need anything yet...
I've got batteries. I'll trade them for tubes...
Drop by if you need anything. Or just to talk...
Oh! No problem. Take these. Don't stuff them down your pants. Bit radioactive...
Not far. Straight along the tracks from the hangar. All kinds of bastards hanging around, but we need to deal with the others first. You in?
Go on.
Hmm, I might help, but not for nothing.
Bargaining? All you loners are alike. Strangle your brother for loot. Stalker today, Papa Borov's pet tomorrow?\nGot a couple of special artifacts. Help kill the bastards, I'll share... Agreed?
Your prized ones? All right, I'll try to help.
Sort it out yourselves. I've got enough problems of my own.
Job's not done yet. We'll talk later.
Hello. I need to see the repairman.
I won't let you through for nothing...
I've got bandages. Need any?
Bandages? Sure... Ten of them.
Here. Will you move aside?
What if it isn't for nothing? What do you want?
My brother and I are planning a deep artifact raid. Gathering supplies. Antirads essential, almost impossible to get here.\nGive me an antirad, I'll step aside...\nDeal?
All right. I don't use them anyway. Prefer vodka.
It's a deal! Go through!
I haven't got any antirad on me...
Then have you got a military medkit?
Collecting your suit from repairs? Long told me... Go through...
I've got an ordinary one. Will you take it?
An ordinary one? Two, then...
Great. Can I go through?
So it's ready? Thanks...
Yes? So? Remember the fee? Hand over the antirad...
Yes, I've got one. Here.
Ah, Marked One. Of course, go through. Thanks for the medicine...
I've got a scientific medkit.
Thank you.
I haven't got any medkits...
Listen, Garik, stop messing with my head... Tell me straight. How much medicine do you need?
Let me think... \nFifteen antirads or army medkits. \nTen scientific medkits would do too, and we can settle this...
It's a deal. Here's fifteen antirads.
Fifteen military medkits. Take them.
I've got ten scientific ones.
I haven't got that much medicine yet.
I'll come back next time...
You mentioned trading for vodka?

Me? When?
Oh, yes. Waiting's miserable. Bottle, and...
Stock up at Mikhalych's, doesn't last two days. Got vodka, I'll trade.
Two cans of food a bottle. Electrical artifacts too: tier one for three bottles, tier two for seven. 
Rare ones sometimes, no promises. Find today, nothing next emissions. Need a special detector. Worse, found without capsules, then shells form over time. Zone keeps surprising...
Fifteen bottles for ordinary capsule, forty-five for white. Those very rare.
I've got a bottle here. I'll trade it for canned food.
Ah! There it is... Here are the jars. Don't think they're expired... Come back if you need more...
You'll drink yourself to death at this rate...
Three bottles. I'll take the artifact.
Yes, I've got an ordinary artifact. A "Sparkler"...
No, doesn't work... Dulls things a little. Forget myself, hands stop shaking, heart isn't so cold. THEY'RE nearby... Got any?
I've got seven bottles. Give me the artifact.
Oh! Bottles, lovely bottles... And here's a good artifact. A Sparkler... Wanted to keep it, but never mind...
I'll save up some more bottles and come back.
Here's the vodka, 15 bottles. Give me the capsule.
Wow! That'll last a while. Here's the capsule. Glad you're taking it. Gives off a hell of a lot of radiation...
Sorry, friend, I haven't come across any.
A shame.
I'll save up some more bottles and come back.
I'll take a Pendulum capsule. Found one? White thing. Gives off even more radiation than the ordinary ones...
Got one. Have a container? Won't get it there without one, I'm afraid...
I'm afraid not. I very rarely find them...
Hold on... Only found one. Come back after the next emission. Maybe I'll find another...
Makes sense. And here I was getting my hopes up...
Hmm, I have one, but I need it myself. Maybe later.
I'll believe you, again. Here, take this.
Ivar, I met a couple of your seekers.
Yeah? Where?
At Tesla. Came across them by chance. Helped them with batteries. My last ones. Said they'd return them later, that they were on your team. Haven't come here?
No. Didn't see... Want something in return? Nothing now. Except... Dropped part of my load returning from Radar. Heavy... Lots of dogs. Find it, it's yours. Otherwise, sorry. Nothing to give.
All right. I'll look when I get the chance.
At Tesla. Asked for batteries, but I had none with me. Said they were on your team. Don't know if they got out. Haven't come here?
No. Haven't seen them... Check on them if you go back.
I doubt they're still there. I'll look when I get the chance.
No water to spare yet. Rationing it ourselves. Prosha needs to wash mutant parts, and we need water for production. Besides...
We're rationing it... But you did us that favor with the hides. All right, fill up at the washbasin. No more than two flasks a day. Free for now.
At least something's free.
No, it's all gone.
You've had water today already. Ought to leave some for others...
Hello. You in charge? Heard someone was looking for me. I'm Marked One. Got a tattoo on my arm. Here.
So what do you need? What do you want to ask me?

Think your bosses ordered you not to kill me, or "eliminate" me. Otherwise you'd have done it after speaking to the chief, then reported. Businesslike people, not talkers. Perhaps speak to your chief without intermediaries?

Don't be rude! Don't tell me who to report to! No hero act. We'll close the case here. Nobody found you. Came yourself. Higher-ups don't know yet. Never will. Counting to three. Who told you about the device? One... Two...

Wait, commander. Calm down. Some fellow I don't know said drunkenly a scientist lost a device for a monolithic gun. Thought drunken nonsense. Didn't describe gun. Assumed big solid cannon. You mentioned special weapon firing electric flames, remembered and connected it.
Fear loosens your tongue. Stops you calculating every move, eh? Never said the weapon fired flames. Seen it working, then? Where, when? Jokes are over, Marked One!
But Wolfhound said...
Couldn't have said that. Didn't know himself. Learned it only when the northern route opened. Time to finish this. I'm not Wolfhound. Won't pamper you. Other ways to loosen tongues...
Still alive? Nobody's bumped you off yet?
Who'd bother with me...

Think your bosses ordered you not to kill me, or "eliminate" me. Otherwise you'd have done it after speaking to the chief, then reported. Businesslike people, not talkers. Perhaps speak to your chief without intermediaries?

Don't be rude! Don't tell me who to report to! No hero act. Tell me what the Monolith men wanted, or we'll close the case quickly. Nobody found you. Came yourself. Higher-ups don't know yet. Never will. Counting to three. One... Two...

Wait, commander. Calm down. Some fellow said drunkenly a scientist lost a device for a monolithic gun. Thought nonsense, big solid cannon. Then wondered if he meant a Monolith gun. Went to ask. You mentioned electric flames, remembered and connected it.
Fear loosens your tongue. Stops you calculating every move, eh? Never said the weapon fired flames. Seen it working, then? Where, when? Jokes are over, Marked One!
But that guy said...
Couldn't have said it. Nobody knew. Learned it only when the northern route opened. Time to finish this. Enough pampering. Plenty of ways to loosen tongues...

You'll go where and when I say. Don't rush. \nKnow Radar's underground rooms. Knew before, didn't try. Emissions gone, situation changed. Send groups to guard bunker approaches so nobody grabs weapons prematurely. Seal doors, perhaps. They'll summon you eventually. We inspect first. Come when I call, show weapon if we haven't found it. With luck, put it in a container.
So devices like that exist? Told me anything I'm not supposed to know? Another question: what if I don't want to go to Radar? What's there for me...

Refuse, we'll bring you by force. Asking politely because better if you want to come and take it. Intent might affect whether it rejects you. Consider everything, if true. Still, refuse and you're brought anyway. Know more or less, same end.
Not a cheerful prospect... I'll gather my things, at least. Radar's no park, and I take it you won't give me an escort.
Hi!
Hey, brother, help me out!
Go on through...
Marked One! Killed that burer? Good man! Gift for you. Still setting up. Return in a few days. Oh, I'm Lyokha. Junk Dealer. Collect weapon junk, armor too. Small business. Bring anything, pay well.
Hi, Lyokha. You mentioned a present earlier.
Marked One? Oh! I remember. Here, take an ordinary artifact...
Yeah... Not much... Thanks.
Here, have a look...
Well, then... Let's work it out.
A stalker told me you knew Strelok?
Strelok? Didn't see him. Fang, his associate, came often. Gifted hands. Make something good from shit. Looked for parts sometimes. Lucky stalker. Tightfisted, though. Why the old story?
I'm interested. He knew something, or someone.
Over half a year ago.\nFind Strelok, remember: unusual gun. Valuable loot or artifact for it. Looks like Ksyukha with enough extras to resemble a Western rifle. Asked then. Wouldn't give it...
A fancy "Ksyukha," you say? I'll bear it in mind.
Remember our talk about Strelok's Kalashnikov?
Yes. Why?
I heard on the network that you knew Strelok?
Well... I came across one...
Wow! Will you give it to me? I'll give you a capsule. Eh?
All right, it's yours...
Thanks! Here, a little something out of my generosity...
No... I'll see how it handles, then we'll see...
Oh, it just came up...
Hi, man! Come to see us? Sit down, let's talk.
Sorry, can't right now. Something important: found any papers, scraps of information, or PDAs about X-18?
Yes, found it once... Why do you want that death trap? Wouldn't go there for all the artifacts in the world...
Unfortunately, there's no other way. Could you tell me where it is? Not for free, of course...
All right, I can see I won't talk you out of it... Don't need anything. I'll tell you and show you for free. Give me your PDA.
Thanks, friend. You helped me out.
I've got a question.
Just one? What is it?
Exactly. Didn't happen from nothing. Something must have contributed to the... Change. Never mind. Won't fill my head with it.
Can the information in someone's brain be replaced?

The brain is only a physical structure. An information medium, as they call it now. Data is data, immaterial. Changing the brain's structure destroys part of that medium. Its owner becomes an idiot. At best.
Without affecting the brain, could consciousness somehow be replaced? Partially, at least? Something tiny. An urge to go somewhere. North, say.
What is suggestion, then? Psychological conditioning, with or without chemical stimulants? Isn't that partial replacement of consciousness?
So it's possible someone pumped me full of something and drilled instructions into my head? Is that it?

You're winding yourself up again. I've told you you're too suspicious... What is a conviction? People can change their beliefs or ideas through outside events alone. An atheist sees something extraordinary he can't explain and suddenly believes in miracles. Becomes a convinced theist. Nobody suggested anything, yet his consciousness seems replaced. A different person before your eyes. He sets off into unknown lands to meet his creator... Did that kind of change ever occur to you?
More complicated talk. Speak to you and there's no need for a university. You seem to find it all funny too.

You suggested the discussion. Consciousness is delicate. You're right: I can't seriously discuss what nobody understands without smiling. Personally convinced no suggestion works unless the person is predisposed.
Here. He gave me an artifact as payment.
Decent artifact. Ten sausages for a sample. Tell Sidor larger orders need appropriate payment. Won't get away with artifacts.
All right, I'll pass it on. See you.
Said you'd work it out when you got there.
Old rogue... Got a job. Hunters at the northern camp nearby need a parcel. Buckshot, food, vodka. Bring mutant parts back. Do it, I'll give Sidor about ten sample sausages. Well?
If it's nearby, I'll take a walk. Why not.
Go on. Ask for Chinaman there. Here's the box.
Heavy bastard. Well, I'm off.
Sidorovich gave me an artifact to pay with.
Hmm. Plenty of wildlife running around your Gut... Think I'll do some population control, then trade the parts for sausage.
Fine by me. We'll spare some sausage for that. Let's see what kind of hunter you are... Come back when you've shot them.
All right, I won't take too long.
Listen, about the route to the Swamps...
The route? Oh! You mean the route to Clear Sky's base?\nWell? Got the ammo? Three hundred rounds, as agreed?
Yes, of course. Here they are...
Hmm, not quite...
Yes, of course. Here they are...
Great! Sorry I didn't help you for free... I'm a little short, and then you came along...
No, lad! Think I'm an idiot? Unload those little popgun rounds on someone else...
Ivan! Get to the point...
What do you mean, caps? I bought them... From a trader...

Beyond the hollow just past the village. Old trailer. Use it to cross the barbed wire. Trail leads to the Southern Farmstead in a couple of kilometers. West from there, through the old church... There...
All right, I'll go and try to find it...
Listen, Ivan, heard of the Clear Sky faction?
Ha ha! Joking? See my armor? They call me Nebov because I was in that faction... Yes, those were the days...
I heard the faction leaders were looking for a stalker called Strelok.
Why the old story? Yes, searched... Hired a mercenary to hunt Strelok. Wasn't involved myself. Lebedev and Kalancha decided Strelok was making the Zone grow... Gathered everything available on him...
Where's the information? Anything left? And what are these mercenaries? Freelancers working for anyone they choose, or some central organization?

Don't know or care who mercenaries are. Just avoid their sights. Anything left of Clear Sky, at our old Swamps base. Left with Lebedev almost a year ago. Boar wounded me, spent nearly two months here, all loot gone. Recovered, visited base. Empty...
Right... Will you take me to your base in the Swamps?

Not going there. Sick of mud... I'll show the Swamps route, but not free. Want another try at finding the center. About ten packs of AKM ammo, ordinary rounds fine. Serious beasts up north. Then I'll show you.
I'll think about it. I need ammo myself, especially that caliber...
Think it over... Just don't think too long... I'll be heading back to the center soon. Spent a bit too much here.
Ivan, I've got the artifacts you need...
Ivan keeps his word! What artifacts? Remember the Kalashnikov?
Here are the artifacts and the rifle.
Sorry, I've still got to stop by Sidorovich's...
Excellent! Take the shotgun...
Ivan, about your shotgun.
What's my little shotgun to you?
Honestly, I've been promised some very important information for that gun... Maybe we can strike a deal?
Ivan, about your shotgun.
We've discussed it, haven't we? Two tier-two artifacts, plus a pair of ordinary ones, and this marvel's yours...
Hi, brother. I'm Marked One. What's your name?
Good health to you, too. I'm Ivan.
That's an unusual weapon you've got. Where's it from?
Unusual, yes. Traded a stalker for it at the Garbage. Had artifacts, decided to... Good gun for creatures. What's your interest?
Listen, Ivan, honestly, I've been promised very important information for that gun... Maybe we can bargain?
Just curious. Does it hit hard?
Not opposed. Paid three good artifacts... Give two good tier-two ones, gladly hand over gun. Need a good weapon too: 7.62. Spent all loot drinking with boys, secretly. Deal?
Like it? Hits hard... Want to make a deal?
All right, it's a deal. Here's two artifacts and the rifle.
I haven't got it on me yet. Wait, I'll bring it soon.
Well, I wouldn't mind. If you don't ask too much.
Excellent! Take it...
Won't profiteer. Paid two artifacts. Return those, plus a little bonus, and it's yours. Two tier-two artifacts... And a couple of ordinary tier-one ones.
All right, I've got just the thing. Here.
I haven't got it on me yet. Wait, I'll bring it.
Good. Take it. Remember Ivan Nebov's generosity. Former Clear Sky man...
What details... Told him your childish counting rhyme. He told me another. Something about sevens.
Be specific. What numbers did Major Cherepanov give you? How we conclude this business depends on that.
Uh... Well... Definitely seven. Then... Seventy-seven, maybe... No. Definitely started with seventy. Forgot what came after.
Seventy-six? Seventy-two?
There! Exactly! Seventy-two! Made me think of those two barrels in the eyes...
Fine. Can't expect much from an ordinary stalker. Consider the job done. Here's supplies. Can I count on you if needed?
Yeah, supplies... We'll see. Depends how things go.
I think I've seen it before...
Good. The more you bring, the less you'll get... Heh-heh.
Your jokes sound like a cop's. Were you one, once?
Cop or not, what difference? Business. I'll tell our people in the Valley not to interfere. Try to come back. Here's something for the road.
How caring of you. Take care, cop.
Hear me out before judging. Told me you're planning to enter the old laboratory at Borov's former base, looking for traces of your Strelok.
Hear me out before judging. Told me you entered the old laboratory at Borov's former base, looking for traces of your Strelok.
Let's say I'm going. What do you want from me?
I've been there. What do you want from me?
Sort your business out without me.
Not right... Speaking as a speci... alist. People with schizo... Sick people don't think that way. You're different. Strelok meant a techni... cal problem. Not consciousness...

How do you know? Technical, mental... Knowing another consciousness might be overlaid, I'll doubt memories, whether I sought center or another mind led me. Dreams, desires: mine or not? Stand at Monolith shouting "Who am I?" Ignorance is bliss. Ghost was right.
Too suspicious... Someone says something and off you go. Interpreted their words yourself. Doctor was right... No suggestion for you... Must understand yourself... \nWhy that look?
Doctor discussed me with you?! My... Case? So the Doctor too... Should've understood. Said he'd met Strelok. Sent me to Ghost... Told me nothing. Head's spinning... Some Doctor.
You've misunderstood... The Doctor's worried about you. We didn't discuss... Only a little. Asked my advice. Wants to help. Right not to tell you...
What? You think he's right not to tell the truth?

Come on... Really! What truth? You'll make me stutter... Truth is what's true for you. Only you can discover it. Didn't want to suggest anything. You had to understand yourself... Still can. Realize who you are. Understand?
Yes... Myself... Only myself! Can't trust anyone now. Your "truth" is nice, but I can't trust you either. Sorry.
Quite right. Speaking as a psychologist... Don't take anything on faith. Find out for yourself.
Certain now... But how? Whatever anyone says, I'll doubt everything. Even my "memories." Only one way. North, to the Monolith... Find out there whether Strelok did anything or not.
Do you know the way to the Monolith?
Not yet... Ghost knows. Or pretends, and wants to see how I do it. Doesn't matter... He'll tell me what I need. Now he won't have a choice.
It's very dangerous. You realize there... May be no way back? Think carefully.

What's to think about? Doubt who I am all my life? Lie awake wondering if I'm a zombie, or becoming one? Better die at the Monolith with a chance to learn everything than become something else. \nNeed to ask the Doctor something first, though.
With all due respect, I've got the artifact you need!
Give it here... Let's see if it's different...
Here...
Get your PDA out, connect it. I'll download the recipe for you...\nAnd to ease the pain of giving up such a rare artifact... Here's a Dummy.
Wait. I'll have a look myself.
Got any interesting recipes?
There's... a way to trans...form an arti...fact into a "Dummy." If interested...
Oh, really? All right, I'll try to find it.
Nah, what do I need that for...
Got any more interesting recipes?

No recipes... Got a good artifact... Modified. Interested? Arranged something with Shinkar... Has a weapon for me. Should've put it aside... Go see him? Need to give him money. Won't hand it over otherwise. You understand.
Shinkar's a real miser. Give me what you've got... I'll go.
What would I need that for...
I brought the weapon. It's fantastic...
Give it here...
Here...
Yes... Good weapon... Here's your artifact...
I'll keep it. Sorry.
I brought the containers you asked for.
Yes... Well, thanks...
So what about the recipe?
Where is it... Lost it? Looks like it... \nBad luck. Don't be so upset, though. Got something else...
I'll think about it. I might still need it myself.
Got any more interesting recipes?

There are... A way to trans... form Night Star into Mother's Beads. Good, eh? You've helped already, I know, but bring two containers: one for a single artifact, one for three. I'll need them now. Will you?
All right, I'll bring it...
Sorry, Ivar, I can't. Those containers are expensive...
Listen, do zombified people ever recover?
We should... Just need to find a method... Precise enough. Still trying. There are failures too... Unfortunately.
Lost their memory... If someone partly loses it, is he a "half-zombie"? If the "process has started" and can't be reversed, what awaits him? Makes you think...
Lost their memory... If someone partly loses it, is he a "half-zombie"? If the "process has started" and can't be reversed, what awaits him? Makes you think...
Lost their memory... If someone partly loses it, is he a "half-zombie"? If the "process has started" and can't be reversed, what awaits him? Makes you think...
Lost their memory... If someone partly loses it, is he a "half-zombie"? If the "process has started" and can't be reversed, what awaits him? Makes you think...
I was thinking... Did you know Fang?
I was thinking... Did you know Fang?
I've been thinking... Maybe contact the scientists. They could suggest a way to help zombies if we brought them one...
I was thinking... Did you know Fang?
I did... What's Fang got to do with this?
I did... What's Fang got to do with this?

No scientists! You'd give them a... Guinea pig. Think they want a cure? Do everything to keep him half-zombie. Study what happens with knife, fire, whip... Then "for science" condition him, study control. "Good cause." "One innocent victim to save thousands." Hypocrites! Don't... Do it...
I did... What's Fang got to do with this?
Had a problem with his head... Met him underground at Agroprom. Don't know exactly what happened. Whenever he surfaced, became like a zombie. Exactly that description. Normal underground.
Has a problem with his head... Met him underground at Agroprom. Don't know exactly what happened. Whenever he surfaces, becomes like a zombie. Exactly that description. Normal underground.
Calm down! This isn't good for you. Getting so worked up. I want to help too... How do you know?
Had a problem with his head... Met him underground at Agroprom. Don't know exactly what happened. Whenever he surfaced, became like a zombie. Exactly that description. Normal underground.
You said "becoming"... What happened to him? Did he recover?
Hmm... What happened to him? Did he recover?
Know... A little about it... First... hand. That's why I want a way... Trying. Trying to help... Not experimenting on zombies. I mean...
You said "becoming"... What happened to him? Did he recover?
Don't know yet. Sakharov made a protective helmet. Took it to Fang. He surfaced. Helicopter picked him up, took him somewhere. Sakharov said they'd cure him. Thought I might contact the scientists...
Not yet. Sakharov seems to know how to cure him. Thought I might contact the scientists...
Well? Getting stuck again? Don't strain yourself.
Don't know yet. Sakharov made a protective helmet. Took it to Fang. He surfaced. Sakharov offered a helicopter at Agroprom to take him somewhere. Said they'd cure him. Had doubts, though...
So did he get out or not?
Came out, but not where Sakharov asked. Secret route. Fang took the helmet into the Misty Thicket. Wondering if I was wrong. Scientists would've helped somehow. Who'll help him there now...

No scientists! Think you helped Fang? Gave a... Guinea pig. Want to cure him? Keep him half-zombie. Remove helmet sometimes, study knife, fire, whip... "For science," condition him, study control. "Good cause." "One innocent victim to save thousands." Hypocrites! Shouldn't... Have... Done it...

No scientists! Think you'll help Fang? Give a... Guinea pig. Want to cure him? Keep him half-zombie. Study knife, fire, whip... "For science," condition him, study control. "Good cause." "One innocent victim to save thousands." Hypocrites! Shouldn't... Do it...
No. Not that. I meant... Don't experiment now... These are sick people... Lost so much memory they don't remember being people... But they ARE PEOPLE. That's what matters.

Not those scientists! Think that would've helped Fang? Given a... Guinea pig. Kept him half-zombie. Removed helmet sometimes, studied knife, fire, whip... "For science," conditioned him, studied control. "Good cause." "One innocent victim to save thousands." Hypocrites! Did right. Don't doubt...
Calm down! This isn't good for you. Getting so worked up. I wanted to help too... How do you know?
Calm down! This isn't good for you. Getting so worked up. I want to help too... How do you know?
Calm down! This isn't good for you. Getting so worked up. Why do you think they'd do that?
Know... A little about it... First... hand. That's why I want a way... Trying. Trying to help... Not experimenting on zombies. I mean...
Well? Getting stuck again? Don't strain yourself.
No. Not that. I meant... Don't experiment now... These are sick people... Lost so much memory they don't remember being people... But they ARE PEOPLE. That's what matters.
Know... A little about it... First... hand. That's why I want a way... Trying. Trying to help... Not experimenting on zombies. I mean...
Well? Getting stuck again? Don't strain yourself.
No. Not that. I meant... Don't experiment now... These are sick people... Lost so much memory they don't remember being people... But they ARE PEOPLE. That's what matters.
Know... A little about it... First... hand. That's why I want a way... Trying. Trying to help... Not experimenting on zombies. I mean...
Well? Getting stuck again? Don't strain yourself.
No. Not that. I meant... Don't experiment now... These are sick people... Lost so much memory they don't remember being people... But they ARE PEOPLE. That's what matters.
I told you about Fang.
Yes. You did the right thing. I already said that.
Maybe right, maybe not. Still can't surface. Go see him? You understand this better than others. Even the Doctor.
Of course I'll go. The whole thing... bothers me too. A lot. But I'm not ready yet...
Don't forget him when you're better. Go to the Doctor in the Misty Thicket. He'll explain what happened to him, and take you there.
All right. You're his only hope now.
You? Think we've met... Not properly... Let's get acquainted. Ivar.
Yes, we've met... You probably don't remember well, since you were out of it. I'm Marked One. See you've come around.
Ah... Yes. A little. Remember this, forget that...
Much the same with me. More or less. Ivar, are you the ones called the Seekers? What are you looking for, if it's no secret?
Yes... Looking for special artifacts... Could use them for dezom... bification. Still can't pro... nounce things well. Sometimes.
Dezombi... Can't even say it myself. You mean curing zombies? Think I've heard something about that...

At the Bar, you must've heard... About "Doctor" Ivar... They don't understand they could become like that anytime. Any of them. Voronin himself. Would he want his own kind of "help" for zombies, his comrades? Or a cure?
I thought they were walking corpses. Can you really turn something dead back into something alive?

Exactly: you thought... Some justify their... Experiments. Like dissect... ing a corpse. Medical students use corpses too... But they're people. Need help. Trying, not succeeding yet... Want to help us?
Not sure yet... Makes me feel sick. Zombies don't look like people... I'll think about it. Maybe come back.
Ah, Marked One... Look at yourself from outside... What makes you look human? And me now... Think. Maybe... That's all that separates us from beasts...
Where are all your seekers? You seem alone. Nobody else around.

Hard question... A couple disappeared. Then the Scorcher... Sent them, gave diagrams... Didn't return. Maybe others... Blame me. What could I do? Exposed myself. Barely got out. Recover, try gathering the group again. Meet anyone, say I'm at the Bar.
Of course I'll pass it on when I get the chance.
Good you reminded me. Met two at Tesla. Helped with batteries. Last ones. Said they'd return them, they were on your team. Come to see you?

No. Didn't see... Want something back? Nothing now. Except... Dropped part of my load returning from Radar. By the fence. Heavy... Lots of dogs. Find it, it's yours. Otherwise, sorry. Nothing to give.
All right. I'll look when I get the chance.
Good you reminded me. Met two at Tesla. Asked for batteries, had none. Said they were on your team. Don't know if they got out. Come to see you?
No. Haven't seen them... Check on them if you go back.
I doubt they're still there. I'll look when I get the chance.
And, uh... Thanks for your help.
Mmm...
How are you doing?
Yes... Seems to be easing. Doctor came, helped... Left straightaway. Have I... Seen you before?
Of course. You told me about the District Center. Don't remember? You weren't speaking well. Still aren't, really.
No... Not that. Some time before.
You think we've met? Do you know who I am?
No... Don't understand myself. You reminded me of someone... Well... Can't be... You can't be him...
I see. You're getting confused again. You should rest. You're still not looking too good.
Yes. Probably... Not very well yet.
Wait, while you're a little more yourself... You said Strelok gave you documents. Drawings, plans, diagrams? What were they? Where from?

Don't know. Put copies on my PDA... Gave him research too... Don't know where he got it. Sought a route, wanted to understand... Thought zombies came from the Scorcher. No. Scorcher gone, new zombies. More... Why? Don't understand... All for nothing...
Don't worry. It's still hard for you to get the words out.

He said Monolith emits, causing zombies, mental disorders. Worked on it, didn't understand. Thought stories. Monolith, field, Call... Thought illness. Said Scorcher deliberately blocks apathy field. Didn't think... Understood on myself. Barely escaped. Hard...
Lucky, really.
Yes... Happens. Worked on it. Know... Cured a few... Not completely gone yet... You reminded me of someone...
Later. Don't get sidetracked. Tell me about Strelok.
Yes. Strelok... He left me notes... Before he went... So I'd understand why...
Where did he go?
Don't know... Gone for good... the Mark...
Did he pick up the "Black Mark"?
No... Didn't understand... All in the notes... Gave them to the Doctor... Everything. Why it's on... Why it can't be turned off. Thought it was a mistake...
Why was the Scorcher deliberately switched on? So Strelok did switch it on? Since he had the diagrams.
Don't know... Unlikely. Though... Said something about modulation... It wouldn't let him... Now... Must switch it on. Another modu... lation, if not the same...
That's what I want to know. Where did you switch it on? An egghead said Radar. Can't figure out where. You must remember.
Yes. There. Not me... Monitored only. They misunderstood. Switched everything off. No power now. Doors blo... cked... Deliberately, probably. Or mistake... Nobody else... But backup... Mmm...
Wait, hang on a little longer. A reserve of what?
Power... Somewhere in the Valley... Don't know... References in the diagrams. Gave them PDA... Mmm... Worse again... Go find out... In the Valley... Mmm...
All right, sorry. Rest for now. \nSomewhere in the Dark Valley, then...
The Doctor... To him...
What? Something else you want to say?
Doctor came... Went to the Thicket... He's there. Gave him papers... Notes. Go see him... Mmm... Maybe among them... Where... Backup... Mmm. See him...
Understood. Doctor has Strelok's notes. Good he took them. Won't be lost... Visit him in the Thicket first, then the Valley. Things to discuss.
Mmm...
Yes, yes. Don't strain yourself. Rest. Still have a lot to ask you about Strelok.
Marked One...
Well, feeling better now?
So-so...
Got the Doctor's notes. Can't quite understand them... Is all of it really true? About the Monolith, the madmen?
Yes. Thought it was... Fantasy, at first. Compared things... Very similar. Must switch it on... Again. Then something... Will be clear.
Worked that much out... All right, I'll switch it on. Then what? Try to reach that Monolith? Why would I... How, even... If Strelok couldn't.
Ghost... He probably knows how... Roughly... At least. Strelok couldn't have done it anyway.

Ghost... Secretive bastard. Doc said he'd wait in the Cave. Fell for it. Looked at me asleep and vanished. Don't understand. Doctor says he wants a word. Why stall? What does he want? Come and talk...
Yes... He's strange. Strelok didn't really... Trust... Ghost, I think. Didn't tell him about the Mark.
So he did pick up the "Black Mark" after all?
No... Not that. Doesn't matter now. He's gone anyway... Mmm...
What, twisting you up again?
A little... Main thing now is to turn it on. You understood.
I didn't understand any of it. Someone talks as if the Zone's a hundred years old. A typo, or what...
Yes. That's right... Thought Strelok was some kind of scientist... But... I suspect... He's... Hmm...
Why are you moaning again? If talking's hard, keep quiet. Don't strain yourself. We'll discuss it when you're better. Just stay at the Bar.
Yes. Later...
Meanwhile, I'll sort out the lab in the Valley. See how it goes. Then we'll know what to do next.
You... Who? Why... Doesn't matter...
What? I don't understand... Who are you?
I... Ivar... Ivar... No strength. Pressure. No desires. None of it needed. In vain. Pressure... Something... Went wrong. Probably.
Ivar? You're who I need... Take it slowly. Calm down. I'm Marked One. You're Ivar. Let's try talking. All right? Say if you understand.
Yes... Marked One... Hard to talk. Let's try...
Here's the thing. I was at Radar. Thought that's where you shut it off. Switched a few things off, but it...
Mmm... Oh...
Damn! Need to keep it simple... \nIvar, did you switch off the Brain Scorcher?
Yes... No... My people...
So was it you or not? All right. But how?
There, underground... Strelok... Gave me diagrams... Can't remember. Shouldn't have... He asked me. Shouldn't have...
Strelok gave you the diagrams? Where is he?
Yes... Diagrams, maps... He had them. Don't know... where from... He left... Asked me not to do it.
Don't do what?
Not turn it off. Dangerous... He turned it on... Had no choice... Didn't understand then... Oh!.. Hard.
All right. Get some rest.
You... Again.
Yes. I need to ask about Strelok. How are you?
Yes... Better... Strelok... Said it mustn't be switched off.
The Brain Scorcher? Why? It burns people's brains out.
Thought so too... He's probably right... Beyond Radar, something... He suppressed it... With emissions. Didn't understand... Hard to understand...
Don't understand you... Strelok switched on the Scorcher at Radar? Nonsense. How? What was he trying to suppress with emissions? How did he know?
Tired... Keep it short...
Yes, sorry. What's beyond Radar, up north?
Monolith... That's what he called it... Creates a field... Helplessness, apathy... Drives you mad. Illusions... Expanding. Worse for everyone...
The Monolith? It's all fairy tales... Probably.
Tired...
Just a little longer. Stay with me. How did he learn the route? Where did his diagrams come from? Where are they?

Don't... Know. Gone... Gave PDA. Stayed there... Didn't get out... Worse... Listen while I can... \nScientists. Could say... Where underground. Scientists. In town. District Center. Go. Must... Switch back on. Important. They know, might know... He said... Didn't believe... Mmm...
District Center? What District Center?
Yes, yes... That one. There. Go...
District Center... I'll think of something.
It's hard... I can't...
Yes, I understand... Rest.
Mmm...
What?
Need to rest... Come back later.
All right. Rest.
I don't know!.. Always spoke in riddles. Stopped in mid... Sen... tence... Damn it.
Take your time.
In fragments. Then suddenly... Happy. Says it's a chance! For everyone. Everyone thought wrong... The Mark isn't evil. A blessing.
Who did he mean? A chance for whom?
Didn't say. His group, maybe... A chance for them. Somehow. Then rushed off again... Looking for the Mark? Its carrier? Strange man. Black Mark drains life. What damn chance? Don't understand...
I'm not sure yet, either. Those plans he gave you... Did he say where from?
No... Said he tried going through them... Those tunnels. Can reach Rainbow's controls, but no farther... All flooded. Says there's no point trying.
Where did he need to go after that?

Don't know! Strange, riddles, fragments. Never spoke openly... Interested in my research. Wanted Black Mark, fragment information. Gave some. Gave me plans in return. Says impossible to pass that way... Where? Who knows. Can only guess.
Yes, I have a fair idea... Need to think it through. You get some rest for now.
I'd like to store a few things...
Yeah? Well... Spit it out...
I've collected some loot. Worried it'll go missing...
Hand over your loot. No mutt will touch it... They respect me here.\nYou'll owe me!
Well... In a little while, maybe. What do you charge for storage?
Women are a problem here. None in the Zone...\nBring at least a magazine, and we'll be happy.\nYou can leave your stuff with us for a day.
So that's how it works... All right, deal!
Hi, Wiry. Will you look after some loot for me?
Of course. Haven't forgotten our deal... Got a magazine with girls?
Had one around here somewhere... Take it.
A deal's worth more than money! In the cabinet. No bastard'll get in...
Excellent!
You gave me a good magazine, brother. Want to extend the time?
Where do I find you a magazine? Will you take cash instead?
Money... Sounds tempting, but no... Bring a couple of bottles or some hunter's sausages for one-time access instead.
No, haven't found a single one yet. Just open it.
Vodka. Two bottles.
I can give you a couple of sausages...
I've got a bottle and a ring of sausage to go with it.
Used it all myself.
Ah, Marked One. Sorry, can't do it now. F... Damn lock's jammed. We'll fix it soon...
I've changed my mind...
Yeah, it happens... I'll wait.
The safe's open. Stash your stuff.
How are you doing here?
Worse than before, better than it'll be. What about the scientists?
Did you modify it?

Yes. Not all the way. Started on it, changed a few things. Didn't test it a second time, though. Thought, to hell with it, let him fire it himself. Maybe he'd made another mistake, enough to take my arm off this time.
And what about the weapon?
What kind of weapon is that? I wouldn't even call it a weapon. It's just another one of Strelok's experiments. You had it right: a prototype.
Fine, a prototype. Where is it?

Who knows. Left it in a stash. Secret cave under a lake in the Misty Thicket. Used to keep things there. Protects from emissions. Looked later, couldn't find it. Dropped it somewhere, maybe. Didn't need it much.
What did Strelok say to that?
Nothing... Always full of ideas. Forgot it, or planned something better. Wrote a list of new experimental parts. Sometimes no idea what he wants... Prototype's somewhere there. Why do you need it?
How do I get to this Thicket?
How do I explain it...
Just describe a landmark by the passage. I'll understand.
If you mean the most distinctive one, it's in the Dark Valley. Enter from the Garbage, turn left immediately. Walk a little. A fallen tree somewhere...
Ah. I think I get it...
Tell me how much longer I have to stay here.
Well... I just got curious.
Ah... I'm interested in what the scientists say. How much longer here?
Scientists study everything... Wanted to ask you something. Heard at the Bar you made an unusual weapon.
Not much longer now...
Made all sorts of things. Weapons, too. Fixed someone's TOZ, another man's Kalashnikov. Can't remember everything.
A special weapon. Some prototype that runs on a battery.

Oh! Yes. But I never finished it. Strelok gave me some drawings. Where he found them, who knows... I told him it wouldn't fire. Where would I find a power source like that? He said, don't worry, the power's not your problem. Just build the thing. So I did. If that's what you mean.
Have you tried firing it?

I did. Strelok brought a couple of strange batteries to try. Said he couldn't get more yet. Missing some special substance. Thought he was joking, pulling my leg. Loaded it, pointed it at a stone, and it really did go off. Smashed the stone to bits. A fragment nearly hit me in the head. I said, you should warn me! I'd have stood farther away. He scratched his head and said there'd been a little error in the calculations. Needed some modifications.
What, the battery?
No, the design itself. Focus the beam more tightly.
Here we are. Sorry, my friend. Lied. Your husband died... \nTell you when we met, you'd never have come... \nNeed to leave. Nothing here for you but death.
What?! No, you're lying... I don't believe it... \nHow could you...
All right, calm down. You can curse me later. Right now we need to get out. Let's go...
It's not far. Let's go...
Here's a medkit, man...
I can't help you. Sorry...
The Cordon, then... Damn it! I need to go the other way... There goes my lead.
If I hurry, can I catch him? All right, I'll hurry...
I haven't got that gun! Traded it yesterday for a couple of Sparklers...
Do you know Diman, the guy called Nut?
Marked One, still running around... Tempting fate...
Ha! Don't lecture a scientist...
Take care...
Respect to you scientists. You don't lose heart.
You bet! Can't do otherwise.
Ah! It's you, Marked One... Still looking for happiness?
By the way, I managed to get your data back...
Good. Sit with us... Shashlik will be ready soon. Good meat, from outside the Zone. How are you?
Oh! Unexpected! No need to redo all that dangerous routine work now.
Respect to you scientists. You don't lose heart.
You bet! Can't do otherwise.
Helped greatly. My little help might be useful. Friend Rasp in Valley needs a neutral contact with bandits. Visit him there. Has something unique to help a wanderer like you...
Rasp? From Borov's gang?
Don't get worked up! You help me, I help you... Brother to brother...
Hey, stalker! Come over, let's talk...
Are you Rat?
Krysyuk! My surname's Krysyuk!
What rubble?
There's a way underground in the Dark Valley nearby. Entrance blocked, but not badly. Five men could clear it in half a day. Help? Asking you as a respected man. All those rookies around you...
I'll wipe out all the bandits. Count on it.
Nobody there. I've already cleared the approaches.
All right, big exterminator. Get to work, then... Come asking favors afterward...
Cleared it, you say? Don't look special. Surname Terminator? Joking. How will you pay? Rookies or not, nobody breaks their back for thanks, even for the Terminator...

Who needs hardware! A check for a thousand dollars, then business. Can you get one? Sidor issues them. Barkeep too.\nAlso short on buckshot. Plenty of mutants, unfortunately. Bring a hundred rounds for a good cause with the money... Deal?
A check and ammo? I'll try...
Don't hesitate. It's all agreed. Money and bullets from you, work from us.
Hmm... All right, I'll go get it.
I need a lot of food. Have you got more?
Hmm... How much more?
A couple of crates of canned meat. More than ten loaves of bread, too.
No, won't have that much. Go see Sidorovich. Might keep a reserve. I've got what I've got.
Sidorovich, then? Hope I catch him there.
Sidorovich says your battalion commander collected some dirt?
That's true. He's pissed everyone off. Why can't he leave well enough alone? What's it got to do with you?
The trader promised to help me with something if I got that incriminating material... Can you help? You'd benefit too, wouldn't you?
Could do it myself. Others too. Problem is, commander practically sleeps with the case. Combination lock too. Understand?
I don't follow. What's the problem?

Case disappears, they'll search us all! Commander checks almost daily. Can't remove papers. Locked... Thought if we found an identical case, swapped it... Frame the commander, keep us above suspicion.
Yes, that's fine. What sort of case? Could we find another like it?

Couldn't find one. Got it here in the Zone. Some stalker craftsman made it. Find out quickly. In a week, might be too late. Here's a photo, might help... Find one, come back. I'll make the arrangement flawless.
Right, I see... I'll try asking some people with the know-how.
About the case with the compromising material.
Come on! Too late! Our battalion commander flies out tomorrow... Feel like we'll never meet again... Hope I don't end up in prison! Ahhh!
All right, maybe...
I found a case like that... So it's too late?
Got the case on you? If so, I'll arrange the swap quickly...
Hmm! No, I left it somewhere nearby.
Yes, here it is. Take it...
Hurry up and bring it! We've only got a few hours left!
Identical! Excellent... I'll speak to our people... Come to the barracks from the fence side around midnight. Know where? Concrete slabs...
I'm on my way!
I know, I know...
Be more specific. I'd rather not walk into a bullet.
Good. A soldier will wait by those slabs with a box... If it works, you know you'll always be a welcome guest here...

Facing checkpoint from here, APCs in center and right have heat-seeking systems. Avoid. Left, close to wire. Gap by fallen tree. Cross, fence and sentry tower on right. Concrete slabs at fence end. Soldier there after midnight. If successful, come share a bottle...
What acid? What do you need it for?
Ordinary sulfuric acid. You've probably got some kind of vehicle workshop? Somewhere you fill the batteries?
My memory's fine, unlike some people's... Kidding. Brought vodka?
Yes, I've got it. Here.
Not all of it yet. Wait a little...
All right. Deal. I'll tell the men. Come back in an hour. You'll have your jar of acid.
Then why bring it up? Go get it. We'll talk when you bring it back.
All right...
Ah! It's you, stalker. What do you want?
Passage is prohibited here, stalker.
Job's done!
What job? Why are you so pleased with yourself?
I'm sorry, but I really need to get to the other side.
Oh, I just wanted to ask something.
Stop dragging it out. Talk!
Got vodka? Three bottles, then you can pass.
Three bottles! All right, here...
Good man! Get through, quick. The officers might show up...
I'm moving, I'm moving...
Three bottles is a lot. Can we work out something else?
What are you, a fag? That's not our line of business...
No, I just thought you might need something else...
Passage is prohibited here, stalker.
Hello, Comrade Major. Someone said we could make a deal?
Someone told you? Hmm... What did you want?
To get to the other side...
Here. I was saving it for myself...
Get through quickly. Any officer could show up...
Got it, I'm moving...
A couple of bottles, then through you go...
No, nothing like that...
I haven't got any vodka...
Get some vodka, and we'll make a deal...
Ah! It's you, stalker. What do you want?
I want to cross.
The fee's set. Two bottles...
I remember. Here you go...
Yeah, go on. Quick as a fly...
Already flying...
I thought it'd be cheaper...
Hello, Marked One. How's it going?
Still alive. How about you?
No offense taken. What did you want?
I want to get through...
Here. Good vodka.
Good vodka? Go on, quick, before an officer sees you...
I'll be quick. I need something else...
Make it quick. What else?
One bottle, then run like a bullet.
Bad. Killed my old classmate Seryoga. You were seen there. Dark Valley. Knew it was your work, I'd shoot you. Otherwise, leave while I'm still kind.
I want to buy some gear.
I'm out of vodka. I'll come back later...
Your call... I'm not clairvoyant.
Uh...
I'd like to discuss something.
Be specific...
Don't loiter here! Move along if you've got no vodka...
Well, I'd like...
What else? Stop hesitating. Get out what you've got!
Hi, Marked One! Want to pass through?
I want to trade for something you've got.
Your call...
Yes, I need to get through.
Of course, go through! Just make it quick. Never know who might show up...
Take care. I'm off...
Hi, Marked One! Want to pass through?
Yes, I need to get through.
Of course, go through! Just make it quick. Never know who might show up...
Take care. I'm off...
Do you want to pass through?
Hmm... Yes...
Got vodka and something to eat? The officers seem to be gone for now...
Vodka? How much?
A bottle and a couple of cans will do... Then pass... Or just a couple of bottles. Failing that, about four cans of food.
Here's the canned food. Don't burst...
I've got vodka. A couple of bottles...
Here's a bottle and a can...
Ah, army life. I haven't got any vodka...
Yeah... You can go. Just be quick.
Got it! Take care...

What?! Think this old man is some Jew at the market? I'm trying to help you kindly! Wait, it's on the tip of my tongue... Ah! Remembered!\nKnow Gray? An experienced stalker. He told me, probably back in spring, he'd been in that basement. Tried palming off some crap as valuable, but I didn't take it. Ask him if you see him. He'll know what's where. Forget your bomb. We'll all be healthier for it.

What?! Think this old man is some Jew at the market? I'm trying to help you kindly! Wait, it's on the tip of my tongue... Ah! Remembered!\nKnow Fanatic? An experienced stalker. He told me, probably back in spring, he'd been in that basement. Tried palming off some crap as valuable, but I didn't take it. Ask him if you see him. He'll know what's where. Forget your bomb. We'll all be healthier for it.

What?! Think this old man is some Jew at the market? I'm trying to help you kindly! Wait, it's on the tip of my tongue... Ah! Remembered!\nKnow Ghoul? An experienced stalker. He told me, probably back in spring, he'd been in that basement. Tried palming off some crap as valuable, but I didn't take it. Ask him if you see him. He'll know what's where. Forget your bomb. We'll all be healthier for it.
Gray, then. I've met him...
Fanatic, then. I've met him...
Ghoul, then. Familiar nickname...
Everything's fine for now. I wanted to talk about the PDA.
What's there to say? Hit your head again? Told you already: ten grand, and the PDA's in your pocket!
I think I'll take it. Here's ten thousand.
I'll buy it when I've got the money. Bye for now.
Fair and square. Yours became ours. Here's one. As they say, come again. How about it? Want another?
Yeah, bye. Life without cash is rough. I know.
Yes, found the route to Pripyat. Been there myself. Rotten place. And... You won't make it in that outfit. You'll die on the approach.
Found it?! You're quick. As soon as I can, I will.
What's wrong with you?! Doesn't like my clothes, he says. Fine coat. Stepanych made it. Top quality.
Maybe first, but the situation's bad. Scorcher off, still attacks the brain. Radiation, poisoned air too. Pripyat itself burns... Can't pass like that.
Let me think... Got it. Swap. Bring a scientific suit like Sakharov's people wear at Yantar. I'll give a great stash lead and about ten PDAs. Fair, brother?
As a favor?! What did you promise? I give you a route, you give me a stash lead. Getting there isn't my problem.
Why get worked up? How would I know about those problems? Thought with the brain grinder off we could slip through quickly.
He thought about it. That's not how business works, chump. Keep your word, or we walk away and forget it.
Stubborn man. What a friend... Convinced me. For the lead, secret route and Sakharov suit, I'll give a check... Two dollar checks, even, and a dozen PDAs. No more. Honest, swear on my teeth. Deal?
Swears on his teeth. Still don't see your interest. Why give me a rich stash? What's your profit? Something in Pripyat worth your last shirt?

Not your sick head's business. Rest is mine. Clear?\nNeed to sort your head, right? Everyone knows you're gathering Strelok and friends' information. Agree, I've got a sure Pripyat hideout lead. Serious people interested in him then, probably now, discreetly. Friend guided them. Found his place. Friend vanished later. Information true, not drunken talk. Told nobody, not even boss. Only you. Respect. Deal?
A deal? Asking too much. Don't need your stash. Clothed, equipped, not hungry. Strelok seems more myth than man now. Stories put him everywhere, left traces everywhere. Nobody really knows anything.

Tough man, veteran, not nobody. Honestly, murky story. Few dealt openly with his group. Can't find them now. Those who knew are quiet, others taken by Zone. Was here, caused trouble, certainly. Some still have people on their tails, look over shoulders.
All right, you've convinced me. I'll try to get a good suit for you. I'll send the route coordinates anyway. With life like this, we might never meet again.
Another trip to Pripyat, looking for God knows what. I'll send you the passage coordinates anyway.
I'll wait, then. Just don't take too long.
Bad choice, Marked One. You could've made a tidy sum.
Sorted it... Brought a scientific suit. Hope it fits.
Sorted it out?! Gear like yours doesn't grow on trees.

Brother, respect! Always believed in you. Something decent in you. Listen.\nPripyat central square, opposite monument to "our bright future." Cross, can't miss. Don't know who's buried. Fiksa hid stuff in that grave. Obviously good loot. Wouldn't haul vodka and snacks to Pripyat.
And the second question?

Don't rush. Gather my thoughts. Hotel in central Pripyat. Fancy flea pit, they say. Strelok set his hideout upstairs. Understand? Doubt he only meant to eat and sleep. Search it. Might find something. Feel a big haul there.
Still, Fraer, I don't get it. If you knew all that, why tell me? Could've gone yourself when you had the chance and taken the stuff.
Hit your head again, or pretending? "Serious people," I said. Don't need extra eyes. Quietly in, quietly out, gone. Won't return. Fraer's had enough running.\nMy "inheritance" will wait.
I'll have a look. Maybe I really will dig something up.
Here, take a tier-three artifact!
Take a Dummy, busybody...
Ah! Look, we're holding a checkpoint here. Keeping things in order. Understand? Need to support us brave heroes...
So many of you... I've already paid up!
Easy, brother. Respectfully... That was coming from the south! Now from the center, full of artifacts. Everyone knows! Share a decent artifact or turn back...
Oh, yeah? What if I slit your throat?

Knife, sure. Nobody's safe... Won't help you. Explosives on the bridge. Unless I disable the detonators, anyone crossing dies. Understand? Respectfully: pay and pass, or don't pay and don't pass. Clear?
More or less...
Have a look. We're not causing trouble. Living peacefully, keeping the bridge safe so ordinary fellows can haul loot... You ought to understand...
I'll make you understand! Here's a bullet in your gut!
Is that so? Well... Here. A tier-two artifact.
All right, I've got a tier-three artifact. Take it.
Protecting the bridge? Heroes! Here's a Dummy.
What if I haven't got an artifact like that?
Is that so? Here. A tier-one artifact.
Good man... Wait, I'll turn off the detonators. Don't rush...
Turn around, or you'll spread your brains all over the forest...
Here's your dough. Your rubles. Let me through.
I'll manage somehow.
Switch it off. I'm waiting.
Water now, none later. That's how it goes. Some find clean water, some pay for it. Get it? Want a flaskful? Hand over a medkit or antirad.
That's my hope... Not stupid enough to walk into a trap. Not sure I'll find the exit again. Not at all. Can't bring them from another entrance. Can't without the device...
So there's more than one entrance? Do you know another?
Just talking to my hallucinations. Don't mind me.
Play the fool well... Not asking much. You understand. Show me the device, at least, so I'm certain. Can't pass on assurances alone. Reputation matters to me too...
I can't promise. I've never seen it myself.

Shake hands, goodbye. Won't cry for poor Marked One. Need the device. You or someone else brings it, don't care. Treat your friends before the long trip. Leave properly. Make them remember you. Heh...
Your jokes... No friends here. Though... Should visit someone, ask something. If I say goodbye to anyone, him. Early to think that way, but you never know...
Never late to visit God. Always early, never late.
See you, philosopher. Hope I'll be back. Don't disappear yourself... Maybe I'll find those pumps without you.
Here's three capsules. Take them before I start glowing myself.
Excellent. I knew you'd get it all done.
He knew... Tell me about connecting the pumps. What's the deal?
Pumps can get power from two places. One's underground, nothing more clear. Other's underground too, but scientists lived one level above in the same complex. Mean anything to you?
Does it matter to you whether he talks? Trying to get information out of me on top of my payment? What next?
That's all. But I can see you understand what I mean.
You wanted artifacts for "that's all"?! Isn't that a bit steep?
Inflation. I told you. That's what sets the price. That, and a monopoly on information.
All right, where are the pumps themselves? Same place?
Pumps elsewhere. Now the important part. Heard you met Monolith men at Radar. The ones with scrambled heads.
What have those lunatics got to do with the pumps?
None. Maybe some. Someone flooded that tunnel you want. Not the point. Heard about their weapons? Crumble to dust as soon as you take them. Someone wants to stop that... What are you thinking?
Just thinking. Working out where you're going with this. Whether I should keep listening or refuse straightaway.
Listen. Gets interesting. They say a group almost found a way. Equipment to slow the decomposition, perhaps stop it entirely. Now need the weapon itself.
Let them go to those Monolith men and take it. Why me?
Device exists. Can find a weapon too. Can't take it, even with that device. Decomposes instantly near a human. Need someone whose hands won't make it decay. That's where you come in.
Are you suggesting I'm not human? Interesting...

Didn't say that. Know they're looking for your tattoo. Supposedly people like that can take the weapon without it vanishing. Don't know if true. Neither do they. Play on it, test it yourself. Don't you want to know if you're human?
What do you think I am? Two arms, two legs, a liver, a spleen... Same as everyone. What's it to you?
Curious... Learned some from Ghost. For a good price, said he'd met you and had doubts about you. Understood you had no fewer doubts yourself.
What's in it for you, then? I know you won't lift a finger unless there's something to gain.

Interested people compete with the weapon seekers. No device themselves, believe deliberate disinformation. Need certainty: real or false. Proof equipment exists, group owns it, plans to remove weapons from Zone. Or proof none of that is true.
Well, well. Seems Ghost's connected to those competitors. That's why he was so interested in me...
Why is he interested in you, again?
Your remarkable mind... So go ask them directly about secret plans? Tell me everything, then I tell you. Right?

Don't be thick, Marked One. Put the facts together. Why are they looking for you? They want to use you. Told you: whoever holds all the cards sets the price. Use that remarkable head. You're the only one with that mark so far. Or the only one left. You can bargain for information. Play it by ear. Most importantly, you'll have a chance to learn what's troubling you about yourself. Then you can go where nobody else has gone. Perhaps understand everything at last... Perhaps even return and tell us.
Playing with words, Zub. Think poor Marked One will get emotional and tell you everything free? Plans, doubts, where and why he's going, Ghost, everything you want to know? Planning a big score?

Only interested in what I told you. Decide to do it, go to the mercenary camp at the Warehouses. One-way ticket, but you'll manage... \nSomeone interested in you visits occasionally. Probably know that too. I'll wait for results.
Why didn't you say? Dragged it out, waiting for a capsule.
Tell you straightaway, you might refuse. Had to see how much you wanted that tunnel drained. Now you've invested, got half. Foolish to turn back.
Quite the psychologist, aren't you? I'll still think about it. Best not to rush into dealings with those fellows.
Three tier-three artifacts in good condition, as agreed.
Take a couple of Dummies.
Parting with this Absolute breaks my heart.
I was just checking whether you'd forgotten.
