Right, uh-huh...
Give it here. What is it?
Here, take this one.
What?
In half an hour? All right.
Baldy wants me to ask a stalker called "Smart Guy" why he's so lucky at gambling. Gives me five days to ask around.
Good health to you, since you're here. Your name and patronymic?
I've got one name and patronymic: Marked One. That's how it is.
I see. We're all marked. By one thing or another. Got something to discuss, or just hello and goodbye?
Just interested in a rumor about you. They say at the bar you're wildly lucky. Cleaned Baldy out, and so on?

Clean Baldy out? Surely got as much loot as Strelok himself. Lucky a couple of times, everyone talks... Maybe not chance. Heard of Luck? Lots of stories, nobody's seen it. If they have, would they say?
An artifact called "Luck"? Never heard of one...

Rumors: artifact brings luck. Hit enemy's eye from half a kilometer, find good artifacts, easy profitable jobs, wild gambling luck. Found an unknown artifact recently. Wanted to sell at Yantar, then incredible luck at bar! Outside, found two artifacts and capsule. Maybe not Luck, but...
Yes, nice thing... Would you sell it?
Sell it? Hmm... Don't know. Could trade. Really need a Goldfish right now. Might trade my luck for one. Deal?
Sell it? Hmm... Don't know. Could trade. Really need a Night Star right now. Might trade my luck for one. Deal?
Sell it? Hmm... Don't know. Could trade. Really need a Soul right now. Might trade my luck for one. Deal?
No, I don't really believe that crap. I'll think about it.
Uh... All right, I've got a "Goldfish." Let's trade.
Uh... All right, I've got a "Night Star." Let's trade.
Uh... All right, I've got a little "Soul." Let's trade.
All right, your call. I'll keep my luck, then.
Deal. A shame, but a tsar's word is firmer than a pea! Take it!
Enough chatter. Take care...
Ah! Hello, Marked One... How's your luck? Still holding? My offer's still good, you know.
Remind me which artifact you needed?
Oh! Memory trouble? Write things down, like I do... Kidding. I need a Goldfish.
Oh! Memory trouble? Write things down, like I do... Kidding. I need a Night Star.
Oh! Memory trouble? Write things down, like I do... Kidding. I need a Soul.
I'm doing fine. Keep your "Luck" for now...
Hi, Marked One. How's the luck? Not good?
Have some fun? Sounds suggestive...
Don't worry, good clean fun. Nothing gay...
Compassionate? No room for pity in the Zone! Pity someone today, regret it tomorrow. I'm serious! Think before helping every fool... Sold the gun to a hunter for two artifacts.
All right, we'll see.
Yes. A capsule or good artifact cooked from one buys four worry-free days... \nCollect everything you've stored anytime, day or night...
I've got a capsule. Take it, quick...
Here, a great artifact. Take it...
Fair enough. You pay honestly, we store honestly... Go downstairs and put your things away.\nWant to extend the time?
No, I'll just put away what I wanted to.
Well, I probably should extend it.
A capsule with an artifact, or a good artifact cooked from one, buys four worry-free days... \nCollect everything you've stored anytime, day or night.
All right! Put everything in the ground-floor armory. The guard will open the safe. It's secure here...
A capsule or a good artifact? Bit steep. Any other way?
Understand, stalker. Capsules are rare... \nGive a tier-two artifact, we'll keep your loot until times improve for you. Deal?
Can't be helped. Here's the artifact.
For one visit? No, I'd rather hide it myself!
Nothing yet. I'll ask you again later.
I've done a few jobs for you. Maybe I'm entitled to a little extra perk?
All right. We can look after your loot for the next four days, free of charge...
Now we're talking! That would be good. Artifacts are a bit hard to come by...
No, I don't need anything yet. Just asking.
Here's a medkit. More sausage? Want some medicine?
Yeah, here you go. I've got more medicine. Well? Trade?
I've got nothing to discuss with you. Just passing through.
Not here! Follow me to my den...
Lead the way.
Skip the preliminaries, Cap. We're not at a market.
To people!
There's a market, approach wisely... Asked to guard civilians. Delicate worms need watching. Sent two men. Idiots tasted freedom, got drunk, crawled back... Said scientists started it. Understand?

Respect each other! Why sit here? Zone, artifacts: nonsense. Stable money from black gold, oil!
Little well here. Light, pure oil almost like gasoline. Soldier refines with special process...
Every two or three days, five tons or more of good gasoline. Hard to ship, but manage.
Another drink!
I don't understand. What are you getting at?
Go on... What do you want from me?
Three bodies. Burned farmstead, apparently, unless my idiots mixed things up. We'd like them gone... Understand? Wrong person finds them, follows the trail...

Good. Not even grimacing! Want something?\nExperienced man. Soldier idiots caused trouble. Pakhom asked guards for three technicians. Owed him. Men got drunk, fought eggheads. Trouble hurts business...\nAs a friend, go to nearby farmstead. Make those bodies impossible to find, even by chance.
Why should I? What about you? And where is it?
Listen, Cap, why should I? What about you? And where is it?
I'll repay you. Equipment, weapons... Send my men again, something else goes wrong. Farmstead nearby. Cable runs east. Follow it to the burned farmstead.
I'll repay you. Equipment, weapons, money, fuel... Send my men again, more bullshit. Farmstead nearby. Cable runs east. Follow it to the burned farmstead.
No, I don't want to. I'm not an errand boy or a garbage collector.
All right, Cap. I'll have a look. Maybe I'll think of something.
Then get lost! Watch your back, though... You never know!
I respect that! I'll wait for good news...
Don't try to scare me, you damn businessman...
Take care... Businessman...
I'm thinking about what to do with them...
Your corpses are gone... Went into an anomaly! Walked there themselves.
You're a real man! I owe you a bottle! Ha-ha... Kidding... Nobody saw?
No, I don't think so... All clear. What were you offering?
Nobody? Good. As agreed, 20 packs of PM ammo, or armor-piercing 5.45: 7 packs. AKM ammo? Give 7. A Stechkin pistol... Or a decent tier-two artifact. Choose?
Nobody, then. Good... Take care... Sucker...
Knew you were a good man! Respect! In return, 20 packs of PM ammo, or armor-piercing 5.45: 7 packs. AKM ammo? Give 7. Modified AK-74 and a little ammo. Or a Stechkin pistol... Choose?
Give me the pistol rounds! Useful if there's plenty.
I'll take ammo for the AK.
Give me AKM ammo. Caliber matters.
A Stechkin! A good weapon never hurts...
I'll take the artifact.
Give me the pistol rounds! Useful if there's plenty.
I'll take ammo for the rifle.
Give me AKM ammo. Caliber matters.
A Stechkin! A good weapon never hurts...
An AK-74! Good weapon. Reliable...
Deal! Here's a little something extra...
Deal! Here's a little something...
Deal! Here you go...
Deal! Here you go...
Deal! Here you go...
Deal! Here's ammo... Personally, a couple of fuel canisters too! Need more, come by. Bring your own canisters. Fill what you need from the barrels under the stairs...
Deal! Here's ammo... Personally, a fuel canister too! Need more, come by. Bring your own canisters. Fill what you need from the barrels under the stairs...
Deal! Here... Personally, a fuel canister too! Need more, come by. Bring your own canisters. Fill what you need from the barrels under the stairs...
Deal! Here... Personally, a fuel canister too! Need more, come by. Bring your own canisters. Fill what you need from the barrels under the stairs...
Deal! Here... Personally, a fuel canister too! Need more, come by. Bring your own canisters. Fill what you need from the barrels under the stairs...
Take care... Maybe we'll meet again.
Ah! It's you... What brings you here?
Oh, just dropped by for old times' sake. Bye...
I think everything will be fine now.
Hmm, well, I could use some help now...
I've got a bank check. Can I buy ammo?
Do you know Captain Sergeyev?
Well? Can't be! Go on, we're all friends here...
No problem! Dollars are dollars wherever you go. What do you want? 5.45 or 7.62?
Nothing yet. Come back in a few days. Maybe we'll think of something...
A shame. Take care...
I'm short on ammunition. You've probably got a reserve? I'd buy some... Or trade something for it...
For the AK-74. 5.45...
For the AKM. 7.62...
Got ammo. What can you offer, though? Your candy wrappers? Can't even wipe with them. Artifacts? What use? Interested in proper currency. Get some, we'll talk.
Your money's ours now. Here's the ammo tin... \nGood. Honest money! Take the tin... \nDeliveries every five days. You know where to find us.
Traded without looking... Here's the ammo tin... \nGood money. Respect! Here's your tin... \nDeliveries every five days, if you need more. Don't be shy.
There's an option. Some traders issue bearer checks... Could give you one of those. For a thousand dollars...
Really? Now we're talking business... A thousand dollars is... Anyway, I'll give you a tin of ammo for a thousand. For the AK74, or even the AKM, 7.62... Bring it.
Deal. Get the ammo tins ready...
Hmm. Why the interest? Just asking...
I've got my reasons. They say he was here?
Too many questions, Marked One... You're not, uh... Buying a Slavic wardrobe? Joking... Truth in every joke. Not Russian to talk without a drink, either!
Got it! I've got half a liter for a good man here.
Uh... I haven't got any on me.
Half a liter? For a good drink? Marked One, are you sure you're not from that joke about the wardrobe? Need at least a liter! I've got some too, don't worry.
No half-liter bottle with you? Unbelievable! I've got some, don't worry. Finally a decent man to drink with. Why begrudge it...
All right, let's have some... \n ... \nSo what about Sergeyev?
All right, let's have some... \n ... \nSo what about Sergeyev?

Don't hurry, Marked One. Soon talk to wild cats...\nSergeyev was here before me. Good, reckless, desperate. Soldiers respected, feared his heavy fist. Military intelligence or similar, they said. Uncle or relative high up. Serious trouble, hidden here to fix service record. Didn't settle. Stalker dealing with scientists at later-burned farmstead. Strange clear eyes, called Ghost.\nWhy freeze? Pour! Not Hennessy, but we're not gentlemen!
Oh, nothing... Let's have another each.

Good!\n...\nLeft sergeant in charge, disappeared three days. Signal near mine drift, asked help. Smart sergeant and conscript rescued him without losses. Serious: broken ribs, moderate burn, torn thigh. Delirious, cursed Ghost. Anomaly grew before him, Ghost vanished like magician. Sergeyev slow, hit anomaly. Survived, only grazed, reacted in time. Can't drink away skill. Transport took him to hospital outside.
Hmm, it doesn't quite add up...

Pour, don't jump! Couldn't escape if needed!\nJoking...\nRelative, through my superiors, wanted investigation, two reports. Heroic rescue of men and facility for career. Unofficial one, perhaps to punish nephew privately. In return, hinted knowledge of oil well but won't interfere. There.
Annoying. Thought meeting Sergeyev might help me remember something.
Stop worrying! Almost as many Sergeyevs as Ivanovs in the world! Maybe you had a neighbor called Sergeyev, or a school gym teacher. Who knows...
Ghost was with someone at that farmstead that burned down? Didn't go see what happened? Send a patrol to check, or anything?
Not our business what burns. Sent boys to look for weapons and bring them. Serial numbers, you see. Don't need questions about what came from where, why there... Nonsense, but just in case.
Find anything?
Nothing... Burned rubbish. A fireproof box. Thought money. Opened it. Papers, notes, egghead calculations. Nothing interesting.
Nothing left? I'd take some.
You started with Sergeyev, then switched to papers. Why do you need them?
It's all the same. I want to remember who I am. Well?
All right... Gave the papers to the local academics studying frogs here in the Swamps. What do I need their calculations for?
Much obliged.
Hi, man. Interested?
Yeah, something like that... What are you studying?

Me? Hard to explain... Watching equipment for now. Does the work itself. Records energy fluctuations during emissions, compiles data, sends via relay repeaters to our outfit. They try understanding it there.
Why here? Emissions are much stronger closer to the center...

Really? The boys don't know!\nJoking.\nWe know. But emission data must reach people who can analyze it. Zone communications are hopeless. That's why continuous observation is only possible here on the edge.
Hmm, you've got a constant connection here? Interesting...
By the way, about the connection. Someone told me to talk to you...
Hi, man... Still wandering?
Yeah, still walking the earth. Just dropping by. Bye...
Connection all right? Someone told me to talk to you.
What's wrong with the connection? Talk? To me? About what?
About me... Can't remember who I am or where from. Everyone calls me Marked One. Nickname. Heard you can get information from a fingerprint database?
Ah, that... Interesting. First request like it. Know a woman in the agencies. Could try. Illegal, though. You understand...
I understand. I'll make it worth your while! I'll pay...

Money? What use is that here? Someone might kill me for it. You said emissions are stronger in the center. Try installing a scanner there. Once it's working, we'll get readings after a while. Then we're square. You get your inquiry results, I get material for my dissertation. Been trying to finish it for a year.\nWell? Deal?
And if I say yes, then what?

I'll take your fingerprints and send them to my acquaintance. You'll get a clever instrument to install around Limansk. Not the center, but emissions there are strong enough to show the properties I need. Just install it. It'll start transmitting after an emission. Processing the readings takes time too: three or four days. By then I should have information about you as well.
Hmm... What will you use to take fingerprints, and how? What then? How will you send them? Not over the radio.

That's simple enough. Mix soot with oil, coat your fingers, press them onto paper. I'll package it properly and send it with scientific correspondence. Food and equipment don't arrive by radio, and we send written results too. Label it something like 'print of an anomalous tushkano species...' Then arrange for it to reach the right people.
Three or four days? Oh! Fine. Put the stuff on my hand and get your gadget out. I'll try. I'm in no hurry anyway.
Haven't got time to run around with gadgets yet. I'll think about it.
Hi, Marked One. How's the memory?
All right, grease my palm and get your gadget out. I'll try installing it.
Same as ever. All right, take care.

Made up your mind? Here. Install it in Limansk, as high as possible to reduce interference and reflections. Don't bring it back, and don't wait there. An emission has to pass before I receive results. Then processing takes time. By then your fingerprints should have arrived and the inquiry results come back. Clear?
Yes, but a couple of questions. What if I fit it in the wrong place?

Don't do that! Starts scanning immediately. Wrong place, wrong results: program tied to approximate coordinates. No spare. Order, review, approve, find, ship, possibly wrong model... A headache. Understand?
Single-use, then... Complicated. How can I be sure I put it in the right place? How will I know?

Install it near the coordinates the program's tied to, and it'll signal success. You'll know immediately. Wrong location, no signal. \nHigh ground in Limansk, as I said. That's where the coordinates are. I know what you're thinking: put it somewhere nearer and be done. But it has to be there!
All right. Damn, it's heavy... Wanted to cut corners, but what can I do? I'll install it at Limansk, since your instruments are so complicated.
Ah! Marked One. How's it going?
Is that iron coffin working? Think I did everything right.
I'm doing fine. All right, take care.

Worked! Not finished processing yet.\nYour inquiry...\nNo fingerprints in security database. Law-abiding, fingers not yours, or from far away. Asked Lyubasha to try Interpol. Slow. If anything, leave information for you.
And I'd hoped... All for nothing!
Don't be upset. Takes time. Here's something for helping, from the heart. Not much, but useful. Can share an artifact too. Stalkers value them, right? Great help with that measurement.
What did you measure? Anything important? Was the trip worth it?

Still need processing, but worthwhile. Want to confirm a hypothesis. Simply...\nEverything changes cyclically. Events come in waves, fade in waves. No mutants, suddenly plenty like washed ashore. Noticed?
Uh... I've seen something like that.

Simple example. Emissions more complex, still follow same periodic law. Like breathing, in-out. Zone like living thing. But energy streams, not ordinary breaths. Need source of incoming/outgoing flows. Unclear? Main thing, important work.
Breathing in, out... Someone said something like that, about a deity. Breathes on us. Inhale, life; exhale, death. Or reverse. Mysticism...
Possible. Everything's born and dies. Cycles everywhere. Even the universe expands and contracts in cycles. Theology has explanations. Science too... You've grasped the idea?
Not really... All right, take care...
Hello, my friend Marked One. Alive and well?
Yeah, alive for now. Well, I'm off.
Thanks! Here's the ammo. Need more? If you've got food...
Great! One gets you a pack and a half of 5.45. Two get a pack and a half of 7.62. Not ordinary rounds: armor-piercing... Which do you want?
Give me 5.45.
I'll take 7.62.
I'm not taking anything yet. I've changed my mind.
Thanks! Here's the ammo. Need more? If you've got food...
Thanks! Here's the ammo. Need more? If you've got food...
It's nighttime. Come back in the morning...
Know anything about the military here in the Swamps? Captain Sergeyev, specifically. Know who he is?
Sergeyev... Sergeyev... Oh! There was a little captain once. The captain who brings us gasoline from the oil pump replaced him. Why?
I thought meeting Sergeyev might help me remember something.
Brother! Almost as many Sergeyevs as Ivanovs in the world. Maybe you had a neighbor called Sergeyev, or a school gym teacher. Who knows...
Yes... Ghost lived at that farmstead that later burned down? Didn't go see what happened?
Not our business. All sorts of things burn here. Stalkers brought some stuff, though. They grab anything in the Zone not nailed down...
What did they bring?
Burned rubbish. Didn't take it. A fireproof box for a couple of medkits. Already open. Papers inside. Probably expected money. Notes, calculations. No interest to them. Brought it to me.
I'd take it off your hands. Maybe there's something in it... I told you, I want to remember who I am. Well?
Nothing for you, certainly. Scientific correspondence. Ask Ivan Sergeyevich. Gave it straight to him.
All right, I'll ask.
He's gone? Shame... Where? What do you know?

Murky story. Talkative sergeant brought gasoline, traded, chatted.\nSergeyev commanded before current captain. Respected, feared fist. Something with that guide, Ghost. Lived near oil pump, farmstead later burned. Called Burned afterward.
What happened there?
Who knows? Lightning strike, a Burner appearing, or someone setting it alight while drunk...
Not that. I'm asking about Sergeyev's dealings with Ghost.

Sergeant said captain and Ghost gone three days. Signal sent him and conscript toward mine drift. Rescued captain, badly injured. Ribs, burns. Cursed Ghost. Anomaly appeared, Ghost vanished. Sergeyev too slow, fell in. Survived somehow, only grazed. Hospital outside Zone.
And that sergeant?
How would I know? Been gone ages. Never came back. Probably finished his service and eating his mother's pies. Why do you want Sergeyev?
Here. My head's still buzzing.
What about the controllers?
Take the two hands, as agreed. Nasty beasts, those.
We specifically selected only mature mutants. Those are the specimens with the DNA we need.
I think I've heard of the seasoned ones. Remember the reward?
The reward awaits its hero.
Let me know if you need anything else.
Didn't hear anything? \nControllers nearly reached your base, with a couple of zombified stalkers. \nSome hunters... Missed a whole group...
Strange... No, it's quiet here. You know our base isn't easy to reach. Tarzankas block sound. Could you...
Give you the hand? We agreed on two. Take those. I'll find a use for this one. Cost me too much.
Leave it, Marked One... \nA shame. As thanks, I'll speak to Pakhom. He'll preserve it free if you want.
Thanks, you did me a favor.
All right, take it. I've got no use for it right now.
Thank you. Nothing to offer now, but I'll repay you in the future. No doubt about it!
We'll see how honest you are.
Damn, I forgot the hands... Wait a bit, I'll bring them.
Got your message. What's going on there?
Got a lead on a couple of controllers here in the Swamps. Still willing to continue our experiment?
Controllers in the Swamps? Used to be quiet... Dogs, boars, squeaking tushkanos, purring cats. What's happening... Dangerous beasts. Can't get close. Need a good rifle with optics.
Can't help with the rifle. Ammo and medicine, as usual. I'll find something else too. Well?
Deal. Mark where I should look for those telepaths.
Sent their locations to your PDA. Don't forget to chop off a body part for our research.
Hope this isn't goodbye...
I don't like this idea.
Your call. I'll look for someone else willing.
No time right now. I'll come back later.
Pakhom said you needed help.
Yes, an urgent little job. Remember our talk about biopsies?
You're asking a lot. Dangerous, you said. Mature too. So much for hunting principles. Not chasing dogs and cats around the Swamps.
All right, I'll help... What do you know about where the beasts are?
Excellent. You won't regret it. Listen carefully:
I really hope so... All right, moving out.
I understand they're hard to kill, but...
Exactly, it isn't simple. You advance science here, I risk my ass. Why should I? What exactly do I get?

I'll cover supplies. Ivan Sergeyevich provided funds. Also rare artifact recipe, Airship, after completion. Our institute studied it closely, received materials from old labs here. Artificially grown substances only work in Zone. Outside, pretty stones. Another mystery.
Refresh my memory. I've got trouble with it.
I'll manage without riddles.
Your call. I'll look for someone else willing.

Joking's good. Mutant tissue research. Some specimens more pronounced, "mature." Zone changes, mutants adapt quickly, aggressive, resilient. Some think intelligence emerging. Millions of years of evolution here in years. DNA comparison with earlier samples further confirms evolution, benefits other sciences. Capital institute colleagues study it.
Let them do it, then. What's this got to do with me?
Promised to contact hunters through my connections. Help find rare mutants. Refuse to hunt them themselves, though. Principles. You seem ideal, Marked One. Already legends about you.
Skip that. What do you need me to do?
You need to kill the mutants, then report their coordinates. We'll handle delivery and preservation of the material. Will you help?
What mutants will I have to deal with?
I'd say the most dangerous ones: bloodsuckers, chimeras, controllers, pseudogiants. Top of the food chain.
Dealt with the creatures around the Gut and collected their parts. Study them before they start stinking...
As promised, a little compensation. Bonus for your responsible work: spoke to Pakhom about preserving biological material. He'll explain. \nNo mutant information now. I'll message if any comes.
See you soon, man of science.
Like hell I'm ever signing up for that again...
At last, we can finish this exhausting research. Those are precisely the specimens with the DNA we need.
What about my reward?

Excellent work! Here's the recipe, as agreed. 
Your biological material and our research have let us extend the effects of the armor treatment. 
At present, that adds 12 hours to its established duration. 
If you need anything, I'll help as far as I can.
I'll let you get on with your work.
All right, calm down...
Memory? Hmm... Maybe a psychiatrist? They deal with disturbances of consciousness and memory, don't they?
No... I definitely don't need a psychiatrist... Forget it.
No, just passing through.
Though what? Go on, since you've started.

There's urgent work that could justify using the main computer's time. We desperately need some 'polyamorphous acid-beslagent anomalous substance.' You stalkers call it Witch's Jelly. Get us a couple of jars, and we might find time for calculations unrelated to our research.
I'll try to collect some "Witch's Jelly"... What do I put it in?
The quartermaster has special containers. Ask him.
Oh, just passing through...
I brought some "Witch's Jelly." Two jars.
Oh... Good timing. We've developed several hypotheses to test. You mentioned a computer, didn't you?
Yes, I need this data on the disk processed. Can you do it?
No, I don't need it anymore...
No problem. Wait twenty minutes. Should be enough.
All right. Get on with your work.
Marked One! Sorry, but we're working here...
About those measurements. Ready?
Really?
Oh, yes. They're ready. Here. This is what we managed to get. Do you know what these numbers mean?
Not yet. Wait a little.
Not quite. Probably need to go to Sakharov at Yantar.
All right. I'll walk around here.
Hello, young man... Life seems to have treated you harshly...
Hello... Unfortunately, or perhaps fortunately, I don't remember my life... Trying to find any thread from my past.
Judging by the scars on your face, you've had a difficult life... What should I call you?
For now, my name's Marked One.
Well, Marked One, I hope you manage to recover all your memories. Can I help you?
I'd like that... You're a biologist, aren't you? Could you explain why people lose their memory and how they recover it?

Difficult. Nobody fully explains where or how memories are stored. "Supermemory," partial amnesia with consciousness intact, unexplained too. Theories, opinions, yes. But want specifics, your own case?
Yes.
I can't say exactly what happened or what to do in your case. General speculation wouldn't help.
I see... Nobody understands my memory problem. Not even you. Another question: wasn't a secret stalker group's base here before?

Project studying Zone properties, Professor Lebedev involved. Learned of this place from him. He and assistants apparently died attempting center. Don't want to speak ill, but couldn't succeed. Sakharov's cautious approach I approve.
Sorry to interrupt, but did the previous occupants leave any records?
Papers, yes. No use to us, different field. Study natural Zone mutations leading to telepathy! Preliminary research shows some emissions whose field sustains...
Sorry, I... Need to step away...
Young man... Marked One? Yes? How can I help you?
Ivan Sergeyevich, where are the notes?
Notes? Oh! Lebedev's... Seemed right to give them to my guide. Interested, he said some information might help stalkers find a safe way to the center...
Where's this guide? And what's his name?
Don't know. Left a couple of weeks after we settled in. Said north... Name... Forgotten... Phantom? No... Pale eyes... Ask our quartermaster. Mostly dealt with him.
I'll ask. One more question: you mentioned the center. Heard about it many times. What's so important that everyone keeps looking for a way there?

Could answer if I'd been. Perhaps superartifact MONOLITH there. Indirect evidence people protect it. From whom or what? Are they people? Unknown. Center full of secrets, guesses, rumors. Attracts, frightens like all mysteries. Explains interest.
Yes... Secrets, rumors... Wish I knew why Strelok wanted to get there. Thank you, Ivan Sergeyevich.
Marked One, how are you doing?
Marked One, how are you doing?
Ivan Sergeich, may I ask a couple of questions about memory?
I'll help where I can...
Take you. How do you know the memories are yours? Happened to you, not visions, dreams, books, films, or something else?
Still focused on your own concerns... So, if I understand correctly, your amnesia persists, but there has been some progress?

Who knows... Something comes back, I write it down. Not certain it happened to me. Bright episodes, few, vague, imprecise: fine. But need certainty they're my life... Don't have it. Not for everything.

Let's reason. Can't always be sure memories happened to me. Childhood especially. Emotional, identify with book heroes. Physical disability sometimes absent from one's memories, brain defense. Often remember from outside, observing rather than participating. Surely same for you.
Well... Yes, something like that.
Memory's too complicated to explain over tea. Whatever they are, the memories arise in your own mind. Nobody puts them there. You're not looking into other heads. Correct?
Hmm... Well, perhaps...
Accept memories as yours. Childhood dream, book, someone else's story, film, real events: all yours, connected to your life. Remember, record, analyze. Eventually something will happen.
Yes. Thank you, Professor.
Sorry, what? What are you talking about?
Long story. Briefly, stalkers lived at the farmstead before it burned. Vasilyev visited. Notes found afterward, given to you. Need to see those notes badly.
Hmm... Yes, there was something. Calculations, scientific notes and Vladimir Valentinovich's personal correspondence... I think... Why do you want it?
Hard to explain. I'm looking for any lead now... Did you know Professor Vasilyev?

Research in sector 82, the Gut, stalkers call it. Only here briefly. Lost latest measurement notes, financial trouble. Helped a little. You're right: half a year ago wrote ideas on "variable" wandering anomalies. Search computer, perhaps draft left. Check farmstead papers for mentions too. Come later...
All right, I'll walk around for now.
Found a strange note. Draft letter addressed to me. Don't remember receiving it. Rather than retell it, look yourself.

"Our acquaintance Ghost appeared from nowhere... Knows how to enter X-16!..." What we need. "You gave the documents with that information!... Answer was yours... Knew I needed it... Tomorrow we assault... Afraid to suppose..." Where are those notes? Found them?
Don't know what I expected. Doubt I'll understand these. Thanks, though... Need to see Petrov again. Maybe he knows something and can explain.
What did you lose? Calm down... I'll help...
You won't understand... Like all the others... Blind...
You've got the "Black Mark"! You're one of them, too!
You're right. I don't understand anything...
Know about the "Black Mark"? What? How do I get rid of it? Tell me!
Good to see you, Marked One. Glad you came. Remember your favor.
Well... Nothing special...
A debt should be repaid... Spoke to Ivan Sergeyevich. Told Pakhom to thank you more tangibly.\nTalk to our quartermaster.
Thanks, man of science...
Hello, Marked One. How's life?
Fine for now. Can't complain.
Well, good luck with everything...
Hello, stalker. A quick word? What should I call you?
Hi, I'm Marked One. What did you want?
We've got a problem. Our guide's unconscious...
What happened?
We work with Ivan Sergeyevich. Expedition studying Zone fauna. Unverified report of unusual beast nearby, called giant. Sent to verify, observe in natural conditions if possible.
So what happened?

Guide Frol led us toward the sighting. Went alone to scout den. Something happened... Returned somehow, found unconscious 30 meters away. Called help, arriving soon. Dilemma: object may move while we wait, search again...
What do you need me to do?

Would you cover me now while I observe that known den? I can't promise much, but we should have something at the base to make a stalker's life easier. Once help arrives, we'll get our guide to the medics too. \nI'll add a marker for the approximate location to your PDA.
You've talked me into it, you silver-tongued devil.
Later. I've got some unfinished business.
Well, Marked One, will you help?
With what?
Forgot? Asked you to escort me to the giant's lair...
Oh! All right, let's go...
Oh! Maybe another time...
Thanks for your help! The professor sent me the location of a teleport anomaly leading to our base. We're heading there...
All right, lead the way.
Hi. You're welcome... How's your guide? What's wrong with him?
Frol? Recovered. Probably has a few kind words, too. Talk to him.
I'll talk to him...
Hello...
I've got a couple of blind dog tails.
Got two good boar hams here.
Found a nice cat tail.
I've got a pseudodog tail.
Will a flesh eye do?
Fought a chimera. Took a claw as a souvenir.
You've got tushkanos everywhere. I've got their heads...
Thank you... I won't forget your help...
Found out about a trail to the Cordon. Let me take you there. It's a little safer, at least.
Really? Thank you! I can't wait to see my dear husband...
Keep up. Meet at the guide. He'll lead us off the base.
Oh, don't mention it...

Weapons harder. Recent experiment proved possible.
Chimera claw. Some incredibly strong. Found they contain subatomic particles not of our world!
Meeting days ago, attended.
Time flows differently inside. Our-time tools can't penetrate structure.
Makes your head spin! So what?
Split the claw. Unusual quarks apparently can be embedded in ordinary metal. Complex technology, hard X-rays and anomalous claw needed. Bring one, we'll think. Professor agreed.
Nothing, really. Thinking where to go next...
Why do you keep poking at that map?
All roads lead to the Zone's center... Decide yourself. Quiet work here, not much profit. Helpers aren't very skilled, as you see. Think what really matters to you.
Thinking. Scientists vanished somewhere in the central Swamps. Can't find them. Nobody to search.\nWent with guards. An army man supplied soldiers. Long time, no news.
Yeah, the Zone. Easy to go missing here. Which soldier?

Military nearby guards or works oil well, unclear. Pakhom supplies food, drinks for fuel, sometimes guards. Commander denies knowing missing men. Stalker saw scientific-suit bodies at burned central-Swamps farmstead. Searched, found none. Where else? One missing is Kyiv official's son. Sergeich harassed constantly.\nMaybe offer reward. Bodies at least. Sick of uncertainty...
I've met the scientists. Even escorted one here.
At the burned-out farmstead? I saw bodies there, too...
Think it over. I'll tell you if I learn anything. Bye.
Gluzov's group? Heard. Thanks. Short of experienced guides who can protect scientists. Some don't even know which end of a rifle the bullet comes out. Have to ask the military for guards.
You saw it? Damn... Thought I'd searched the whole place. Maybe I should go back.
Anything could've happened. Mutants ate them, or something...
Well... I buried the bodies in an anomaly.
You?! Your own idea, or did someone suggest it?
Too far to carry three bodies to the cemetery. This way, at least animals won't desecrate them. So I buried them... In the Zone.
Buried them... Maybe it's for the best. Here, for your trouble.
Hmm... All right, you've convinced me. Take the artifact. Study it.
Thank you, Marked One. You won't regret it, I assure you. You'll like this modified artifact's properties. Write this down.
Take care, man of science... I'll go enjoy myself.
A shame, a great shame. We could both have benefited.
Need to transform dozens of artifacts for your analysis. Won't be quick. If I even go there again. You'll have work without my data...
Really?! Calculations right! A breakthrough! No idea how well you've done, Marked One! Where's the artifact? Show the result!
Do bring it. Very important! Urgent analysis needed! I'll try to make it worth your while, Marked One.
To the Cordon. You asked yourself.
The scientists aren't far from here. We'll go to them.
All right, I understand. Should I follow you?
All right, I understand. Should I follow you?
More or less. If something happens to me... Map here. East along the road to the old machinery yard, south to the church, east to the Southern Farmstead. Then the Cordon. Clear?
More or less. If something happens to me... Map here. East along the road to the old machinery yard, south to the church, west to the fishing village. Meet a guide there. Clear?
One moment. Let me remember the way... East from here... Then to the church... Then... Got it.
One moment. Let me remember the way... East from here... Then to the church... Then... Got it.
Good. Let's move...
Good. Let's move...
Thanks... I've got a little here...
Keep it... Not everything can be bought and sold...
Well? Shall we keep going?
Go on ahead. I'll follow.
Let me catch my breath... I'm tired.
All right, I'll head south slowly... Keep up...
All right, keep moving...
Here we are... Marked One, where's Kostyan?
Draw me a diagram of the guard posts at Agroprom Research Institute.
Don't worry. The world's round. We'll meet again.
Wait. I left him nearby...
He's lying right here. Kostyan? Yes...
How did you get from the Agroprom base to the farmstead?
Yes, of course. But, Marked One... Please don't be a beast... We're all human... Here, take it.
Going deeper, toward the center? Heard of a priest near the Bar. Meet him, ask him here. Even if I'm gone, let him pray for Kostyan.
Southeast along power lines from base, gate in wire, onward. Radiation, but passable. Marked safe path with cans. Here's draft map. Commander's report draft, took it.
Don't worry... Goodbye, Sanya...
I'll ask... Goodbye, Sanya...
All right, goodbye, Sanya...
Put him here. This'll be the grave... Ah, Kostyan... Thanks for helping, Marked One. Honestly, don't know how to repay you. I've got nothing.
What! Ah... How could... Ah... My friend...
Well... All right. Take care...
Huh? What? Sorry. I don't want to talk...
I understand...
Trade... What about selling?

Not a shop! Money? Foreign currency? Hide it before someone decides to take it. Don't need that. Food, medicine here. Sergeich studies mutants, barter parts for supplies. Artifacts too, expedition costs. No money!
Can I see what you've got? Might find something useful.
Not much choice. Some food, medicine, useful little things... Have a look... In exchange for what the Zone provides...
Pakhom, I spoke to Ivan Sergeyevich...
Good man. Not quite of this world... Thinks too much about those mutants, how and why... What did he tell you?
Said he gave notes to the guide who brought you here. Says you talked to that guide more.
Ghost. Secretive. Nothing definite, disliked him. Mysteries, disappearances. Calmer after he left north. Notes stayed, certain. Said junk in old mine drift at Tuzla. Where's that?
Don't know. North, then? I'll head there, too...
Fine, thanks. Let's see what you've got.
I don't charge for looking... Have a look...
Just here to talk about life.
We can talk. I'm in no hurry, and neither are you, I see.
Would you take a look? I found some scientific papers...

Scientific? Hmm... 
One moment... 
Not our research field. Could leave them for... 
No! Don't. 
Too few of us. Won't distract myself or colleagues from our task.
Take your "treatises"...
Well... I'll offer them to someone else.
There's a strange guy sitting in your little swamp.
I know. Let him sit. Strange or not, he's a good shot.
He was talking about some secret. About the Monolith men...
He talked plenty before they stuck him in the swamp. All nonsense. Don't worry about it.
Hmm... I'm not taking it. Just interested. Read about a similar case recently. Might be a connection...
Mikhalych sent me to talk to you.
From Limanych, you say? How's that old bastard? Still squeezing us stalkers? Give him my regards if you see him again.
Again? The Limansk basement? Didn't we agree? Donate medicine to a good cause, and I'll give you the door codes. Thinker!
He said you got into that basement. Nearby, across the road from Mikhalych's storeroom. Reminded me of something. Can't grasp what...
Reminded you? Hmm. Forgot your head wasn't quite right. No offense, of course. What did you want?
Can you tell me how to get there? I've heard there's some clever machine that might restore my memory.

A clever machine? Maybe... I've been there. Nothing interesting: no power, just cables lying around. Your call, though... Since we're talking openly:
I spent a couple of days cracking the entry and exit codes...
I'd tell you, but...
We're planning a deep raid. Need medicine. You're experienced, and I hear your supplies are overflowing. Ten scientific medkits for a good cause... Or twenty army medkits. I'll tell you everything I know...
Deal?
I'll think it over. Might work out the code myself.
All right, I agree. Here's ten scientific medkits.
I've got military ones here. Take them...
Your call... Think it over. You know how it goes, though. Today someone asks for your help. Tomorrow...
Good! Thanks. Chemicals will help. "Knowledge is power" matters to you too! Look:\nEntering Limansk across the bridge from the Red Forest, bear left. A little door leads into the hillside.
I heard you've been to Limansk?
I've been all over! Can't remember everywhere. Why Limansk?
There's a strange little basement. Right across from Mikhalych, Limanych. Reminded me of something. Can't grasp what...
Opposite Limanych, you say? Right. And?
Mikhalych said you'd been in that basement? Tell me how to get in? Heard there's a clever machine that might restore my memory.

That melofom basement? Been. No power, cables only. Your call...
Spent two days cracking entry/exit codes...
Would tell, but...
Training rookies, short trip. Need buckshot. Heard your supplies overflow. Five hundred buckshot rounds or two hundred slugs. Tell everything...
Deal?
I'll think it over. Might work out the code myself.
Your call... Think it over. You know how it goes, though. Today someone asks for your help. Tomorrow...
All right, I agree. Here's the shot shells. All five hundred.

Good! More skills for rookies, better for everyone. "Knowledge is power" matters to you too! Look:\nEntering Limansk across the bridge from the Red Forest, bear left. A little door leads into the hillside.
I've got slugs here. Take them...
The Limansk basement again? Didn't we agree? Five hundred buckshot rounds for a good cause, and I'll give you the door codes. Thinker!
There's a strange little basement in Limansk... Know about it?
Plenty of basements... What's strange about it?
They say your head's not right. Discussed it already! Machine in the basement. Coded doors! Two tier-two artifacts for the codes. Thinker!
Reminded me of something... Not sure what. But...
So? What's your memory got to do with me? I've got enough of my own.
Mikhalych, the Limansk trader, said you've been in the basement? How to get in? Heard there's a machine that could restore my memory.
That melofom basement? Been. No power, cables only...\nTwo days cracking entry/exit codes. Time's money, money's artifacts. One per code, two total. Two tier-two artifacts, or one better... Shake?
I'll think it over. Might work out the code myself.
Well... All right, here. A couple of artifacts.
I've got a good artifact here. Take it...
Think, then. We've got one brainy type already, Mozgun. You'll be the second.

Good man! Knowledge is power! Heard that? Find more artifacts, heard your supplies... Look:
Enter Limansk across Red Forest bridge, bear left. Door into hillside. Panel code 59685. Exit code 85621.
Write it now before forgetting.
...
Take care, friend. Wish you everything I wish myself, but can't: too greedy...

Good man! Knowledge is power! Heard that? Find more artifacts, heard your supplies... Look:
Enter Limansk across Red Forest bridge, bear left. Door into hillside. Panel code 86954. Exit code 75698.
Write it now before forgetting.
...
Take care, friend. Wish you everything I wish myself, but can't: too greedy...

Good man! Knowledge is power! Heard that? Find more artifacts, heard your supplies... Look:
Enter Limansk across Red Forest bridge, bear left. Door into hillside. Panel code 12389. Exit code 85412.
Write it now before forgetting.
...
Take care, friend. Wish you everything I wish myself, but can't: too greedy...

Good man! Knowledge is power! Heard that? Find more artifacts, heard your supplies... Look:

Write it now before forgetting.
...
Take care, friend. Wish you everything I wish myself, but can't: too greedy...

...

...

Good man! Knowledge is power! Heard that? Find more artifacts, heard your supplies... Look:
Enter Limansk across Red Forest bridge, bear left. Door into hillside. Panel code 75963. Exit code 65213.

...
Take care, friend. Wish you everything I wish myself, but can't: too greedy...

Good man! Knowledge is power! Heard that? Find more artifacts, heard your supplies... Look:
Enter Limansk across Red Forest bridge, bear left. Door into hillside. Panel code 78524. Exit code 16379.
Write it now before forgetting.
...
Take care, friend. Wish you everything I wish myself, but can't: too greedy...
Calm down. No need to foam at the mouth... Business with your boss...
Your name? Why do you need our Wolfhound?
I'm Marked One. I'll tell Wolfhound what I need myself...

Marked One, marked by whom? A joke...\nWant to pass here, help us. Bad place. Weapons and armor wear to rubbish. When we came, I thought we'd need nothing. Now we need repair kits. Bring them, you can pass. Otherwise, no. Understand? Twelve kits. For rifles and armor. Any kind will do.
Calm down. No need to foam at the mouth... I just need to pass through...
What's your name?
I'm Marked One.
Go on, keep walking...
Fuck... All right, take it.
Ah, good man! You did right... Go through...
Yeah, I'll remember how "right" I am...
Ah, I haven't got any kits...
Don't talk too much about what you've learned and heard, all right? Here, take... A little gift. You've earned it.
Don't talk too much about what you've learned and heard, all right? Here, take... A little gift. You've earned it.
Don't talk too much about what you've learned and heard, all right? Here, take... A little gift. You've earned it.
Hello, friend. Was it you I fought a month ago? Or not? Am I mixing you up? Pin? Right?
Hmm, no. Not me. I'm Marked One.
Damn! For crying out loud, I already know about the ointment... Came all this way for nothing. Thanks anyway.
Marked One? Heard that nickname, I think... Something about stalkers and bandits fighting? No? Never mind. What do you want, pal?
In the Swamps, you say? Interesting. Thanks for the information.
Do you know Belomorkanal?
Belomor? You mean Kostyan? Yes. Went out together a couple of times. Didn't make much, but didn't come back empty-handed. What about him?
Seems fine for now. Here's the thing: he said at the Bar you knew a recipe for strengthening weapons?
Must've misunderstood. Had a good drink... Said years ago, Swamps scientists did that and asked for chimera claws. Now only treat armor. Forgot how, or can't be bothered. That's it, friend...
I've got a tier-three one. Take it.
Take the Dummy and tell me the recipe.
No time to waste...
What?

Enough talking! They're tolerating you for now, not for long. You've learned too much. If it dissolves in your hands, you were useless anyway. Ten minutes to enter the bunker. Come out without the weapon, we shoot. Draw another weapon, same. Try leaving now, same.
Hey! Wait, the door's got a code. How do I get in?
You'll get in. Code's easy to crack. If you've been there, you managed somehow. We'll see now. Find out whether you were there or fed us bullshit.
Right... I might not make it in time. I'm not a hacker...
You talk too much. Clock's already running!
Damn!
I remember...
You finally showed up, that's what. We were about to come help. Thought you wouldn't make it yourself.
Thanks, I'll manage without your help. Do you still need me here?
What was that story about weapons? Searched two bunkers. Nothing. Lost a man in the farther bunker by the antennas, too.
He probably took the gun. That's why it disappeared... With him.
Don't give me the runaround! Where was the weapon, here or there?
Well, yes, somewhere here. Might have rolled away, but I definitely saw it. Didn't even know about the second bunker... Maybe look there first?

Nothing there. Sealed door to keep evil in. Enough games. If true, enter this bunker. They're waiting. Get device, bring weapon out openly in hands. No jokes, hiding. If there, find it. No leaving until then. Not there? Neither are you.
And if it's already dissolved on its own, or that tool doesn't work... How's that my fault?
Well, weapon finder, where's the gun?
It was around here somewhere... Are you handing out tools?
Take it. Damn thing's stretched my arms. Some kind of alloy, maybe... Makes my head hum too.
Yes, heavy... Really does make you uneasy, that thing. Alone here? Aren't you scared? Some nasty thing flying around.

Quiet before you. No more creatures seen. Lied about weapons, apparently. Searched everything three times. Worse for you. Prepare for a warm welcome. Two men slipped into the Electro hangar, checking again. Doubt they'll find anything.
I'll go look, too.
It was around here somewhere... You should go back to your people.
I've got a few Cobblestones.
I've got a unique artifact. Called a Pendulum...
I met a Duty squad near your base.
Well, well... Looks like Duty's trying to get even again... \nGo inside. Don't start shooting here, or they'll carry you out feet first.
All right.
Uh... What? Piss off... People traipsing through here...
Hey! Wake up! Got any water?
Hrrm... What? Food soon... Go to Shinkar for water.
Well...
I don't really feel like it.
Then stay out from underfoot. Loner.
Yeah, I'm a loner. Work it out yourselves...

Job, yes. Freedom bastards' base beyond hill. Going to stir it up.\nOne guarded entrance. Want fence hole, sniper in tower stops us. Won't send men under fire. Lets you near, won't shoot immediately. Kill him, payment, any equipment at base if successful.
Uh... Why so sure? Won't send your own men, but you don't mind putting me in the line of fire?
You're not one of us. A Freedom man wouldn't hesitate. Told you: all you need to do is kill the sniper on the tower beyond the fence.\nWell?
No, I don't want any part in this.
Then stay out from underfoot. Loner.
Take out the sniper? What's in it for me?
Right approach. Decent artifact could be yours. About thirty thousand for the sniper, plus equipment at the base. Plenty of bodies, I promise. Help us, help yourself. Well?
All right, I'll take the job.
No way! Shoot each other yourselves...
I'll look around for now. Then we'll see.
Excellent! Once you take him out, we'll start the show.
We'll wait. Not long, though.
Marked One. What are you doing here?..

Where needed. Preparing major operation: "kick certain psychos' asses." Freedom base beyond hill. One guarded entrance. Duty never stopped by obstacles! Another entrance soon. Join? Plenty to loot, promise...
Hmm, plenty of loot? All right, I'll go with you.
No way! Shoot each other yourselves...
Step aside, all right? We need to get ready...
All right, get ready.
Don't rush me. I've only got one life. Need to think it through.
Ever sell watermelons at a market? Told you in plain language: walk up and shoot. What's difficult?
If it's so simple, why's your soldier lying there like a lump of carrion?
Here's the thing. I'm not getting involved. Find another fool.
All right, got the hint. Hurry up, though, or we'll find another hunter for easy pickings.
All right. Off you go, loner... What goes around comes around. Might come back as nine grams of lead...
Well... It wasn't that hard.
Yes, yes... Continuing with us? We'll clean those little bastards out... Don't worry about payment! Got a special artifact you'll find very useful. Believe me!
I've started, so... I'll go with you.
No, I'm going my own way.
We'll blow the fence now and start the fun. Could you handle the snipers in the towers? Without them, it'll be easier to reach that bastard Lukash.
Understood. I'll get to it...
Move aside while we get ready...
All right...
Continuing with us? We'll clean those little bastards out... Don't worry about payment! Got a special artifact you'll find very useful. Believe me!
You... Managed without you, hero. Ready to prove yourself now?
How's that?
What next? Coming with us? We'll clean those little bastards out... Don't worry about payment! Got a special artifact you'll find very useful. Believe me!
Still walking, looking... Got doubts: are you an informer, dear friend? Or prove your manhood and do what we discussed?
All right, I'll do it... A sniper, then.
Hmm, no, I'm not... I won't dirty my hands...
Good man! Shake on it. I respect that.
What an asshole! Get out! All talk! We'll manage without you...
Go to hell!
Don't interrupt, Marked One.
All right.
What else?
Nothing.
What are you hanging around for? Not interested in proving yourself on a real job? What else do you want?
Move along... See how many real men died here...
Nothing there. Looks like some joker played a trick on you.
Found a PKM, a couple of ammo boxes and other things. More military depot than mysterious stalker's stash. Anything to say?
Nothing? A shame... A real shame, yes...

Calm down, Marked One. Bull breathing fire, eyes bulging. Set up, were you? First time? Zone collapsed? World upside down? Life, especially here. Part of this shitty life. Me today, you tomorrow. Moralist. Wanted that machine gun hidden yourself, eh? No lectures. Emerald artifact, or capsule if not wanted...
The Zone, the world... What about people? Something should remain in us, though... Hard for a "dead man" among people. Give me your emerald and take the hardware. It's killing my shoulders.
Don't get so worked up. I didn't send you beyond the Barrier... Here's an emerald artifact. No hard feelings. Told the truth about the man.
Common cause? All good at pretty speeches. Say it: boys went beyond the Barrier for loot, got into trouble... Take your machine gun. Give me the capsule...
Don't get so worked up. I didn't send you beyond the Barrier... Here's your capsule. Radioactive bastard... No hard feelings. Told the truth about the man.
At Radar?! No, to hell with that stash.
Your call. I offered, you refused.
Send me the lead. I'll look around when I'm at Radar.

Sent the stash to your PDA. At Radar, near the bunker, among the APCs. Follow the road. Few beasts there, mostly in the forest. Scorcher doesn't cloud the head too much. Find something interesting, come discuss it.
I'll stop by if I find your stash.
Go yourself, then tell me about it.
Looking for something. Wanted a look around. What's so scary here?
Looking around... First time here? Different matter... Waiting for someone. Signal from the village. God knows what's happening there! Vlad saw bloodsuckers, he said... Maybe joking...
Bloodsuckers? Have you seen them?
Vlad and Yuras went to the pumping station. We're waiting here. Take a look, don't be scared...\nQuiet enough, except poltergeists flying about. Find anything interesting, let us know.
You're a generous lot, I see... All right, I'll go.
Thanks for that, at least...
Maybe you've got three lives. I've only got one. And I'd like to end it without anyone's help. Clear?
Debit and credit? Hmm... All right, give me the artifact...
Don't feed me that crap. I don't agree!
Movies, you say? Give me yours. It'll come in handy.
Uh, no! I'll poke around myself. Might be something important...
Here! A "green" one! Fresh! Stalker brought it recently... Don't talk about the case, okay? Rumors about Shinkar not keeping order... Understand...
Stop driving up the price. Take the papers. Nobody needs them. Go wipe your ass with them...
Here! A "green" one! Fresh! A stalker brought it just recently... Shame about the briefcase, but never mind. Forget it...
Poke around! I gave you such an artifact, out of respect! Ah...
Are you expecting a package? From whom?
Listen, Marked One, enough... Found something? Give it here.
Those bloodsucker corpses lying there are your friends, I suppose?
Bodies? No... None when I lost it... Will you give it back?
Told you, nothing but bodies there. Ask those fellows in the village. Maybe they found something.
Found this little case... What's in it for me?
There was a case, couldn't reach it... Picked up this PDA. Want it?
All right. Just upset. Had my last month's earnings in there. Wanted to send them home... I'll ask my people. Probably gone now, though...\nForget it...
Looks similar... Good artifact, entirely positive properties. Take it? Last month's accounts in there. Debits, credits... Hate recalculating. Could, though.\nWell?
A PDA? What for? Wanted that case...\nSeems a decent little computer, though. Jokes, interesting films... Well... A tier-one artifact. Agreed?
I think I'll help. There's something to that idea of freedom.
Work it out yourselves. These philosophical wars of yours...
You've already taken a path that can free you from everything stopping you living. Good luck! Talk to Max. He'll gather the men and explain what to do.
Your path, your decision. Remember: a chain of events begins with a specific action. Nobody knows where it'll lead...
We dealt with those Duty men!
We? Sounds much like I...\nWhat means "dealt with it"? Who's "we"? Why bring this "interesting" news? Hoping for gifts?
You said we needed to deal with it, help...
I helped your men. We shot the Duty guys. That's it.
I decided those ghouls needed to be eliminated...

Sorting it out isn't just shooting... Told you helped, though. Maybe deserve something. Maybe not. Why involved? Concern you? Suspicious...\nHere. From our community of free people.\nMaybe better treatment now. I'll tell men you may keep your blade.
Helped, did you? The free wind whispers nobody saw it...\nUnderstandable. Don't understand freedom of choice or how to use it. Go with God...
Helped shoot? Why get involved? Concern you? Suspicious... Told you killed someone there, though. Maybe you deserve something. Maybe not. \nHere. From our community of free people.
Helped? The free wind whispers nobody saw it...\nUnderstandable. Don't understand freedom of choice or how to use it. Go with God...
Decisive, aren't you? Why involved? Concern you? Suspicious... "Decided" today. Tomorrow? Don't trust you. Go take a walk...
Eliminate? You're an "exterminator"? The free wind says they managed without you. All talk.\nUnderstandable. Don't understand freedom of choice or how to use it. Go with God...
Kill the Duty men, then we'll talk.
All right.
Lukash said you'd come. Seen those... at the farmstead?
Shit... Duty's got an itch up its ass again! Come with us, eh?
All right.
Yes.
How many are there?
Can't say exactly. Don't think there are many.
Well, well! Look who's turned up! See our chief, Lukash. Then we can shake hands. All right?
Uh... What? All right, then...
Well, well! Look who's turned up! You should see our chief, Lukash. You never know.
Well, well! Look who's turned up! You should pay our Lukash a visit. You never know.
Ever dealt with madmen? There's one here. Maybe you can get him talking? If it goes well, I owe you a bottle...
What do I need to do?

Fellow in swamp shed on stilts nearby. Ran from Red Forest blindly, boys saw. Something drove him mad. Ghosts, secrets, fragments... Tried understanding.\nImportant, rich loot perhaps, unclear.\nTalk to him. Learn something, share profits.
Oh! That oddball! I used to bring him food...
Hmm... Well, he kicked the bucket... That's it.
Yes, our poisoner Cook's feeding a relative, apparently. Let him. Still a person. You never know. Might be useful...
Certain? Bad luck. Nothing gained, then. Shame. Something interesting in his head, I think. Missed the goal this time...
How's it going? All good? Sit down, dry your footwraps, wet your throat. Make yourself at home. We're all friends here...
Hello, wanderer... Well, been to see the loon? What did that madman find?
Well, that nut of yours died, so...
I talked to that lunatic...
No, haven't had time yet. I'll go sometime.
Well, did you understand anything? Or is it still "I'm afraid of ghosts, higher beings," and so on?
Yes, go see him. Time's passing. Someone else might get their hands on whatever he knew about.
Well... Hardly anything, really. But I think he's muttering about Ghost, not ghosts. Heard of a stalker with that nickname?
Heard, seen. Shady. Always asking, disappearing, appearing from nowhere. Like you. Rumor said he and Strelok found the way into the center, the Sarcophagus. Doubt it, honestly. Why him?
He or Strelok might help me remember. Madman mentioned a device in a red tank in the forest. Didn't understand. Mean anything?

Only nearby forest, Limansk reserve, Red Forest. Maybe red forest, not red tank? Tank in Red Forest? Don't remember, but wild place. Tanks possible. Won't go on weak clue. Someone said drunk in Limansk talked devices. Nonsense... Your thoughts?
A madman's a madman. But could look at the tank, or ask in Limansk if I go. Might learn something. All right, you owe a bottle!
Of course! Here. If you're really going into that reserve of fearless monsters, take what I have, from the heart... Should help. Come back, tell me about it. All right?
All right, I'll tell him. Take care!
Hey, brother! How's life? Relax, knock back a shot. Or did you want something?
Go report to Lukash, then we'll talk. All right?
All right.
I'm Vakhtang. Need to work. Find what people order. Marked One. You know what? Do you have it?
Got what? What are you looking for?

Don't know? You're a stalker? Everyone knows Vakhtang looks for what he needs. Everyone can get ammo and things from Vakhtang. Takes broken PDAs with what he needs inside. Bring PDA, get what you want. Rifle? Have it. Ammo? Have it. Medicine? Have that too!
Hmm. So you're collecting PDAs? What are you looking for in them?
I'm Vakhtang... \nWait. Marked One, you say? That one?! You killed our people in the Wild Territory?! No, brother. No business. Who knows what's in your head.
I'll tell you something wise. Don't be offended: the less you know, the longer you live. Bring the PDA. Don't ask questions.
Right. All right, I understand.
I'll tell you something wise. Don't be offended: less you know, longer you live. Bring PDA, no questions. Helped our man, so a small discount.
Not here to trade. Anyone looking for me? Expecting me?
Yes, have... Damn it. I've got a PDA. What can I get from you?
No, don't have... I've changed my mind.
Have a look: rifles, rifle scopes, ammo, grenades, medicine, armor... Tell me, what do you need?
You haven't? Why did you come here, then?
Hmm? All right. True... I'm off.
Can I get anything else? What will you give me?
Me... You... Vakhtang remembers everyone, yes? Who are you?
I'm Marked One. And, uh... I've got an interesting tip.
Ah! Tattooed Marked One. Important man waited for you. Then went looking himself. Said he'd be back.
Soon?
Important man. Much to do. His own boss. Doesn't tell anyone. Come again. He'll be here.
All right! I'll try my luck... Here's a "Jellyfish."
Well, I'll risk a "Wrenched."
Well, made up your mind? Come on, don't be scared! Duty Roulette: one against two...
I've got a "Stone Blood." Here...
Familiar faces everywhere!
You're wrong about that... Here's your artifact.
You know how it is. All sorts of people. We can play if you want.
Maybe another time.
Take the "Droplet." I'll try...
Sorry, Lukash told me not to play with you for now.
Well, then. Take care.
Take the "Sparkler." I'll take the risk...
I've got a spare "Slime." I'll try my luck.
I'll risk it... Here's a "Thorn."
No, the Zone gives me enough risks already.
I respect that! Get moving... The loot's in one of the three...
Ha! I'm off!
Nothing! Just wanted to talk...
Uh, don't get mad...
I haven't got any vodka! Everyone wants a cut!
Entry's by "pass," friend. Bring vodka, you've got a pass... Your call, of course. Go as you are if you can't be bothered respecting good people.
Too many "good people"! Can't provide for everyone...
We'll see. Maybe I'll tell you. Bye for now...
Oh, get lost!
Getting by. Still keeping watch?
Yes... You never know. Yuras disappeared around here yesterday. Went off with a stalker for a couple of hours and... Makes you think...
What about that stalker lying in your barracks?
The one mumbling about Crooked? Or whatever his name was...
I'll read it.
Pockmarked.
Yes, that's right. It's over now. You could see he wouldn't last long. Did you meet that Pockmarked fellow?
Not exactly met him. He vanished too. The Zone took him. As Diodor says, we'll pay for our sins. Sad but expected end for someone like him.
We don't know who was more at fault yet. That wounded man of ours turned out to be a piece of work too.
Meaning?
Diodor visited just before he died. Man asked to confess. Dictated, whispered as best he could. Disjointed, but clear enough.
How do you know?
Diodor left the confession on the body. Looking for Pockmarked, weren't you? Read it. Keep it. Can't deliver it now. Don't need it, everyone here read it.
Who's that wounded stalker in your barracks?

How he crawled here, no idea. Terrible condition. Pure anger kept him going. Helped as able. Knew Zone perfectly. Beautiful hunting: moving target, eye shot, done. Travel with him, survive. No charge. Good, slightly touched. Knew Zone... Once.
Not the point. I'll ask at the Bar. Small chance, but there's one.
Ask. Maybe someone knows. Plenty of scum hanging around there. Cozy under Duty's wing... Fuck...
Got caught in an anomaly, or what?

Maybe, not by himself apparently. Asked, speech confused. Still poor, worse initially. Think robbed, stripped by scum. How hurt, perhaps thrown in anomaly to hide traces. Won't know. Dying, can't dump like dog. Bring food, won't eat. Water only, when conscious.
Thought so. Heard him mutter something about some bastard... Probably delirious. How would you find who it was now...

Find culprit, good deed. I'd strangle scum like that. Took everything. PDA perhaps unsold, still transmitting? Recent. Ask. Dark-haired, if that's who he raved about. Mustache or beard...\nVasyan... Rudoy? No. Pockmarked!
Who?!
Are you deaf? What are you staring at? A friend of yours? I'd stay away from friends like that...
Don't know... Heard about some Vasyan at the Bar, for another reason. Know if Pockmarked had anything to do with Strelok?
What a question... If he is involved, I'd finish Strelok off along with Pockmarked. Same gang, apparently!
Ah!.. Oh! Mmmotherf...! ...
Why are you groaning? Need a medkit?
Mmm! No... Won't help now... They gave me... Did what they could. Thanks for not dumping me outside the fence... Who are you, friend?...
Maybe a friend... I'm a stalker. What's wrong with you? I'd help, but I'm not a doctor...
Stalker, then friend... One of us... Want to be with stalkers... Burden here... Won't last long, feel it...\nBastard... He'll get what's owed there...
What can I do... The Zone gets us all in the end, brother.
Didn't understand a thing... Who do you mean? Hey!..
Ah!.. Oh! Mmmotherf...! ...
You're looking much worse... Hang on. You might pull through...
Man, got something broken?
Broken?
You're not here for me? Wow! They've been driving me mad. Anything breaks, they come running here to whine.
Who are you?
I'm a mechanic. Tinkerer... Name's Screw. Fix guns and anything people bring. Decided to get the vehicles running now. What should I call you?
I'm Marked One. How's the work on the cars going?
Running? All junk. Sick of it. Got vodka? I'd give you... Uh... A couple of weapon repair kits... Interested?
Interesting, but I haven't got any on me...
You should. Always carry things like that. Never know... If you get some, come by. Have a little drink to getting acquainted.
No problem.
I've got a special one. Here, take it.
Thanks! Good of you. I'll have some later. Here, as promised.
Good luck.
Don't interrupt. I'm thinking...
Did you really bring vodka?
I've got a sort of flamethrower here. What do you think? Can you revive it?

Nobody uses those now! Broken. Damn... Severed hose, this broken too. Dragged through every anomaly, or chimera ate and vomited? Plenty of work. Ungrateful work. Payment, parts needed. List... Have some, ask boys for some. Need to hunt others...
To hell with the thing! More trouble than it's worth. Want it?
Running around, you say? Used to it. What do you need?
Fine, I'll take it. Even throw in a little green artifact for a deal like that.

Right... Here's a rough list:
 First, a Fireball artifact. Look at all those holes! An ordinary soldering iron would keep me busy until winter. With a Fireball, I can weld it up much faster. I've got a good method...
 Second, tubing. What's on it now is for watering cucumbers, not carrying a fuel mixture! Find something suitable. Try Sidorovich. Rookies bring him junk from the Garbage constantly. Give him my regards. Maybe he'll find something for me for old times' sake.
 Third, a pressure gauge, for those who don't know the word. This one's completely wrecked. Looks like someone opened cans with it. Geniuses... Go find me one. Try Agroprom. Used to be a research institute there. Maybe one's still lying around.
 Fourth, a burner. Can't do without it. Who chewed this one? Looks like someone shoved it between a burer's teeth! Ask our people, but nobody will give theirs up. Good for smoking sausage. Heh. Unless you search the barracks quietly... Better option: the Barkeep. A storehouse of assorted crap. Get one from him, and I'll fit it. Don't tell him who it's for. Might tell Duty I'm tinkering here, and they'll raid us straightaway. Do we need that?
 Most important part of any machine: lubricant. Alcohol, that is. Polish the parts, varnish my insides. Understand? Find me some vodka. Don't fancy all this work sober. Plenty to do, so five bottles... No, seven... Wait, ten. Might leave none for the parts otherwise.
 That's it. Get gathering. You're a stalker, brother! I believe in you. Preferably start with the vodka...
Wow. That's quite a shopping list! All right. Hope it's worth it.
Yes, it's worth it. It'll cost just one artifact. A good one. Tier three. Even that's a special favor!
You didn't mention artifacts!
Now it is. Could charge more for what I'm building! Kind, though. Who else will assemble this crap? Don't be stingy.
Oh, all right... I'll go. Don't drink yourself to death before I return!
About refilling the flamethrower.
What? Flame... What? Head's not working after yesterday... Pour me some, eh? Maybe I'll get it then...
Can't get near you without a bottle, I see. Here.
That's more like it. You're asking me something, and all I hear is ringing... What do you want?
Someone wants to learn to fill flamethrowers. You've got experience. Share it. I'll return the favor.

Would tell free, but need colloidal-gas cylinders. Lab store looted by childish stalkers, dumped everywhere. Now need three badly. Seen them? Bring, and three fuel canisters. Can deliver separately. Deal?
Three gas cylinders and three fuel cans. All right. Maybe.
I haven't got anything. We'll talk later.
Remember you promised to explain how to refill a flamethrower?
I remember. Stop pestering me. Also remember someone was going to bring gas cylinders and fuel. Where are they?
I keep my promises. Here's all the gas and fuel... Well?

Not empty? Good. 
Write or remember? Better I write, save pestering later... Pen won't work... 
Needs lubrication? Joke, works.
Here. No great secret, needs equipment. Written. Gather it, fill it yourself.
Can't find it! Could we work something else out?
Can't... Neither can I! So? A fellow promised to bring it. Need payment... A thousand dollars? Got a check? Then we'll talk.
Yes, I've got a check. Here.

Not fake? Good. 
Write or remember? Better I write, save pestering later... Pen won't work... 
Needs lubrication? Joke, works. 
Here. No great secret, needs equipment. Written. Gather it, fill it yourself.
I'll get it. Wait, I'll run over.
It's not for me. All right. Maybe we can make sense of your scribbles.
Right, what about the flamethrower?
Ohhh! The proud flamethrower owner finally dragged himself here!
Really! Didn't think I'd ever see decent work from you. Looks good. Hand it over. Thanks.
Hey, wait! You're in a hurry... We had a deal! Two artifacts for the work...
What?! Drunk your brains away? We agreed on one!
Shhh... Don't get heated... Yes, I forgot. Happens. One artifact, yes. One of the good ones. Like a Soul...
That's better. Here's your payment. Going on about two!
Right! Much obliged... Here's your flamethrower. Now you can light things up. Ha ha. Good luck.
Yeah. But it's empty! How do I use it?!
Filling this thing isn't easy! Remember: fuel canister, cylinder of... What's it called... Colloidal gas! Or I'll obtain it all, but that costs plenty.
A cylinder of what, sorry?.. Where do I even start looking?

Some colloid. Scientists brought it for experiments. Perfect fuel mixture ingredient. Agroprom, perhaps. Scattered across Zone, who knows where. Search. Remember: fuel canister and strange colloid cylinder.
Well... Understood. Thanks again. Now you can get drunk.
I'll think some more. Whether I need all this.
Oh, Marked O-o-one!.. What do you want?.. R-r-really think... I c-c-could've... F-f-finished already?! Hic...
If you drank less, you'd have finished ages ago! All right, to hell with it... Work. I'll come back later.
I've got everything to repair the flamethrower.
Well? Can do! All of it? Didn't expect that... Let's have a look. Vodka hasn't gone sour, has it?
Take the Sphere and parts first. Plenty of time to drink the vodka later. Get working! I'm waiting for the flamethrower. My thanks await you.
Relax! Said I'd do it. Give me a day. It'll be done.
Deal. I'll wait.
Some water? For wiping things down? Might have some. Got anything to pay with?
Well! Some exchange rates you've got. All right, here.
It's the Zone, brother. Only tushkanos come free here. There's water left in the kettle next door. Help yourself...
Go wash in a puddle. Fits your bastard behavior.
Those prices... I'll manage without it.
Hello, stalker. Want something? What's your name, by the way?
Hi. I'm Marked One. Looking around. Do you trade?
Something like that. Barter. Keep people supplied.
What do you take as payment?
Artifacts, of course. Here's the list. Have a look.
What interesting things have you brought?
Ah, it's you... What would you like?
Nothing... Just looking around. Actually, I'm looking for someone. Ghost. Heard of him?
I'll do it.
Good. Find anything else, bring it. I'll pay well. Maybe a PDA or note you come across. I collect those.
Hmm... Of course I've heard... Know where Bloodsucker Village is?
Well... More or less. I'm not here often. Could be wrong.
Good... Not what I meant... Bad situation. Ghost urgently needs help. Signal from the village. Nobody to send for a good man. Almost need to call Duty.
Go on.
A couple went into the village. The other three are still on the outskirts. Help them, and I'll reward you too. Will you?
Can I get gear from you?
You've fed me bullshit, friend. No Ghost there. Only bloodsuckers. Thank God I dealt with them.
Quick as a case of the shits, stalker... \nNever said Ghost. Misheard. Said Prozaik. Meant him. Probably died there. Here's something for heroics...
For the right price, anything.
Not this time.
Look, Ghost could die. Need to help the man.
Well, how did it go?
You've fed me a load of bullshit, friend. No Ghost there. Only bloodsuckers. Thank God I killed the creatures.
Was it hard?
So-so.
Interesting... Filth pouring from the center. Where from?.. \nNever said Ghost. Misheard. Said Prozaik. Meant him. Probably died there. Here's your payment...
I even sent you some men to help!
I've changed my mind. Don't want the risk.
Fair enough. Your life's worth more than rewards...
No problem. Just don't expect anything from me, then.
Wait a little... I need to get ready!
Don't rush me! I think I'll give it a try...
Get ready, but don't take too long...
What about the bloodsuckers? Time's ticking... Not good.
Don't panic. It'll get done...
You'll get it... You'll get turned into shashlik... Thought you were a serious man. Turns out you're just talk.
To hell with those bloodsuckers! Life's worth more...
Fond of yourself, eh? Well... Maybe that's right. Maybe you're right...
People say you killed the bloodsuckers in the village. True?
That happened...
Hmm... Was it hard going?
So-so. Did you have an interest there?
Well... Yes, I did. Think the matter will be settled now. Oh! Here, for your heroics...
Hmm... Not much...
You said it wasn't hard. \nBy the way, find anything interesting? A little box with a clever lock, maybe?
No, nothing but mutants there.
Hello, Marked One. What did you bring? Or do you need something else?
I've got business from Ivar... Should I come back later?
Why later? I respect Ivar. What did he send?
He sent money. Says you promised him a weapon...
Ah, yes. We talked about that once... Here it is. Complete set: rifle and pistol.
Found the soldiers' gravisuits. Good stuff!
Gravi-armor? What? Oh! You mean the antigravity suits? Got them out, did you? Good man! What do they do?
Let you lift almost two hundred kilos, but they're heavy themselves...
Well, damn! I'll sell it to a fellow who's very interested. You shared an artifact, didn't you? Here, take an artifact capsule...
What do they do? Plenty! I'll keep them.
Well, brother! Your find, your choice...
I'm free for now. Need anything?

Time? Good.\nMilitary scientists studied Cobblestone antigravity. Lured to America before finishing, but made two antigravity suits. Military dumped in attic, forgot. Steal them? Tier-two artifact for lead. Anyone would snap up such suits.
Well? All right, here's the artifact. Where, exactly?
Where? Karaganda... Sidor said Cordon checkpoint. Soldier told him something like it was in the barracks attic. Unless thrown out already.
Don't want to tangle with the military...
Your choice. Maybe I'll offer it to someone else.
Max asked me to take someone's belongings to the Cordon.
Yes, now. Hardly anything. Photos, scribbled notebook, bits and pieces, knife... A small bag... Hey! Why staring at nothing? Still here? Talking to you!
Thinking... Running around, forget past lives, reminders, people to receive them. Me? No personal belongings. Rifle and torn backpack don't count. No photos, reminders, memories. Nothing...
That? Wanted to keep the knife. Too small. Couldn't cut sausage. Pretty handle, though... Why freezing up again? Smoked yesterday?
A knife! Seen a handle like that before! Must've known the owner. Let me see the photo... Him? What was his name? Who's next to him?

Ilyukha Ace. Friend beside him, started stalking together. Didn't join us. Ilyukha never mentioned you, nobody remembers you here. Knew him, likely earlier stalker days. Visit friend. Somewhere... He said... Remember... Ah:
Ilyukha... Hmm... Give me the package. I'm off.
Here. Drop by if you need anything...
Where were you wandering? Delivered it without you already.
Ah... All right, then.
Need anything else? Just ask...
Hi, drug baron... Here's your "weed."
How's the herb? Get you high?
Try it yourself. I'm not becoming a guinea pig...
All right, we'll try... Take your artifact. Haven't got more.\nDon't make faces! Here's some money from the boys...
I'll go have a smoke...
Anything else I could earn a little money on?
Brave boys, like relaxation. Vodka before. Rumor: mutated grass, smoke and triple strength, almost see through things, heightened senses... Want to try that weed. Interested?

Might be lies, but rumors. No smoke without "grass"... Understand.\nOld man in the Swamps. Makes coats, sells to bandits. Supposedly had special "tobacco." Stepanych. Met him? Ask if you find him. Might get a taste.
Three times stronger? Sounds like bullshit... Where'd you hear it?
