Might be lies, but rumors. No smoke without "grass"... Understand.\nMikhalych, old man in Limansk. Deals things. Supposedly had "grass." Talk to him. Might get some.
Might be lies, but rumors. No smoke without "grass"... Understand.\nHunter, their chief, forgotten his name. Keeps their hangout in the Gut. Probably know him! Ask carefully. Might work out...
Here's the ammo. A crate. Heavy bastard!
The right kind? What caliber?
Says 5.56. Haven't looked inside.
Right ones. Give your PDA. I'll send the promised artifact-modification recipe...\nOh! Since you're responsible, Lukash needs someone reliable for a job. Should pay well. Talk to him.
Don't know. Didn't check...
Someone screwed someone. Sidorovich you, or you me. Useless ammo type for us. What do I do with it? \nTake some back. I'll send someone else.
Hmm, just the caliber I need...
The people at the Barrier want some ammo!
Ammo's running out... Sidor promised a box or two. Need a courier. Promised a new artifact for him to sell, ammo for us... Go? Not free. Information comes from everywhere. Unusual recipes...
Uh... All right, give it here. I was going there.
Here's the container. Just make it quick. One foot here and the other... Well, you know where.
No, I wasn't heading there yet... Maybe later.
Hello, potheads! I want to teleport. Can we arrange it?
Teleport? Damn... What were we talking about? Think I remember... Didn't forget the Compass? Where do you want to go?
Of course, here... You'll need something else, naturally?
Ah, you fools. Here you go. Need a trip to the Cordon.
I'm not dealing with junkies. I'll walk...
Smart. Only memories of that sack you brought left now... Good grass costs money. \nWant a smoke, need cash! Proper currency, not rubles. Don't puzzle over it. Current prices here.
I'll save my artifacts. Walk there myself...
Set it for Yantar. Here, buy yourself some good weed...
To Pripyat...
What favor? Go somewhere and bring a magic brick again?
Brick? What brick? What's magical about it? Where?
Well... Never mind. What did you want?
Magic Brick... Interesting.\nMining suspicious spots, short mines. Left, mine warning signs. Military laid them before great emission. Old. Bring two, pass free. Deal?
What am I, a sapper? We'll see...
Ah, you, Marked One. Still wandering... Back to see us? If so, surrender your guns. Better safe than sorry. Anything can happen after a drink.
No, just saying hello. Then I'll move on.
I've got business with one of your men. Here's my "arsenal."
Hello, then... Drop by if you've got something to tell me...
Right, come on... Go through. I'm starving... When are we getting a proper cook here...
Look who limped in. \nHeard of you... Surrender weapons, add a hundred armor-piercing rounds for Western guns. Only then enter the base with decent people.
As you say. Take my weapons for safekeeping, and the ammo.
Go through. God help you if you screw the men over again, though... Don't complain afterward.
Everything will be fine. Don't worry.
I haven't got that ammo on me.
Then get lost...
I'm leaving, I'm leaving. Calm down.
Vodka, obviously! Against your two bottles of crystal-clear, health-giving drink, today I'm putting up:
A liter of vodka against this? Let's see who wins...
No... My head's not working today... Come back later...
Your call. Could've had a game...
Some fun, Baldy? What are we betting?
Can't today. Flat broke. Once a fellow pays what he owes, then... Anyway, come back tomorrow.
Let's go again...
Oh, come on...
No, enough...
Right, my stone...
Ahem... You're too lucky, Marked One... I'm out of money. Might have more tomorrow...
Don't keep me waiting. Throw it!
Until tomorrow, then!
You still owe me from last time. Lost and ran off...
Damn...
Don't be upset. It's not like you lost a cow...\nAnother round?
Well... All right, take it. That's how it went.
Oh, come on...
As usual... My rubles against your artifact with positive properties. Stakes? \n • 15 000: tier-one artifact \n • 30 000: tier-two artifact
Aha! I always knew!
He knew... Take your winnings!\nAnother round?
I'll bet an ordinary artifact. Here...
Let's play for a mid-grade artifact.
Something serious. Here's a good artifact.
I've changed my mind. I'm not playing.
Well, God be with us...
Ah! Here we go...
It's all right. I'll win next time!
That's right!\nAnother round?
No, we've had our fun. Enough.
Let's go again...
We can. Your tier-one artifact against six half-liter bottles of my crystal-clear drink.
Let's play! An ordinary artifact from me, then?
No, I can't yet today. Come back tomorrow...
Uh... Haven't you forgotten something? We've already played...
I'll pay it back another time...
No, Marked One. Don't want to play now. Need some sleep...
You've cleaned me out! Sorry, no vodka left for today... Come back tomorrow.
No, enough...
Right, my stone...
All right, until tomorrow.
Don't keep me waiting. Throw it!
My stakes are fixed...
Damn...
You lost, Marked One. Bye-bye bottles and artifact...\nAnother game?
All right, here's the artifact, and... Let's begin!
Well, let's risk it!
I've changed my mind. I'm not playing.
Sorry, friend. Won everything I had. Come tomorrow, I'll have more.
Aha! I always knew!
You got lucky, Marked One. Here's your artifact and your bottles back...\nAnother game?
Ah! Here we go...
It's all right. I'll win next time!
Here's yours back...\nAnother game?
No, we've had our fun. Enough.
Hi. A bit gloomy here.
The Zone, brother... That's the main entertainment. The Zone and artifacts. What should I call you, stalker?
Marked One. What's your name?
Look at my head... Baldy, they call me. Entertainment? Dice? Artifacts piled up, no good prices here. I'll stake artifacts, you money. Deal?
Is that so? Well... Thanks, you did me a favor.
You've really made our lives easier. Thank you, stalker. Work like that deserves a reward!
Marked One, thanks for killing those troublesome mutants. Here's a little gift from me personally.
Mutants aren't a problem anymore. Safe to move around.
You really saved our lives. We owe you our deepest thanks.
Didn't expect you to handle that so quickly and efficiently. Good luck out there, stalker!
You've really helped us. Those creatures won't bother us anymore. Here. Only a small part of what you've earned.
Impressive work! Not everyone could manage it. Thanks for helping.
You're a real professional, stalker. The Zone appreciated your contribution.
The mutants aren't troubling us anymore. You've saved more than one life. Here's your reward:
Did what many thought impossible. Well done! Take this present!
We can sleep peacefully now. The mutants aren't a threat anymore. Hope you'll be happy with the reward.
You're a real hero of the Zone. Not everyone would dare do that. You've earned a reward:
Impressive cleanup. I think you'll find this useful:
Get lost, asshole. I don't want to talk to you either!

Me? You wanted something... A job: find, bring. Scientist, big name, boasts. Sniper? Shooter? Accurate? No... Wanted case. Tools for Monolith gun. Left in lab. Said number, designation... Something...
Sleep it off! Drunk...
Well, what is it? X-16? X-18?
What are you talking about! Ten what?
No... You really are thick... I keep telling you: an egghead left a briefcase at Yantar... Don't you get it?
Judging by your face, you're Marked One?
And judging by your attitude, you're Brazen...
Easy, no offense... We're not having a pissing contest. Trying to survive. Earn a little too, of course. Came into this shithole for money yourself?
Not interested in money. Looking for a man named Strelok...
Strelok? None of my business, but he's been gone a long time... His friend Ghost was here recently, though...
Go on...
Don't rush. Slow and steady... Ghost wanted Strelok's stash. Said something there could greatly help get closer to the center.
Is that stash here? Thought Strelok's stash was near Agroprom?
Don't care how many stashes, Strelok's or anyone's... Interested in artifacts and proper money. You're not a coward, Marked One?
Well, Marked One, show my crooks how tough you are after all?
What do you want? Skip the stories...
Listen. Been here nearly half a year. Good place. Many stalkers cross the bridge to Limansk and back. Gathered plenty... Wonder why we only take Dummies now? Too many small artifacts to carry...
Brazen, tell me about Strelok's stash instead...
Don't rush, you'll get there... Preparing to retire. Enough Zone for a lifetime... Lie in the Canary Islands' sun, warm our bellies with young girls.
What's it to me? Fuck off...
Want Strelok's stash? Quit arguing. Most loot in nearby forest, against military/Duty raids. Bloodsucker family settled by stash. Rich, can't reach. Enter expert Marked One. Understand?
So I kill the suckers, and you tell me about Strelok's stash?
Not just that. I'll throw something in... Got an artifact anyone wandering the Zone could use.
I'll think about it. Need to go to Limansk first.
Find your own loot. I didn't sign up to be your errand boy.
If it's nearby, I'll try killing those mutants.
Think, but not long. Might find a man who isn't scared...
Keep walking... "Hero"...
Very close. I'll mark it on your map... Honestly, didn't expect that... Plenty of tough stalkers piss themselves at the sight of a bloodsucker.
You again, thinker? Made up your mind?
Let's go over it. I kill the bloodsuckers, get information about Strelok?
Right on the money... Besides, I'm throwing in something extra... So make up your mind...
Hmm... I think I'll try, but not now.
All right! Settled! Shake on it!
Your call...
Good man! I respect that...
It's you... "Hero." Keep moving...
Don't push it. You'll catch a bullet...
Hi, Marked One. Done with the suckers?
Not yet. Need to scout the place...
They're done... Some mutants! The ones before seemed easier...
Fuck! Hard to believe! No bullshit? You're a pro!
Skip the big words. I want specific information.

Ghost sought unfinished bunker. Prisoners built for Ukrainian bigwigs. Construction stopped, prisoners shot, almost all. Entrance in closed forest valley, reached through small tunnel a couple of versts away.\nStrelok's group used another entrance, now closed to Ghost.
A bunker in a closed-off valley? Not very informative... Doesn't seem useful enough to justify access to a big haul...
Don't fret... Here's a unique artifact from me and the boys... We're square, I think?
All right, settled... Take care...
Greetings, tough guy! How's life, Marked One?
Remember our talk about Krysyuk?
Nothing wrong with my head. Unlike some people. Well?

Gave me a PDA. Borov's personal handheld, he said. Maybe many secrets. Can't access it. Damaged... Know specialists? Especially interested in an underground lab, apparently in the Dark Valley. Anything here?
Borov's? Hmm... Let's see. Got an egghead in mind. Think he'll figure it out. All right?
All right! Here's the PDA. When do I come back?
No. I'll think about it. Maybe come back later.
Go take a walk for three or four hours. Think we can work something out by then.
You're quick. All right, I'll come back.
Well, how's unlocking Borov's PDA going?
You've got a brain, then. Finished faster than I thought. What did you want? Information about the underground place in the Valley? Right?
Some sort of lab, I think. Borov knew about it.
Borov knew plenty. The lab...\nHere's a diagram from the PDA. Looks like what you want. No guarantees. All encrypted. Here's a little gift from the scientist and me: an artifact...
Hmm... Well, thanks.
If it weren't for... All right. Here's four tier-two ones.
I haven't got that many artifacts.
Two artifacts! Here, take them, robber.
Here's a Dummy. Get talking.
I'll part with a Modified artifact. Now share the information...
What are you doing, dealing in three-liter jars?
Well, this isn't ordinary glass. It's some special kind of crystal... Ivan Sergeich had it specially ordered from Sweden. This glass can withstand the effects of the acidic anomaly "Witch's Jelly"!
Zombie hands are no problem. I'll bring as many as you need.
Should've started with that, don't you think? To hell with it. Sounds promising. I'm in.

Good. Need a jar of Witch's Jelly for every body part. Not the Red Cross here, understand? Plenty of empty jars. Ivan Sergeich ordered a batch recently. Finding Witch's Jelly shouldn't be difficult for a stalker.
Well, damn... Can't you preserve several parts in one jar of Witch's Jelly at once?
Quick, aren't you... Want to have your cake and sit on a d... Witch's Jelly, too. Not simple. Body parts must be preserved separately. Only way! One jar of Witch's Jelly, one body part.
So if I bring you a spoiled mutant part to preserve, I'll get it back fresh?
No. Get back what you bring. Not completely rotten, please... \nNo dog tails, flesh eyes. Scientists won't bother. Cat tails rarer, useful. Research needs rare-mutant preservation. Short on those.
What exactly do you take for preservation and study?
Bloodsucker parts work. Pseudogiants, burers interesting too. Controller or poltergeist parts, chimera innards welcome. \nRefrigerator isn't endless. About ten jars, no more. Clear?
I see... I'll bring anything I need preserved!

Avoid emissions carrying Witch's Jelly. Substance mysteriously vanishes from jars. Special container needed for preserved samples. 
Why tell you all this? Valuable talent wasted... 
Postgraduate researcher Vronsky needs special-mutant hunting help. You're ideal. 
Help him first, then I'll preserve your parts.
Wow! What do you need jars of "Witch's Jelly" for?
No, guys, I pass. I'll manage without it.

Don't you know? That substance preserves flesh! So we use jars of "Witch's Jelly" to preserve mutants for study... Some people in the West pay good money for the chance to study this anomaly under laboratory conditions, too. Whenever we can, we send full jars abroad, and they send us the equipment we need... That's how it works.
Will you explain how to preserve mutant innards in "Witch's Jelly"?
No idea myself. Our brains manage it. Doubt they'll reveal the secret to anyone. Special equipment, laboratory conditions. Can't improvise on your knee. Don't worry about it.
Sometimes I find parts from rare creatures, but they spoil quickly. Can't always reach a trader in time... Isn't there some way?
Bring something rare, we'll work it out. Not free. Preserving flesh is hard work. Time and effort. Won't be easy distracting our technicians...
What do you want?

Zombie research, short hands. Two dead men's hands to preserve one component. Reasonable.\nNever seen zombies in these Swamps. Closer to center. Hunters sometimes bring samples. A few in the Gut east of Cordon, they say.
Choose...
About mutant innards...
What do you want? Preserve something, or collect it? If preserving, remember the jar of Witch's Jelly and two zombie hands?
I need something preserved.
What are we preserving?
I've got bloodsucker tentacles.
Bloodsucker tentacles.
I'd like to collect them.
Marked One, you've already given us mutant parts to preserve. Sorry, we're not magicians. One batch at a time.
Got hold of a burer paw.
I need the burer paw.
Thought we could preserve several parts at once.
Choose which mutant part you want back:
I don't need anything right now...
Hmm, that's it. No room left in the refrigerator... Take something out, then we can preserve more.
Managed to find a controller hand.
I need the controller hand.
Excellent specimen! It'll be preserved in a couple of hours. Then you can collect it whenever you need it.
Flesh from a huge pseudogiant!
Pseudogiant flesh.
I'll bear it in mind.
Take your mutant carcass. If you need anything else preserved, come see me. Always welcome.
Ever seen an electrochimera kidney?
I'll take the electrochimera kidney.
An extremely rare poltergeist eye.
Poltergeist eye.
A cat tail.
Cat tail.
A foul-smelling snork boot.
Snork boot.
A fluffy pseudodog tail.
Pseudodog tail.
Your postgraduate was supposed to discuss preserving a controller hand...
Yes, he sent someone. I can arrange one free preservation job. Interested?
Yeah, that would be nice.
No, thanks. Just asking.
Excellent... Sergeich was just asking...
All right, I'll bring it...
Urgent! Kidney! Electrochimera... Know how hard one is to kill? Few brave souls left. Others fled to heaven... Outside the Zone, that kidney fetches big money.
All right, I need the kidney. Here's the check.
Yes. Asked too little. Never mind. A man keeps his word! Here. Got it by chance. Don't mind it being a little limp...
Well, you've palmed off a rotten piece of God knows what on me... Can I come back if I need another?
As I said: rare goods. Pester scientists in the Swamps or elsewhere. Maybe satisfy your odd interest in strange beasts... Heh.
I'll never get used to your lame "little jokes"...
I told you, one grand in foreign currency! Got it?
Hold on to it. I'll come back with a check for that amount.
I'll hold it. Not for long! Know a couple of fellows who like this sort of thing. Just don't feel like going anywhere now...
All right, I need the innards for something. Here's the check.
Yes. Asked too little. Never mind. A man keeps his word! Here. Got it by chance. Don't mind it being a little wilted...
A rotten bit of flesh for two grand! Some generosity, damn it...
What are you complaining about?! Fresh stuff's barter only.
I need a controller hand, urgently.
Hold on to it. I might come back with checks for that amount.
I'll hold it. Not for long! Know a couple of fellows who like this sort of thing. Just don't feel like going anywhere now...
I need a poltergeist eye, urgently.
Marked One, get out of here while I'm still asking nicely, before I split you in half with this cleaver.
Well? Why the noise? Awake?
What the hell!? What kind of joke is this? Open up!
Calm down, friend... I'll open it. Who knows who brings what? Rested a little. Nothing bad happened.
Nothing happened? Right... Where's my stuff? Why all this nonsense?
Your belongings are in the container nearby. Why? Man in charge wanted to see you. Ordered you put to sleep.
Who is he? Where is he now?

Ghost. Inspected you asleep, all belongings. Seemed pleased. Told me to look after you, find you later himself or through Doctor. Left yesterday.\nWon't attack me? Did nothing bad. Need work. Open door or wait?
Open up. I won't eat you, don't worry.
Not afraid. Cautious. I'll open it. Want to talk, visit. Right when you leave. Enter 85467 on the panel, then through corridors. You'll find it. Take care.
Yeah, unlock the gate...
Sorry, Marked One, my friend... Need to work... Ghost won't pat me on the head if there's no result.
About your attempts to make a protective helmet...
Yes? So? I said there's not enough data.
Anything useful to say? Can we make a protective helmet?
Damn... Helmet probably won't work out. Missed something. Thought this was the answer, but only references. No actual data. Promised too soon. Sorry.
Well. No way to solve it, then?
Unlikely...\n...\nListen! You don't need the helmet itself, do you? What matters is stopping the Rainbow emitter damaging your brain?
Well... Yes. Something like that.
Can alter the emissions' structure. Still emitting, but little effect on a normal brain...\nTheoretically. Description says so.
Theorists... All right, how?
Apparently replace a control-panel unit. Various pulse reference modules determine wave shape and intensity. Warehouse invoice lists different modules supposedly in stock.
Keep it simple. What warehouse? What unit? Where? What needs replacing?

Simpler? All right.
New modules in a warehouse. Don't know which one. No references, only a number. Like the one on my table. Ghost brought it once, thought it useful.
Replace the emitter-control module with an equivalent marked 12-Х-14ТО, and the emitter becomes safe for people.
Probably.
You know the control station. Brought these descriptions from there.
Write down the marking: 12-Х-14ТО. Don't forget...
Oh! Replace the modules in the third and fourth harmonizer units. Don't touch the others. You might give the emissions a form that burns everything...
That's exactly what I'm here about. The data. I've got something.
Right... Somewhere there's a thing to replace in the Radar lab. "Very simple," "very easy." If I find it, bring it to you?
No. Find where to put them in the harmonizer units. In the laboratory where you found the papers. Those descriptions were there for a reason.
Go there again?! Need to think hard about whether it's worth it... Unless I end up there again somehow.
Something? Want to sell something? This isn't a shop. Everything here is needed for work. Nothing's just lying around...
Not selling. Visited an underground lab. Documents there... Controlled the Scorcher! Even a model of the installation, called Rainbow. Here. Might find something useful. Share then? Eh?
Rainbow... I'll look. Lots of text. Need to understand. Sit here. Papers should show straightaway if there's anything useful.
Well... Have a look, if it won't take too long.
Yes! Describes the problem I've struggled with! A couple of experiments, then... We'll see. Don't jinx it... \nWanted something? Help if I can. For the clue...
I might need a protective helmet like that. Maybe more than one. Can we arrange it?
Uh... Just a moment. Need to think... Another minute.
Soldering, I see. What's that thing?

Helmet? Ghost says tuned opposite-phase suppressor could protect from Scorcher. Attempts fail. Standard convective pulse inductor detects, transforms emissions. Induced field turns helmet microwave oven, consequences obvious... Need room-temperature superconductors. None yet. Don't know why Ghost thinks possible.
Oh! So protection is possible, in principle?
In theory, yes. If not for the superconductor problem... If we had any clue how to obtain that anomalous property...
Heard military scientists tried making something like that in their underground labs. Even found documents about it.
If you get anything, share it. Might find a lead...
Hmm... Marked One? You? Sorry it happened like that. You know this place. Man is a mutant to man... Have to be careful. Ghost's orders.
Well... My head's still pounding. What was that nasty stuff?
Gas? Just a paralytic agent. Shouldn't have side effects... By the way, I'm Leonid. Korneyev.
You eggheads always poison people with something nasty, then wonder why nobody likes you. Leonid. What are you doing here?
Studying Zone mysteries. Strelok, heard of him? Invented a device that might affect the Monolith's structure. Trying to solve other things along the way.
So you know about Strelok? Where is he? How do I find him?
Wouldn't say I know. Ghost invited me. Worked at a research institute. Told me about Strelok and his invention. Never met him. Disappeared. Only here half a year. Feels like eternity...
Sorry, Marked One, my friend... Need to work... Ghost won't pat me on the head if there's no result.
About Strelok and his work... Found any diagrams, lab descriptions, anything about switching something on...
Very informative. Something... Plenty of papers describing something. What exactly do you need? Might remember.
You mentioned some reference modules. Insert them, and the modulation won't be lethal. Something like that...
I said... Actually, yes! Emitter probably becomes safe for people. Find those harmonizer reference modules. Install them correctly. Your safety too, not just others'...
Why's that?
Because if you turn the emissions on again with the wrong modulation, how will you get out? Thought about that?
Right... Hadn't thought of that. How did Strelok get out if he turned it on? Did he happen to tell you?
No, he didn't say anything like that. What makes you think he was the one who switched it on?
Well... Ivar said so, I think. Though he could've been wrong, too.
Maybe Strelok simply knew how and why to switch it on. That's all.
And sent someone? Strange... All right, give me the documents.
Take everything in that blue case. What Ghost brought... Take it and... Goodbye. Don't forget to install the units.
Don't know exactly. Something about labs in the Dark Valley. Or switching something on with a backup system... Something like that.
No choice now.
Ghost brought Scorcher power documents. Wanted to understand them. Long ago! Without his recent visit and your question, wouldn't remember. Not relevant now, either. Scorcher off.
Actually, very relevant. Just with the opposite sign...
What does "opposite sign" mean? Backup power diagram in those papers. Didn't study closely. Useless then: Scorcher powered by main circuit. What now?
Now another affliction spreads from the center because the Scorcher's off. People lose will and strength. Some call it an "apathy field." Must try switching the Brain Scorcher back on.
Do you realize what you're saying? If the Brain Scorcher's switched back on, a lot of people will die!
If we don't switch it on, everyone dies! Could we alter the Scorcher somehow? So it doesn't affect people?
Don't know. Want no part. Think you know what you're doing? Take all diagrams, do it yourself. Don't want to be cursed as a murderer.
All right, all right. DUTY and debts...
Here's what I found in an underground laboratory at Radar...

Let's see. 
Hmm... 
Fragments... 
Directed hard radiation on frontal-lobe areas. Power limits...
Might interest someone, but time needed, fragments too. No spare time...
 Can't help.
Well... I'll offer it to someone else.
Well... I brought something for you...
Excellent. This one?
You said the one with three brunettes, didn't you?
My beauties... Look at them...\nTalked heart to heart with a soldier. Let slip Agroprom's commander keeps unique things in a safe. Should have a Vintorez there.
Yes... Simple. Just go get it! Hey! Looked through the magazine. Just looked at the women. Couldn't find any recipe...
Maybe wrote it in another journal? Take another artifact.
Maybe wrote it in another magazine? Deal's a deal. Won't owe you. Can give an artifact, or army load-bearing gear. Spare at the warehouse. Choose.
Give me the artifact. We're even now.
I'll take the load-bearing vest. We're even now.
We're even now.
Hello, soldier. Why the frown?
Listen, you get around. Could you find something for me...
All right, if I find it, I'll try to bring it...
Find someone else...
What is it? And what's in it for me?

Unique wear-free Vintorez location.\nNeed Playboy, not for women. Important recipe. Drank with Baldy, woke, magazine gone. Praised women to whole Bar, someone stole. Three lovely brunettes on cover. Well?
Thanks, Marked One. Really helped! Hand it over quickly. Won't let the enemy through now. Hold the line. You'll feel safer passing through too.
Thanks, of course...
Think, Marked One... Need a decent gun and ammo. How else defend against mutants terrorizing our checkpoint?
Calm down. I'll bring a good, loaded rifle soon.
So are you going to tell me about Strelok or not?
Want to know a lot for nothing. Seen Fang, then?
You know nothing. Only pretend. Fang sends regards. Says when Prapor stops acting clever, he'll come to the Bar...
All right. Maybe I'll come back when you're in the mood.
Offended? Wonder myself: really remember nothing, or playing dumb? An infiltrator? Wandering, pretending, sniffing around...
Ah... Should've said straightaway you suspected me of being a Freedom spy. Why didn't you report me back then?
I couldn't give a damn about Freedom... Let the bosses, Petrenko and his lot, promote their ideals and catch spies.
Let's talk again.
Go on.
I'll find out. Still interested in what you know, even if you keep being vague. About Strelok, for example. Maybe me too.
Maybe... What about Fang? Bring him here. Talk together.
Can't surface. Something happened: emissions turn him zombie-like above ground. Asked me to contact scientists for protection and treatment.
Treatment? Scientists doctors now? Zone isn't a clinic. Cure him outside the perimeter. Then I... We learn nothing from him. Useful alive, talking, and in the Zone.
Who else can help? Can't spend his remaining days in a basement. They could make a device, helmet, something. Fang could surface.
Then? Won't keep him here, except as research material. Take him away. Not good. Where is he? Big conversation needed while he's here.
He's... There... I'll think about it. Sakharov could probably help. The only other person is the Doctor. He's already done what he could.
There was another scientist. A "healer" too, though his subjects all bleat like sheep. Maybe not all. Some might just have forgotten how to bleat.
What? Who do you mean?
A scientist who'd open your skull for science if allowed. Forget to ask his subjects' permission, though.
No jokes... Someone told me Fang made an unusual weapon. And you should know something about it.
Now you're off on one...
Don't rush Fang outside the perimeter. Someone else might help. Find a way to bring him out among people normally. Then talk. Strelok, scientists, you, probably. Certain people's debts too.
You're making things up again... I'll think about it.
Go talk to this someone, then. What do you want from me?
Calm down. I wanted to tell you I know where Fang is.
So do I. But it's a one-way ticket.
If you think he's dead, wrong. Saw him, talked. No joke. Underground somewhere. Badly wounded, in poor shape. Can't see, but can speak.
Alive? Sure? And you thought I'd care?
Yes. He could probably tell you a few things. Where he left things, hid things. Who he owes what.
Let's say so. Why not go straight to Fang and ask where everything is? Or did you come for my permission?
What?! More nonsense!.. Stop bullshitting! I don't understand.
Did Ivar happen to mention Strelok's notes?
He did. So? The ones about the Monolith and a shard? I've read them.
Have you? Well, well. Didn't anything... worry you?
For example, why does it say the Zone's a hundred years old?
That's normal enough, considering where Strelok came from... I mean the Monolith men waiting for you. If I understood them right.
What? Nothing about that in there.
Didn't give Ivar everything, then... Look at these notes. Complete the picture. Don't take offense. Need to know who you are now, whose mind's in your head. If his... Later.
Whose could it be, besides mine?
Read, understand. Better ask Ivar why he brought you to Strelok. Doctor too. Say told everything, no evasion. Learn much. Best. Won't believe me until you've shaken truth out. Then talk specifics.
Not telling me anything now? Fine. Ask Ivar and the Doctor. But if anything!.. I'll find you. Won't dodge then. Answer every question.
You'll find me. Not going anywhere. Still need you.
I'll be back.
You're back?
Good, then.
All right. What about the Monolith fighters? And those notes you gave me: how do they fit into this?
Don't know for certain either. Coincidences worried me. Interesting coincidences, admit it. What if... You might use their weapons. Seen those interesting guns?

Think you're working both sides. Someone else wanted those guns. I'm your bargaining chip, useful to either side. Monolith too. Don't understand them... Knew Lebedev, now Swan the Liaison, leading those fanatics in Pripyat?

Knew Lebedev. Vanished, later detected in Pripyat. Suspected Monolith, you confirmed. Adds to notes. Perhaps marked too. Some seek center without knowing why, Zone accepts some, rejects others. Why? What draws them?

To hell with secrets and guesses! Who's marked, why, where they go. Everyone has a path. Want to understand myself alone, walk mine. Clear? Those Lebedevs and their jobs... \nMentioned him because Monolith men gave me a strange assignment. More fog. Can't understand them.
Did you do it?
To hell with secrets, guesses! Who's marked, why, where they go. Don't want to think. Everyone has a path. Want to understand myself alone, walk mine. Clear? All those Lebedevs and their jobs...
Visit Swan. Strelok had contact with them once, learned something important. If they tend the Monolith, only they can show the way. Not everyone gets it. You might be honored.
Sure... Always dreamed of it. Think that Liaison will tell me the route if I go?
Still thinking.
Do it. Strelok had contact with them once, learned something important. If they tend the Monolith, only they can show the way. Not everyone gets it. You've been honored.
Sure... Always dreamed of it. Think that Liaison will tell me the route if I do their job?
I did, but what good is it? Liaison won't talk. Don't know the way.

Strelok had contact with them once, learned something important. If they tend the Monolith, only they can show the way. Not everyone gets it. You've been honored. Done something for them? Talk to Swan when he calls.
Think he'll call me? And that Liaison will tell me the way?
Most likely.
What next? Lost. You've said things I don't understand. Ivar, Doctor too... Can't trust anyone, even myself. Only the Monolith left? Seems you're waiting for that "decision" of mine.
Don't worry what I expect. My business. Everyone has a path, as you said. Only you can walk yours. Seems you've decided already.
You can't wait, can you.
Here I really want to help. "Borrowed" Strelok's information about the Chernobyl NPP once. Stash locations. His or not, don't know. Could help. Realize it's probably one way?
I don't even want to think about it. Like thinking about death. Just as pointless.
Think it through. Fully equip yourself. Probably no shops or service stations. Understand? Those stashes will help.
You've become quite considerate. Thanks, of course. But... I'll think very carefully before I do anything.
Putting off the inevitable? Think or don't. If you've decided... Still... It really is your path. Good luck.
I really don't know...
Where did you expect him? Agroprom's basement? The Doctor must have told you, surely.
Anywhere but on the scientists' examination table. Sakharov said you were the one who handed him over.
Didn't hand anyone over. Gave Fang Sakharov's helmet. They took him out of the Zone, then had to bring him back. That's what the professor explained.
You believed his story? Nothing seemed strange?
Who else can I trust here? You? Only the scientists can evacuate someone urgently. Helped as best I could.
Saw Fang taken away? Don't think anyone intended it. Understand what they'll do now? Your decision, not judging... Pity Fang.
Judge what?! What did you do? Knew he was at Agroprom. Some judge... Better yourself? Gassed me, fed me nonsense, manipulated me. Supposedly helping? Sure. Clearly your own interest!
Calm down. What's done is done. Let's forget it.
Why are you here yourself? Not because of me.
My own business. But I saw Fang and stayed. Didn't expect to see him here, let alone in that state.
Then that's that.
You know Fang well.
Yes. Sakharov said he gave you a helmet, and Fang was supposed to be taken away for treatment. Did you help Fang?
I helped. Just not the way the professor told me to. I sent him to the Doctor in the Misty Thicket.
So he's still here in the Zone?
Yes. He's in the cave for now. The helmet doesn't work in the Thicket. We'll think of something, though.
You call that help? He still can't go anywhere. What else can the Doctor do? Feed him. Nothing more.
Fang's alive. That's what matters. The Doctor knows his job. I did what I could.

Scientists offered real help. Evacuation, actual specialists, not local charlatans. Only scientists can evacuate urgently. Refused, now tell yourself better for Fang. Still trapped underground either way. Your decision. Not judging... Pity Fang.
My own business. But it was time to see you, too.

Judge what?! What did you do? Doctor must've told you he was at Agroprom. Some judge... Better yourself? Gassed me, fed me nonsense, manipulated me. Supposedly helping? Sure. Clearly your own interest!
Calm down. What's done is done. Let's forget it.
Then that's that.
Hello, Frol. How's your health?
Hello to you, stalker... Know me? From where?
Saw you unconscious. At the farmstead with two postgraduates... I'm Marked One.

Marked One! Didn't recognize you. Wanted a word.\nDecent man. Found dead stalker's documents, map. Marked spot, perhaps Clear Sky's reserve store. Nearby, but can't travel yet. Boys carried me here.\nWant to look?
I could look, why not... What's your interest?
The description suggests a weapon of an unusual type. I'd like to try it in action...
Describe the place. I'll try to find it.
No, Frol. I've got more important things to do.
Somewhere between the machinery yard and the old farmstead. Around here... Hurry, though. Plenty of scum around that area.
Hi, Frol. Found the depot you asked about.
Clear Sky's? Well... What was there?
Nothing special. A SIG... Some ammo for it, too. Interested?
A SIG... That's 5.56, right? Haven't come across one... Let me try it. See why Demyan Ugryumych praised it so much.
Take it. I can spare it...
Didn't even take it. What would I want that junk for?
I'll try it myself first...
Thanks. We'll see what this is. Oh! Know the way to the Forgotten Farmstead? I can tell you...
Your call... To hell with that gun...
Forgotten Farmstead? Don't know... Why Forgotten?
To the Forgotten Farmstead? Yes, someone told me already.

Forgotten because nobody knows its name. Need a name to say "I'm going to the farmstead"... Near that warehouse, beyond a couple of houses, gap in the wire. Trail there. Careful. Mark safe landmarks on your PDA.
A house has a basement. Hid an artifact in a backpack and a hunting carbine. Heavy... Yours for helping. Special artifact: cats bother you less with it on your belt.
Yeah, thanks... I'll visit if I need to...
Thanks... I'll look if I'm there...
What? Stay out of their business. That bunch of idealists is really a jar of spiders. Duty will fall apart. Mark my words. Eat each other alive.
I don't care... I'm on my own. Wouldn't hurt to have another word with your Prapor, though.
Hmm... Heard you can remove them. Just need the recipes... All right, thanks for that much.
Forget it.
Why?
Even if only half is true, he said there are anomalies. That half I believe. How will you get through them?
N-no...
Never mind. Forgive me... I'm a little... Thank you again. You've done excellent work. Important information.
You're welcome. Still didn't understand a thing, though...
Listen, do your people go to Radar?
Our people? Oh. No trips now. No point. Sent a group once, couldn't pass. Came back empty-handed. No more. Only costs money.
I understand... He won't tell me anything, from what I gather.
Did any of them fail to return?
From Radar? Don't remember... Had a failed experiment on the factory grounds once. Long ago. Better not remember. Got off lightly, even then...
What do you mean, got off lightly?

Military forced an experiment near X-16. Sakharov supplied people, all vanished with soldiers. Searched during lower emissions, no people or equipment. Barely escaped ourselves. Specialists questioned us, nearly charged Sakharov. Said only consultant, not his idea or decisions. None of us responsible. Got away with fright. Shelved, might resurface.
What's the military got to do with it? Thought Sakharov was in charge and decided what experiments to run.

Who's funding it? His pocket? Whoever pays calls the tune... Military guarded us before. After that incident, backed away. Sakharov arranged Duty... Or someone else, don't know. Stalkers followed Duty.
Yes... Thought he was holding something back. Did Ghost arrive with the stalkers then too?
Don't know. Came with Vasilyev, talked to Sakharov, planned things. No time to talk. No more personnel after that incident, so loads of work for me... Said too much already. Don't tell Sakharov.
Yes, of course... Dangers... You don't understand. That's not the point... So that's why the instruments picked up signals from Radar! Where are the other scanners?
I'm missing something here... Didn't you tell me about them? You said there were three.
Wonderful news! Scientists dead, yes, terrible, sorry... Not that. Breakthrough! Unexpected result, but excellent. Compared with memory-card data... What prospects! Understand?
I found an interesting document at Radar.
Really? Strange. Where would any documents come from there?... What's interesting about them, exactly?
Have a look. Mentions Ghost and some routes...
Strange. Notes from a missing colleague, apparently. Yes... Route unclear, but observations very interesting. Leave papers. We'll study closely. Might clarify something...
Tell me if anything useful for me turns up...
About the calculations. I've thought about it.
Good that you thought. I'm always thinking, thinking, thinking... Almost a habit... What did you decide? Willing to spare the artifact?
A habit, you say? Here are the artifact and data. When's it ready?
You're a funny guy... I haven't got an artifact!
Don't worry... Come back in three or four hours. I'll let Zhorik know. Or Garik? Always mixing them up.
As they say, "No goods, no grounds for complaint"...
You need a prosecutor to deal with you. That's what.
Well, how are the calculations coming along?
Your calculations are ready. Here are the results. Don't know what they are or what these numbers are called. Ask whoever gave you the program.
Uh... Not ready yet. Wait a little, will you.
Another trip to God knows where...
Hmm... I'll wait.
Listen, got a powerful computer?
Can't complain. Built a beast of a machine... Why the interest?
Need some data processed. The eggheads' main computer at Yantar died. Look: can you run the calculation in this program?

Possible, provisionally. Time's money. Computer time big money. Tier-three artifact, Soul class? Classics: "Money in the morning, chairs in the evening. Money in the evening, chairs in the morning..." Understand? Artifact first.
The classics, you say? Well, well... Here's the artifact. When's it ready?
You're asking a lot. I think I'll give it some more thought.
Don't worry... Come back in three or four hours. I'll let Zhorik know. Or Garik? Always mixing them up.
Think, then... Take your data back.
Impatient? Results surprise me. Strangely, numbers show the Brain Scorcher's rhythm has been stable lately, and the minimum risk
Professor, tell me how it is. We'll see from there.
A helicopter with colleagues vanished around there. Weak signal nearby. No exact bearing. Small chance someone's alive. Learn anything, return and tell us. All right?\nA small request...
I'll tell you if anything turns up. See you.
Marked One... Since you're risking yourself again, could I ask you, if possible, to try finding someone...
Professor, you seem deep in thought...
Ivan Sergeyevich, I need a calculation run on a computer.
A difficult calculation? Otherwise you probably wouldn't have come to us... Show me exactly what it is.
Need measurement data processed. Your colleagues' main computer at Yantar broke. Can you run this program's calculation?
We'll see. Complex algorithm. Ordinary PC takes ages. Ask technicians. If they find time on the main computer, fine by me. Here's your data.
All right, thanks.
How's the Brain Scorcher data coming along?

Marked One, I'm sorry to say something unexpected has happened. Our main computer has failed. Unfortunately, we couldn't process the data. Everything's saved, though! Once the repairs are done, I think we'll get the information we need...
We haven't processed the results yet, Marked One. Please wait!
How long will the repairs take?
Our technicians say at least two days, perhaps longer. We've ordered the necessary equipment, but it has to be gathered and delivered... Even that is an optimistic estimate.
Two days, maybe more? No other way to process this data?

Grigorovich's Swamps base has powerful computing equipment. Bar's amateur researchers might calculate too. Give saved data, program, instructions. Find computing resources. Fail, wait for our repairs.
All right, understood.
Yes, of course. I'll wait...

Here's the suit. Remember: thirty minutes of protection at most! Plan for twenty-five to be safe. Remember to start the timer... I'll mark where we need measurements. Here, here, and here! Power cells here. Easy to insert. Just don't reverse the polarity. Remember to remove the recording card... Good luck!
Three places. At Radar. What was I thinking... All right, I'll try.
I haven't got artifacts like that.
Please don't take offense... Here, take it. Try to be careful. I understand: it's the Zone, anything can happen... Still...
No offense taken. See you.
About that Brain Scorcher.
Here, scanned documents on the flash drive. Have a look.
The Brain Scorcher? What exactly do you need?
The Barkeep sent me. Said you'd explain everything... Gave me some papers. Where are they...
People say all sorts of things. Bring something concrete, then we'll talk. For now, sorry. We've got plenty of work.
There were folders of documents... Where did I put them...
Three places. At Radar. What was I thinking... All right, I'll try.
Hmm... All right, I've got a capsule here.
A Dummy? I've got one. Here you go.
Well, I'll look. Find it, then we'll talk again.

Here's the suit. Remember: thirty minutes at most! Plan for twenty-five to be safe. I'll mark where the equipment was installed. Here, here, and here! Power cells here. Easy to insert. Just don't reverse the polarity. Remember to remove the recording card... Good luck!
What? How long? Oh! Processing the results? Two or three hours, I think. Rest meanwhile. You'll certainly need your strength...
All right, understood. I'll wait.
What about my artifact? The one I left for the suit.
What? Yes... The artifact... You're right. Give the suit back.
Here it is. Take it.
Oh, just asking. I still need it.

All right. You know, we've just sent off a batch of artifacts. There's very little left. Here, a good tier-three artifact. Nothing better at present. I'm sorry... We'll do the calculation, though. Free of charge!
Vergas, do you know Fang?
Knew him... Stubborn devil. Start arguing about weapons and you'll never win. Never mind... Speak well of the dead, or not at all.
He's alive. Was. Last time we met, at least.
How can he be alive? I've seen his grave myself!
Alive how? Alive like that. Couldn't come to the surface or be around people. Spoke badly, couldn't see, dragged a leg too.
You call that alive? Seen people here who can barely see, drag a leg, can't speak, only moan? Better to die outright than "live" like that.
Maybe you're right... It's not about him anyway. It's Strelok. He knew him, after all. Didn't he tell you?
No. He didn't say.
Vergas, what about the decoder? Ready yet?
Right, Marked One, the decoder's ready. Remember the artifact?
Of course. Here's the Mesomodified artifact, as agreed.

Listen carefully: connect your PDA before using the decoder. I've made a few adjustments. When you get a match, you'll receive a message showing the digit's position in the code. You won't miss it... \nYou'll see for yourself. I hope it helps. I have no more ideas for improving it.
Unfortunately, I don't have a mesomodified artifact. But I've got something better: a full-fledged hypermodified artifact.
I'll part with an Absolute. Nothing else left.
Turn off that newfangled feature. No artifacts to pay with.
All right, I'll switch it off. Don't come back with this problem again, though. Wasting my time on you...
Sorry, forgot. I'll bring it soon.
No. Be patient and come back in a few hours, as we agreed...
All right, I'll walk around for now.

About the decoder. Straight to the point: we're simple people, us stalkers. We'd rather shoot mutants and find an artifact than solve complicated riddles. Could you improve the device to make it easier for fools like us?
Marked One, your brain needs exercise too. Otherwise, you understand... \nAll right, let's see what else we can do. Come back in a couple of hours with a good artifact. A mesomodified one will do.
Good. You'll get your artifact.
Maybe you're right. I'll try figuring it out myself...
Listen, looks like you've got various PDAs?
Uh... Yes, have some. Find them by chance. Wild places here. Vicious animals. Find them now and then. What's your interest?
A few things can be sorted out with two or three PDAs...
True. Plenty you can do with goods like that. Vakhtang at the Warehouses keeps asking. We've got somewhere to sell those innards...
I'm not asking for nothing. I'll pay. How much do you want?
Hmm... Won't sell them one at a time. How about a thousand dollars for five devices. Verstehen?
Hmm, I'll think about it. Maybe.
Can deal with you, Marked One... Want the boys' respect? Don't be stingy. Good artifact for the common fund. Shit can go up your... Keep it. Brazen won't hold a grudge then. Understand?
All right, I've got a tier-three artifact. Take it.
I feel sorry for you oddballs. Here's a Dummy.
Hmm... All right, here's an artifact.
Turn around, or you'll be lunch for the blind dogs...
Here! A bullet for you, bastard!
Got a spare tier-two artifact lying around. Take it.
Here, take a tier-three artifact!
Take a Dummy, busybody...
I've got an ordinary little artifact. Here.
We'll meet again... Sometime.
House on the northern edge. Careful. Something lives in that town. Drains your soul. Barely walk. Escaped by a miracle, left my backpack.
Still sitting here?
Wait, I haven't got time for that yet.
Been there. Horrible place. Don't know how the scientists stay there.
Something... Can't get to the center. Legs feel like jelly. Didn't see any of those bubbles you mentioned.
Didn't see any of those bubbles you mentioned. Found your stash, though. Barely got through... Hard going. Weak legs, ravenous hunger. Strange city...
Well, it happens...
That's how it is... Complicated business.
Don't hesitate. Understand. Couldn't, couldn't... Don't need it now, recovering anyway. Find it, keep everything for your trouble. Found it already? Yours by rights. Don't worry...
Thanks, Red. I won't forget.
Take care.
Yes. Brought the artifact? Or...
Here's your artifact, Red. Get well.
I was... Thought you wouldn't... I'll bring it quickly if needed.
Thanks. Artifact will get me up quickly, Doctor's treatments too. Visit in a few days. If better, I'll give this artifact as a reward as well...
Understand. Don't need it now, recovering anyway. Keep it for your work. Want to return it, bring it. Yours either way.
Hi. How's your health?
Better now. Here's your artifact, as agreed.\nProblem: lost some properties during treatment...\nWould give something else, but have nothing.
Better, better. Not fully recovered yet...
To hell with it... Thanks for everything, Red!
Get well!
No, nothing... Just dropped by to say hello.
Professor, found a document in the Swamps. Hard to understand...
Let's see. Hmm... Interesting. I'll study these materials a little. Come back in forty minutes... Or an hour... Or a few.
As you say.
About the route in the underground documents.
Yes, yes... What would you like?
I brought the artifact you asked for.
Agroprom Research Institute? Safe path there directly from here. Soldiers came running from there, at least... Sometimes take mail outside the Zone. So...
Just right, thanks.\nVerified safe trail behind factory buildings to Red Forest. Map here.\nWouldn't advise without serious preparation. Our scouting group vanished. No news...
Dangerous? Probably need a good weapon... Means Agroprom. Think there was a chance to get decent equipment there. But... All that going back and forth...
Could you remind me what to bring?
Yes, yes. I know already. Need to ask those soldiers...
Of course...
Where did I put it... Left it somewhere, maybe.
I hear you sell unique recipes...
Of course, of course. Our research base is studying precisely that subject.
Let me have a look.
You know, Professor, I've changed my mind...
Hello, Professor. Found an unusual container with an electronic lock... Could you tell me how to open it?

Interesting specimen! Supplied once, stopped long ago. Expensive, impractical.\nCan't help. Computer failed, password data lost about a year ago. Could buy for forty thousand rubles to your account. Send outside Zone. More resources, exhaustive search. Takes time, costs money...
Sounds tempting... All right, I agree.
Excellent. I'll keep you informed. Come back in a few weeks, or even a month. Perhaps something will become clear.
A month it is. I'll wait.
A month?! No, man of science, too long. Give it back, please.
I understand, but I warned you it wouldn't be quick.
Might not even live that long in this damned Zone...
I'll ask around some more. There are clever people here...
No problem. Good luck with it.
Thanks!
Hello, Professor! You study various artifacts. Could you help me understand something?
Hello, hello. Show me what you have. Perhaps we can shed some light on the matter.
Hope this helps us both.
I think you're right... I'll trust you scientists.
Wise choice. Come back in a day. We'll try to find something out.
Here it is. Traders aren't keen to take it, and it doesn't seem to show any properties...
No, Professor. I think I'll keep it and try to figure this out myself.
I've decided already.
Your choice, but I'd reconsider in your place.
Got your message. Any news?
Of course. I wouldn't have called you otherwise. I think this information matters to both stalkers and scientists, so I'd like a tier-three artifact for it.
All right, Professor, tell me. Hope it's worth it...

Let me offer further findings from detailed research. 
Using these artifacts during transmutation can activate physical processes involving anomaly energy fields, causing an energy release. This can affect the original material's quality and surroundings. 
The process is complex. More research and experiments are needed to understand mechanisms and consequences. Further calculations must establish optimal conditions, methods, and safety for stalkers and the environment. 
Transmutation has potential to change artifact properties. Use must be justified, informed and controlled to minimize risk and maximize benefit.
Didn't understand. Something simpler for us mortals?

Simply, artifact cooks might value it greatly. Gives energy to ingredients added afterward, improves final transmutation. Maybe restorative properties, but lacked research facilities for precise calculations. Find samples, perhaps do better yourself.
Excellent news. Interesting, too. I'll try that method...
Wait a little. I'll bring it...
There was no agreement on an artifact payment... I'd like my research material back. I'll find a use for it myself...
Sorry to hear that, but it's your property, after all...
You know, science, we stalkers can manage a few things without you. Figured out what these artifacts do myself.
Interesting. Will you share it with us? Your conclusion may differ from ours. For the information, I can offer a deposit to your account or an artifact. Deal?
You know stalkers 'cook' artifacts. If you throw this artifact into the anomaly before the other ingredients, it releases energy that affects the quality of the finished product...
I'll take the barter option.
All right, thirty thousand to your account.

Interesting. Theory is one thing, practical application another. Well done figuring it out yourself. You're right! What would you prefer as payment for the information: thirty thousand credited to your account, or a tier-two artifact?
No, not this time.
Always a use for an artifact.
You're welcome. Thank you for helping advance science.
A shame, but it's your right. Don't forget the sample.
Take care, clever folks.

Appearance suggests unique energy signature. Less obvious properties don't mean no potential. 
Analyze structure, test for hidden abilities or relationships with other anomalies. 
Study origins too. Reports, stalker tales, legends may describe abilities. 
Leave it with us? A day should suffice.
Where's this junior researcher, then?
I think not...
I'll look around. Might go with your junior researcher...
Should be in the yard. I'll tell him the details...
I'll try to convince Voronin to find someone more experienced...
Yes, of course. Have a look...

You've done a great deal for us, Marked One. Try it... Our junior researcher, Valery Vorobyov, will go with you. He's a strong lad, though not well trained militarily. I'll try to provide whatever I can from my own supplies...
Vovchik Matveyev? Forgot about him. He made it, then?
Vovchik Matveyev? Would he really agree to go back?
Found some documents in an underground laboratory...
People keep bringing things... Why? What have you got? Hmm. No! We have no use for this. Physiological parameters, wave functions... We haven't time. Someone might be interested, but not us.
Well... I'll offer them to someone else.
It's you, weakling... Don't want any business with you. Move along...
Ahem...
Heard of similar capsules. Opening difficult. Can equipment cope? Already uses much power under our independent supply. This shell is much stronger than formations we use.
The capsule's heavy and gives off a lot of radiation... Could you keep it for a while?
Unfortunately, we're very short of containers. Perhaps we can extract something for your needs in exchange for an ordinary artifact. Agreed?
All right, agreed.
Excellent! We'll put it in the container now.
I've got a tier-two artifact on me. Will it do?
I'll manage on my own...
I explained everything. Come back later. The apparatus is being tested.
Could you hold the container with the capsule for a while? It's terribly heavy.
Why not help? You've served science well before.
I see. I'll come back later.
One more request. If testing succeeds, could you start opening my capsule straightaway?

One moment! Let me think... Why not? But you must help science in return. We're studying anomalous formations of the NG-985 series, what stalkers call tier-three artifacts. Bring one, and I'll gladly work on your capsule.
I've got just that.
Excellent, Marked One! We'll try to open your unusual material within three days.
Will you take an artifact capsule?
I'll think about it, Professor.
Thanks. See you soon!
Glad to help. Scientific curiosity interests me too. Several stages needed: shell density, equipment power, new experiment. Help us with a good tier-three artifact...
A good artifact? Will this one do?
Yes, yes. Of course! Please come back tomorrow at the same time. I think we'll manage it.
The apparatus is in use, my dear fellow. Let's try later.
Professor, I haven't got anything like that, unfortunately.
A shame... We can't afford charity yet.
Hello, Professor. I'd like the unusual capsule back.
Oh, yes! Sorry, lost in thought. Where did I put it... Please don't drop it.
Take care, bright minds...
Has Ghost been here, by any chance?
Yes, he appeared quite recently. So unexpected... Especially after what we learned about Professor Vasilyev. Remember the strange person at the Army Warehouses you told us about?
All right, call it a teleport. But why did it... How do I put this... Go haywire?
I can't say anything yet. Psychiatry isn't my field. Ivan Sergeyevich, who knows more about it, has an idea of what might have disturbed Vasilyev's mental balance.
Yes. He arrived quite recently. So unexpected...
Interesting, is it?

His hypothesis: time deeply woven into us. Internal clocks with individual rhythms. Slight desynchronization from real time could cause severe mental disorder. Thinks schizophrenia may involve impaired time perception. Imagine not knowing if actions precede or follow awareness. Cognition fragmented, unable to identify your actions' effects. "Wasn't me, don't remember doing it." His thoughts.
So memory loss could also be a gap in time... Or schizophrenia?
I understand your concern. Probably not in your case. You'd remember fragments then. As far as I know, your memory seems to have been cut off from a particular moment.
Cut off. Exactly... If I have another blackout and only remember fragments afterward, could that be a sign? Professor, is schizophrenia treatable at all?
Come now! That's not your case. Everything suggests you're mentally healthy. You have some amnesia, with an unknown cause. I think it's temporary.
Yes... Causes, consequences. So many unknowns. \nYou've talked me in circles, Professor. Wanted to ask about Ghost. Where is he?
Where is he?
He's somewhere around here. Look around the grounds. Wasn't planning to go far. Waiting for someone.
Yes... Oh, speaking of which, what about that odd fellow from the Warehouses? Did you find out who he is?
Let's hope it's me this time.
Yes! Can you imagine? It's Professor Vasilyev! Incredible! His condition is distressing, of course, but I'm overjoyed he's alive.
Where is he? I'd like to speak to him.

Unfortunately... I'd like to ask him a great deal myself, but his mental condition leaves much to be desired. They've sent him outside the Zone for treatment. I'm afraid we won't speak to him soon, if we ever can...
A shame... He did look rough. I understand. At the Warehouses they said he'd fallen naked from the sky, long before he went into X-16. That's why I didn't think it was him. The stories don't fit...
I'm wondering too. If we compare all the facts, it seems he encountered a teleport that sent him into the past. A far-fetched explanation, certainly, but I can't make sense of it another way yet...
Is that possible?
It's hard to say. Spatial teleports exist in the Zone. That's a fact. Temporal ones should exist in theory too. We should wait. He may recover, and then we could learn a great deal.
We'll see.
Stalker... Sitting here...
I can see. What are you doing here, soldier?
Found my friend dead... Together in training, volunteered here. Now lies there, surprised by nothing. Leave him for dogs? Kostyan... Planned university in Kyiv together after the army.
Ah, boys, why do they send you here... What's your name?
Sanya. Private Ryzhov... Used to be... Ran away from my unit. Me and another fellow want out of the Zone. Who are you?
I'm a stalker. Marked One. You're right, this Zone's no place for people... Get out while you're still alive...
I'm Marked One, a stalker. Were you with the ratcatcher in the swamp?
Marked One... And here I am...
Enough. Get out while you're alive...
Were you with that ratcatcher in the swamp? Sanyok, right?
Can't leave Kostyan here. Think we should bury him properly. Not like a dog...
Yeah. Why?
How's that?
Saw him in the Agroprom swamp. He's waiting. No food... And you're sitting here...
He says you know the patrol layout at Agroprom Research Institute?
There's an old church nearby. Cemetery beside it... Need to take the body there... Help me? Hard alone. Too many creatures...
Can't leave Kostyan here. Need to bury him properly, not like a dog... Kolyan can wait a little...
Know. Copied them. Can help, but help me too... Can't leave Kostyan. Bury him properly, not like a dog...
Carry it? I'll help. How are we doing this?
Sorry, friend. I've got my own business.
Properly? How?
Properly? How?
Here's the plan. I'll cover you and show the way. You carry Kostyan... Not far. We'll be done in a couple of hours.
Go, then. I'll do it myself...
There's an old church nearby. Cemetery beside it... Need to take the body there... Help me. Hard alone. Too many creatures...
Let's get going, then...
Take care...
Carry it? I'll help. How are we doing this?
Don't give me the runaround. Talk!
Fuck off! You don't scare me...
Along the path to the Swamps now... Ready? Where's Kostik's body?
Here he is... Come on, let's move...
Here it is... Let me catch my breath...
I'll bring it now. Ran out of strength...
What body? Piss off...
Move along, Marked One. I've no respect for you...
I've got a special PDA. Seems to have some kind of cipher.
Where do you find them? Show me, I'll look.
Here. Something seems encrypted.

Doesn't look encrypted. Perhaps imitation, no special program, too visible. Simple protection from fools. Combination of symbols with a key owner knew. Logic suggests simple key. Not difficult, but no time. Swamped.
If it's simple, why go to all that trouble?
Perhaps a place or name encoded so its owner could remember, others wouldn't understand at a glance. Leave it. I'll work on it tomorrow if time permits.
Tomorrow? All right, here. Work your magic. No rush.
Can't wait. I'll try myself if it's really simple.
Your choice. Up to you.
That's right.
What about the encrypted PDA?
Where's my payment?
We didn't agree on that. Said it was simple. Took nearly a day already.
All right. I'll repay your waiting with kindness. Write this down: "Stash in the forest, at the old spot in the mine drift."
That's... all? No information?
What else did you want? A list of everything in the stash, or all the Zone's secrets laid bare?
Something more specific, maybe? Still... Got it free. In the forest, you say... Have a rough idea.
Don't forget poor Docent if it's a rich stash...
We'll see...
What do you want to know, Doctor?
What have you learned about yourself? Remember everything?
Don't know where now... Don't want the past. Nowhere to go. Belong here. Rest, head to the Bar. Need to find things out.

Why do you want to know? It's my life. I needed to understand it, not you... You wanted me to understand myself, and I have. Still, if you want to know, I'll tell you... 
We lived in a small town in central Russia. Childhood was childhood, carefree, much like anyone else's. I remember fragments. A dog biting me, nearly drowning... Probably just fear. Could hardly drown in that frog pond. But I remember feeling hurt: I was drowning, and nobody noticed... 
I got along with my parents, but work kept them busy. Father was a senior manager, always in meetings. Mother worked shifts at a factory. Grandmother was bedridden, apparently paralyzed. I had to look after her all the time. Most of my childhood passed that way... 
School was ordinary too. Like any teenager, I wanted to stand out. Felt proud when people noticed. Studied reasonably well, as far as I remember. Liked chemistry, anatomy, biology. Mathematics and the other exact sciences, not so much... What else is there to say...

Then I decided to study medicine. An obvious choice. By then I hadn't imagined anything else. Medical institute, studies, internship... I liked it. Distinguished myself on my very first day at work. Saved some woman, I remember. More 'heroics' afterward: nobody else could do it, but I could... Once I had to take over from the chief surgeon during an operation. It went well. They even commended me. Funny, finding pride in doing my own job... \nI never served in the army, but worked awhile at a hospital in a military town. Routine and memorable cases. Once I miraculously survived an accident while saving a soldier. Later I returned home and joined the hospital there. Well regarded. Someone said I had 'golden hands.' Maybe they were partly right... Helped a neighbor get expensive medicine, not entirely legally. Some 'golden hands'... Got away with it, but earned a reputation as a wonderful doctor. Married there too, like everyone else. Then... The tragedy with my son...
What happened to him?

We wanted a child, but it wasn't happening. Finally he was born, with a congenital defect. Somehow I kept him alive. Of course: the doctor with the 'golden hands'! He lived far longer than the doctors predicted. There was hope, but... I'd have given anything for a magical artifact that could bring back the dead, if one existed. That's when I thought of the Zone. I'd heard rumors, never paid them much attention. The Zone was far away. What connection could there be? Then I felt it. The Zone called... I had this absurd certainty that I was above death, stronger than it. I wanted to prove I could save my son... Bring him back, rather. Cheat death. That's why I came. How foolish.

You wouldn't understand. I wasn't trying to remember. I was trying to understand myself. I see that clearly now. The bare facts, where I was born, studied, married, don't matter. What matters is that I finally understand who I really am, what I'm like... \nAnd it isn't a happy conclusion. Some foolish vanity drove me all my life, until it became real pride. I imagined myself God's equal. Thought I could conquer death, control everything... My wife didn't understand when I left for the Zone. Nobody did. They thought I was a stubborn idiot who invented a fairy tale and believed it. Probably thought my son's death had driven me mad... They didn't understand, and neither did I. Now I do. It wasn't stubbornness. It was boundless PRIDE. Just like everything else in my life...
Exaggerating. Too demanding of yourself. Your story shows helping, saving, doing everything to avert harm. What's wrong? Compassion, desire to help: good qualities. Why that strange conclusion?
All right... \nWait! You never told me your real name. What should I call you now?
Call me MARKED ONE.
All right, Marked One. What business at the Bar?
There's something else.
Can anyone remember everything? Every moment of life? No... Yes, remembered some things, but that's not what matters. What matters is I understood who I am.

Why do you want to know? It's my life. I needed to understand it, not you... You wanted me to understand myself, and I have. Still, if you want to know, I'll tell you... \nI stuttered, or spoke badly, until about 6. They teased me for it. I remember hurt feelings. Doesn't matter now, but it mattered then. My speech improved, but for a while I was scared I wouldn't find the words, so I stayed quiet. Liked a girl at school, afraid to talk to her... Nothing, really. She went out with another boy anyway. But my reluctance to talk made me read, write and think. That shaped my life... \nMy parents loved me. Father was a leading specialist at a restricted enterprise. Mother taught school. They were pleased I read instead of roaming the streets. I spent more time in libraries than out with the other boys... What else is there to say...

Even at school I wanted to be a scientist. Not just any scientist: an outstanding one. Childhood dreams. Got into university, then with difficulty into a serious faculty where you could work in science from the first years, or at least be close to it... Looking back, perhaps I was the only crammer and workaholic. Always in libraries and laboratories. Others took life more easily. Let them. My only regret is how much of youth passed me by while I pored over textbooks. Others didn't miss their chances... Never mind. \nSomehow I married. Can't say it was love. It was what you did. Didn't work out. Never had time for family. Science interested me more than my wife. One day I found her with another man... A nobody. I left. Even felt glad: nothing tying me down or distracting me from science...
What did you do?

My field? Pure chemistry at first, then biochemistry. Worked for military industry awhile. Didn't care whether the result was a harmless pesticide or poison. I was doing pure science. Wanted to achieve something, find a place in the scientific world. Everywhere I looked, opportunists and incompetents hid behind academic titles!.. Then a decent polymer company, some consulting for a scientific journal... \nComfortable posts, quiet posts, all kinds. I left them all. No scientific prospects. People chasing money or an easy life thrive there. Not me. At my last job, some tried persuading me to stay, some sympathized, most didn't understand. What did they know? I believed a real scientist achieved real results through constant work, not connections... \nThat's how I came to the Zone. Volunteered. They arranged a researcher position in a field laboratory in the exclusion zone. Expected great success. Had to prove to myself and others that my work mattered. My mind, my discoveries, not just patronage, stolen degrees and cushy positions. Now I see where all that heroism, hardship and suffering led... Nowhere. How foolish.

You wouldn't understand. I wasn't trying to remember. I was trying to understand myself. I see that clearly now. The bare facts, where I was born, studied, married, don't matter. What matters is that I finally understand who I really am, what I'm like... \nAnd it isn't a happy conclusion. Foolish resentment drove me. Others were quicker to grab, act, speak, write... It became ordinary envy. Couldn't accept someone being smarter, quicker, more curious. Couldn't accept my wife choosing some clerical rat who wasn't worth my little finger! Thought everyone else incompetent or connected, and I alone achieved things through work. Thought I worked only for science. Now I understand. Resentment and ENVY drove my life...
Exaggerating. Too demanding of yourself. Your story shows work, study, good results. What's wrong? Diligence, thirst for knowledge: good qualities. Why that strange conclusion?
Tell me.

Why do you want to know? It's my life. I needed to understand it, not you... You wanted me to understand myself, and I have. Still, if you want to know, I'll tell you... 
A small village in the south. For some reason I remember only summer: apple orchards, the scent of apples... Picked them every year. Pleasant time, climbing trees and eating your fill... 
Ordinary games. Everyone played together, no divisions by neighborhood. One school, practically one street: the main road. Lapta, cops and robbers. Liked being a cop. Perks, a share of the 'loot'... Childhood. 
Then sports school, competitions all over the Union... Or Russia. Can't remember which it was then. Nearly missed a competition once. Father was ill, had to visit, but events were the same days. Coach sorted it out. I was glad: really, I hated spending on the ticket. Planned to buy audio equipment. Always saved for little things, guarded every kopek. Sometimes called a miser... What else is there to say...

Then service. No war zones. Spent my 2 years quietly in the northwest, between Pskov and Novgorod. Took to vodka there. Quiet service, no supervision. Glass after glass, got hooked. Shook it off afterward. Not immediately, but thank God I quit... \nAfterward I had nowhere to go. Needed money to live. Police recruited us before discharge, so I signed up. Police school. Wanted traffic police. Heard you could earn well if you had a head, not salary, but 'on the side'... Ended up in criminal investigations. Less to gain, but enough. Shield someone, scare someone, take confiscated goods... \nMarried, of course. No grand wedding. Expensive. Just our circle. Before the wedding, the men and I planned a camping holiday. Had to take back my share. Wedding coming, short of money. They didn't understand. Took offense...
Then?

Then work, mostly routine. Had to hustle. Sometimes did things that weren't quite legal. People slipped bribes into my hand. I took them. Told myself everyone did it, everyone was corrupt, someone else would take it if I didn't... Excuses. But that's the system. A sheep among wolves gets driven out, or eaten sooner. By its own pack. Happened to me... \nSomeone at the top of the region got caught stealing. They pulled the thread, inspections through every district police department. Something small involving me surfaced. Later I realized that wasn't chance. They needed a box checked, 'measures taken' against someone. Chose me, framed me. Remembered I'd once refused to share. Squeezed me out... Knew a stalker from a case. Wanted a change, needed money for loans. He told me of quick, profitable loot in the Zone... I listened like a fool.

You wouldn't understand. I wasn't trying to remember. I was trying to understand myself. I see that clearly now. The bare facts, where I was born, studied, married, don't matter. What matters is that I finally understand who I really am, what I'm like... \nAnd it isn't a happy conclusion. Greed drove me, until it became real avarice. Never enough money. Saved and saved. For what? To put aside for the future and save again... Took every chance to grab what was offered, or what I thought I could take. Became an obsession. My wife warned me I'd get caught, my own cops would arrest me. She was right, but didn't understand how we were all tied together. One principle: one hand washes the other. A crow won't peck another crow's eye. Unless you get too bold... I did. That's what brought me here. My AVARICE...

You're too demanding of yourself. Your story shows fighting crime, trying to improve the world. Maybe ends sometimes justified means. Still, rejected injustice and dishonesty, wanted a cleaner world. Good qualities. Why that strange conclusion?
Go on, I'm interested.

Why do you want to know? It's my life. I needed to understand it, not you... You wanted me to understand myself, and I have. Still, if you want to know, I'll tell you... \nSmall as a child, but cheeky beyond belief. Challenged giants like a little dog barking at an elephant. Liked it. Got sweets, gum, and some authority as little as I was. Funny... What more did a child need? \nDon't want to remember my parents. Father was a plumber and drunk, took everything from home. Mother a house painter, exhausted by work, life, him, me, fate... Never a kopek from them. What they bought was rubbish. Better not spend. Had to take what I could. Swiped anything not nailed down. Stole enough cable from the nearby telecom construction depot to wire a city. Burned insulation, sold copper. Our own pennies. Hustled as we could...

Already sick of it all. School over, then what? A machine shop was for suckers. Army? Dodged it however I could. Didn't want serious crime either. My friend and I planned to leave the country and stay abroad... Then a depot audit. Who stole copper and cable? Plenty of their own thieves, but they needed someone to pin every loss on. Army, and they'd find another scapegoat, or arrest for theft. Chose army. Construction battalion... \nHardly service, more passing time. First year went by. Second, stopped caring about commanders, duty, 'comrades.' Only waited for discharge. No work afterward, no wish to slave. Old friends helped: watch the girls while they worked, shake up or scare clients who got aggressive. Mostly bluff. Livable, but wanted more... \nPimping, club protection, confrontations, threats. Didn't dive deep into crime. Wanted no attention. Friends had prison terms, I didn't even have an arrest. Clean.
What next?

Lived with a woman, not married. Quite a slut... Needed a home and somewhere to land. Wasn't particular myself: any woman when the urge stirred. Cheated everywhere. Children? Hell knows. Maybe. Didn't care. Wasn't supporting anyone... \nOthers later. Tried avoiding serious jobs. Quiet burglaries, car theft when possible. Nothing from important people, so got away with it. Not a hardened crook. Clever enough to stay unnoticed, no arrests. But everyone slips. Why did I touch drugs? Had I known! Told myself not to... Lost the goods and fucked away the money. If I'd known what they wanted delivered, I'd never have agreed. Had to flee to the Zone. Cornered: one lot wanted money, another goods, police on my tail. Distribution sentence long enough for the rest of my life. Chose a different Zone. Had no choice...

You wouldn't understand. I wasn't trying to remember. I was trying to understand myself. I see that clearly now. The bare facts, where I was born, studied, married, don't matter. What matters is that I finally understand who I really am, what I'm like... \nAnd it isn't a happy conclusion. My whole life was debauchery. Spent money I hadn't earned, wore things I hadn't bought, took women who weren't mine... A parasite. Created nothing. Used what belonged to others: stolen, quietly taken, seized by force. Sleeping with another's woman was normal. Squandering others' property, taking it, normal. Recklessness and LUST, nothing more. A foolish life.
Too demanding, perhaps. Didn't originally intend debauchery. Didn't accept crime as normal. Knew life was wrong, some goodness remained. Ready for right path. Why that strange conclusion?
Don't blame yourself. You finally remembered who you are. That's what matters...

Why do you want to know? It's my life. I needed to understand it, not you... You wanted me to understand myself, and I have.
