Still, if you want to know, I'll tell you... \nWe lived in a detached house on the town's edge. Father hardly drank, came from the Baltic region. Mother from Siberia. Worked together at a firm. Spoiled me because they rarely saw me. Business trips, holidays, everything together. I stayed with grandparents. No supervision, do what you like. Independent boy... \nLoved the shooting range. Father took me when home. School hikes too. Small town, half-hour walk to forest. Walked plenty later. Used to long journeys, Spartan conditions, independence. Loved weapons. No cars or toys, only a new pistol. Collected cards and stamps with guns. Carved wooden copies from pictures. Liked holding weapons, even toys...

Maritime college first. Wanted to sail. Too independent for barracks, quit quickly. Funny: chose barracks later. Special forces in the army. Brutal drilling doesn't describe it. Kept us under harsh discipline. Liked it. Uniform, heavy fatigue, dead sleep, showing off. Strength, flexing muscles, proving yourself... \nSigned a contract afterward. Learned much, could do much, but none suited quiet civilian life. Training camps, asserting ourselves, sometimes fights. Force solved everything, I understood. Then service: war zones, 'peaceful dispersal' of protesters, hostage rescues, all sorts... \nFamily didn't work. All women fools, at least those I met. Married one, parted. Brainless hen too...
What next?

Service, assignments. Not telling every case. Then left. Units cut en masse, I 'cut' myself too. Voluntarily, tired. Loner's independent life suited me. Security company, then someone dug into my past and saw my skills. Offered an illegal job... First two clients cleanly handled. No fuss. Knew my business. Morals didn't matter much. Work is work. Everything has a price, everyone too... \nLast contract. Why agree? Big money, excitement, cat and mouse? Finally use everything I knew? Prominent target, constant guards, hard approach. Managed... Then sensed I had a price too. Gut feeling, sixth sense. Had to vanish. Chose the Zone. Now think it wasn't the best choice...

You wouldn't understand. I wasn't trying to remember. I was trying to understand myself. I see that clearly now. The bare facts, where I was born, studied, married, don't matter. What matters is that I finally understand who I really am, what I'm like... \nAnd it isn't a happy conclusion. Cruelty drove me, then uncontrollable anger. Force solved everything. How have strength and not use it? Used it, displayed it, showed myself. Now I see stupid violence, pointless cruelty, hatred. Not just doing my job. Hated anyone against me, contradicting me, in my way. Baseless hatred. Meaningless WRATH ruled my whole life...
Too demanding. Independent, pursued results at any cost, never surrendered. What's wrong? Determination, will to win: good qualities. Why that strange conclusion?
Think what I just told you is important? Think it means anything to me now? None of that's what matters.

Why do you want to know? It's my life. I needed to understand it, not you... You wanted me to understand myself, and I have. Still, if you want to know, I'll tell you... \nWe lived in the north. Forest around town, blueberries, lingonberries, mushrooms. Farther away, taiga. Could meet a bear face to face. Father and I did, picking berries. Had no interest in us. Went separate ways... \nLoved forest, mushrooms, fishing, children's camps with hikes. Different from home. Often visited uncle's logging site, hunted with him. Taught me everything. First gun at 18. Visited less later, stopped. Angry I'd left his favorite dog in the forest. Wolves killed it...

Army next. Useful time, in 'Jaeger' units. Only nickname. Ordinary army, historically famous regiment. Decent service. Anti-hazing inspections started then. Sergeant demoted to private and sent to logistics. Deserved it... \nThen game warden in a reserve, briefly. Didn't fit. Accidentally shot a colleague's leg, everyone turned against me, left. Never got along with people. Wife left with daughter. First threw me out for cheating. What cheating? A little affair, happens. Principled, uncompromising woman. Me too: apartment mine. Why leave? Don't like it, they can leave. Won apartment in court... \nNorthern procurement office, eastern Ussuri taiga. Traveled Russia. Alone, bored in one place. Couldn't stay in teams. Always someone I couldn't get along with. Kept moving...
Then?

Everything bored me. Town, forest, all the same. Half a year alone in a one-room Khrushchev-era flat, waiting for hunting season. Half a year alone in the forest. Don't like partners: always dissatisfied. Better alone, sometimes dull. Needed a shake-up, something new and unusual. Otherwise drink myself to death, or hang myself from misery. Then hunters recruited for the Zone. Later learned institutes and private clinics sponsored an unusual project. Genetic material impossible in ordinary forests. Unusual beasts in an unusual Zone, unusual hunters too. New, interesting, unknown, just for me. Only that could break my boredom. Signed up. Fool. Had I known, never join that 'hunt'...

You wouldn't understand. I wasn't trying to remember. I was trying to understand myself. I see that clearly now. The bare facts, where I was born, studied, married, don't matter. What matters is that I finally understand who I really am, what I'm like... \nAnd it isn't a happy conclusion. Life was a chain of deception and betrayal. Cheated everyone somehow, even those closest. All turned away. Rightly: who can live with a liar who cheats at every step and blames 'circumstances'? Nobody wanted dealings with me. My creed was BETRAYAL.
Exaggerating. Too demanding of yourself. Your story shows love of nature, travel, no wasted idle life. What's wrong? Adventure, learning, love of nature: good qualities. Why that strange conclusion?
I don't understand... Isn't that what you wanted...

Why do you want to know? It's my life. I needed to understand it, not you... You wanted me to understand myself, and I have. Still, if you want to know, I'll tell you... \nA southern town. Courtyard games, potatoes roasted in fires. Ordinary childhood. Little interest in parents. Mother tried raising me. Don't remember father. Said he'd never been there. Stepfather appeared as she tried building a life. Feared him. Harsh, a slap if wrong. Left later, apparently drank himself away... \nSlot machines came to every shop, sucker traps we called them. Then a gaming club. Entered, never left figuratively. Consumed by gambling. Loved anticipation, luck. First big loss shook me. How possible? Wanted independence, got debts. Even seriously thought of stealing money. For what? Gambling...

Thank God, army spared theft. Boredom and captivity. No need to find gambling money. Shooting 2 times a month was only fun. Invented target game: speed, accuracy, technique. Squads, pairs, rookies against veterans. Only good army memory... \nFoolishly married. Wife, sisters, especially mother nagged daily. No money home, all in machines. Not family, a sawmill. Left... \nComputer clubs came later. Learned I could earn with brains, not dumb hope for combinations. Poker, preferans: strategy, thinking, plus luck. Never thought myself an idiot, whatever mother-in-law said. Switched to cards...
Then what?

Same streaks. Luck, no luck. Win, live grandly. Lose, borrow, beg, pawn... Waited my chance. Lucky bird would land on my shoulder, grab and never release... \nOnce a 'jackpot,' I thought. Club raid, found a dollar-filled case in a little garden nearby. Tip: drug dealers protected the club. Understood what money it was, why so much. Couldn't refuse. Money without gambling? Impossible. Stakes noticed, facts connected. Not fallen from sky. Serious men demanded their property, or... Less than a quarter remained. Decided to win back. Staked all, lost... \nWhy kill me? Dead men don't pay. Sent to Zone to work debt. Foggy arrangements, probably drugged: 'gave' apartment, savings, everything. Ordinary idiot's idiotic life...

You wouldn't understand. I wasn't trying to remember. I was trying to understand myself. I see that clearly now. The bare facts, where I was born, studied, married, don't matter. What matters is that I finally understand who I really am, what I'm like... \nAnd it isn't a happy conclusion. Never worked. Laziness and idleness my creed. Never thought of honest work, only easy money and life. Spent unearned sums, didn't think money meant someone's labor. Expected it at my feet. No work, only bets and miracles. Never lifted a finger. IDLENESS, nothing more.
Too demanding. Never lost hope, kept going in hardship, sought quickest success. What's wrong? Belief in yourself, hope: good qualities. Why strange conclusion?

Why does the cause matter? Too critical, suspicious, invented it? Monolith suggested it, or dreamed it? You haven't understood. Could pretend it wasn't me, wasn't mine. Why? I need CERTAINTY. Before, doubted which 'memories' were mine, who I was, what drove me. Now I know. Doesn't matter how that feeling came, whether it matches YOUR view. What matters is that I know who and what I am. Finally understood MYSELF.
All right, if that's the understanding you need... \nWhat now? Where are you going? Rest here. You're exhausted...
I need something charged...
No problem. Happy to charge it. What have you got?
Sorry, Marked One. Can't now. Power problems, as you can see... Should be fixed soon. Keep checking in...
Always the way when you urgently need something...
Marked One... Despite your past services, we'll have to impose sanctions in light of recent negative events. Sorry...
What do I do now?
Here's the battery.
Here's your charged battery. Come back if you need anything else.
Thanks. Take care, eggheads...
Can you charge a silver-zinc battery?

Silver-zinc? Where did you find that? A good thing. Lasts twice, even three times longer, but specialized and difficult to charge. It needs several times its rated current. An ordinary charger won't do. You need a powerful rectifier. We have one, but you'll have to wait a little.
Excellent. Take it.
Come back in an hour. It'll be charged.
Wonderful, thanks!
Can you charge a PDA, too?
Of course. Let me see the connector.
This one...
Standard... There's a free charger.
So? Money?
No charge. We'll put it on. Collect it in about thirty minutes.
Half an hour? All right.
Can't you see what you've brought?
A little mistake...
Later? All the chargers of this type are busy...
I'll wait...
Sorry, I don't need anything.
What about my battery? Charged?
Here it is. Enjoy.
Take care, man of science. Helped me out.
Too early. An hour hasn't passed yet.
Time drags so slowly here...
What about my PDA? Charged?
What PDA? PDA... Oh! Not charged yet. Wait some more.
I'll wait...
One moment... Yes, charged. Want it back?
Yes, thanks.
Here's your device.
Semyonov, take a look. I've got a few run-down PDAs here. Can you charge them all at once?

Not straightaway, unfortunately. We need a unique Battery artifact to stabilize the process. You know our electrical supply's a disaster... Heavy use will gradually degrade the artifact until it's exhausted. Then we'll need a replacement. There'll also be a separate fee, with inflation taken into account. We'll discuss that after the work.
Lucky me, I've got a "Battery" on me... Take it!
All right, take the PDAs.
Wonderful! We'll work on it a little, check its condition with an instrument... Ten to twenty minutes, and done.
Still testing the artifact. Have to wait.
Interesting... I'll look for it.
I'll come back a little later.
Research finished. We can begin.
Sounds complicated. I'd rather use the old method...
Well, have the PDAs come back to life yet?
Let's see what we've got...
Agreed. Deal!
Use them. Fully functional.
Thanks, helped me out.
Nothing's charged yet. Stop fussing and shaking... As soon as it's ready. After payment, of course...
Can't afford it yet. Keep them for me.
No luck.
Listen, Ghost was hanging around here for a while. What can you tell me about him?
Nothing. Shady. Didn't talk. Took water, charged battery. Sold a recipe once. No idea why. Needed money, perhaps.
The burned farmstead... Worth searching there. Should talk to the military too. Maybe they know something.
Did Vasilyev come from the Swamps with him?
The burned farmstead... Worth searching there. Should talk to Ivan Sergeyevich too. Maybe he can tell us something.

With him. Don't know where he found him. Swamps, perhaps. Went often. Asked about Ghost. Said needed him, dangerous though. His words. A soldier introduced them there. Seryogin, Sergeyev... Yes! Captain Sergeyev. Didn't ask more.
A soldier from the Swamps? There are soldiers there, that's for sure. When was this? When did he introduce them?
Don't know. Long ago, probably. Vasilyev spent half a year visiting those Swamps. Sakharov furious: independent, disobedient. Obsessed with the lab instead of assigned work.
Vasilyev lived at Ivan Sergeyevich's base, then?
Said he didn't bother him. Had his own settlement on a farmstead there. Maybe Ghost too, don't know. Last time, said no more Swamps: farmstead burned. Ready for the lab then.
Water? To drink? Beer would be better. Just in case.
Mmm... Friend, help... Had to go and do it...
Well, brother... What's happened to you?
Mutant chewed half my leg off... Need a stimulant. Can't crawl to my destination otherwise. Standard scientific medkit? Good painkillers, antiseptics.\nHurts like hell...
A scientific medkit? I've got one. Here...
No scientific one. Would a military medkit do?
Only an ordinary medkit. Better than nothing.
Sorry, friend. No medicine at all...
Thank you... What a relief! Shame it's only temporary... I'll definitely reach the Bar now.\nWhat's your name, savior?
All right... Still a relief! Shame it's only temporary... Should last me to the Bar, though.\nWhat's your name, savior?
A little better, of course! But it's a bandage on a corpse... I'll try reaching the Bar. Someone there.\nWhat's your name, friend?
They call me Marked One. You don't look much like a stalker. What brought you here? Without medicine, too?

Good to meet you, Marked One! You're right, I'm not a stalker. Not exactly. I work for government agencies. Alexander Mankov, though I'm used to my call sign, Seraphim-12. Call me that.
There are several Seraphims. I had medicine. Excellent stuff, probably unlike anything you've seen here...
Lost it with almost all my load at Yantar. Mutants drove me into a swamp. Barely fought my way out.
Only managed to save the scanners I promised to install...
Scanners? Why?

They're planning an operation deep into the Zone, involving our agencies and foreign ones. They want to identify possible problems. Developed anomaly scanners and ordered them installed on a grid. I've installed two, still have three. Perhaps it wasn't meant to be...\nThey'll nag me to death. Took a hefty advance...\nCould you install them? I'll reward you! A clever device from our overseas friends for cracking encrypted locks. Interested? Each scanner has to be installed within 5 days. No more.
Could help... Where are your scanners?
Sorry, friend. I've got more than enough problems.
One with me. Left two at the Bar. Heavy bastards... Install this one, then find me there. We'll talk about the rest. Here... Well?
All right, sorry. I'll look for someone who can help at the Bar for now... Take care!
Heavy. All right, though. Where and how do I install it?
Fuck, that's heavy! No, Seraphim, take it back. Can't carry it.
Take care... Seraphim...
Simple installation. Put exactly at point, activates itself. This one's nearby. Northern metal mass detected by satellite. Machine, perhaps. Precise point here, map marker?
All right. Maybe I'll find someone stronger at the Bar. Or greedier. Take care. See you...
Doesn't look far. Get there safely...
You too...
Hi, Marked One! How's life? Getting back to normal, as you can see...
Hello to you too. Listen, Seraphim, I'm planning to go deeper into the Zone. Could try installing your scanners.
Hi. Installed the first scanner. Can set up the rest...
Hello, Seraphim. I've installed the second scanner. If you need it, I can put in a third.
Hi, Seraphim. Fine! Take care.
Excellent! Nobody here will take it on... Mind you, they're heavy bastards... Install this one, then we'll discuss the rest. Here... Well?
No need now. Found a braver stalker. No offense.
Second scanner goes to Tesla. Don't know what was there, point here. No special urgency, but don't delay. Within 5 days would be good.\nLittle gift too, Marked One.
Thanks. Another stalker agreed to install the remaining scanners. Sorry...\nSmall gift for your help, Marked One.

I respect people who keep their word! Here's the third scanner. Install it at this point in what local stalkers call Radar Forest. As far as we know, the Scorcher doesn't reach that location, so don't worry too much. If you can install it within 5 days, that would be good.\nAnd here's a gift for your work...
Respect people who keep their word! Met one of Ivar's men. Been near the Scorcher, agreed to install the last scanner...\nHere's something for your help...
Heavy. All right, though. Where and how do I install it?
Fuck, that's heavy! No, Seraphim, take it back. Can't carry it.
Don't worry... I'm on my way.
Tesla... Can I get there somehow?
Through Limansk north. Getting out alive harder. Terrible electrical shocks, high-frequency fields roast like microwave. Not Burner, shed suit and run. Burns from inside.
Have you been there?

Never been. Would've installed a sensor. People told me about big round things there. Supposedly caused it all. Experienced stalkers say there's a reasonably safe path. Don't know where. Ask, perhaps you'll learn.
I'll ask around. I'm on my way.
Radar... Dangerous place... I'll try. No promises.
Put scanner exactly at point, activates itself. Red Forest. Northern metal mass by satellite, perhaps installation. Exact point here. Map marker?
All right, then. Maybe I'll find someone stronger. Or greedier. Take care. See you...
Doesn't look far. I'm off, then.
Take care... Seraphim...
Marked One! Good to see you!
Installed the third scanner.
Still here? Thought you'd flown off already...
All scanners working, told me. Sorry, friend. Promised lock-code device. Stray bullet. Had one, gone. Remains here. Thanks from humanity and me. Little compensation to remember...
All scanners working, told me. Sorry. Lock-code device stolen. No trust in people. Had one, gone. Memories only. Thanks from humanity and me. Little compensation to remember...
All scanners working. Sorry, promised code device, gave it to Ghost. Needed it badly. Thanks from humanity and me. Little compensation to remember...
Enough word games. Thanks to you, too.

Wait. Got a recipe from Yantar scientist, don't ask how. Forgot earlier, distracted. Stalkers value it. Drunkenly swore artifact lets you walk Tesla almost in underwear. Send to PDA. Decide yourself, not my field...
Take care, Agent "Seraphim-12."
Cunning lot around here. Steal your last pair of underwear...

Wait. Got a recipe from Yantar scientist, don't ask how. Forgot earlier, distracted. Stalkers value it. Drunkenly swore artifact lets you walk Tesla almost in underwear. Send to PDA. Decide yourself, not my field...
Take care, Agent "Seraphim-12."
Ghost? How? When? Where did he go?

Why upset? Know him? Here two days ago...
Said two unopened coded underground doors. No exact place. Begged, nearly gave free.
Heading Tesla, he said. You've been. Why there? Couple days earlier...
Also Yantar recipe, don't ask how. Forgot. Drunken scientist swore artifact lets you walk Tesla almost in underwear. Send PDA. Decide, not my field...
Hard to catch, isn't he? Tesla, then... I'll look at the recipe. Might be just what I need.
How's life, Marked One? How's the loot?
Getting by...
Ivan Sergeich needs substance from the Witch's Jelly anomaly for his experiments. Could you bring a couple of jars?
Give me the jars. I'll fill them if I find any.
Can't right now. A bit later, all right?
What are you, prosecutor? Business, say it... Hidden it. Understand? Want the location? Two... No, three bottles! Then talk...
What are you, a prosecutor? Got business, say it... All this grilling... Pour me a hangover cure. Then maybe I'll remember something...
You're a character... Take it. Don't choke.
No vodka for you!
You're a character... Take it. Don't choke.
No vodka for you!
You're the... The one starting with B. My soul's burning... Seen things you've never dreamed of. Take the damn phone. Who gives a shit...
Your call... Don't remember where that phone is...

You're the... Word starting with B. Soul's burning. Seen things you've never dreamed... You help me, I help you. Sold the phone to scientists nearby, at old Clear Sky base. Name... Pakhom! Haven't got it.
Your call... Don't remember where that phone is...
Drop dead... He saw it, did he...
Fuck!...
Oh, fuck... Couldn't say right away...
Where's the PDA, Shersh?
Where's the booze?
Sick of you!..
Oh! Fuck! Will you leave me alone?
About the document case... Vodka's here!
Well done! Good man, Russki... Come on, don't keep me waiting...
Documents first. Brought them?
A soldier's word is firmer than a pea! Here's your documents. Let's trade!
Documents? Problem. Someone stole the case. Not only you interested, apparently. Sorry... Anything else you need?
Here's your vodka...
I think I'll come back later.
Take the case. Don't strain yourself...
Know anything about those documents they found here?

Egghead stuff. Formulas, graphs. Lieutenant thought important, looked and spat. Waiting for a courier to send the shit to headquarters. Off his hands. \nWhat's your interest? Scientists hired you for papers?
Something like that. Asking because I'm interested...
Bring a crate of vodka, get the documents. Deal?
Deal. What if the lieutenant remembers them and comes looking?
Needs scientific treatises like last year's snow... Busy setting up. Important stuff goes in the safe, reported immediately. Didn't even report. Not your worry. I'll arrange it.
Deal. Can't promise fancy liquor, but I can get you some vodka... Genuine stuff.
Ah, soldiers! You'd sell your homeland for vodka... I'll get them myself...
Well... Yes... Brought vodka?
Yes. Here.
Not all of it yet. Wait a little...
All right. Deal. I'll tell the men. Come back tomorrow. You'll have your jar of acid.
Then why bring it up? Go get it. We'll talk when you bring it back.
All right...
Bottle, no problem... No bottle, problem... Eh?
Here. Don't drink it straight away.
Don't worry. I'm even quicker at this with a drink! There, a fully charged battery already! Magic trick...
You're a magician...
I know I messed up with you, but can we settle on two little bottles? Do the work first, though.
Never mind, no need...
I need a drink. So what?
What PDA?
This one.
Charger busy. Come back later...
Charge the thing. I'll buy you a drink.
Half an hour? All right.
I'll wait...
Screw, how's the repair? Done?
Ready! Would like to celebrate, though...
Honestly... Hold it with both hands. Break it by accident and I'll have to get another bottle. Shaking like a drunk...
It's not us. It's life. Can't get by without vodka. Here, untouched. Think I'll have a drink...
Yeah, take care...
Working on it. Wheat vodka would speed it up...
Wait a bit. I'll bring some.
Get to work. Won't interrupt.
I'll have a look. No promises!
What did you take? Anything valuable?
Found something here. Have a look. Might be yours?
Well, well... One moment, I'll look...
Good jacket, chain-mail lining. Rookie in village offered good money. Dogs attacked leaving railway tunnel into former hospital, Sanatorium. Dropped all loot... Help find suit?
Go get your own things.
The Sanatorium? How did you get there?

From Gut over railway bridge into Sanatorium. Little door exits. Straight through also reaches Garbage. I'll mark... 
Jacket left near tunnel. Find, reward...
Buyer has money today, tomorrow gone, could lose...
Good reward if successful. Rainy-day stash.
Got lucky. Lying around... Here.

Promised stash, yes...\nBackpack near Gut tunnel, possibly blocked. Exact place unknown. Hunter said good artifact. Dogs killed him by old regional committee's dacha. Saw returning Cordon. Planned visit, but last Gut trip's outcome... No.\nFind yourself. Thanks. Second rescue.
Well, gasoline's expensive now. You understand.
All right, understood. Here's your thousands.
What am I, a factory? Previous one's not ready!
I've got an ordinary artifact. Take it.
Come back in an hour. Should open by then.
Here... A tier-two artifact.
Sidorovich, you should be kinder to people.
Kind enough already, if you haven't noticed... No profit, no deal...
Here's a Dummy. When's the explosive ready?
I've got a Modified artifact. Will it do?
You'll get your Dummy... Old miser.
Flamethrower not ready yet?
You're in a hurry, Marked One. Takes time for this and that...
Refilled your big hunk of metal. Here... Come back if you need anything...
All right, I'll wait...
I need my flamethrower refilled.
Possible... But it'll cost you!
What am I, a factory? Previous one's not ready!
All right, understood. Here's your thousands.
I've got an ordinary artifact. Take it.
Sidorovich, you should be kinder to people.
Yes. I'll send it off quickly... Should be ready to collect in five or six hours...
Kind enough already, if you haven't noticed... No profit, no deal...
I remember. Take it. Everything's useful in the Zone.
I remember. Take it. Everything's useful in the Zone.
Useful, yes. You're right.
Agreed. Let's see this "Gut."
Has the battery arrived yet?
Think, Marked One. First I order it, then they find it, then send it with someone passing through. It takes time!
Delivered ahead of schedule, even. Good lads I've got! Here's your battery. Play as long as you like now... Heh heh...
Take care...
I need a smartphone battery.
What requests... Damn... Games? Better do real work, Marked One. Might get memory and money back...
Why's my business. Can you do it or not?
Hand over the artifact. Battery's yours tomorrow...
Here. Tomorrow, then?
An artifact and a wait? I'll manage without it.
A tsar's word is firmer than a pea! Tomorrow!
Well... Just wanted to know about Strelok. Fang knew him, and you never once told me about Fang.
How would I know who knows whom? Not my business. He didn't report to me. Enough talking about others. Brought something? Hand it over.
How much? Are you... Ahem! All right, here. Copy it down...
Oh, you've ruined me. Left me begging... What I won't do for a good man.\nHere, take it.\nRemember how well I've treated you!
All right, all right! Can't even ask...
I'll pay by check...
I'll rummage through my supplies. Maybe I can scrape the money together.
Hand over an artifact as an advance, and we'll get our little business going... We already discussed it.
Yes, yes, I remember. No artifacts yet.
That's settled. Come back tomorrow, about this time. Think everything will be here by then.
I do. Here's a pair of ordinary artifacts.
I do. Still thinking, though...
All right. Here's the sack. Don't drop it on your foot. The salt's gone hard as a rock...
I've got an unusual, rare modified artifact. Take a look!
Sidorovich, I found a flash drive a while back...
Throw it away. I don't need that junk.
Not offering it. Just wondering: if a flash drive's lain around a long time, can everything still be read? Can you check it for me? Got a computer handy.

Don't get it? Don't need junk. Not a computer, more junk. Chinese rubbish. Vergas says a port burned out. Needed Nimble's flash drive urgently, couldn't read it. Sent a reliable courier to the Swamps. Not me.
Ah... Sorry. I didn't know.
About improving the armor...
No problem, if you have the amount of zombie tissue we agreed on earlier...
Here, five cold zombie muscles. Can you treat the suit?
Wait until the equipment's free. Then we'll talk...
I've got a good tier-one artifact. Will that do?
All right, I'll wait...
We'll do it. Go take a walk for a couple of hours. I'll try to let you know when it's ready...
Of course! As agreed: five icy hands from our dear zombie friends, or a decent artifact. Your choice. How will you pay?
I can offer a tier-two artifact.
All right...
Just wanted to make sure.
Yes, I've got the claw. Here. And here's the gun. Can you do it?
It's you... Sidor said not to let you in until you've settled things in the Gut.
I've sorted things out with the hunters and got ten sausages.
It's me again, about the sausages...
You've been here about this already, haven't you? Give me ten thousand rubles. Maybe you'll learn to value other people's time...
Deal! Here's ten thousand...
To hell with you and Sidor!
That's why I'm here. A tier-two artifact gets you access to the safe anytime for three days.
I need to preserve some loot.
Your safe access hasn't expired yet. Need an extension? An artifact buys three more days.
Heard you got the case at Agroprom. Time to raise safe access price. Made an exception because of the truck, but you're established now. Tier-two artifact's no problem for you.
Damn, are you kidding me? All right, I'll think about it.
Here's your artifact. Take it.
Are there any other trails out of here? Could you tell me?
Yes, son... To the Cordon, from there to the Forgotten Farmstead... Not easy guiding someone along safe paths. Risk, effort...
Tier three, you say? Hmm... All right, I've got one.

Thank you! Now listen carefully. For the Cordon, head east from the farmstead. A large stretch of water on your right, ruined buildings on your left. Follow the road to a fallen pole beside a roadside toilet. That's the passage. From the Cordon to the Farmstead, go west after the tunnel. Fallen slabs, fleshes running near the railway: that's the passage. Careful, son. Dangerous there.
Well, it wasn't cheap, but thanks for the valuable information...
And what do you want for that information, Stepanych?
Hate to lose the Dummy, but there's no helping it... The information matters more.
Hard times, son... Need to live. Valuable information... Good tier-three artifact or better, and I'd tell everything. Cordon, farmstead...
No, Stepanych. Think I'll hold off for now. A bit too expensive...
Your call, son. If you change your mind, I'm always here. Just don't try it alone. Terrible things happen there. Be careful.
Brought the hides and the artifact, just as we agreed. Show me the rifle.
You young people always hurry. Here, son. The Mosin and scope. For treating an old man kindly, a little ammo too. Don't need it now.
And thanks for that, too. Take care, Stepanych.
Wait for me, Stepanych.
Here, look. Not new, of course, but the structure's intact. Wear it like before. Good protection too. Take it. Now I can rest with a bottle.
Hmm, yes. Can't see any seams.
Do an old man a kindness. Bring a bottle of vodka for a job well done.
All right. You'll get your vodka...
Hold on! Don't get in my way. It isn't ready yet...
I'm not in your way! Get on with it...
How am I supposed to check... \nLook for yourself.
Know a couple of destinations. Swamps, Gut... Nearby. Maps would let us calculate farther ones. Interested, go underground. Information might be there.
I found a briefcase full of maps in one of the laboratories...
Why's everything wet? Covered in some kind of slime...
Listen, it's not like I've just come from a food warehouse...
Hang on, I'll wipe it off...
All right, all right. Cool down... Here's a decent artifact for your work.
Aura... Smoke less and your aura will be cleaner... You mentioned a teleport.
Why three?
How can I get there quickly? I'll bring you anything you want...
Need nothing. Food, vodka, fresh air... A woman, but where would you find one...\nYantar, though. Men go outside the Zone. Might bring new Playboy issues. Look at heavenly creatures...
Ever been to the Tesla area?

Never went. Planned with men, failed. Vitka Curly? Skilled stalker. Guide told him trail. Went alone to check, all follow later.\nTwo Souls! Wanted some too. Then refused: bad feeling, offered map. Killed same day by idiot cleaning rifle. Removed magazine, didn't clear chamber, shot sideways into Curly...\nNo map. Maybe better...
Maybe so...
Maybe... Maybe not. Too many coincidences with Guide...\nNever mind. Talking like an old woman at the market...

\nSemyonov knows about an emerald artifact at Yantar's factory. From the entrance to the grounds, go right to the end, to a construction trailer. Bring him that artifact, and he promises to discuss a reward.
That's settled, then. Stop making faces. Stasik struts around in an outfit like that, and he's fine.
Take care, my generous benefactor.
Suit yourself.
Well, hello, since you've turned up. What brings you here?
Got a moment? I'm thinking I might join you.
Well... No problem, really. Let's talk.
You hunters seem to have things pretty good. Do the profits make that life worthwhile?
Better than mining for pennies. Risk almost the same. Joining us could work, friend, with a firm character. Don't hurry, don't fuss. Profit and skin intact.
Who buys the innards? One buyer? If that buyer-supplier link breaks, we're left with all the stuff and nothing to show...
Calculating, good. Can help with ammo: hunting tough-hided fleshes, many rounds. Or collect everything from three lost stashes of surplus. Either counts. Choose.
Doesn't really matter to me. Maybe I'll decide later.
I've got the ammo you need. Here. So what have you got?
Think away. Nobody's stopping you.

Now those pigs... Your question: hunting business tied to wealthy man, factories worldwide, pharmaceuticals, research. Wants new drugs, more money, presidency somewhere. Stable channel. No artifacts/anomalies, risk arrest. Tails and hooves ignored.
I see. Seems clear enough for now. I'll be going.
Ammo's simple enough. What exactly do you need?
Good! It's a deal. Write this down so you don't have to make two trips:
I'll bring it when I've gathered it. Not today, though.
I'll be waiting. Don't take too long: we're checking those stashes tomorrow anyway.
Wouldn't this be simpler? Tell me where the stashes are. I'll go myself and bring everything at once.
Can you find your way with a map? I'll put markers on your PDA so you don't spend ages searching.
I'll find my way with the map. Mark the spots.
Marked them: the dacha, the gas station, and south where the fleshes graze. Gather everything, then come back. We'll talk.
Hmm... I don't have a PDA. Nowhere to put the markers.
You restless soul... All right, here's a diagram. Hand-drawn locations to search. Don't lose it.
I'll manage. Not my first time.
Don't lose it. If not today, we'll come check those stashes ourselves tomorrow.
Hello, Marked One. Well, been to the stashes?
I've collected everything from your stashes.
Good man! You really do want to become a hunter. Go on, put everything in my sack.
Here. Every last bit of mutant innards.
Haven't got everything yet. Tell me exactly what you need, and how much.
Zombie hands, boar legs, flesh eyes. Five of each. Come back when you've got them.
Hello, Marked One. Well? Want to become a hunter?
Sounds doubtful. What if nobody wants these hooves and tails? Said you could put my doubts to rest?
Don't get so worried!
Why are you looking me over like that? Need something?
Just wondering if you can manage... Heard of recipes? A fellow gave me one. Stas is willing to test it.
I won't go hunting them especially. But if I manage to shoot any, I'll bring you the parts.
Can't deal with that now. Some other time.
Excellent. I'll be waiting to see the results.
All right, all right. I'll try...
About that job of ours... I've collected the innards.
You're late. Someone found them for me already... Haven't tested the recipe yet, though. Bring yours too, since you're here. First try might fail.
Take them. You promised me something for this.
Promised, you say... \nGot a couple of medkits and something else. \nOr would you like a lottery ticket instead of the medkits?
I'd rather have the medkits.
What lottery? "Free happiness, courtesy of Sidorovich"?
Free, yes. What happiness, find out yourself. Got a dead man's belongings recently. Note in his pocket with a stash location.
Then you should've gone and checked.
Time to crawl through holes? Prefer a bird in my hand: goods here, safe, comforting. Rather give a stranger's uncertain prize than my own stock. I'll show the place. Decide whether to go.
No... Doesn't sound very reliable. I'll take the medkits.
I'll take the gamble. What have I got to lose? Maybe there's more there than two medkits.
Suit yourself. Here...
Wise choice. Here...
That'll do. See you.
About the mutants... I haven't got time to chase them. Sorry...
Suit yourself... I'll ask someone else.
Yes, do that...
D-damn, this is bad... I'm dying...
How are you? Still alive?
For now... Bleeding like hell. Give me a medkit, will you?
Here.
Thanks, brother!
Sorry, brother. No medkit.
Check the bodies... The guys in our group should... Should have some.
Whew...
How are you doing?
Getting there. I'll live. Damn, still haven't saved up for body armor. Going deeper into the Zone without it is suicide.
Thanks, friend. A little longer, and... I owe you.
What happened, anyway?
Returning from a trip, ran into bandits. One killed immediately. Vitalya tried fleeing, hit an anomaly... All the loot! Played dead. Searched my backpack, but empty. Got away with it.
I'm looking for Nimble... Heard of him?
That drunk? Saw bandits drag him to the vehicle depot. Heard he stole something from them. Probably why the whole gang came here.
I'll go take a look. The vehicle depot, you said? Want to come along?
Oh, friend... About as much use in a fight as a footwrap now. I'll recover a little, then head to camp. Tell everyone you helped me!\nMaybe... Never mind...
What about you? What are you going to do?
I'll recover a little, then head to camp. I'll tell everyone you helped me!\nMaybe... Never mind...
Can I get equipment from you?
We have supplies for surviving the Zone. Can't give them free. Bring research material. We'll open "credit" you can use for what you need.
Credit? Um... In what currency?

Provisional "transferable rubles." Tell value per material. Record funds carefully, sponsoring Zurich bank converts to hard currency. Account details when you leave. International conventions, no deception.\nNo cash here, understand? Avoid attempts to extract sums by force...
Yes, I understand...
I'd help, but I used my last medkit on myself.
Speaking of Strelok. Someone said there's a door down in the basement. Strelok went through it. Know anything?
Nothing yet. Something flickers through my head. But...
Basement door? Perhaps. Entrance filled with concrete. Thought original. Why deliberately pour? Unless bandits atrocities, hide traces. Bastards. No door, effectively.

Caught a thug for old business. Said Strelok went through their base basement to center.\nDidn't find entrance, didn't seriously search. Concrete-filled opening. Thought original. Strelok filled it? That's my information.
No! I've been there. Not long ago... Need to get in. Could you clear it out? A gap for one person?
Strelok? No, the basement was open recently. Need to get in. Could you clear it out? A gap for one person?
Well... Could blow it open with dynamite. Got any? If you have, we can sort it out...
Well... Could blow it open with dynamite. Got any? If you have, we can sort it out...
I'll try... Listen, could you give me a couple of fighters to help? Who knows what's behind that door.
No spare men. Setting up, plenty of work. Don't go far. Peek in. Anything serious, come out immediately...
Typical! Everyone's ready for a shot. A hole to enter? All "busy." Post a guard at the door, at least. Who knows what's behind it? Might call in time.

Stop grumbling. I'll post someone. Oh, I remember: when we left the Garbage, Ivantsov's messenger was asking about you. Go see him. He's a decent man. Keeps his own counsel, but at least isn't mixed up in dirty business.
Stop grumbling. I'll post someone there.
Why would Ivantsov want me? Visit if I remember. Had a flamethrower? Lend it? Been in these basements, know them. Nasty flying things.
One more thing! Didn't you have a flamethrower? Could I borrow it? Been in these basements before. Know what they're like. Nasty things flying around.
Gone. Remember one... Probably left at the Garbage. Why extra weight? Return, tell me what you saw. Interested myself now.
Used all fuel at the Garbage. No need to refill. Take it if you find fuel. Box in that room. Return, tell me what you saw. Interested myself now.
We'll see...
A shot? Hmm... No. A little later.
Your call. Think I'll have a little medicine myself...
Well? What's down there? Anything interesting?
What's interesting about it? Dark, full of gas, damp, scary, and it stinks... Empty, too.
What does it stink of, if you say it's full of gas?
Stinks of death. What else? Right to close the passage. Don't fancy going in again.
Hmm... Probably ought to post two men on guard down there. Who knows...
As you like. But I wouldn't advise going in.
Speaking of Strelok. Someone said there's a door down in the basement. Strelok went through it. Know anything?
Nothing yet. Something flickers through my head. But...
Door existed. Basement, door. Filth poured out before us. Bandits fled, cowards.\nConcrete entrance. Their prison there, hid traces. Bastards!

Thug said Strelok went through base basement to center.\nArmored door existed. Filth poured out before us. Bandits fled, cowardly bastards.\nPoured concrete over entrance. Cement handy. That's Strelok link.
I need to get in there. Could you clear it out? Just a gap big enough for one person?
I need to get in there. Could you clear it out? Just a gap big enough for one person?
Well... Could blow it open with dynamite. Got any? If you have, we can sort it out...
Well... Could blow it open with dynamite. Got any? If you have, we can sort it out...
Hello, friend. A shot, maybe? Or are you here on business? Your call...
Hmm, no. Listen, do you happen to know where I can get dynamite?
About the basement. I've got the explosives. How do I blow it open?
A shot? Hmm... No. A little later.

None here. Heard Wolf, experienced stalker, got dynamite. Through Sidor, probably. Ask if you find him. Duty had none, know for sure. Discussed it. Nobody wants explosives. Who knows what sets them off? The Zone!
Remote detonator? No? Put explosives roughly in the middle of the poured barrier, retreat far, shoot it with a rifle. Simplest...
Your call. Think I'll have a little medicine myself...
Careful... You'll push your luck too far... Take it!
Good man! Off you go for now...
I'll take a walk... See you...
Right! Corpses are kind, don't object... Treat the boys to booze, food, good artifacts, then go. Leave a little honestly earned stuff so you survive. Might be useful again. We're kind today.
You'll choke on my stuff, you greedy bastards!
Damn you all! Everyone wants some crap brought to them! What thing? Can I just give you money?
Money won't protect your ass fleeing a pseudodog... Told you what I need. Bring it, talk about your friend. Otherwise don't. Don't care...
That's more like it. I'd never find your damn stash... Give me the modified artifact, and we're done.
Good artifact. Took from an experienced st... Anyway, useful.\nBusinesslike man, I see. Got a job to discuss. Between us.
Your little job can wait. I've got business to take care of somewhere...
All right, I'll believe you... Mark where your stash is.
Look. Nearby in the Gut... Fellow swore on God it's a great stash. Useful.\nBusinesslike man, I see. Got a job to discuss. Between us.
Your little job can wait. I'll look at the stash first, then decide whether it's worth doing business with you...
Like I've got nothing better to do than find junk for you...
Brought it... Is this what you meant?
Think Mother's Beads will be more useful to me. I'll take those.
You're the boss.
Thanks. Take care.
What the hell would I need that for?
All right... I'll bring one intact. Wait for me.
Later... Maybe...
Ah... Duty picked him up. Poker. You've probably heard of him.
A stash. Fellow hid lots of grenades in the Gut. Swore on Christ. Check? Here... Look.\nBusinesslike man, I see. Got a job to discuss. Between us.
Know what's going on at their factory?
Something? What do you mean?
Borov found underground entrance. Old lab, perhaps. Someone wanted in, entrance problem stopped him.\nDon't go. Many bandits.
Bandits took PDA with encrypted ammo-stash coordinates. Won't understand, I think. Activated beacon. Track if possible. Chance to destroy nest. Recipe reward: Fireball into Soul.
Thanks for your help!
See you.
You couldn't care less about people... What have we got to talk about?
Oh, get lost!
Feel sorry for my partner... He was a good friend. Still, I owe you.
It happens.
Not really in the mood...
Take care, then...
Hey, friend! Help! I'm a Duty scout. Help me get out!..
I'll try.
I can't help you.
Thanks, brother! Owe you. Learned something useful: Borov, their leader, keeps plenty of goods. Knows the old factory's underground entrance. Guards said a lab was there. Hard to reach him, though.
Thanks for the information.

Wrenched and Droplet into Stone Flower: throw into Electro with canned food and dog tail. Need leave alive, reach friends... \nDropped AK-47 at gas-station building to carry more artifacts. Nobody stole it, take it.
Thanks for that, at least. Good luck.
Need to get out of here. Bandits might drop in! Want something? Make it quick!
No, nothing.
Hey, friend! There's a switch on the wall. It opens the barred door.
All right, I'll look.
Hmm... I'm after a particular gun. Told me it was around here somewhere.
Tolik! Have you got things mixed up?! Wolf's waiting for you and the radio at the Warehouses!
Too many commanders... Nearly died! Two, no, four bloodsuckers attacked! Killed three, ran out of ammo, broke knife... Barely escaped. Treating nerves with vodka. Three hundred grams?
Well, Tolik... Where's the radio?
Behind the Garbage hangar. Trench with pipes... Probably there, unless bloodsuckers took it... Hic... Excuse me...
We've got plenty of guns. Looks like you've got one too...
What gun? This one?
People say all sorts of things. What gun are we talking about?
Everyone needs something. Some need a smack in the face, others a knock on the head. What do you want, exactly?
Gun, gun... What make? Tell me. Maybe we can work something out.
And I need a woman... Seen one? Ahhh... What gun?
Apparently someone lost a pistol around here. Called a gauss pistol. Know anything about it?
Goss? Funny name. Seen PMs, Forts, Walthers... But that... No, don't think I've seen one.
A fellow boasted about a pistol that kills a giant in one shot. Don't believe it. Long ago. Got drunk, demanded things. Asked him to leave politely. Could still walk out himself.
Stories. Monolith fighters having miraculous weapons. Or the dark stalker. Same thing: talk...
Think Sidor was looking for one. There was a message. But I haven't seen it. Ask around.
A man returned from deep in the Zone with one. Coils along the barrel. Nothing more reliable than our Kalashnikov, I think. Was drunk too. Maybe imagined it.
Got one. From hell itself, practically! Fine thing! Kills a giant in one shot! Want it? Wouldn't part with it, but short on cash. For you, a good man, only ten grand! Ten thousand, that's it!
Interesting. All right, I'll look myself.
That's a lot of talk. Here, I'll spell it out.
I'll think about it some more. Have a look.
If I'd known you needed that device so badly, I'd have asked more... Never mind. Here. Use it. Remember who your friend is...
I'll remember that... Friend... For ten grand.
Friend, give me a medkit!
Well, look at you. Here, take it.
Sorry, I don't have a medkit.
Thanks, friend! Can't say how much you've helped. If we're alive and meet again, I'll try repaying you. What should I call you?
Hmm... Getting tired of explaining. I'm Marked One.
Good to have people like you, Marked One. I'm Vlad. Sorry I can't repay you immediately. Still a rookie. Looking for a miraculous artifact. Need it badly.
Miraculous? Right... Don't really believe in miracles.
Vlad? Hmm... You look familiar... Is Oksana your wife?
Wouldn't believe either, but... People talk, and I need it desperately! Overheard bandits discussing artifact transformation. Can send the information to your PDA...
Oksana? Yes... Uh... How do you know?
Interesting. Why don't you try it yourself?
I met her. In the Swamps. She was looking for you. Took her to the Cordon.
I met her. She was looking for you. Took her to the scientists' base in the Swamps.
I saw her. But... Heard she died. In the Swamps.
I saw her. In the Swamps. With some guide.
I'd try, but I haven't come across the components I need yet...
The Cordon? Right, I... Sorry, I've got to go there...
The Swamps? Right, I... Sorry, I've got to go there...
Dead? Don't believe it! I'd have felt it! What about Masha? In the Swamps? Know exactly where? I... I'm going there...
All right, we'll see. Maybe something like that really is possible...
Sorry, Marked One. I have to go.
All right, off you go.
Listen, old man, can you help with a Black Mark?
What's wrong?
Caught something nasty. Like an artifact... Barkeep calls it a Black Mark. Drains all strength. Can't throw away. Comes back... Been here long. Know how to remove the curse?
Heard of it... Think Sidor said he knew a stalker who got rid of it... Talk to him. Maybe he'll suggest something...
Let's see... Right, heh...
Well, get on with it. What are you waiting for?
Here, take this one.
Ah... All right, come back in half an hour.
Stop chuckling. Get to the point!
Half an hour? All right.
There was a mistake...
I've got a new battery here. Need it?
Well... Could use it. Giving it to me? I'll give you a repair kit. Which kind: weapon or armor?
Think I'll take the armor one.
All right, take it. I'll take the weapon one.
Hmm, no. Not giving it up. I'll keep it.
Deal. Here you go.
The Sanatorium? What's that, and where is it?
Told you: a sanatorium. Treated patients. Nearby, can't say exactly where. Was a bit out of my senses when I escaped. Ask experienced people. Surely know...
Tell me! How did you manage it?
All right, enough tall tales. I'm off...
Remind me what I owe you for fixing the notebook.
A tier-two artifact. Or a new battery, or five PDAs.
Hmm, ready now? Well... A tier-two artifact. Or a new battery, or five PDAs.
A tier-two artifact. Or a new battery, or five PDAs.
A tier-two artifact. Or a new battery, or five PDAs.
I've arranged it with Sidor. He got me a new battery.
I've collected five PDAs. Here.
Right, yes. My memory's a little...
An artifact? Tier two? Here, take it.
Still can trust people, then... All good. Come by if you need a patch sewn on your suit, or a gun spring adjusted...
All good. Here's the keyboard. Tested. Works. Come by if you need a patch sewn on your suit or a gun spring adjusted...
All right...
What about the notebook? Does it work?
Seems to, but the test isn't finished. Wait a little longer.
Yes, works. Memory's all erased, though. Completely blank now. Here... Remember: an artifact or a new battery...
Thanks. I won't forget.
All right, we'll wait...
I've come across something that seems to be in your line of work.
My line? Let's see it...
Deal. I'll stop by when I've got it.
Here, some kind of circuit board. Connector looks like a PDA's, but I can't tell what it is.
Board from a field navigator. Stalker here a month and a half ago found lots of them. Showed me. Useful, but won't connect directly to a PDA.\nWhere'd you get this?
On a bandit. A dead bandit, rather. Not far from here.
Bandit, then... Didn't do him good.\nCan adapt the board to a PDA. Build adapter, adjust firmware. Mark your own map. Delicate work, but can do it.
So you'll do it? What will you charge?
Sounds complicated... Some other time.
I'll take it. A favor for a favor, though. Ever reach our Sanatorium, the hospital where I stayed? Look for my teacup. All I remember from before...
All right, suit yourself. Come back if you change your mind.
A teacup? Come on, old man! How could something like that survive in this mess?
Not insisting. Asked many, no results yet.\nOrdinary tier-one artifact for the adapter. Bring PDA, board, artifact when ready. Install while you wait.
All right, I'll put it together.
Give me an armor repair kit.
Deal!
Friend, keep your promises first. Then you can place orders...
Sorry, friend. No more ready yet... Come back tomorrow.
I'll take a weapon repair kit.
Deal!
A bit expensive, though...
I don't mind. It's broken, though. Never got around to fixing it. Ghost already went, too. Useless. Wasted good artifacts on it...
Can you fix it? Need to go somewhere first anyway. Put little things in a bigger thing. Nearby... Back, that decoder would help a lot.
All right. I'll tinker with it... Get a tier-two artifact ready for me. It's work, after all. You understand.
You'll get an artifact. Tier two, since that's the only kind you want.

Here's device. Ghost went already. Useless, wasted good artifacts... \nConnect, switch on, four-digit combinations. Two light columns. Left lights: digits present but misplaced. Both columns: digits present and correct positions. Determine which logically. Auto-reset after eight attempts. All lights on, switch off, enter combination while device still attached. Enter first, disconnect afterward.
I don't mind. It's broken, though. Never got around to fixing it. Ghost already went, too. Useless. Wasted good artifacts on it...
Can you fix it? Need to go somewhere first. Forgot completely. Bring little things to put in a bigger thing. Nearby... After all that, decoder would help a lot.
All right. I'll tinker with it... Get a tier-two artifact ready for me. It's work, after all. You understand.
You'll get an artifact. Tier two, since that's the only kind you want.
What can you do? Practically fixed it on my knee. Had to simplify a few things... Works, though. That's what matters.
All right, I'll try. Take a walk out there. You never know...
I met her. In the Swamps. She was looking for you. Took her to the Cordon.
I met her. She was looking for you. Took her to the scientists' base in the Swamps.
I saw her. But... Heard she died. In the Swamps.
The Cordon? Right, I... Sorry, I've got to go there...
The Swamps? Right, I... Sorry, I've got to go there...
Dead? Don't believe it! I'd have felt it! What about Masha? In the Swamps? Know exactly where? I... I'm going there...
All right, off you go.
Who's the fellow in that unusual blue suit?
Vanka? Good man. Foolishly walked into a bullet. Used to be in Clear Sky. That's where they got armor like that.
Clear Sky? Heard the faction's leaders were looking for a stalker named Strelok?
Why the old story? Heard they searched. Hired a mercenary to hunt Strelok. Leaders decided he was making the Zone grow. Gathered all available information...
Where's the information? Anything left? What are these mercenaries? Freelancers choosing employers, or a central organization?
Don't know. Don't care who, why, where from. Just avoid their sights. Anything left from Clear Sky, probably their old Swamps base. Heard they left nearly a year ago. Nobody there now, they say...
Right... Could you take me there? To that base in the Swamps?
Don't know exactly. Clear Sky hid from everyone. Swamps... Know the path? Near Sidorovich's bunker. Old trailer in the misty hollow, cross the barbed wire and south...
I see. I'll look...
About that strange fellow in the village... Remember our talk about the emission and an artifact against telepathy?
Marked One, can you say it straight? What did you want?
Was that man called Fang? You knew him? Heard things at the Bar. Came there together several times. Fang, or not?
Wanted to ask: you knew Fang, didn't you? Heard things about him at the Bar. That you came there together several times.
Well... I knew him. So?

Fang visited Vergas. Questioned old man, joking, only talked. Fang sought electrical, magnetic knowledge. Sidor's parcels supplied rare, valuable parts for artifacts. Vergas unsure purpose. Some for Fang, some passed on, perhaps Strelok. Generator or emitter, judging parts. Fang building alien-film weapon too: ray pistols ignoring armor. Nonsense...
Anything can happen... It's the Zone.
All sorts of crap lying around. Makes you wonder. Don't believe tales, but stalkers said Strelok handled several chimeras quickly. No ordinary gunfire heard, only whistling. Understand? That's all.
Got it. Found a route toward the center, you say, and built something mysterious. Wanted to ask something else... Thanks for that anyway.
Well... Fang. So?

Met underground Agroprom. Controller hurt him. Surface turns zombie, underground without emissions still human. Doctor visits sometimes. Thought knew me. Strelok, Ghost, labs. Prapor mentioned him and you. Piecing together.
Alive! Didn't expect. Long acquaintances, met, drank, not closest. Gifted technician. Useful devices, weapon expert. Debates with Vergas turned arguments. Helped many stalkers, respected.
A fine artifact, no denying it. Write down the coordinates for the stash at Radar.
A fine artifact, no denying it. Write down the coordinates for the stash in Limansk.
A fine artifact, no denying it. Write down the coordinates for the stash in the Red Forest.
Good luck to all of us. I'm off.
Thanks, of course. See you.
Share the recipe, then? Might agree on a price. Need to go north. Heard brains boil without good protection. Well?
Problem: artifacts, no recipe. Forgotten name too. Had paper... Lost it. Maybe used it for toilet hygiene.
Suggesting I check every hole in the Zone? Don't want to talk, don't. Take your valuables, and the PDA too. I'm leaving.
Something... I've learned how to get Electric Beads.
Learned how? Have you actually got them? I don't need words. Give me the artifact...
Here it is... Take it...
I'll get it ready. Still need something else.
All right... I keep my word... Here, take the egghead's device. Think we'll meet again, Marked One... Here's our armor too. It'll help.
Anything's possible...
All right, I agree. I'll ask Kruglov...
I'll think about it. If I decide to, I'll come back later...
Think I'd rather head over to Agroprom...
Here's the thing. You attacked the scientists from the helicopter. Left them with nothing... In all conscience, you should return their research results.
Don't know how to react...\nLike you, Marked One. Not stingy, not scared, think of others. Job done, sent PDA data to the right people. Could return it... But not the Salvation Army. Nothing free...
A diagram? Heard a soldier's hiding in Agroprom's swamp. It's a long way, though... There and back. Through the Bar...
Isn't there another way? I've got a bad feeling...
Know a shorter route. Soldiers from that base ran to Yantar scientists to call home. Reliable communications there... Ask your soldier. Might know the shortcut. Get moving...
What artifact?
Electric Beads. Heard? No? Supposedly Mother's Beads and something else thrown into an anomaly. Don't know exact recipe. Ask those poor fellows you're helping. Should know.
I'm looking for people who know something about Strelok. Can you help?
Why would I need that? We've got our assignment. Ask about your acquaintances with the people who've been hanging around doing nothing.
I remember what you said. Don't worry. If I learn anything, I'll bring you the information.
Not much to go on...
Here, take it. That's all for now. Maybe we'll have more business later, but not now.
All right... See you.
Not bad... Could be better, though.
Ah! You. Didn't work out with those odd fellows... We'll have to gather information ourselves. What about you?
I talked to one of those "odd fellows." Something strange going on in their heads...
Nothing, really. Got some business here. What about you?
You talked to them? What did they say? Can we deal with them?
Thinking of trying to reach Pripyat. Heard there's a whole community of those Monolith people... Maybe we can finish our business.
Wouldn't say you can. Utter nonsense. Some field, knowledge from space... Keep sending us somewhere. Wouldn't advise dealing with them. What about you?
Thinking of Pripyat. Whole community of Monolith people, they say. Perhaps clearer there. Might finish our job. Maybe.
Hello, I suppose. Anything about our business? If you find any information on unusual weapons, let me know. You won't regret it.
Right, been waiting for you. Here's the plan: move forward, take it slow, stay alert... Ready?
Where are we going, anyway?
Only one road here. We won't get lost.
I don't mean the direction. I mean, what's waiting at the end of the road?
Monolith squad here. Don't understand their work. Leader agreed to meet. Going to him. Don't make sudden moves. I'll talk first. See how it goes. More questions?
All right, let's go.
Wait here. I'll try talking to them. Don't make any sudden moves. Who knows what's in their heads.
All right, I'll wait.
Go there. Chief by the fire. Head shaking all over. Try getting him talking. Didn't understand what he wants, but apparently asked for you.
All right.
Well? Did you talk to them?
Strange conversation. These "superhumans" moo like bulls. Only one can talk, and even he sounds like a robot...
Who? Superhumans?
The talkative one said they were superhumans. Looked at me like I was some kind of bug.
Fine. So what did you talk about?
Almost nothing. Needs me somehow. Not me personally: someone with the tattoo. Wants the Brain Scorcher switched off.
Tattooed? Interesting. Not alone, then. Never saw that symbol on anyone else, though. Fine. Why need you? Any hint about our business?
Learned nothing! Chops sentences with an ax. Only guess what he means. Maybe I can go somewhere they can't, far away. Or maybe reach the Scorcher and turn it off.
Something, at least. Need you, good. If you can get somewhere, why not bring something back? Understand? Why turn it off, though... Might they talk more if we shut it down?
Didn't understand. Says it stops them thinking, and they can't go any farther because of it...
Can't pass... Perhaps Scorcher protects against Monolith, not people. Switched off, where and why go superhumans? Could draw beyond Barrier. Muhammad won't go to mountain? Invite mountain to him.
Not what matters... What's my part? Tattoo, some block? Where can I go, what's there? Why do they want it? Head's bursting. Already unclear. More questions now.
Don't worry about that yet. They need you. That's what matters. Means I wasn't wrong about you either. Need to think about the Scorcher... That's all. I'll find you.
See you.
What's wrong? Trouble?
Found something out... There's a diagram of the posts...
Stop dragging this shit out... If you've got a diagram, hand it over. Or are you driving up the price?
Easy with the threats... Here's the diagram. Where's the eggheads' data?
I need to think some more.
Yes! Don't get worked up... Everything as agreed... Here's their stuff. We've sent everything we need where it belongs.
Well, well! Then we each walk away with what we came with...
Raven, you said you were interested in unusual things.
Said so. Don't need radioactive rubbish. Unusual, unique things. Spoiled customers. Even rare artifacts won't surprise them. What have you?
Just asking, that's all.
No, Raven. I'd rather keep it.
Take care. If I come across something "unique," I'll stop by.
Not artifacts. Interesting notebook. Drawings, notes, even artifact combinations. Look. Good for your clients?

Know notebook. Artist in Zone, harmless, friendly, widely traveled, unusual speech, interesting instructive stories. Folklore collector. Drawings, stalker tales here. Visited often, long unheard... How'd you get it?
Yes, I found it... By accident.
Don't want to say, fine. Unique, but clients need different goods. Take myself as keepsake, perhaps return owner. Good tier-two artifact, or chance lead to soldier's Agroprom underground stash. Well?
Deal. Take the notebook and give me the artifact.
Here's your artifact. Take care.
Take the notebook. I'll go check the stash.
I've sent the lead to your PDA.
A coat from Borov's former friend. Says unique. Specially cured Swamp flesh hides, extra-soft material. Hardly tire in it. Interested?
Half Borov's gang wears similar coats. But... Special tailoring, yes. Not every thug can afford it. Good goods, little demand outside the Zone. Can offer assorted grenades. All right?
All right, that'll do.
Then it's a deal. Hold out your backpack.
Found a distinctive suit in a dead stalker's backpack in a Yantar lab. Seems Ghost's own. Interested clients? Unique goods. Won't find another.
Heard of that suit. Legends say Ghost never carries medkits. Heals like a dog. Good design reduces fatigue too. Can offer a stash lead. Supposedly decent loot. Well?
All right, I agree.
I've sent the lead to your PDA. Somewhere in the Swamps.
Got an interesting little thing. Vergas, the craftsman at the Cordon, made it. No use to me. Maybe you can offer it to someone curious.
Know Vergas. Whole Zone knows that grouch with a barometer up his ass. Could offer it, but who outside wants it? Useful for a stalker... Fine, decent artifact. No more.
All right, I agree.
Here's the artifact. Take care.
Took armor from a soldier at Yantar's factory. They say special treatment speeds wound healing and removal of radiation contamination.

Who told you? Special military-made armor. Heard failed special-forces factory clearance. Radiation and mutants not main issue. Offer soldiers, only vodka treatment now. Stash lead, decent supposedly. Don't expect too much. Well?
All right, I agree.
I've sent the lead to your PDA. Somewhere in the Gut.
Freedom man's tip sent me through military attics. Unusual specimens. Useless armor, but makes you a dump truck: carry 200 kg.
What do I do with it? Though... Have an idea. Stash lead and good artifact for the suit. Rumor says decent stalker loot. Well?
All right, I agree.
I've sent the lead to your PDA. Somewhere at Yantar.
Found a photograph in X-18. Rumors on the network said you were looking for something like it. Were you?
Let me see. That's my friend! I can offer a decent tier-two artifact and a stronger flashlight in exchange for yours. Well?
Agreed.
Thank you, Marked One. Make good use of it.
Bet you've never seen this. A perpetual fan from a nasty laboratory. Interested?
Let me look. Interesting thing, but it's hardly summer... I'll offer a capsule for it. Deal?
Why not? Go ahead.
Thanks. Here's a gift for you. We'll meet again.
Found something very good. Hope you'll offer something really valuable this time... \nA protective psi-helmet.
Rare indeed. Won't ask where from. Unique artifact lets you cover long distances much faster. Interested?
First I've heard of anything like that. I'm willing to try it on myself.
Thank you once again.
Interested in a Black Mark artifact?
Life-draining Black Mark? Bad artifact... Plenty of idiots enjoy thrills. Someone might buy, but delivery... Nobody carries that nastiness outside the Zone free...
So we're talking business now? What do you mean, "for nothing"?
A rich customer keeps pestering me for Mother's Beads. Useful artifact, few stalkers will part. You're desperate, though...\nBring Mother's Beads, I'll take your Black Mark.
Beads? Hmm... Where am I going to get those? Is there another way?
If you really need it... Any artifact from the Dummy family. Plus an artifact for the courier, no lower than tier two...
I've got an artifact from the Dummy family. Take it along with the Black Mark!
So that's what a Black Mark looks like! All right, a deal's a deal... What did you bring?
Here, just what you wanted: Mother's Beads. Are we all set?
Here's a Dummy and a good artifact! Everything we agreed on. Right?
No, I've changed my mind... Hate to give up good artifacts.
Right... There... Ugh, bastard! Hits hard! Need to find Kostyan quickly... See you, Marked One...
See you...
A favor? What blockage?
A way underground at the nearby factory. Entrance blocked, not badly. Five men could clear it in half a day. Help? Asking you as an old hand here...
I'll deal with them.
There's nobody there. I've already... Checked. It's quiet.
Then deal with it, if you're so tough. Come back on business afterward...
What was that shooting? Never mind, not my business... Don't even know what would tempt people into a job like that...
Klon-d-i-i-ike... What if not? Time, effort, maybe no loot! Bring four good artifacts, Gravi quality. Might interest the boys. Agree this: talk once you've collected them.
You boasted you'd cleared all the approaches? The factory's crawling with bandits again...
Uh...
Hmm... Not enough? All right, I'll go find more.
Don't know. Never been. Ask around. Plenty of former Clear Sky men. Someone might show the route. If they searched for Strelok, something should remain at the base. God help you...
What can you offer a stalker?
Hey, Marked One!
You're in luck. I've got just what's needed.
What would you prefer, money or goods? Take your pick.
Money's no use to me. I'll take goods.
I'll take the money. That stuff doesn't look much use.
Hello. There'll be artifact orders coming up soon.
If I find one, maybe I'll bring it...
All right, I'll be waiting...
Unfortunately, there's nothing at the moment.
Good. Keep an eye on the stalker network. I'll send a message if an order comes in.
Deal.
I'll have a look... Who did you say was hanging around?
So what? What's this gang of thieves doing under Duty's protection?!
Smartest? Fine. Yashka Gypsy, veteran loner. Find him, tell me. If him and riches true, probably Canaries now... Free guards meanwhile.

Stop shouting, catch bullet! Nervous men... Failed to watch, admit. Investigate if possible.\nIf case exists. Suspicious. Had anything there? Shut mouth, listen. Examine facts. Return in week if alive. Free guards meanwhile.
Yes, I'm smart... And you lot...
I'll catch a bullet? Well, we'll see...
What is this, a secret facility?
Secret or not, stop waving your gun. A respected man lives here. Does good for all stalkers...
Father Frost, is it?
I'm here to see Mikhalych. Got business with him...
If it's business, come in...
You could say that... Mikhalych! Knows a lot. Can do a lot. Who are you, anyway? Why are you here?
Name's Marked One. Maybe you've heard of me?
Marked One? No, haven't heard... I'm Vovan! Some call me Hammer. I strike twice. Second time on the coffin lid!
Heard that somewhere before... Also "Drop! Do push-ups!" Any relation?
Got the joke... Funny... Make another one like that and nobody will ever find you...
All right... We've had our laugh. Open up. I need to see your Father Frost.
Come in, Remarked One...
It's nighttime. Mikhalych's asleep... Come back in the morning. You can talk then...
I'm here about that green artifact.
Hmm. I gave you a good artifact for it. What else do you want?
Turns out that artifact's badly needed for something. Would you sell it to me?
Se-e-ell it...\nAh! All right. Agreed! A grand in dollars, and it's yours.
A grand. One thousand dollars. Cash, or a check for that amount.
Damn it! Where am I supposed to get dollars for you?
Your problem... See the Barkeep. He'll exchange rubles for proper money. Anyway, it's your problem.
Don't lose it! I'll be back soon.
Here's your dollars. A grand! By check.
Deal! Here's your "green" one. Wanted to sell it outside the Zone later, but if a good man needs it...
North? Into the reactor itself, or figuratively? Be more precise... "North" could mean anything...
Yes, I've got one. Here's a Dummy...
Hmm... I'll think about it...
Oh! Good. Watch closely. Remember it and write it down...
I said I'd show you! What's the matter with you? All right. Got a decent artifact?
I've got two excellent artifacts...
I've got five average artifacts...
Would a modified artifact interest you?
Could you tell me about this place?

Road into the Zone here. Avoid checkpoint soldiers: orders to shoot stalkers without warning. Ruined bridge farther north, another permanent checkpoint. Dog packs in the open. Dangerous for rookies. Other mutants sometimes too.
What about the soldiers at the bridge? I need to get past them.
Kuznetsov on duty loves vodka, might let you pass. No money or different guard? Bypass: left of bridge along railway embankment. Stay unseen! Little tunnel under embankment. Zombies sometimes.
Thanks. What's farther north, beyond the checkpoint?
The Garbage, that's what... Grim place. Radioactive trash makes some spots impossible to cross.
Why are you so scared?

Still shaken by recent incident. Toward Garbage at night, very drunk. Better sleep than hit anomaly or attract dogs. Abandoned house, quiet. Match inside, attic ladder. Hole in roof, moonlight. Sacks, rags, junk. Lay near hole to hear passersby. Rifle nearby, loaded backpack pillow. Slept, usually light. Awoke, moonlight, grunting or bubbling behind. Looked over shoulder: bloodsucker curled asleep right behind me. Sweat, afraid to move.
And then?

How sneaked near? Why no attack? Rifle nearby, but finding and chambering it takes time, throat gone. Could barely breathe. Backpack strap in hand, heavy pack under head: artifacts, food, ammo. Slipped strap over creature's head, hurled pack through roof hole, jumped aside. Yanked bloodsucker neck-first into hole. Woke screaming, flailed, stuck. Don't know more frightened one, ran till exhausted. Then realized I'd entered its den unseen.
Oh, I can't! Ha ha! You're something else... Spending the night in a bloodsucker's den!
You think it's funny. I'm worried about my backpack.
What makes you think that? Everything's fine...
I've found some scientific documents. Here. Will you take a look?
Is the case intact? What have we got?\n...\nSome nonsense. Scattered reports and orders. Biochemistry, perhaps?... No. I don't know. A pile of wastepaper we don't need. We haven't time for it. Sorry.
Well, maybe there's something important?
No. Once again, forgive me. Take your "briefcase of incriminating material" and stop distracting me with it.
Seems so. At least the lights on the instrument came on.
Excuse me?
Well... You said to take measurements at three points. Here...
Yes, yes... Exactly three points. Let's see what you measured.
Here's the measuring instrument. The readings are probably in its memory...
Uh... Probably in the instrument... Where did I put it...
We'll check the readings and try forecasting from them. Come back in an hour. We'll talk...
An hour? Hmm... All right...
Are the results ready? The timing for entering the area with the laboratory entrance.
We've processed your measurements. There's a strong chance that over the next day, perhaps two, the intensity of the psychotropic emissions will fall to an almost safe level approximately
We haven't processed the measurements yet, Marked One. Please wait!
What does "almost safe" mean?

We can't guarantee anything in the Zone. From earlier measurements, intensity falls about two hours before our calculated extremum, then rises again over about two hours. During that window, you can enter the laboratory and return relatively intact...
All right, understood. Two hours before and two hours after the stated time...
Don't mix it up!
Yes, yes, of course. I'll wait...
I'm ready to try getting underground, but...
But? Just one "but"? Desperate optimist! Attempting something not every suicidal man would choose... One "but"? What is it?
Quite a while since my measurements. Could things have changed? Measure again, maybe? Just to be safe.
Good thought. No guarantees, but lucky: new measurements yesterday, processing just done. Psychotropic intensity should fall to safe level approximately
All right. Plus or minus a couple of hours too?
Yes, yes. Intensity falls about two hours before the calculated extremum, then rises again. About two hours for that too.
Sick of you! Going nowhere! Why always me? Vasilyev vanished, snorks tore Fedotov apart, anomaly dissolved Kryukov... No money's worth dying like a dog!
I'll go myself. Just give me the instrument and show me where to measure.
Yourself? Is your head all right? Well... Here's the instrument. Put it on the ground here, here, and here. Don't touch it until this light turns green and it beeps. Clear?
How's your head? Gave you the instrument already, didn't I? Haven't got another... Measure here, here, and here. See?
What instrument? No freebies here... Ask Sakharov...
Sakharov told me himself. Said to go to Docent, to Semyonov, and get his instrument for measuring psi...
Should've said so... Here's the instrument. Take it. Saves me lugging it around...
Didn't I give it to you already? Haven't got another.
I need a measuring instrument...
Uh... What for?
I didn't take the measurements at Agroprom. For Fang's helmet.
Oh, yes! Remember you wanted to do something like that. Remember how to use it? Here, take it...
We have no more instruments. I'm very sorry...
I remember. Thanks... Could you mark the measurement locations again, though?
Yes, yes. Apparently you erased everything. Look: here, here, and here. Please don't lose it again.
Hello, Professor. I'm Marked One. I've got a message for you from Kruglov.
Hello, M... Marked One. What happened? We only just saw him off...
The helicopter carrying Kruglov and his group was shot down. He sent you this note.
How unpleasant... Months of work lost! Such a shame about our colleagues... I'll call a rescue helicopter to collect Kruglov and his group. Here's a little gift for your help.
Thank you. Think it'll be useful... Tell me, Professor, what's this Monolith Kruglov mentioned?

I'm not sure I should, but you've helped us so much... We believe it's a unique artifact in the center of the Zone, capable of altering spacetime. Only a theory, though. Nobody has studied it directly.
A continuum, then... How do you know, if nobody's studied it?

We're not wasting our time, young man. We have measurements, direct and indirect data, statistics, aerial photographs, and information from reliable sources. That's what we base our theories on.\nYou're like Professor Vasilyev: believes nothing until he sees and touches it himself. Even contacted stalkers to test his theory. I told him it was dangerous and wouldn't end well.
What did Vasilyev say about the Monolith, if it's no secret?
Not secrecy. Theory unscientific! Suggested Monolith living, inducing unknown waves. Nonsense. Proved impossible in physical world. Stubborn, wanted test. Where now?
Voronin asked me to put zombified stalkers resembling your faction's men to rest. Said you'd help identify them. \nHow's that going?
I've got a group of zombified stalkers in mind. Give me your PDA. I'll mark their location.
All right, I'm heading out.
Unfortunately, haven't come across anyone specific yet. Keep checking in, though...
Deal.
Think the job's done. Your men are at peace now.
Good deed! Nothing to offer. Brought no spare supplies. Return to Voronin and report success.
All right. See you again.
I've installed the device you gave me. Getting any data?
Stable signal. Data lets us tune artifact. Need it, have artifact, welcome.\nResearching received data for farther destinations.
How long will the research take?
Can't say precisely. Come back sometime later. That's all for now. Thank you.
So... I lugged 20 kilos on my back for a thank-you? Professor, that's not quite...
Oh, yes! You're expecting some reward for your work.
I'd like one, yes.
What can I give you... You were interested in recipes, weren't you? Write this one down.
Better than nothing... Though I think I wrote that one down already. Or maybe I'm mistaken...
It's what we have. Nothing else for now.
Hmm... Strange. No signal. Sure you installed the instrument? In the right place? Please check again whether it's working...
Uh... I'll look when I get the chance.
