We're receiving data, but I think there's an error! The spatial continuum's phase amplitude remains independent of the distance gradient! Only the temporal constant changes. Impossible!\nWe'll try deriving a general equation for the teleportation field. It will need careful checking and rechecking...
I see. How long will this "double-checking" take?

I can't say. We'll need time to identify general trends. I think this could revolutionize our understanding of the universe's very foundation: time. If it all proves true, I'll mention you in my report!
I'm thrilled... Instead of mentioning me in a report sometime later, could you give me something substantial now?
You're rather mercenary... Will you take medical supplies and a decent recipe? What we can spare, as they say...
Nothing special, but it'll help.
Sorry to disappoint, but you need to check the installation coordinates. No signal. Please check again whether it's working...
For crying out loud. We'll see...
Finished studying the data from the instrument at the Warehouses?

Fluctuations in the disturbance gradient are within the acceptable error margin. The correlation suggests more distant areas are accessible, conditionally...\nIf you're willing to continue, let's try farther away, practically at the perimeter. We'd like to see how the continuum-folding fluctuations change with distance from the epicenter of anomalous activity. You've been to the Cordon? Install the instrument at the highest point. Our survey shows that's the railway bridge. The upper structure should do. Will you?
All right. Give me your contraption.
Here you are. Come back after you've installed it. We'll see whether we have enough data.
Can't right now. A little later.
Sorry, Professor. Don't want to haul that weight to the Cordon. Find someone else.
Yes, you're right. Why am I burdening you? We'll speak to other candidates...
They say some people can somehow direct where a teleport sends them?

A teleport? You mean that unstudied fold in spacetime? We've received reports of the Compass artifact influencing it. The relative positions of its components indicate the next continuum-network node. But we need disturbance data from the destination. We've built the necessary equipment into a vacuum-tube transmitter. Now it must be delivered to what we could call the receiving area...
Where do I need to take it? And how heavy is this thing of yours?

Let's start with a nearby quantum-network node: sector 72, what stalkers call the Army Warehouses...\nInstall the device, less than 20 kilos, on high ground near the sector's center. The village water tower. What's the village called? No data. I think you'll manage?
I'll try. Twenty kilos? Hmm. Right...
Hope you're able to do it. I think our future dealings could benefit us both. In any case, good luck!
Sorry, Professor. I can't yet...
Sorry, assignments like that don't interest me.
Ahem. All right... We'll have to consider other options.
Haven't we discussed this already? Oh, yes... You'll need to install a device weighing about 20 kg on the water tower in the central Army Warehouses. \nCan you manage it?
Hello, Professor! I'd like to use your teleportation services.
Hello. We can do it now. \nI hope you remember anomalous formation series 896? \nI believe you stalkers call it Compass.
There it is... Looks like a toy.
Wouldn't mind getting to the Army Warehouses...
I don't have one. Thought you did.
Computing needs hardware capacity diverted, expensive. Better justify expense. Teleportation prices follow. These artifacts can be recorded as research necessities.
I don't have one. Thought you did.
The Cordon. The edge of the Zone.

According to our data, we've put the artifact's main variables into the correct positions. That may produce the desired result. Personally, I wouldn't risk such untested methods to reach my destination.
I've taken bigger risks before.

Yes, we know. That's what makes it surprising. Here, take it...\nThe nearest node's anomaly hasn't moved, according to the latest data. Still on the island behind our bunker. You can use it. Remember to activate the tuned artifact!
Thanks. Take care...
Closer to the center of the Zone. Pripyat...
You say there's a route to Agroprom?
Yes. As far as I know, conscripts often run away from there. Perhaps they could tell us more about the reconnaissance operations...
All right, I know of a soldier.
No. I'll keep trying to reach the center...
Come by when you have time...
Good afternoon, Academician... I've brought the documents.
Let's see exactly what you've brought...
Here's the case. Take a look.
Sorry, I've hidden it somewhere safe for now.
What we sought... Yes. Interesting! Route markers to Agroprom too. Note them... Rest...\nAnother request for a responsible, experienced man...
Take it... Heh heh... Careful. Gives electric shocks sometimes... Strong ones...
I know. Had a couple of shocks myself. Brain nearly leaked out... Write down the recipe: to obtain anomalously transformed matter...
Listen, keep it short... Enough showing off...
All right, short version. Throw an electrochimera kidney, Mother's Beads, a controller's hand, and a bloodsucker tentacle into a Snowball.
Where is it? Lost it...
Written down! See you.
Hello, hmm... Don't think we've met before? Though I'm not good with faces. What did you say your name was?
Hello. I'm Marked One. Unfortunately, that's all I can tell you about myself.
Marked One... No, don't remember. What brings you here? Artifacts to sell? Or something else?
Hello, hmm... Marked One? Did you want something? Information for us, perhaps? Artifacts?
Hello, hmm... Don't think we've met before? Though I'm not good with faces. What did you say your name was?
Hello. I'm Marked One. All I know about myself. Looking for a lab. Barkeep says somewhere at Yantar. X-16, I think. Says you may know where.

Marked One? Don't remember. Interested in X-16, especially mind-affecting emitter. Powerful. Enter without calculations, tragedy even if avoiding zombie hordes: become one. Serious. Need complex disturbance readings at several widely separated points. Help, perhaps predict psychotropic gradient.
Could you make it simpler? Just tell me how I can help.

Sorry, I've been talking too much... Take measurements at the points we've indicated and bring me the results. We can calculate when you can enter the factory grounds, theoretically without the risk of becoming zombified.
Is the laboratory entrance on that factory's grounds?
Entrance in the main building, almost certain! Only very lucky people get inside. Luck? Only their shells return. Minds left somewhere there...
That's clearer... I'll take the measurements and get into the building.
No... I'd rather not take that on yet.
Excellent! Get the measuring instrument from my colleague Semyonov, along with the coordinates, and head out.
A shame. A real shame... Don't know when we'll be able to send our own expedition to take measurements.
All right.
About getting into the laboratory.
No new data. Unstable psi-field. Predicting a safe drop in intensity without readings is like playing Russian roulette.
I've thought it over. Think I can take the job.
You're probably right. It really is too dangerous.
Is that you? Did you manage to get accurate measurements?
Not yet. I'll try...
Well, I put the instrument down where I was supposed to.
Do try, my dear fellow. It's in your interests...
Were you able to take the measurements?
Uh... Marked One? How can I help you?
Hello, hmm... Don't think we've met before? Though I'm not good with faces. What did you say your name was?
Marked One! Responsible man. Kruglov told me how you helped. Sorry, little funding. Investors demand an account of every dollar. Still, accept this credit on our "virtual account"...
A "virtual account"? Um... What's that?

Provisional "transferable rubles." Credit each material you bring. Record carefully, Zurich sponsoring bank converts to hard currency. Account details when you leave. International conventions, no cheating.\nNo cash here. Avoid misunderstanding or attempts to extract payment by force...
Hmm... Thank you. But let's get back to X-16...

Interested in X-16's mind-affecting emitter. Powerful. Enter without calculations, tragedy even avoiding zombie hordes: become one. Need complex disturbance readings at widely separated points. Help, perhaps predict psychotropic gradient.
Marked One... My colleague Kruglov told me he'd met you...
Yes. Wanted to help, but it didn't work out. What about X-16?
Could you make it simpler? Just tell me how I can help.

Sorry, I've been talking too much... Take measurements at the points we've indicated and bring me the results. We can calculate when you can enter the factory grounds, theoretically without the risk of becoming zombified.
Is the laboratory entrance on that factory's grounds?
Entrance in the main building, almost certain! Only very lucky people get inside. Luck? Only their shells return. Minds left somewhere there...
That's clearer... I'll take the measurements and get into the building.
No... I'd rather not take that on yet.
Excellent! Get the measuring instrument from my colleague Semyonov, along with the coordinates, and head out.
A shame. A real shame... Don't know when we'll be able to send our own expedition to take measurements.
All right.
Hello, hmm... Don't think we've met before? Though I'm not good with faces. What did you say your name was?
Hello. I'm Marked One. Unfortunately, that's all I can tell you about myself. But I do have something to ask you...
Marked One! Responsible man. Kruglov told me how you helped. Sorry, little funding. Investors demand an account of every dollar. Still, accept this...
Hmm... Thank you.
Yes, yes... Was there something you wanted, Marked One?
Marked One... My colleague Kruglov told me he'd met you...
Yes. Wanted to help, but it didn't work out.
M-Marked One, is that you? Want something?
M-Marked One, is that you?
How do I get into X-16? Where exactly is the entrance?
Can't tell you. Somewhere on the factory grounds. Vasilyev dealt with the laboratory, not me.
Who's Vasilyev? I should probably talk to him.

I'm afraid not. Professor Vasilyev led a small group into the laboratory. A few hours later, we were badly shaken, and the emissions briefly stopped. Another hour later, we received a weak, broken signal from him. Only a few words came through. I distinctly remember 'Swamps.' Something like 'I'm in the Swamps.' Then the signal vanished. Apparently they all died.
Why do you think everyone died?
Nobody came back. No signals, either.
And you didn't look for anyone?

How long have you been at Yantar? Don't answer. Rhetorical question. You've barely arrived, and already you're lecturing... We searched the entire factory area. No traces. We never learned the entrance from him. Once he found the way, he left so quickly... Try finding his body if you think we didn't search properly. You may even find information on shutting down the emissions.
No offense, Professor... Didn't mean anything bad. What do we do now?

I don't know myself... Start by finding Vasilyev's body. That's our only chance of learning the laboratory's location. It's not just about the laboratory, though! We need to find him and everyone else: Matveyev and the two stalker guides. Ghost seemed to know much more about X-16 than he admitted. If he somehow survived... Though it's foolish to hope.
Ghost?

Didn't say Ghost went with Vasilyev? Met in Swamps. Why there with work here? Distinguished professor, but hierarchy! I'm leader, should listen, obey. "Free in research," instead. Where now? Sorry, upset by disappearance.
Wait. He met Ghost in the Swamps? Know Ghost was there for a while. Could those be the swamps in Vasilyev's transmission?

We could speculate forever: which swamps, which part of the Zone? We first thought of Yantar's swamp and searched there. Anywhere else is a needle in a haystack. Find out where Vasilyev went. It might give us a lead. Ask Semyonov. He spoke to Ghost.
All right, I'll try.
Well, my dear fellow? Found anyone from Vasilyev's group?
Unfortunately not. I'll try...
Apparently nothing remains, or never did. Who knows? Signals in the anomalous Zone behave anomalously sometimes. Hardly surprising.
Dead end? No hope? Why didn't he tell you where he went, the entrance? Why secretive? Don't discuss work? Same cause, apparently...
Same cause, different work. Disagree with Vasilyev's Zone ideas. Don't ask why, no time for debate. Idle talk wastes time. Didn't take stalker connections, lab attempt, other things seriously.
What do we do? Could you give me people to help? Search more carefully, use... What do you call it... Some method?

We're short of people already. I see no point taking anyone from important work to look for we don't know what. Where would we search? The whole Zone? Unrealistic. Try asking in the Swamps, and talk to Docent Semyonov. He may have leads.
Right... Turns out it's not so simple. The Swamps are big. Where do I even look... I'll try, of course.
Please do try.
Uh... Marked One?
Yes. It's me...
Did you want something? I thought we'd settled everything?
Yes, Marked One?

Marked One, I'm glad you returned alive and, more importantly, sane. We know the route now. We'll try studying that underground facility more closely. Our tight funding won't let us reward you properly, but information is the most valuable thing in this mad modern world! We'll 'leak' you a recipe for a mesomodif... A modified artifact with new properties. I'm a poor storyteller. Read it at leisure. I hope you'll be pleased.
Well, thank you, of course...
No, no, don't thank me... Brave people like you let us piece together this enormous puzzle called the Zone...
Hello, M... Marked One! Good to see you. What brings you? Strange artifacts, unusual anomalies, other observations?
Well... Not this time...
You're always welcome here. Need anything?
Excellent work! If the readings are correct, in about an hour we'll be able to tell you how the emissions will behave over the next day.
Could you be more specific?

You can reach the laboratory now, but unless you switch off the emitter, you won't last long even during a relative 'lull.' We've calculated its approximate location underground. I've marked your map.
How do I get into X-16? Where exactly is the entrance?

Vasilyev and Ghost entered about a week ago. Hours later shaking, emissions briefly stopped. Another hour, swamp signal, gone. Probably dead. Had exact lab location/access. Find body, perhaps shutdown info. All known coordinates sent.
Hmm... It would certainly be interesting to see those documents. You think Vasilyev has them, then?
Start with Vasilyev's body for exact lab location. Ghost's too, somewhere. Knew more about X-16 than admitted. Miraculously alive? Foolish hope...
All right, I'll try.
Marked One, we haven't seen much of you. You used to come by almost daily. Now you disappear for weeks...
Business... How could I spend a day or two at Radar, but two weeks pass? Remember only those days.
Hmm. Lost consciousness? Blacked out?
Don't know. Don't remember blacking out. Slept, of course. Maybe was a zombie the whole time, wandering, moaning, then something switched me back on? Possible?
Can't say without observing. Far-fetched explanation. More likely coma or lethargic sleep. Doubt zombified. Restoring consciousness would mean cure possible. Sadly no evidence of that.
Maybe I'm the first evidence... Should talk to Ivar about it. What does science say about moving through time? Into the future, for example.
No fantasies. Scientist, facts and exact testimony. Gone slightly over two weeks, only fact. Don't know where or what. You report two days. Unreliable testimony, no offense.
How are you, Marked One? Blackouts, shifts in time? Or are you here on business?
Hello, Marked One! How are you?
Oh, Mother... Oh... Mmm...
Alive? Get up, then... Slowly. It's over now. All over.
Hello, Marked One. How are you?
Done! Plenty of readings. Time to head back!
Hello, Marked One! How are you?
You're asking a lot straightaway. Didn't I help already? You ought to repay me, not ask me to do more work for you.
I understand, but I've got nothing right now... I'll find something to thank you with. I promise.
Like you'll find something for Baldy? All right... Don't fuss. We'll settle up later.
Thanks. What about the rifle, then? Will you look for it?
Gave me a bit of trouble...
Told you: depends on my luck. If I find it, I'll bring it. You could make an effort yourself...
How did it go?
Still interested in the mutant part?
Just asking...
I've come across copies of scientific documents. Would you take a look?
Copies of documents? Where from? Let's see...
I was told one of the scientists lost them...
Lost it? Strange. Data suggests a separate group of independent naturalists working for the UN. Research close to Grigorovich's interests. Ask him. Here's your storage device.
Ivan Sergeyevich? Hmm. A trip to the Swamps...
No, I'm not handing it over. Take photographs and tell me where the pumps are.
I'll give it, then. Not radioactive, but presses on the brain. Suspect the artifact inside. Better give it. Ammo helps too. Take it. Tell me where the pumps are.
Good man. Yes, something in this thing does press on the brain. Never mind. I'll hide it somewhere for now...
Tell me where the pumps are.
Pump location unknown. Switched on from a lab if powered from place described. Entrance from Tesla, code probably, unknown. Another lab access mentioned, no identity. Any idea?
From Tesla, you say... Hmm. Have a rough idea. Is that all?
All of it. You know where it is, then? Share the information.
No, Zub. You've made enough off me already. See you. Hope I won't need you again.
You see, Zub... I'm not giving you this thing.
Take it. I've had it up to here with lugging that weight!
Why? Want to sell it yourself?
No. Need to find something out. Test whether I really can pick up a Monolith weapon. Whether I'm able to.
What's it to you?
Can't orient myself from a vague PDA clue. You've heard and seen plenty. Many information sources. Help? Not free...
Right place. Many requests. Walk same ground daily, can't navigate...\nCosts the stash PDA itself, plus small payment. Can change payment anytime. Deal?
Deal! Probably couldn't manage it myself.
Stash might've been looted long before you. Still owe for my time. Give the handheld. Should be somewhere here:
I understand... Buying a pig in a poke. Here's the money.
I'll keep that in mind. Pay later.
Pay what you owe for the last service first. Then we'll talk.
That's why I'm here. Brought the payment I promised.
A pleasure doing business with an honest stalker.
Take care.
Wait a little longer...
Quick on your feet, Marked One... Helped last time. Looked away a moment and you vanished. Not how business works. Do the decent thing. Pay what you promised.
Sorry, forgot... Here.
Next time I'll think before dealing with you. Remember: if I were easy to cheat, I wouldn't be standing here.
I wasn't trying to...
Don't understand what you're talking about...
I hear you. I think you understand what an act like that could eventually lead to...
All right, understood.
Unfortunately, I don't have that PDA anymore. Do you need anything else?
Bring an average artifact, and we'll try again.
No problem. Here.
Maybe another time.
Don't know what to call your carelessness. You've brought useless junk. Waste of time.
Damn it, where did I put them...
I'd like to buy recipes...

Several unique recipes. Payment: artifact in good condition with positive properties, or check, depending recipe. Ordinary or unique interests you? Unique: Yantar scientists researching, might share...
Hmm. Short on artifacts. Can't deal with that yet...
Simple tier-one recipes.
What tier-two recipes can you offer?
Tier three. Just what I need.
I'm interested in Dummies.
Talk

Stas told him, did he? This isn't a free canteen. All right, our poor patient. Eat before you starve. Didn't invest in you for nothing. First and last time, mind. This is the Zone. Everything has a price, literally and figuratively. Look through the barter offers while you eat. You'll need them later. When you're done, go find that artifact.
Thanks for that much. All right, I'll see what these artifacts are.
Only one way to the center: north through the Garbage. I'll mark your PDA. Here, to the Garbage, and back from it. Follow the road. You won't get lost.
That's clear. What else would you suggest?
All right, deal...
Listen, Sidorovich! All sorts of creatures running around out there! And I haven't got a decent weapon!
Damn, lost the artifact somewhere. Wait a little longer...
All right, then. Can't go on with a "Black Hole" where my memory should be...
I can sort out my own problems.

Here's the thing, Marked One. A courier called Nimble was bringing me information... Vanished right nearby. Sent a message saying he was already at the Cordon. Sold it to someone else, or sitting drinking vodka? Find Nimble, alive or dead. What matters is the flash drive. Bring it to me. He was one of Wolf's men. Ask around. Someone might know something...
Your call. What goes around comes around, as they say...
Uh...
"Ruby Compass"

An exceptionally rare ruby artifact with a crystalline structure. Nonradioactive, shining as if pointing nowhere. On the belt, creates a teleport anomaly, then loses strength for a long time. Scientists debate whether this is a property or a warning.
Listen, my PDA's running low. Almost no charge left. Can you charge it?
Simple enough. Need power, though. Bring any tier-one artifact: Jellyfish, Wrenched, Droplet. It'll go into the charger.
Here's the artifact.
Done. Fully charged. Last a couple of days. Then come back.
Nothing now. Bring it later.
Vergas, my PDA's nearly dead. Can you charge it?
Simple enough, but I need power. Bring any tier-one artifact: Jellyfish, Wrenched, Droplet. Leave the PDA too. I'll charge it. Come back in an hour. It won't be ready earlier.
Here's the artifact. Keep the PDA for now too.
Good. Go take care of your business meanwhile.
Nothing suitable now. I'll bring it later.
Well, is my PDA ready?
Not yet. Needs an hour, I told you. Come back later.
Here. Fully charged, good as new. Don't drain it completely next time. Batteries don't like that.
Docent, my PDA's flat. You're the science man here. Bring it back to life?

For science, yes. Your PDA's battery isn't chemical. You can't feed it from an outlet: it uses anomalous energy. Bring any tier-one artifact, even a Jellyfish. Leave the device with me. Half an hour, good as new. No hovering over my shoulder, either.
Here's the artifact. Here's the PDA. Science is in your hands.
Excellent. Walk around the Bar. Come back later.
Nothing on me. No artifact.
Docent, how's my PDA?
Cycle's still running. Science takes patience, my friend. Come back later.
Take it. Full capacity. Not a scratch, either. Unlike workshops that take a soldering iron to it like a surgeon.
Semyonov, my PDA's discharged. Could I use your equipment?

Of course. We have electricity, but your PDA battery won't charge from the mains. It needs anomalous energy. Bring any tier-one artifact. The converter will transfer its charge to the battery. You'll have to leave the device. About a quarter-hour's work.
Here's the artifact. I'll leave the device.
Accepted. Return in fifteen minutes.
No artifact right now.
Semyonov, is the device ready?
Not yet. Process isn't complete. Come back a little later.
Ready. Full capacity. Here. Try not to drain it completely in the field. Shortens the battery's life.
Professor, my oxygen tank's nearly empty. Could you fill it?
Fill it? Yes, simple enough. I need artifacts for experiments, though. Bring me a capsule, and I'll fill your tank.
Here you are.
A capsule, excellent. Leave the tank here. Our compressor's old and slow. The air needs drying and filtering too. Come back in about two hours.
All right. I'll look for a capsule.
Professor, is the tank ready?
Not yet. The full cycle takes two hours. Run the compressor faster and the air carries moisture and oil. Interrupt it, and you'll have half the pressure. Come back when the time's up.
Ready. Full tank. Here. It'll last about two hours underground, no more. Take care of it.
Doctor, know where I can exchange artifacts?
Stalkers sometimes thank me with unusual artifacts. Mostly ordinary ones, though. Can help exchange them... Need containers and backpacks to store them...
Good. You'll get backpacks and containers.
What did you need... Shall we trade?
Let's trade...
Marked One, we agreed last time. Forgotten?
Sorry, been running around. Here...
Don't understand what you're talking about.
Try to remember. I'll wait here. If you don't want to, that's your call...
Can't manage it yet. Come back in a few days.
All right, wait for me...
Marked One, come see me. Got something for you!
Message from the Barkeep
Marked One, I have information about your question. \nBring a tier-three artifact as payment for the work.
Message from Sakharov
Marked One, come to the Swamps. Got some work.
Message from Vronsky
Don't forget to turn off the water! \nHow's our business? If you've got something, come over.
Recipient unknown
Screwup, come over. Got something about our business.
Message from Zub
Demyan, hello! Found Oksana's husband in the Dark Valley. Could you escort her to the Cordon?
Marked One
Ah... Hate to part with such a beauty, but as you wish. We'll deliver her safe and sound.
Message from Demyan
Saw a stalker with a Ksyukha chambered in 7.62. Anyone know where to get that "marvel"?
Don't know where... \nHeard the Junk Dealer's been looking for one like it for ages. Apparently that Kalashnikov belongs to his friend Strelok.
Strange. Don't feel any changes now...
Vronsky, come in... \nAll mutants found and killed. Sending the carcass coordinates. Don't delay. The Zone will take them quickly.
Excellent work, Marked One!\nWe've just received information on the next research specimens.
This time we'll need their parts. My people will be busy cutting up the previous batch.
Think I've dealt with them all... \nMust remember to cut off the parts the scientist wanted. Then I can return.
Chimera
Snork
Pseudodog
Boys! An order's come in for the following artifact type:\\n
Message from Raven
Clear Out the Mutant Den
Marked One, thank you for helping study the Zone's fauna. Unfortunately, the teleport has ceased to exist... \\nI'll wait in the bar at our base.
Message from Gluzov
Marked One, heard about the Army Warehouses. Come see me at the Bar. We need to talk.
Marked One! Alive, you devil... Saw us? Warehouses ours! Lukash done running. Bar called us suicidal, penal troops, deserters... Some penal troops!
You made short work of them. Said you wouldn't shortchange me on the reward.

Promised, won't shortchange you. Personally, here. Found in battle. Need it more. Main reward: Voronin at the Bar. Radioed how you killed Freedom men. Let general pay. Freedom base handed him on a plate.
Voronin thinks you're deserters.
Thought we were, brother. Let him try turning up his nose now. Winners aren't judged. Go on. He's waiting.
No time for you now, Marked One! Base isn't cleared. Still rats in the corners. Talk later.
Too late. Someone hit Freedom's base before us. More than half dead. Nobody to assault. Boys won't squabble over corpses. Won't take you either. Discussion over.
Suit yourself.
Told you, nothing to discuss. Go your own way, Marked One.
Ah, you've appeared... Where were you when my boys faced the machine guns? Didn't see you fighting.
I was with you, wasn't I...
With us, he says... Didn't kill one Freedom man, wants a reward. Owed nothing. Don't ask Voronin. Reported exactly that. Go.
General, about the Army Warehouses.

Cherepanov radioed, overflowing joy. Would gladly court-martial disobedient men. Broke orders, lost lives. But Freedom base ours. Winners aren't judged. Praised you: killed Freedom men alongside his boys.
Know. Pity Cherepanov... Headstrong, stubborn, died for it. Good soldier, though. Men did the job. Freedom base ours. Told you weren't hiding behind others there.
Warehouses? Duty took the base. Paid in blood. You watched, I hear. Killed no Freedom men. No rewards for that. Go.
Understood... Take care, General.
Skull promised I'd be paid at the Bar.
Promised, we'll pay. Duty keeps its word, even penal troops' word. Here. Artifact not every scientist has. Saved for a special occasion. This is it.
Then we'll pay. Here's a fine artifact. It'll be useful. Consider it from Cherepanov too.
Thank you, General.

More. Use our storage? Different terms for our own: exactly ten thousand for two days. Won't increase, however often you use it. My word. Visit Colonel Petrenko. Knows the situation. Has something too.
I'll certainly stop by.
For you, as agreed: exactly ten thousand for two days. One-time access at the usual price. Got the money?
Two days. Here's ten thousand.
Marked One! Come in... General told everything. Warehouses, Lukash. Didn't expect it. Nobody took Cherepanov's penal troops seriously. Look how it turned out.
The general said you had something for me.

Yes. First, special terms for you: anything you barter from me will cost less by a factor of one and a half. Second, our EKS13-1 exoskeletons. Not issued to just anyone, but I'll give you one. Bring four artifact capsules for a set. Not for money. Only that.
Understood, Colonel. Thank you.
Colonel, about the exoskeleton. Brought the capsules.
Let's see... Four. All in order. Here's the EKS13-1. Straight from storage, untouched. Wear it well. Hope it serves you in battle.
Four capsules, Marked One. Come back when you've got them. The exoskeleton isn't going anywhere.
Halt! Who goes there?.. Ah, Marked One. Duty holds the base now. Our rules: no ammo toll from our own, no taking their guns. Go through. Behave yourself.
That's more like it. Take care.

No, no, no... Don't go blabbing. Find out about the courier casually, as if in passing. He was headed for the Warehouses, and that's our base now - Cherepanov's men drove Freedom out of there. But I won't be asking my own people: if the courier was going to one of ours, we'd scare him off. \nLook around there, ask the locals whether a fellow came by with a peculiar little briefcase. A white case, that sort of thing...\nWell, will you do it?
All right, I'll go ask around the Warehouses. I'm heading that way anyway. What if I don't find anything out?

Then you don't. But do your best. I can't give this assignment to any of my own people yet. One last thing. The base at the Warehouses is held by our men now, Cherepanov's lot. Not a word to them about this. Do what I've asked, the rest doesn't matter.
